lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我昨天在書店排隊排了四個小時，才拿到那位演員的簽名。
lines.simplified: 我昨天在书店排队排了四个小时，才拿到那位演员的签名。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān zài shūdiàn páiduì pái le sì ge xiǎoshí, cái ná dào nà wèi míngxīng de qiānmíng.
lines.english: Yesterday I queued at the bookshop for four hours before I got that actor's autograph.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 四個小時？妳腦子裡在想什麼啊？那些時間能做多少事！
lines.simplified: 四个小时？你脑子里在想什么啊？那些时间能做多少事！
lines.pinyin: Sì ge xiǎoshí? Nǐ nǎozi lǐ zài xiǎng shénme a? Nàxiē shíjiān néng zuò duōshǎo shì!
lines.english: Four hours? What were you thinking? Think how much you could have done in that time!

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 別這麼說，你不是戲迷，當然不懂。能聽到他跟我說加油，我心裡多麼開心啊！
lines.simplified: 别这么说，你不是戏迷，当然不懂。能听到他跟我说加油，我心里多么开心啊！
lines.pinyin: Bié zhème shuō, nǐ bú shì xìmí, dāngrán bù dǒng. Néng tīngdào tā gēn wǒ shuō jiāyóu, wǒ xīn lǐ duóme kāixīn a!
lines.english: Don't say that. You're not a fan, so of course you don't get it. Hearing him tell me to keep going made me so happy!

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 女的是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the woman mean?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 不應該花那麼多時間排隊
choices.simplified: 不应该花那么多时间排队
choices.pinyin: Bù yīnggāi huā nàme duō shíjiān páiduì.
choices.english: She should not have spent so long queuing.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nán de yě yīnggāi qù páiduì.
choices.english: The man should queue too.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Pái le hěn jiǔ yě hěn gāoxìng.
choices.english: She is glad even though she queued so long.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yǎnyuán duì xìmí bú tài hǎo.
choices.english: The actor is not nice to fans.

questions.why: 我心裡多麼開心啊 after four hours in the queue: she is happy it was worth it. Wasting the time is the man's view, she never asks him to queue (he is 不是戲迷), and the actor was kind to her (跟我說加油).

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我有一個朋友以前是律師，去年不做了，跑到山上開了一家小咖啡店。
lines.simplified: 我有一个朋友以前是律师，去年不做了，跑到山上开了一家小咖啡店。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yí ge péngyǒu yǐqián shì lǜshī, qùnián bú zuò le, pǎo dào shān shàng kāi le yì jiā xiǎo kāfēi diàn.
lines.english: A friend of mine used to be a lawyer. Last year he quit and went off to open a little café in the mountains.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 不當律師了？那多可惜啊！他念了那麼多年的法律。
lines.simplified: 不当律师了？那多可惜啊！他念了那么多年的法律。
lines.pinyin: Bù dāng lǜshī le? Nà duó kěxí a! Tā niàn le nàme duō nián de fǎlǜ.
lines.english: He gave up law? What a pity! He studied law for so many years.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 他可不這麼想。他說以前天天加班，現在每天看著山煮咖啡，多麼輕鬆啊！
lines.simplified: 他可不这么想。他说以前天天加班，现在每天看着山煮咖啡，多么轻松啊！
lines.pinyin: Tā kě bú zhème xiǎng. Tā shuō yǐqián tiāntiān jiābān, xiànzài měi tiān kàn zhe shān zhǔ kāfēi, duóme qīngsōng a!
lines.english: He doesn't see it that way at all. He says he used to work overtime every day, and now he makes coffee looking at the mountains. How relaxing!

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 那位朋友覺得現在的生活怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 那位朋友觉得现在的生活怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Nà wèi péngyǒu juéde xiànzài de shēnghuó zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What does the friend think of his life now?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bǐ yǐqián shūfu duō le.
choices.english: It is much more comfortable than before.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bái niàn le nàme duō nián fǎlǜ.
choices.english: He studied law all those years for nothing.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Měi tiān dōu děi máng zhe jiābān.
choices.english: He has to work overtime every day.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Hěn xiǎng huíqù dāng lǜshī.
choices.english: He wants to go back to being a lawyer.

questions.why: The friend says 多麼輕鬆啊 about his new life, and 可不這麼想 rejects the woman's 多可惜啊. Wasted years of law is her view, overtime was his old life, and he does not want law back.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這張畫是我女兒畫的。她說這是她夢到的地方，天上有魚，海裡有鳥。
lines.simplified: 这张画是我女儿画的。她说这是她梦到的地方，天上有鱼，海里有鸟。
lines.pinyin: Zhè zhāng huà shì wǒ nǚ'ér huà de. Tā shuō zhè shì tā mèngdào de dìfāng, tiān shàng yǒu yú, hǎi lǐ yǒu niǎo.
lines.english: My daughter drew this picture. She says it is a place she dreamed of: fish in the sky, birds in the sea.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 她才六歲就畫得出這樣的畫，多有想像力啊！以後可以讓她去學設計。
lines.simplified: 她才六岁就画得出这样的画，多有想像力啊！以后可以让她去学设计。
lines.pinyin: Tā cái liù suì jiù huà de chū zhèyàng de huà, duō yǒu xiǎngxiànglì a! Yǐhòu kěyǐ ràng tā qù xué shèjì.
lines.english: She is only six and she can draw a picture like this. What an imagination! Later you could let her study design.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我也這麼想，可是她說長大要當醫生。
lines.simplified: 我也这么想，可是她说长大要当医生。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yě zhème xiǎng, kěshì tā shuō zhǎngdà yào dāng yīshēng.
lines.english: I think so too, but she says she wants to be a doctor when she grows up.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 女的是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the woman mean?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Huà de gēn zhēn de dìfāng yíyàng.
choices.english: It looks just like a real place.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yú gēn niǎo huà de bú tài xiàng.
choices.english: The fish and birds do not look right.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Huà de dìfāng tài qíguài le.
choices.english: The place in it is too strange.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 孩子畫得出來很不簡單
choices.simplified: 孩子画得出来很不简单
choices.pinyin: Háizi huà de chūlái hěn bù jiǎndān.
choices.english: It is impressive that a child could draw it.

questions.why: 她才六歲就畫得出這樣的畫，多有想像力啊: she admires a six-year-old for drawing it. The place is one the girl dreamed, not a real one; she never criticises the fish or birds; fish in the sky is what she calls imagination, not something strange.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 聽說你在那部新戲裡只演一個服務生，只有兩句話要說？
lines.simplified: 听说你在那部新戏里只演一个服务生，只有两句话要说？
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō nǐ zài nà bù xīn xì lǐ zhǐ yǎn yí ge fúwùshēng, zhǐyǒu liǎng jù huà yào shuō?
lines.english: I hear you only play a waiter in that new play, with just two lines to say?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 對啊。導演說我長得不錯，可是實力還不夠，得先從小角色開始。
lines.simplified: 对啊。导演说我长得不错，可是实力还不够，得先从小角色开始。
lines.pinyin: Duì a. Dǎoyǎn shuō wǒ zhǎng de búcuò, kěshì shílì hái bú gòu, děi xiān cóng xiǎo jiǎosè kāishǐ.
lines.english: That's right. The director says I'm good-looking but I'm not good enough yet, so I have to start with small roles.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你不覺得可惜嗎？
lines.simplified: 你不觉得可惜吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ bù juéde kěxí ma?
lines.english: Don't you think it's a pity?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 不會。就算只有兩句話，我也要讓觀眾記住這個服務生。
lines.simplified: 不会。就算只有两句话，我也要让观众记住这个服务生。
lines.pinyin: Bú huì. Jiùsuàn zhǐyǒu liǎng jù huà, wǒ yě yào ràng guānzhòng jìzhù zhège fúwùshēng.
lines.english: No. Even with only two lines, I want the audience to remember this waiter.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 男的是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the man mean?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Liǎng jù huà tài shǎo, hěn kěxí.
choices.english: Two lines is too few; it is a pity.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Huì rènzhēn yǎn hǎo xiǎo jiǎosè.
choices.english: He will play the small role seriously.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiǎng qǐng dǎoyǎn huàn ge jiǎosè.
choices.english: He wants the director to give him another role.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā de shílì yǐjīng gòu le.
choices.english: He is already good enough.

questions.why: 就算只有兩句話，我也要讓觀眾記住: the small part does not change his plan to do it well. Calling it a pity is the woman's idea, he never asks for another role, and the director said his 實力 is 還不夠.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你最近每天都留在公司錄音，錄到半夜才回家，不累嗎？
lines.simplified: 你最近每天都留在公司录音，录到半夜才回家，不累吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zuìjìn měi tiān dōu liú zài gōngsī lùyīn, lù dào bànyè cái huí jiā, bú lèi ma?
lines.english: Lately you stay at the office recording every day and only get home at midnight. Aren't you tired?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 累啊。可是這個節目下星期一就要開始了。
lines.simplified: 累啊。可是这个节目下星期一就要开始了。
lines.pinyin: Lèi a. Kěshì zhège jiémù xià xīngqíyī jiù yào kāishǐ le.
lines.english: Of course. But this programme starts next Monday.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那也不用每天錄到這麼晚吧？
lines.simplified: 那也不用每天录到这么晚吧？
lines.pinyin: Nà yě bú yòng měi tiān lù dào zhème wǎn ba?
lines.english: Still, you don't need to record this late every day, do you?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 就算一天只能休息四個小時，我也得在星期天以前錄完。
lines.simplified: 就算一天只能休息四个小时，我也得在星期天以前录完。
lines.pinyin: Jiùsuàn yì tiān zhǐ néng xiūxí sì ge xiǎoshí, wǒ yě děi zài xīngqítiān yǐqián lù wán.
lines.english: Even if I can only rest four hours a day, I have to finish recording before Sunday.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的打算怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 男的打算怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de dǎsuàn zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What does the man plan to do?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xià xīngqíyī zài kāishǐ lù.
choices.english: Start recording next Monday.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Měi tiān zǎo yìdiǎn huí jiā xiūxí.
choices.english: Go home earlier every day to rest.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qǐng biérén bāng tā lù yí bùfèn.
choices.english: Ask someone else to record part of it.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Shǎo xiūxí yě yào zhǔnshí lù hǎo.
choices.english: Finish on time, even with less rest.

questions.why: 就算一天只能休息四個小時，我也得在星期天以前錄完: he keeps going until it is done. Monday is when the programme starts, going home earlier is only her hint (不用每天錄到這麼晚吧), and he never wants to delay the programme or hand part of the work to someone else.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這個表演課程一個月要一萬塊，你付得起嗎？
lines.simplified: 这个表演课程一个月要一万块，你付得起吗？
lines.pinyin: Zhège biǎoyǎn kèchéng yí ge yuè yào yí wàn kuài, nǐ fù de qǐ ma?
lines.english: This acting course costs ten thousand dollars a month. Can you afford it?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我已經想好了。就算每個週末都得去打工，我也要去上。這是我從小的夢想。
lines.simplified: 我已经想好了。就算每个周末都得去打工，我也要去上。这是我从小的梦想。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng xiǎng hǎo le. Jiùsuàn měi ge zhōumò dōu děi qù dǎgōng, wǒ yě yào qù shàng. Zhè shì wǒ cóngxiǎo de mèngxiǎng.
lines.english: I've thought it through. Even if I have to work part-time every weekend, I'm going to take it. It's been my dream since I was little.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那你也別太累了。
lines.simplified: 那你也别太累了。
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐ yě bié tài lèi le.
lines.english: Then don't wear yourself out.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 男的是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the man mean?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Kèchéng tài guì, tā bú shàng le.
choices.english: The course is too expensive, so he will not take it.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Wèile shàngkè yuànyì duō gōngzuò.
choices.english: He will work more so he can take the course.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zhōumò méiyǒu shíjiān shàngkè.
choices.english: He has no time for classes at the weekend.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiǎng qǐng jiārén bāng tā fù qián.
choices.english: He wants his family to pay for him.

questions.why: 就算每個週末都得去打工，我也要去上: he will take a weekend job to pay for it. He does not give up because of the price, the weekends are for the job, not a reason to skip class, and he never mentions his family.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 晚上十點那個說故事的節目，下個月就不做了，你知道嗎？
lines.simplified: 晚上十点那个说故事的节目，下个月就不做了，你知道吗？
lines.pinyin: Wǎnshàng shí diǎn nàge shuō gùshì de jiémù, xià ge yuè jiù bú zuò le, nǐ zhīdào ma?
lines.english: Did you know the ten o'clock storytelling programme is ending next month?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 真的嗎？我從高中就開始聽，一聽就是十五年，可以說是它的老聽眾了。
lines.simplified: 真的吗？我从高中就开始听，一听就是十五年，可以说是它的老听众了。
lines.pinyin: Zhēn de ma? Wǒ cóng gāozhōng jiù kāishǐ tīng, yì tīng jiù shì shíwǔ nián, kěyǐ shuō shì tā de lǎo tīngzhòng le.
lines.english: Really? I started listening in high school and it's been fifteen years. You could say I'm one of its longtime listeners.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 聽說做這個節目的老先生以前是律師，要退休了，想多留點時間給家人。這麼好的節目越來越少了。
lines.simplified: 听说做这个节目的老先生以前是律师，要退休了，想多留点时间给家人。这么好的节目越来越少了。
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō zuò zhège jiémù de lǎo xiānshēng yǐqián shì lǜshī, yào tuìxiū le, xiǎng duō liú diǎn shíjiān gěi jiārén. Zhème hǎo de jiémù yuè lái yuè shǎo le.
lines.english: I hear the old man who makes the programme used to be a lawyer and is retiring and wants more time for his family. Programmes this good are getting rare.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 就是說嘛！最後一天我一定要聽。
lines.simplified: 就是说嘛！最后一天我一定要听。
lines.pinyin: Jiùshìshuō ma! Zuìhòu yì tiān wǒ yídìng yào tīng.
lines.english: Exactly! I am definitely listening on the last day.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 男的是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the man mean?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他聽這個節目很多年了
choices.simplified: 他听这个节目很多年了
choices.pinyin: Tā tīng zhège jiémù hěn duō nián le.
choices.english: He has listened to the programme for many years.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā shì jiémù lǐ zuì lǎo de rén.
choices.english: He is the oldest person on the programme.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他十五歲才開始聽節目
choices.simplified: 他十五岁才开始听节目
choices.pinyin: Tā shíwǔ suì cái kāishǐ tīng jiémù.
choices.english: He only started listening at fifteen.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā xiǎng duō liú shíjiān gěi jiārén.
choices.english: He wants more time for his family.

questions.why: 可以說是它的老聽眾 sums up 一聽就是十五年: he means he has listened for a very long time. 老 is about how long he has listened, not his age on the show; fifteen is the number of years, not his age; more time for family is the host's reason.

focus.en: you could say (sums up what came before)

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這部電影講的是八零年代的臺北，裡面的車子、衣服，都跟我小時候看到的一樣。
lines.simplified: 这部电影讲的是八零年代的台北，里面的车子、衣服，都跟我小时候看到的一样。
lines.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng jiǎng de shì bālíng niándài de Táiběi, lǐmiàn de chēzi, yīfú, dōu gēn wǒ xiǎoshíhòu kàndào de yíyàng.
lines.english: This film is about Taipei in the eighties. The cars and clothes in it are just like what I saw as a child.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 聽說導演為了拍這部電影，花了三年找資料。現在肯這樣做的導演不多了。
lines.simplified: 听说导演为了拍这部电影，花了三年找资料。现在肯这样做的导演不多了。
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō dǎoyǎn wèile pāi zhè bù diànyǐng, huā le sān nián zhǎo zīliào. Xiànzài kěn zhèyàng zuò de dǎoyǎn bù duō le.
lines.english: I hear the director spent three years researching for it. Not many directors are willing to do that now.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 就是說嘛！這部可說是他拍得最好的電影了。
lines.simplified: 就是说嘛！这部可说是他拍得最好的电影了。
lines.pinyin: Jiùshìshuō ma! Zhè bù kě shuō shì tā pāi de zuì hǎo de diànyǐng le.
lines.english: Exactly! You could call this the best film he's made.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的覺得這部電影怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 男的觉得这部电影怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de juéde zhè bù diànyǐng zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What does the man think of the film?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Jiǎng de shì tā xiǎoshíhòu de shì.
choices.english: It is about his own childhood.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Dǎoyǎn huā de shíjiān tài cháng le.
choices.english: The director took too long.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bǐ dǎoyǎn yǐqián pāi de dōu hǎo.
choices.english: It is better than the director's earlier films.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 裡面的衣服不像以前的
choices.simplified: 里面的衣服不像以前的
choices.pinyin: Lǐmiàn de yīfú bú xiàng yǐqián de.
choices.english: The clothes in it do not look like the old ones.

questions.why: 可說是他拍得最好的電影: of all the director's films, this is the best. The film is about Taipei in the eighties, not the man's own story; he praises the three years rather than complaining; the clothes are just like the ones he remembers.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳奶奶七十歲了，還在學電腦啊？
lines.simplified: 你奶奶七十岁了，还在学电脑啊？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ nǎinai qīshí suì le, hái zài xué diànnǎo a?
lines.english: Your grandmother is seventy and still learning computers?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 對啊，她不斷地學新東西，現在還會在網路上看戲，一看就是好幾個小時，可以說是我們家最大的戲迷。
lines.simplified: 对啊，她不断地学新东西，现在还会在网路上看戏，一看就是好几个小时，可以说是我们家最大的戏迷。
lines.pinyin: Duì a, tā búduàn de xué xīn dōngxi, xiànzài hái huì zài wǎnglù shàng kàn xì, yí kàn jiù shì hǎo jǐ ge xiǎoshí, kěyǐ shuō shì wǒmen jiā zuì dà de xìmí.
lines.english: Yes, she keeps learning new things, and now she even watches dramas online, for hours at a time. You could say she is the biggest fan in our family.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 真不簡單！
lines.simplified: 真不简单！
lines.pinyin: Zhēn bù jiǎndān!
lines.english: That's impressive!

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 女的是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the woman mean?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nǎinai diànnǎo yòng de zuì hǎo.
choices.english: Grandma uses the computer best.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 家裡最愛看戲的是奶奶
choices.simplified: 家里最爱看戏的是奶奶
choices.pinyin: Jiā lǐ zuì ài kàn xì de shì nǎinai.
choices.english: Grandma is the one at home who loves dramas most.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Jiā lǐ měi ge rén dōu ài kàn xì.
choices.english: Everyone in the family loves dramas.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 奶奶每天學好幾個小時
choices.simplified: 奶奶每天学好几个小时
choices.pinyin: Nǎinai měi tiān xué hǎo jǐ ge xiǎoshí.
choices.english: Grandma studies for hours every day.

questions.why: 可以說是我們家最大的戲迷 sums up 一看就是好幾個小時: no one at home watches as much as she does. She is learning computers, not the best at them; the line does not say everyone else is a fan; the hours are spent watching dramas, not studying.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 今天的錄音怎麼到現在才結束？
lines.simplified: 今天的录音怎么到现在才结束？
lines.pinyin: Jīntiān de lùyīn zěnme dào xiànzài cái jiéshù?
lines.english: Why has today's recording only finished now?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 要不是那位演員一直把總統的名字念錯，兩點就錄完了。
lines.simplified: 要不是那位演员一直把总统的名字念错，两点就录完了。
lines.pinyin: Yàobúshì nà wèi yǎnyuán yìzhí bǎ zǒngtǒng de míngzi niàn cuò, liǎng diǎn jiù lù wán le.
lines.english: If that actor hadn't kept reading the president's name wrong, we'd have finished at two.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 他念錯了幾次？
lines.simplified: 他念错了几次？
lines.pinyin: Tā niàn cuò le jǐ cì?
lines.english: How many times did he get it wrong?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 十幾次吧，最後導演只好請別人來念。
lines.simplified: 十几次吧，最后导演只好请别人来念。
lines.pinyin: Shí jǐ cì ba, zuìhòu dǎoyǎn zhǐhǎo qǐng biérén lái niàn.
lines.english: Ten-something times. In the end the director had to get someone else to read it.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 今天的錄音為什麼錄了那麼久？
prompt.simplified: 今天的录音为什么录了那么久？
prompt.pinyin: Jīntiān de lùyīn wèishénme lù le nàme jiǔ?
prompt.english: Why did today's recording take so long?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Liǎng diǎn cái kāishǐ lù.
choices.english: Recording only started at two.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yǒu rén yìzhí niàn bú duì.
choices.english: Someone kept reading it wrong.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Dǎoyǎn zhǎo bú dào biérén niàn.
choices.english: The director could not find anyone else to read.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zǒngtǒng de míngzi gǎi le.
choices.english: The president's name changed.

questions.why: 要不是 + what really happened: the actor kept misreading the name, otherwise it would have ended at two. Two o'clock is when it would have ended, the director did find someone else, and the name never changed.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這個星期六晚上的戲，妳要不要一起去看？我有兩張票。
lines.simplified: 这个星期六晚上的戏，你要不要一起去看？我有两张票。
lines.pinyin: Zhège xīngqíliù wǎnshàng de xì, nǐ yào bú yào yìqǐ qù kàn? Wǒ yǒu liǎng zhāng piào.
lines.english: Do you want to come to the play this Saturday evening? I have two tickets.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好啊，我星期六沒事。不對，老闆說這個週末可能要加班。
lines.simplified: 好啊，我星期六没事。不对，老板说这个周末可能要加班。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo a, wǒ xīngqíliù méi shì. Bú duì, lǎobǎn shuō zhège zhōumò kěnéng yào jiābān.
lines.english: Sure, I am free on Saturday. No, wait: my boss said we might have to work this weekend.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那怎麼辦？我的票是星期六晚上七點的。
lines.simplified: 那怎么办？我的票是星期六晚上七点的。
lines.pinyin: Nà zěnme bàn? Wǒ de piào shì xīngqíliù wǎnshàng qī diǎn de.
lines.english: So what now? My tickets are for seven on Saturday evening.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那得看老闆那天要不要我加班。我明天問問他，星期五以前告訴你。
lines.simplified: 那得看老板那天要不要我加班。我明天问问他，星期五以前告诉你。
lines.pinyin: Nà děi kàn lǎobǎn nà tiān yào bú yào wǒ jiābān. Wǒ míngtiān wènwen tā, xīngqíwǔ yǐqián gàosù nǐ.
lines.english: Then it depends on whether my boss needs me that day. I will ask him tomorrow and tell you by Friday.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的會去看戲嗎？
prompt.simplified: 女的会去看戏吗？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de huì qù kàn xì ma?
prompt.english: Will the woman go to the play?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xīngqíliù méi shì, tā huì qù.
choices.english: She is free on Saturday, so she will go.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bú qù, tā zhōumò děi jiābān.
choices.english: No, she has to work at the weekend.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xīngqíwǔ wǎnshàng cái néng qù.
choices.english: She can only go on Friday evening.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yào wèn guo lǎobǎn cái zhīdào.
choices.english: She will only know after asking her boss.

questions.why: 得看 + what decides it: she first says yes, then remembers the weekend overtime, so it depends on her boss. 星期六沒事 is her first answer, which she takes back; the overtime is only 可能; Friday is when she will tell him.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這個劇本有一百多頁，導演要我們明天早上以前就念完。
lines.simplified: 这个剧本有一百多页，导演要我们明天早上以前就念完。
lines.pinyin: Zhège jùběn yǒu yìbǎi duō yè, dǎoyǎn yào wǒmen míngtiān zǎoshàng yǐqián jiù niàn wán.
lines.english: This script is over a hundred pages, and the director wants us to have read it by tomorrow morning.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 一個晚上念一百頁？誰念得了啊！我先念我演的那幾頁就好。
lines.simplified: 一个晚上念一百页？谁念得了啊！我先念我演的那几页就好。
lines.pinyin: Yí ge wǎnshàng niàn yìbǎi yè? Shéi niàn de liǎo a! Wǒ xiān niàn wǒ yǎn de nà jǐ yè jiù hǎo.
lines.english: A hundred pages in one evening? Who could manage that! I will just read the pages I am in first.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 也對，那其他的我們明天再一起看。
lines.simplified: 也对，那其他的我们明天再一起看。
lines.pinyin: Yě duì, nà qítā de wǒmen míngtiān zài yìqǐ kàn.
lines.english: Fair enough. Then let's look at the rest together tomorrow.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的打算怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 男的打算怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de dǎsuàn zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What does the man plan to do?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Jīntiān wǎnshàng quánbù niàn wán.
choices.english: Read all of it tonight.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qǐng dǎoyǎn duō gěi yì tiān.
choices.english: Ask the director for another day.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiān kàn zìjǐ yǎn de dìfāng.
choices.english: First read the parts he plays.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Míngtiān cái kāishǐ niàn jùběn.
choices.english: Only start the script tomorrow.

questions.why: 誰念得了啊 means nobody can manage a hundred pages in one night, so he reads only his own pages first. Reading it all is what the director asked, he never asks for more time, and he does start tonight.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 聽說你要離開石油公司了？那裡給的錢那麼多，你是不是一時沒想清楚就決定了？
lines.simplified: 听说你要离开石油公司了？那里给的钱那么多，你是不是一时没想清楚就决定了？
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō nǐ yào líkāi shíyóu gōngsī le? Nàlǐ gěi de qián nàme duō, nǐ shì bú shì yìshí méi xiǎng qīngchǔ jiù juédìng le?
lines.english: I hear you're leaving the oil company? They pay so well. Did you just decide on a whim?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 錢是不少，可是我不快樂。我從小就想演戲，連做夢都夢到自己在演戲。上個月，有一位導演請我演他的新戲。
lines.simplified: 钱是不少，可是我不快乐。我从小就想演戏，连做梦都梦到自己在演戏。上个月，有一位导演请我演他的新戏。
lines.pinyin: Qián shì bù shǎo, kěshì wǒ bú kuàilè. Wǒ cóngxiǎo jiù xiǎng yǎnxì, lián zuòmèng dōu mèngdào zìjǐ zài yǎnxì. Shàng ge yuè, yǒu yí wèi dǎoyǎn qǐng wǒ yǎn tā de xīn xì.
lines.english: The money's good, but I'm not happy. I've wanted to act since I was a kid; I even dream I'm acting. Last month a director asked me to be in his new film.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 演戲很辛苦，錢也不多，你吃得了這個苦嗎？
lines.simplified: 演戏很辛苦，钱也不多，你吃得了这个苦吗？
lines.pinyin: Yǎnxì hěn xīnkǔ, qián yě bù duō, nǐ chī de liǎo zhège kǔ ma?
lines.english: Acting is hard work and doesn't pay much. Can you take that kind of hardship?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我已經存錢存了一年，這樣子就算半年沒工作也沒關係。再說，我已經三十歲了，現在不試，以後就沒機會了。
lines.simplified: 我已经存钱存了一年，这样子就算半年没工作也没关系。再说，我已经三十岁了，现在不试，以后就没机会了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yǐjīng cún qián cún le yì nián, zhèyàngzi jiùsuàn bàn nián méi gōngzuò yě méi guānxi. Zàishuō, wǒ yǐjīng sānshí suì le, xiànzài bú shì, yǐhòu jiù méi jīhuì le.
lines.english: I've been saving for a year, so even half a year without work is fine. Besides, I'm already thirty; if I don't try now, I'll never get the chance.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的為什麼要離開石油公司？
prompt.simplified: 男的为什么要离开石油公司？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de wèishénme yào líkāi shíyóu gōngsī?
prompt.english: Why is the man leaving the oil company?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Gōngsī gěi de qián tài shǎo le.
choices.english: The company pays too little.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā yìshí méi xiǎng qīngchǔ.
choices.english: He did not think it through.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiǎng qù zuò zìjǐ ài zuò de shì.
choices.english: He wants to do what he loves.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiǎng duō cún yìdiǎn qián.
choices.english: He wants to save more money.

questions.why: He is not happy there and has wanted to act since childhood (從小就想演戲), and now a director has asked him. The pay is good (錢是不少), 一時沒想清楚 is only her worry, and he has already saved.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的覺得為什麼現在就得試？
prompt.simplified: 男的觉得为什么现在就得试？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de juéde wèishénme xiànzài jiù děi shì?
prompt.english: Why does the man think he has to try now?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Dǎoyǎn zhǐ děng tā yì nián.
choices.english: The director will only wait a year for him.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Niánjì dà le jiù láibùjí le.
choices.english: When he is older it will be too late.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Cún de qián gòu yòng yì nián.
choices.english: His savings will last a year.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yǎnxì de qián bǐ yǐqián duō.
choices.english: Acting pays more than before.

questions.why: 再說 adds his second reason: he is thirty, and later there will be no chance. The savings are the first reason (they cover half a year without work; nothing says how long they last), and nothing is said about the director waiting.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 聽說導演要拍妳寫的劇本了？妳真厲害！
lines.simplified: 听说导演要拍你写的剧本了？你真厉害！
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō dǎoyǎn yào pāi nǐ xiě de jùběn le? Nǐ zhēn lìhài!
lines.english: I hear a director is going to film your script? That's amazing!

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 別這麼說。故事講的是一位律師離婚以後，帶著女兒到鄉下生活。我還去鄉下住了一個月，這樣子才寫得出那裡的生活。
lines.simplified: 别这么说。故事讲的是一位律师离婚以后，带着女儿到乡下生活。我还去乡下住了一个月，这样子才写得出那里的生活。
lines.pinyin: Bié zhème shuō. Gùshì jiǎng de shì yí wèi lǜshī líhūn yǐhòu, dài zhe nǚ'ér dào xiāngxià shēnghuó. Wǒ hái qù xiāngxià zhù le yí ge yuè, zhèyàngzi cái xiě de chū nàlǐ de shēnghuó.
lines.english: Oh, it's nothing. The story is about a lawyer who moves to the countryside with his daughter after a divorce. I even lived in the countryside for a month; that was the only way I could write about life there.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那誰演那個律師？我弟弟怎麼樣？他當過模特兒，身高夠，長得也好看。
lines.simplified: 那谁演那个律师？我弟弟怎么样？他当过模特儿，身高够，长得也好看。
lines.pinyin: Nà shéi yǎn nàge lǜshī? Wǒ dìdi zěnmeyàng? Tā dāng guo mótèr, shēngāo gòu, zhǎng de yě hǎokàn.
lines.english: So who plays the lawyer? What about my brother? He used to model. He's tall enough and good-looking too.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 導演說那些都沒關係。他要找性格開朗的人，再說，年紀也得跟角色差不多。你弟弟太年輕了。
lines.simplified: 导演说那些都没关系。他要找性格开朗的人，再说，年纪也得跟角色差不多。你弟弟太年轻了。
lines.pinyin: Dǎoyǎn shuō nàxiē dōu méi guānxi. Tā yào zhǎo xìnggé kāilǎng de rén, zàishuō, niánjì yě děi gēn jiǎosè chàbùduō. Nǐ dìdi tài niánqīng le.
lines.english: The director says none of that matters. He wants someone with a cheerful personality, and besides, the age has to be close to the character's. Your brother is too young.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的為什麼去鄉下住了一個月？
prompt.simplified: 女的为什么去乡下住了一个月？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de wèishénme qù xiāngxià zhù le yí ge yuè?
prompt.english: Why did the woman live in the countryside for a month?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 想把鄉下生活寫得更像真的
choices.simplified: 想把乡下生活写得更像真的
choices.pinyin: Xiǎng bǎ xiāngxià shēnghuó xiě de gèng xiàng zhēn de.
choices.english: To make the country life in her story feel real.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Gēn nǚ'ér yìqǐ qù shēnghuó.
choices.english: To live there with her daughter.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qù nàlǐ zhǎo yǎnyuán.
choices.english: To find actors there.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qù kàn dǎoyǎn zěnme pāi xì.
choices.english: To watch the director filming.

questions.why: 這樣子才寫得出那裡的生活: living there was how she could write country life well. The daughter belongs to the lawyer in her story, the director is the one looking for actors, and filming has not started.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 導演要找哪種人演律師？
prompt.simplified: 导演要找哪种人演律师？
prompt.pinyin: Dǎoyǎn yào zhǎo nǎ zhǒng rén yǎn lǜshī?
prompt.english: What kind of person does the director want to play the lawyer?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Shēngāo gòu, zhǎng de hǎokàn.
choices.english: Tall enough and good-looking.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Niánqīng yòu yǒumíng de míngxīng.
choices.english: A young, famous star.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Dāng guo mótèr de rén.
choices.english: Someone who has been a model.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Gèxìng kāilǎng, niánjì gānghǎo.
choices.english: Cheerful, and just the right age.

questions.why: The director wants 性格開朗的人, and 再說 adds the second point: an age close to the character's. Height, looks and modelling are what the man offers, and the director says 那些都沒關係; young is the reason the brother is wrong.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段介紹，然後回答兩個問題。

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 各位聽眾大家好！歡迎來到「夢想成真」。今天我們請到的是做服裝設計的林小姐。
lines.simplified: 各位听众大家好！欢迎来到「梦想成真」。今天我们请到的是做服装设计的林小姐。
lines.pinyin: Gèwèi tīngzhòng dàjiā hǎo! Huānyíng lái dào “Mèngxiǎng Chéngzhēn”. Jīntiān wǒmen qǐng dào de shì zuò fúzhuāng shèjì de Lín xiǎojiě.
lines.english: Hello, listeners! Welcome to "Dreams Come True". Our guest today is the fashion designer Ms. Lin.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 性格開朗的林小姐，十八歲就當了模特兒，穿別人設計的衣服穿了十年。後來她發現，她更想自己設計。
lines.simplified: 性格开朗的林小姐，十八岁就当了模特儿，穿别人设计的衣服穿了十年。后来她发现，她更想自己设计。
lines.pinyin: Xìnggé kāilǎng de Lín xiǎojiě, shíbā suì jiù dāng le mótèr, chuān biérén shèjì de yīfú chuān le shí nián. Hòulái tā fāxiàn, tā gèng xiǎng zìjǐ shèjì.
lines.english: Cheerful Ms. Lin became a model at eighteen and wore clothes other people designed for ten years. Then she found she wanted to design them herself.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 二十八歲那年，她因為在一場比賽中得了第一名，而被很多人注意到。現在，不少明星都穿她做的衣服。
lines.simplified: 二十八岁那年，她因为在一场比赛中得了第一名，而被很多人注意到。现在，不少明星都穿她做的衣服。
lines.pinyin: Èrshíbā suì nà nián, tā yīnwèi zài yì chǎng bǐsài zhōng dé le dì yī míng, ér bèi hěn duō rén zhùyì dào. Xiànzài, bù shǎo míngxīng dōu chuān tā zuò de yīfú.
lines.english: At twenty-eight she won first place in a competition, and because of that many people noticed her. Now quite a few stars wear her clothes.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 等一下，林小姐會跟我們說明，她怎麼把一張圖變成一件衣服，又怎麼配顏色。節目最後，我們會送出五本有她簽名的書。
lines.simplified: 等一下，林小姐会跟我们说明，她怎么把一张图变成一件衣服，又怎么配颜色。节目最后，我们会送出五本有她签名的书。
lines.pinyin: Děng yíxià, Lín xiǎojiě huì gēn wǒmen shuōmíng, tā zěnme bǎ yì zhāng tú biànchéng yí jiàn yīfú, yòu zěnme pèi yánsè. Jiémù zuìhòu, wǒmen huì sòng chū wǔ běn yǒu tā qiānmíng de shū.
lines.english: In a moment Ms. Lin will explain how she turns a drawing into a garment and how she matches colours. At the end of the show we will give away five books with her autograph.

lines.pinyin: Gèwèi guānzhòng dàjiā hǎo, huānyíng lái kàn jīntiān de xì. Biǎoyǎn qī diǎn bàn kāishǐ, dàyuē liǎng ge xiǎoshí, zhōngjiān xiūxí shíwǔ fēnzhōng. Biǎoyǎn de shíhòu, qǐng búyào zhàoxiàng, yě búyào lùyīn.

lines.traditional: 今天演女兒的演員因為身體不舒服而不能來了，我們改請一位新的演員來演。她很有實力，也演過不少戲，可是這是她第一次演這個角色，請大家多幫她加油。
lines.simplified: 今天演女儿的演员因为身体不舒服而不能来了，我们改请一位新的演员来演。她很有实力，也演过不少戏，可是这是她第一次演这个角色，请大家多帮她加油。
lines.pinyin: Jīntiān yǎn nǚ'ér de yǎnyuán yīnwèi shēntǐ bù shūfu ér bù néng lái le, wǒmen gǎi qǐng yí wèi xīn de yǎnyuán lái yǎn. Tā hěn yǒu shílì, yě yǎn guo bù shǎo xì, kěshì zhè shì tā dì yī cì yǎn zhège jiǎosè, qǐng dàjiā duō bāng tā jiāyóu.
lines.english: The actress who plays the daughter is unwell and cannot come today, so a new actress will play the part. She is very capable and has been in quite a few plays, but this is her first time in this role, so please cheer her on.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 表演結束以後，導演跟演員會在門口幫大家簽名。謝謝！

passage.traditional: 我的室友小真從小就想當演員。大學畢業以後，她來到臺北{1}自己的夢想。她很快就{2}了臺北的生活，可是剛開始只能演小角色，常常一天要拍十幾個小時。我問她怕不怕吃苦，她說：「{3}要等很多年，我也要一直演下去。」三年來，她{4}練習，表演越來越好。去年，一位導演看了她的表演，請她演新電影裡的女兒。電影一出來，很多人都{5}她的表現。小真說，要不是以前那些辛苦的日子，她就沒有今天的{6}。
passage.simplified: 我的室友小真从小就想当演员。大学毕业以后，她来到台北{1}自己的梦想。她很快就{2}了台北的生活，可是刚开始只能演小角色，常常一天要拍十几个小时。我问她怕不怕吃苦，她说：「{3}要等很多年，我也要一直演下去。」三年来，她{4}练习，表演越来越好。去年，一位导演看了她的表演，请她演新电影里的女儿。电影一出来，很多人都{5}她的表现。小真说，要不是以前那些辛苦的日子，她就没有今天的{6}。
passage.pinyin: Wǒ de shìyǒu Xiǎozhēn cóngxiǎo jiù xiǎng dāng yǎnyuán. Dàxué bìyè yǐhòu, tā lái dào Táiběi zhuīqiú zìjǐ de mèngxiǎng. Tā hěn kuài jiù shìyìng le Táiběi de shēnghuó, kěshì gāng kāishǐ zhǐ néng yǎn xiǎo jiǎosè, chángcháng yì tiān yào pāi shí jǐ ge xiǎoshí. Wǒ wèn tā pà bú pà chīkǔ, tā shuō: “Jiùsuàn yào děng hěn duō nián, wǒ yě yào yìzhí yǎn xiàqù.” Sān nián lái, tā búduàn liànxí, biǎoyǎn yuè lái yuè hǎo. Qùnián, yí wèi dǎoyǎn kàn le tā de biǎoyǎn, qǐng tā yǎn xīn diànyǐng lǐ de nǚ'ér. Diànyǐng yì chūlái, hěn duō rén dōu kěndìng tā de biǎoxiàn. Xiǎozhēn shuō, yàobúshì yǐqián nàxiē xīnkǔ de rìzi, tā jiù méiyǒu jīntiān de shílì.
passage.english: My roommate Xiaozhen has wanted to be an actress since she was little. After university she came to Taipei to pursue her dream. She soon adapted to life in Taipei, but at first she could only play small roles, often filming for ten-plus hours a day. I asked whether she minded the hardship, and she said, "Even if I have to wait many years, I will keep on acting." For three years she has kept practising, and her acting gets better and better. Last year a director saw her perform and asked her to play the daughter in his new film. As soon as the film came out, many people praised her performance. Xiaozhen says that if it weren't for those hard days, she wouldn't have the ability she has today.

passage.traditional: 我弟弟從小就愛看電影，夢想是當導演。可是我們住在鄉下，能用的{1}很少，附近連電影院和圖書館都沒有。爸媽怕他將來吃苦，{2}，家裡也沒錢讓他去臺北學，所以希望他改變{3}。弟弟沒有不高興，還是每天用手機拍東西，再{4}上自己找的音樂，放到網路上。他也向爸媽{5}，一定先把書念好。{6}功課多忙，他都會拍一點。去年，他拍的影片在比賽中得了第一名，爸媽這才答應讓他去學電影。
passage.simplified: 我弟弟从小就爱看电影，梦想是当导演。可是我们住在乡下，能用的{1}很少，附近连电影院和图书馆都没有。爸妈怕他将来吃苦，{2}，家里也没钱让他去台北学，所以希望他改变{3}。弟弟没有不高兴，还是每天用手机拍东西，再{4}上自己找的音乐，放到网路上。他也向爸妈{5}，一定先把书念好。{6}功课多忙，他都会拍一点。去年，他拍的影片在比赛中得了第一名，爸妈这才答应让他去学电影。
passage.pinyin: Wǒ dìdi cóngxiǎo jiù ài kàn diànyǐng, mèngxiǎng shì dāng dǎoyǎn. Kěshì wǒmen zhù zài xiāngxià, néng yòng de zīyuán hěn shǎo, fùjìn lián diànyǐngyuàn hé túshūguǎn dōu méiyǒu. Bàmā pà tā jiānglái chīkǔ, zàishuō, jiā lǐ yě méi qián ràng tā qù Táiběi xué, suǒyǐ xīwàng tā gǎibiàn zhǔyì. Dìdi méiyǒu bù gāoxìng, háishì měi tiān yòng shǒujī pāi dōngxi, zài pèi shàng zìjǐ zhǎo de yīnyuè, fàng dào wǎnglù shàng. Tā yě xiàng bàmā bǎozhèng, yídìng xiān bǎ shū niàn hǎo. Bùguǎn gōngkè duō máng, tā dōu huì pāi yìdiǎn. Qùnián, tā pāi de yǐngpiàn zài bǐsài zhōng dé le dì yī míng, bàmā zhè cái dāying ràng tā qù xué diànyǐng.
passage.english: My younger brother has loved films since he was little, and his dream is to be a director. But we live in the countryside, where there are few resources to use; there is not even a cinema or a library nearby. Our parents were afraid he would have a hard life later; besides, the family had no money to send him to Taipei to study, so they hoped he would change his mind. My brother was not upset. He still filmed things on his phone every day, added music he had found, and put them online. He also promised our parents he would do his schoolwork first. No matter how busy he was with homework, he filmed a little. Last year a video of his won first prize in a competition, and only then did our parents agree to let him study film.

下星期六，我們要幫學校的網路節目錄一個二十分鐘的故事，說的是一位總統年輕時候的事。請大家注意：

text.traditional:
在我父母那個年代，想當歌星或演員的年輕人，得先找到一家願意幫他的公司，才有機會讓大家看到自己的表演。現在不一樣了，只要有一支手機，就能拍出自己的影片，放到網路上給大家看。所以，很多人覺得現在追求夢想比以前容易多了。
我不太同意這樣的想法。資源多了，挑戰也跟著變大了。網路上每天都有幾萬部新影片，觀眾看了這麼多，要求也越來越高。一個人就算有了機會，如果沒有實力，很快就會被大家忘了。我有一位朋友很會唱歌，她把自己唱歌的影片放到網路上，前三年都沒什麼人看。她不斷改變自己唱歌的方式，每天練習六個小時，最近才開始有人肯定她。
所以我認為，光有一支手機還不夠，能不能夢想成真，要看你肯不肯吃苦。
text.simplified:
在我父母那个年代，想当歌星或演员的年轻人，得先找到一家愿意帮他的公司，才有机会让大家看到自己的表演。现在不一样了，只要有一支手机，就能拍出自己的影片，放到网路上给大家看。所以，很多人觉得现在追求梦想比以前容易多了。
我不太同意这样的想法。资源多了，挑战也跟着变大了。网路上每天都有几万部新影片，观众看了这么多，要求也越来越高。一个人就算有了机会，如果没有实力，很快就会被大家忘了。我有一位朋友很会唱歌，她把自己唱歌的影片放到网路上，前三年都没什么人看。她不断改变自己唱歌的方式，每天练习六个小时，最近才开始有人肯定她。
所以我认为，光有一支手机还不够，能不能梦想成真，要看你肯不肯吃苦。
text.pinyin: Zài wǒ fùmǔ nàge niándài, xiǎng dāng gēxīng huò yǎnyuán de niánqīngrén, děi xiān zhǎodào yì jiā yuànyì bāng tā de gōngsī, cái yǒu jīhuì ràng dàjiā kàndào zìjǐ de biǎoyǎn. Xiànzài bù yíyàng le, zhǐyào yǒu yì zhī shǒujī, jiù néng pāi chū zìjǐ de yǐngpiàn, fàng dào wǎnglù shàng gěi dàjiā kàn. Suǒyǐ, hěn duō rén juéde xiànzài zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng bǐ yǐqián róngyì duō le. Wǒ bú tài tóngyì zhèyàng de xiǎngfǎ. Zīyuán duō le, tiǎozhàn yě gēn zhe biàn dà le. Wǎnglù shàng měi tiān dōu yǒu jǐ wàn bù xīn yǐngpiàn, guānzhòng kàn le zhème duō, yāoqiú yě yuè lái yuè gāo. Yí ge rén jiùsuàn yǒu le jīhuì, rúguǒ méiyǒu shílì, hěn kuài jiù huì bèi dàjiā wàng le. Wǒ yǒu yí wèi péngyǒu hěn huì chànggē, tā bǎ zìjǐ chànggē de yǐngpiàn fàng dào wǎnglù shàng, qián sān nián dōu méi shénme rén kàn. Tā búduàn gǎibiàn zìjǐ chànggē de fāngshì, měi tiān liànxí liù ge xiǎoshí, zuìjìn cái kāishǐ yǒu rén kěndìng tā. Suǒyǐ wǒ rènwéi, guāng yǒu yì zhī shǒujī hái bú gòu, néng bù néng mèngxiǎng chéngzhēn, yào kàn nǐ kěn bù kěn chīkǔ.
text.english:
In my parents' day, a young person who wanted to be a singer or an actor first had to find a company willing to help, and only then had a chance to show people their work. It is different now: with just a phone you can make your own videos and put them online for everyone to see. So many people think chasing a dream is much easier now than before.
I do not quite agree. There are more resources, but the challenges have grown with them. Tens of thousands of new videos go online every day, and having seen so many, viewers expect more and more. Even if someone gets a chance, without real ability they are soon forgotten. A friend of mine sings very well. She puts videos of her singing online, and for the first three years hardly anyone watched. She kept changing the way she sings and practised six hours a day, and only recently have people begun to praise her.
So I think a phone alone is not enough: whether a dream comes true depends on whether you are willing to work hard.

text.traditional:
我妹妹今年剛成年，是一位男明星的戲迷。他演的每一部戲，她都看了好幾遍；為了拿到他的簽名，她可以在外面排隊排一天，連做夢都會夢到他。爸媽一開始還能忍耐，後來常說她腦子裡只有那位明星，對自己的將來一點也不關心。
我的想法跟爸媽不太一樣。去年，那位明星在一部戲裡演一名律師，幫了很多沒錢的人。妹妹因為這部戲，而開始對法律感興趣。現在她寫了一份讀書計畫，每天拿出兩個小時念書，希望明年能考上大學的法律系。她說：「我知道我不可能每天見到他，可是我可以變成他演的那種人。」
其實，怎麼喜歡一個明星，也是一門學問。如果只是一時的興趣，很快就會過去；可是如果能讓自己變得更好，這樣的喜歡就很有意義了。
text.simplified:

我的想法跟爸妈不太一样。去年，那位明星在一部戏里演一名律师，帮了很多没钱的人。妹妹因为这部戏，而开始对法律感兴趣。现在她写了一份读书计划，每天拿出两个小时念书，希望明年能考上大学的法律系。她说：「我知道我不可能每天见到他，可是我可以变成他演的那种人。」
其实，怎么喜欢一个明星，也是一门学问。如果只是一时的兴趣，很快就会过去；可是如果能让自己变得更好，这样的喜欢就很有意义了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ mèimei jīnnián gāng chéngnián, shì yí wèi nán míngxīng de xìmí. Tā yǎn de měi yí bù xì, tā dōu kàn le hǎojǐ biàn; wèile ná dào tā de qiānmíng, tā kěyǐ zài wàimiàn páiduì pái yì tiān, lián zuòmèng dōu huì mèngdào tā. Bàmā yì kāishǐ hái néng rěnnài, hòulái cháng shuō tā nǎozi lǐ zhǐyǒu nà wèi míngxīng, duì zìjǐ de jiānglái yìdiǎn yě bù guānxīn. Wǒ de xiǎngfǎ gēn bàmā bú tài yíyàng. Qùnián, nà wèi míngxīng zài yí bù xì lǐ yǎn yì míng lǜshī, bāng le hěn duō méi qián de rén. Mèimei yīnwèi zhè bù xì, ér kāishǐ duì fǎlǜ gǎn xìngqù. Xiànzài tā xiě le yí fèn dúshū jìhuà, měi tiān ná chū liǎng ge xiǎoshí niànshū, xīwàng míngnián néng kǎo shàng dàxué de fǎlǜ xì. Tā shuō: “Wǒ zhīdào wǒ bù kěnéng měi tiān jiàndào tā, kěshì wǒ kěyǐ biànchéng tā yǎn de nà zhǒng rén.” Qíshí, zěnme xǐhuān yí ge míngxīng, yě shì yì mén xuéwèn. Rúguǒ zhǐ shì yìshí de xìngqù, hěn kuài jiù huì guòqù; kěshì rúguǒ néng ràng zìjǐ biàn de gèng hǎo, zhèyàng de xǐhuān jiù hěn yǒu yìyì le.
text.english:
My younger sister has just come of age this year, and she is a big fan of a male star. She has watched every drama he has been in several times; to get his autograph she will queue outside all day, and she even dreams about him. At first our parents put up with it, but later they kept saying she had nothing in her head but that star and did not care about her own future at all.
I see it a little differently. Last year the star played a lawyer in a drama who helped many people without money. Because of that drama, my sister became interested in law. Now she has written herself a study plan, sets aside two hours a day to study, and hopes to get into a university law department next year. She says, "I know I can't see him every day, but I can become the kind of person he played."
In fact, how to like a star is a skill of its own. If it is only a passing interest, it soon fades; but if it makes you a better person, that kind of liking means a lot.

text.traditional:
我從小就很害羞，很怕在很多人看著的時候說話。上大學以後，室友拉我參加了表演社團。第一次表演，我只演一個小角色，一共三句話。我在宿舍念了很多遍，覺得一定沒問題。誰知道表演一開始，看到下面坐滿了觀眾，我緊張得腦子裡什麼都想不起來，三句話一句也說不出來，差一點就哭了。還好旁邊的同學很快地幫我把那三句話說了，觀眾都沒看出來。
從那天起，我每天晚上都在宿舍裡練習，一遍一遍地念劇本，還請室友坐在對面當觀眾。現在，我已經能在禮堂演重要的角色了，心裡很滿足。我發現，只有不斷地練習，才能讓自己不怕在很多人看著的時候說話。
text.simplified:
我从小就很害羞，很怕在很多人看着的时候说话。上大学以后，室友拉我参加了表演社团。第一次表演，我只演一个小角色，一共三句话。我在宿舍念了很多遍，觉得一定没问题。谁知道表演一开始，看到下面坐满了观众，我紧张得脑子里什么都想不起来，三句话一句也说不出来，差一点就哭了。还好旁边的同学很快地帮我把那三句话说了，观众都没看出来。
从那天起，我每天晚上都在宿舍里练习，一遍一遍地念剧本，还请室友坐在对面当观众。现在，我已经能在礼堂演重要的角色了，心里很满足。我发现，只有不断地练习，才能让自己不怕在很多人看着的时候说话。
text.pinyin: Wǒ cóngxiǎo jiù hěn hàixiū, hěn pà zài hěn duō rén kàn zhe de shíhòu shuōhuà. Shàng dàxué yǐhòu, shìyǒu lā wǒ cānjiā le biǎoyǎn shètuán. Dì yī cì biǎoyǎn, wǒ zhǐ yǎn yí ge xiǎo jiǎosè, yígòng sān jù huà. Wǒ zài sùshè niàn le hěn duō biàn, juéde yídìng méi wèntí. Shéi zhīdào biǎoyǎn yì kāishǐ, kàndào xiàmiàn zuò mǎn le guānzhòng, wǒ jǐnzhāng de nǎozi lǐ shénme dōu xiǎng bù qǐlái, sān jù huà yí jù yě shuō bù chūlái, chà yìdiǎn jiù kū le. Háihǎo pángbiān de tóngxué hěn kuài de bāng wǒ bǎ nà sān jù huà shuō le, guānzhòng dōu méi kàn chūlái. Cóng nà tiān qǐ, wǒ měi tiān wǎnshàng dōu zài sùshè lǐ liànxí, yí biàn yí biàn de niàn jùběn, hái qǐng shìyǒu zuò zài duìmiàn dāng guānzhòng. Xiànzài, wǒ yǐjīng néng zài lǐtáng yǎn zhòngyào de jiǎosè le, xīn lǐ hěn mǎnzú. Wǒ fāxiàn, zhǐyǒu búduàn de liànxí, cái néng ràng zìjǐ bú pà zài hěn duō rén kàn zhe de shíhòu shuōhuà.
text.english:
I have been shy since I was little and was afraid of speaking while lots of people watched. At university my roommate dragged me into the drama club. In my first show I only had a small role, with three lines in all. I read them over many times in the dorm and thought it would be fine. Who knew that as soon as the show began and I saw the seats full of people, I would be so nervous that I could not remember a thing? I could not say a single one of the three lines and almost cried. Luckily the classmate next to me quickly said those three lines for me, and the audience did not notice.
From that day on I practised in the dorm every evening, reading the script over and over, and asked my roommate to sit across from me as the audience. Now I can play important roles in the auditorium, and I feel content. I have found that only by practising again and again can I stop being afraid of speaking while lots of people watch.

text.traditional:
我舅舅以前在一家石油公司當經理，每天都忙得很，常常加班到很晚。去年他退休了，大家都覺得他會在家好好休息。沒想到，第二個月他就開始學鋼琴了。
舅媽笑他：「你都六十五歲了，還學什麼鋼琴？不如去公園慢跑吧，對身體還比較有好處。」舅舅說：「對我來說，這是一個新的挑戰。我年輕的時候家裡窮，沒錢學，現在有時間了，我可不想再等了。」
他每天練習三個小時，進步得很快。上個月，他到附近的安養院表演給老人家聽，大家都拍手叫好。舅舅說，能追求年輕時候的夢想，還能讓別人開心，他已經很滿足了。現在，舅媽也不笑他了，還常常陪他一起去。
text.simplified:
我舅舅以前在一家石油公司当经理，每天都忙得很，常常加班到很晚。去年他退休了，大家都觉得他会在家好好休息。没想到，第二个月他就开始学钢琴了。
舅妈笑他：「你都六十五岁了，还学什么钢琴？不如去公园慢跑吧，对身体还比较有好处。」舅舅说：「对我来说，这是一个新的挑战。我年轻的时候家里穷，没钱学，现在有时间了，我可不想再等了。」
他每天练习三个小时，进步得很快。上个月，他到附近的安养院表演给老人家听，大家都拍手叫好。舅舅说，能追求年轻时候的梦想，还能让别人开心，他已经很满足了。现在，舅妈也不笑他了，还常常陪他一起去。
text.pinyin: Wǒ jiùjiu yǐqián zài yì jiā shíyóu gōngsī dāng jīnglǐ, měi tiān dōu máng de hěn, chángcháng jiābān dào hěn wǎn. Qùnián tā tuìxiū le, dàjiā dōu juéde tā huì zài jiā hǎohǎo xiūxí. Méi xiǎngdào, dì èr ge yuè tā jiù kāishǐ xué gāngqín le. Jiùmā xiào tā: “Nǐ dōu liùshíwǔ suì le, hái xué shénme gāngqín? Bùrú qù gōngyuán mànpǎo ba, duì shēntǐ hái bǐjiào yǒu hǎochù.” Jiùjiu shuō: “Duì wǒ lái shuō, zhè shì yí ge xīn de tiǎozhàn. Wǒ niánqīng de shíhòu jiā lǐ qióng, méi qián xué, xiànzài yǒu shíjiān le, wǒ kě bù xiǎng zài děng le.” Tā měi tiān liànxí sān ge xiǎoshí, jìnbù de hěn kuài. Shàng ge yuè, tā dào fùjìn de ānyǎngyuàn biǎoyǎn gěi lǎorénjiā tīng, dàjiā dōu pāishǒu jiàohǎo. Jiùjiu shuō, néng zhuīqiú niánqīng shíhòu de mèngxiǎng, hái néng ràng biérén kāixīn, tā yǐjīng hěn mǎnzú le. Xiànzài, jiùmā yě bú xiào tā le, hái chángcháng péi tā yìqǐ qù.
text.english:
My uncle used to be a manager at an oil company. He was extremely busy and often worked overtime until late. Last year he retired, and everyone thought he would have a good rest at home. Instead, in his second month he started learning the piano.
My aunt laughed at him: "You're sixty-five. Why learn the piano now? You'd do better jogging in the park; it's better for your health." My uncle said, "For me this is a new challenge. When I was young my family was poor and had no money for lessons. Now I have the time, and I really don't want to wait any longer."
He practises three hours a day and is improving fast. Last month he played for the old people at a nearby care home, and everyone clapped and cheered. My uncle says that pursuing the dream of his youth and making others happy as well is enough to make him content. Now my aunt doesn't laugh at him any more; she often goes along with him.

lines.english: Hi, could you heat this chicken-leg rice for me?

lines.traditional: 不好意思，機器壞了，今天沒辦法加熱，明天才會修好。前面那家店也能加熱，不過要走十分鐘。
lines.simplified: 不好意思，机器坏了，今天没办法加热，明天才会修好。前面那家店也能加热，不过要走十分钟。

lines.english: Sorry, the machine is broken, so we can't heat anything today; it won't be fixed until tomorrow. The shop up the street can heat it too, but it's a ten-minute walk.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 外面雨那麼大，我又沒帶傘。算了，雞腿飯不買了，我拿一碗泡麵，用這裡的熱水就好。
lines.simplified: 外面雨那么大，我又没带伞。算了，鸡腿饭不买了，我拿一碗泡面，用这里的热水就好。
lines.pinyin: Wàimiàn yǔ nàme dà, wǒ yòu méi dài sǎn. Suànle, jītuǐ fàn bù mǎi le, wǒ ná yì wǎn pàomiàn, yòng zhèlǐ de rèshuǐ jiù hǎo.

lines.english: Excuse me, I want to send something. Can I just give it to you?

lines.speaker: F

lines.simplified: 现在要先在那台机器上打好资料，再拿来给我。
lines.pinyin: Xiànzài yào xiān zài nà tái jīqì shàng dǎ hǎo zīliào, zài ná lái gěi wǒ.
lines.english: Now you first type the details into that machine, then bring it to me.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我剛才試了，它一會兒要電話號碼，一會兒要地址，試了半天還是弄不好。
lines.simplified: 我刚才试了，它一会儿要电话号码，一会儿要地址，试了半天还是弄不好。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ gāngcái shì le, tā yìhuǐr yào diànhuà hàomǎ, yìhuǐr yào dìzhǐ, shì le bàntiān háishì nòng bù hǎo.

lines.traditional: 我可以教你，不過你得先等一下，後面還有三位客人。
lines.simplified: 我可以教你，不过你得先等一下，后面还有三位客人。

lines.traditional: 這雙手套挺好看的，可是太厚了，戴著不能用手機。
lines.simplified: 这双手套挺好看的，可是太厚了，戴着不能用手机。
lines.pinyin: Zhè shuāng shǒutào tǐng hǎokàn de, kěshì tài hòu le, dàizhe bù néng yòng shǒujī.
lines.english: These gloves are quite nice, but they're too thick: I can't use my phone with them on.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 不那麼厚的上個星期就賣完了，要兩個星期以後才會有新的。
lines.simplified: 不那么厚的上个星期就卖完了，要两个星期以后才会有新的。
lines.pinyin: Bú nàme hòu de shàng ge xīngqí jiù mài wán le, yào liǎng ge xīngqí yǐhòu cái huì yǒu xīn de.
lines.english: The thin ones sold out last week, and we won't have new ones for two weeks.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 兩個星期？那時候早就不冷了。算了，就這雙吧，打電話的時候脫下來就好。
lines.simplified: 两个星期？那时候早就不冷了。算了，就这双吧，打电话的时候脱下来就好。
lines.pinyin: Liǎng ge xīngqí? Nà shíhòu zǎo jiù bù lěng le. Suànle, jiù zhè shuāng ba, dǎ diànhuà de shíhòu tuō xiàlái jiù hǎo.

lines.english: They've had that for ages. I pick up a bag every day after work and make soup at home; it's as fresh as the market's.

lines.traditional: 幫我買一把傘吧，我的昨天掉在公車上了。還有兩個饅頭，明天當早餐。不過那家店的饅頭下午常常就賣完了，沒有就不用去別家找了，我明天上班的時候自己買。

lines.pinyin: Bāng wǒ mǎi yì bǎ sǎn ba, wǒ de zuótiān diào zài gōngchē shàng le. Hái yǒu liǎng ge mántou, míngtiān dāng zǎocān. Búguò nà jiā diàn de mántou xiàwǔ chángcháng jiù mài wán le, méiyǒu jiù búyòng qù bié jiā zhǎo le, wǒ míngtiān shàngbān de shíhòu zìjǐ mǎi.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的最後打算怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 女的最后打算怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de zuìhòu dǎsuàn zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What does the woman finally plan to do?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qǐng nán de chī wán fàn qù mǎi.
choices.english: Have the man buy it after dinner.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Jīntiān wǎnshàng zìjǐ qù mǎi.
choices.english: Go and buy it herself tonight.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Míngtiān shàngkè qián zìjǐ mǎi.
choices.english: Buy it herself before class tomorrow.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Míngtiān zǎocān bù hē niúnǎi.
choices.english: Skip the milk at breakfast tomorrow.

questions.why: 順便 means no extra trip, but the store is far from his restaurant, so she withdraws the request and will buy it when she passes the store (經過) on the way to class: 到時候再買. Asking him after dinner was her first plan.

focus.en: while you are out (順便); then

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我要下樓去超商買咖啡，十分鐘就回來。
lines.simplified: 我要下楼去超商买咖啡，十分钟就回来。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yào xià lóu qù chāoshāng mǎi kāfēi, shí fēnzhōng jiù huílái.
lines.english: I'm going down to the convenience store for a coffee. Back in ten minutes.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那你順便把垃圾拿下去吧，垃圾桶都滿了。
lines.simplified: 那你顺便把垃圾拿下去吧，垃圾桶都满了。
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐ shùnbiàn bǎ lèsè ná xiàqù ba, lèsètǒng dōu mǎn le.
lines.english: Then take the rubbish down while you are at it. The bin is full.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 不過垃圾車晚上七點半才來，現在才五點，拿下去也沒地方丟。等垃圾車來了，我再提下去吧。
lines.simplified: 不过垃圾车晚上七点半才来，现在才五点，拿下去也没地方丢。等垃圾车来了，我再提下去吧。
lines.pinyin: Búguò lèsèchē wǎnshàng qī diǎn bàn cái lái, xiànzài cái wǔ diǎn, ná xiàqù yě méi dìfāng diū. Děng lèsèchē lái le, wǒ zài tí xiàqù ba.
lines.english: But the rubbish truck doesn't come until seven thirty, and it's only five now; there's nowhere to put it down there. I'll carry it down when the truck comes.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的打算怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 男的打算怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de dǎsuàn zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What is the man going to do?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Mǎi kāfēi shí shùnbiàn diū lèsè.
choices.english: Drop the rubbish off on his coffee run.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Wǎn yìdiǎn zài qù diū lèsè.
choices.english: Take the rubbish out later.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qǐng nǚ de qī diǎn bàn qù diū.
choices.english: Ask the woman to take it at 7:30.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiān bǎ lèsè fàng zài lóuxià.
choices.english: Leave the rubbish downstairs for now.

questions.why: She asks him to take the rubbish 順便 on his coffee run, but the truck only comes at 7:30 and it is five now, so he will take it down himself when the truck comes. Taking it now was her plan; he says there is nowhere to leave it.

focus.en: while you are at it (順便); wait until

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你弟弟不是大學畢業了嗎？怎麼在超商打工？
lines.simplified: 你弟弟不是大学毕业了吗？怎么在超商打工？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ dìdi bú shì dàxué bìyè le ma? Zěnme zài chāoshāng dǎgōng?
lines.english: Hasn't your younger brother graduated? Why is he working part-time at a convenience store?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 他想存錢去國外學拍電影。他說就算每天站十個小時，也要完成這個夢想。
lines.simplified: 他想存钱去国外学拍电影。他说就算每天站十个小时，也要完成这个梦想。
lines.pinyin: Tā xiǎng cún qián qù guówài xué pāi diànyǐng. Tā shuō jiùsuàn měi tiān zhàn shí ge xiǎoshí, yě yào wánchéng zhège mèngxiǎng.
lines.english: He wants to save money to study filmmaking abroad. He says even if he has to stand ten hours a day, he will make this dream come true.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 站十個小時？我站一個小時腳就痛了。
lines.simplified: 站十个小时？我站一个小时脚就痛了。
lines.pinyin: Zhàn shí ge xiǎoshí? Wǒ zhàn yí ge xiǎoshí jiǎo jiù tòng le.
lines.english: Ten hours on his feet? My feet hurt after one hour.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 這位先生說他弟弟怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 这位先生说他弟弟怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Zhè wèi xiānshēng shuō tā dìdi zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What does the man say about his younger brother?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Hěn xǐhuān chāoshāng de gōngzuò.
choices.english: He loves working at the store.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiǎng zài guówài zhǎo gōngzuò.
choices.english: He wants to find work abroad.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bìyè hòu bù xiǎng zài dúshū.
choices.english: He has had enough of studying.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Wèile mèngxiǎng bú pà xīnkǔ.
choices.english: He will put up with hardship for his dream.

questions.why: 他想存錢去國外學拍電影 gives the goal, and 就算每天站十個小時，也要完成這個夢想 shows he accepts a hard job to reach it. The store job is only a way to save; abroad he wants to study, not work, so he has not had enough of studying.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 聽說你要演那位導演的新戲？這可以說是你的夢想成真了！
lines.simplified: 听说你要演那位导演的新戏？这可以说是你的梦想成真了！
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō nǐ yào yǎn nà wèi dǎoyǎn de xīn xì? Zhè kěyǐ shuō shì nǐ de mèngxiǎng chéng zhēn le!
lines.english: I hear you're going to be in that director's new drama? You could say your dream has come true!

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 角色不大，只有三場戲。再說，拍戲的地方在山上，每天四點就得出門。
lines.simplified: 角色不大，只有三场戏。再说，拍戏的地方在山上，每天四点就得出门。
lines.pinyin: Juésè bú dà, zhǐ yǒu sān chǎng xì. Zàishuō, pāi xì de dìfāng zài shān shàng, měi tiān sì diǎn jiù děi chūmén.
lines.english: The role isn't big, only three scenes. Besides, they shoot up in the mountains, so I have to leave at four every day.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那你還要去嗎？
lines.simplified: 那你还要去吗？
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐ hái yào qù ma?
lines.english: So are you still going?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 當然要去，這麼好的機會，辛苦一點沒關係。
lines.simplified: 当然要去，这么好的机会，辛苦一点没关系。
lines.pinyin: Dāngrán yào qù, zhème hǎo de jīhuì, xīnkǔ yìdiǎn méi guānxi.
lines.english: Of course. It's such a good chance; a little hardship doesn't matter.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的覺得這次演戲怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 男的觉得这次演戏怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de juéde zhè cì yǎn xì zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: How does the man feel about this acting job?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xì bù duō, yīnggāi hěn qīngsōng.
choices.english: He has few scenes, so it should be easy.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Suīrán xīnkǔ, háishì zhídé.
choices.english: It is hard, but worth it.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Dìfāng tài yuǎn, hái méi juédìng.
choices.english: The place is far; he is still deciding.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 機會很好，可惜角色太小
choices.simplified: 机会很好，可惜角色太小
choices.pinyin: Jīhuì hěn hǎo, kěxí juésè tài xiǎo.
choices.english: A good chance, but a pity the role is small.

questions.why: He lists the drawbacks with 再說 (a small role, and besides a four o'clock start), yet ends 當然要去……辛苦一點沒關係: it is worth the hardship. He mentions the small role but never calls it a pity, and he has already decided to go.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳搬到台北快一年了，適應了嗎？
lines.simplified: 你搬到台北快一年了，适应了吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ bān dào Táiběi kuài yì nián le, shìyìng le ma?
lines.english: You've been in Taipei almost a year. Have you got used to it?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 剛開始因為工作太忙而常常沒時間吃飯，現在好多了。再說，公司樓下就有超商，晚上也買得到吃的。
lines.simplified: 刚开始因为工作太忙而常常没时间吃饭，现在好多了。再说，公司楼下就有超商，晚上也买得到吃的。
lines.pinyin: Gāng kāishǐ yīnwèi gōngzuò tài máng ér chángcháng méi shíjiān chīfàn, xiànzài hǎo duō le. Zàishuō, gōngsī lóuxià jiù yǒu chāoshāng, wǎnshàng yě mǎi de dào chī de.
lines.english: At first I often had no time to eat because work was so busy, but it's much better now. Besides, there's a convenience store below the office, so I can get food even at night.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那就好，我還擔心妳想回家呢。
lines.simplified: 那就好，我还担心你想回家呢。
lines.pinyin: Nà jiù hǎo, wǒ hái dānxīn nǐ xiǎng huí jiā ne.
lines.english: Good. I was worried you wanted to go home.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的現在覺得在台北的生活怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 女的现在觉得在台北的生活怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de xiànzài juéde zài Táiběi de shēnghuó zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: How does the woman feel about life in Taipei now?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bǐ gāng lái shí xíguàn duō le.
choices.english: She is much more used to it than at first.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Háishì chángcháng méi shíjiān chīfàn.
choices.english: She still often has no time to eat.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Gōngzuò yuè lái yuè máng le.
choices.english: Work keeps getting busier.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Hěn xiǎng bān huí jiā qù zhù.
choices.english: She would like to move back home.

questions.why: 剛開始因為工作太忙而常常沒時間吃飯，現在好多了: skipping meals was only at the start; now she is fine. Going home was only the man's worry.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳又吃泡麵？這個星期已經第三次了。
lines.simplified: 你又吃泡面？这个星期已经第三次了。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ yòu chī pàomiàn? Zhège xīngqí yǐjīng dì sān cì le.
lines.english: Instant noodles again? That is the third time this week.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我一會兒要準備報告，一會兒要去打工，哪有時間煮飯？超商有免費的熱水，挺方便的。
lines.simplified: 我一会儿要准备报告，一会儿要去打工，哪有时间煮饭？超商有免费的热水，挺方便的。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yìhuǐr yào zhǔnbèi bàogào, yìhuǐr yào qù dǎgōng, nǎ yǒu shíjiān zhǔ fàn? Chāoshāng yǒu miǎnfèi de rèshuǐ, tǐng fāngbiàn de.
lines.english: One minute I'm preparing a report, the next I'm off to my part-time job. Who has time to cook? The store has free hot water; it's quite convenient.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 可是泡麵沒什麼營養。樓下那家店從滷肉飯到義大利麵，中餐、西餐都有，也有蔬菜，請店員加熱一下就能吃。
lines.simplified: 可是泡面没什么营养。楼下那家店从卤肉饭到义大利面，中餐、西餐都有，也有蔬菜，请店员加热一下就能吃。
lines.pinyin: Kěshì pàomiàn méi shénme yíngyǎng. Lóuxià nà jiā diàn cóng lǔròu fàn dào Yìdàlì miàn, zhōngcān, xīcān dōu yǒu, yě yǒu shūcài, qǐng diànyuán jiārè yíxià jiù néng chī.
lines.english: But instant noodles have hardly any nutrition. The shop downstairs has everything from braised pork rice to spaghetti, Chinese and Western, vegetables too; have the clerk heat it and you can eat right away.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那些一份要一百多塊，比泡麵貴多了。
lines.simplified: 那些一份要一百多块，比泡面贵多了。
lines.pinyin: Nàxiē yí fèn yào yìbǎi duō kuài, bǐ pàomiàn guì duō le.
lines.english: Those cost over a hundred dollars each, much more than noodles.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 為了身體，多花一點錢是值得的。
lines.simplified: 为了身体，多花一点钱是值得的。
lines.pinyin: Wèile shēntǐ, duō huā yìdiǎn qián shì zhídé de.
lines.english: For your health, spending a bit more is worth it.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好吧，明天中午我先買一份試試看。
lines.simplified: 好吧，明天中午我先买一份试试看。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo ba, míngtiān zhōngwǔ wǒ xiān mǎi yí fèn shìshi kàn.
lines.english: All right, tomorrow at lunch I'll buy one and try it.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 對女的來說，吃泡麵有什麼好處？
prompt.simplified: 对女的来说，吃泡面有什么好处？
prompt.pinyin: Duì nǚ de lái shuō, chī pàomiàn yǒu shénme hǎochù?
prompt.english: For the woman, what is good about eating instant noodles?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Diànyuán huì bāngmáng jiārè.
choices.english: The clerk will heat it for her.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zhōngcān, xīcān dōu néng xuǎn.
choices.english: She can choose Chinese or Western.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Shěng shíjiān, yě bǐjiào piányí.
choices.english: It saves time and is cheaper.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Kěyǐ yìbiān chī yìbiān gōngzuò.
choices.english: She can eat while she works.

questions.why: She has no time to cook (一會兒……，一會兒……，哪有時間煮飯) and later says the meals are much dearer than noodles: time and money. Heating and the choice of Chinese or Western food are what the man says for the shop's meals.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的為什麼改變了想法？
prompt.simplified: 女的为什么改变了想法？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de wèishénme gǎibiàn le xiǎngfǎ?
prompt.english: Why does the woman change her mind?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tóngyì jiànkāng bǐ shěng qián zhòngyào.
choices.english: She agrees health matters more than saving.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Fāxiàn lóuxià de fàn bú guì.
choices.english: She finds the meals are not expensive.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Pàomiàn yǐjīng chī tài duō cì le.
choices.english: She has had noodles too often.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Diànyuán néng bāng tā bǎ fàn jiārè.
choices.english: The clerk can heat the meal for her.

questions.why: Her only objection is the price; she gives in (好吧) right after 為了身體，多花一點錢是值得的, so the health argument wins. She still thinks the meals are dear, and heating is a point he made earlier that did not move her.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這間店只有十五坪，開咖啡店空間夠嗎？
lines.simplified: 这间店只有十五坪，开咖啡店空间够吗？
lines.pinyin: Zhè jiān diàn zhǐ yǒu shíwǔ píng, kāi kāfēi diàn kōngjiān gòu ma?
lines.english: This shop is only fifteen ping. Is that enough space for a coffee shop?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 夠了。我們主要賣咖啡跟早餐，不用像超商放那麼多生活用品。
lines.simplified: 够了。我们主要卖咖啡跟早餐，不用像超商放那么多生活用品。
lines.pinyin: Gòu le. Wǒmen zhǔyào mài kāfēi gēn zǎocān, búyòng xiàng chāoshāng fàng nàme duō shēnghuó yòngpǐn.
lines.english: It's enough. We'll mainly sell coffee and breakfast; we don't need as many household supplies as a convenience store.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 可是附近已經有兩家超商了，客人會上門嗎？
lines.simplified: 可是附近已经有两家超商了，客人会上门吗？
lines.pinyin: Kěshì fùjìn yǐjīng yǒu liǎng jiā chāoshāng le, kèrén huì shàngmén ma?
lines.english: But there are already two convenience stores nearby. Will customers come in?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我早就去看過了。那兩家早上人很多，店員一會兒煮咖啡，一會兒收錢，客人常常要等很久。
lines.simplified: 我早就去看过了。那两家早上人很多，店员一会儿煮咖啡，一会儿收钱，客人常常要等很久。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zǎo jiù qù kàn guo le. Nà liǎng jiā zǎoshàng rén hěn duō, diànyuán yìhuǐr zhǔ kāfēi, yìhuǐr shōu qián, kèrén chángcháng yào děng hěn jiǔ.
lines.english: I went and looked long ago. Those two are packed in the morning; the clerks make coffee one moment and take money the next, so customers often wait a long time.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好吧。不過房租一個月要六萬，我們再跟房東談談價錢。
lines.simplified: 好吧。不过房租一个月要六万，我们再跟房东谈谈价钱。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo ba. Búguò fángzū yí ge yuè yào liùwàn, wǒmen zài gēn fángdōng tántan jiàqián.
lines.english: All right. But the rent is sixty thousand a month; let's talk about the price with the landlord again.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的為什麼不擔心附近的兩家超商？
prompt.simplified: 女的为什么不担心附近的两家超商？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de wèishénme bù dānxīn fùjìn de liǎng jiā chāoshāng?
prompt.english: Why is the woman not worried about the two stores nearby?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nà liǎng jiā bú mài zǎocān.
choices.english: Those two don't sell breakfast.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nà liǎng jiā de kōngjiān tài xiǎo.
choices.english: Those two have too little space.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nà liǎng jiā de kāfēi hěn guì.
choices.english: Coffee at those two is expensive.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nà liǎng jiā de fúwù tài màn.
choices.english: Service at those two is too slow.

questions.why: The clerks there switch between making coffee and taking money (一會兒……，一會兒……), so customers wait a long time: their service is slow. They do sell breakfast, and space is the man's worry about their own shop.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的打算先做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 男的打算先做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de dǎsuàn xiān zuò shénme?

passage.traditional: 我們公司樓下有一家超商，可以說是上班族的好鄰居。它{1}的服務非常多，除了賣吃的、喝的，還能寄東西、付水電費。店裡的{2}雖然不大，可是東西放得好好的，要什麼一下子就找得到。店員的{3}也很好，碰到很兇的客人，也不會生氣。中午不想走遠，可以請店員把剛買的雞腿飯{4}，在店裡吃完再回辦公室。這家店最大的{5}，是中午常常坐不下。這裡的東西比外面貴一點，{6}能省下不少時間，所以大家還是天天來。
passage.simplified: 我们公司楼下有一家超商，可以说是上班族的好邻居。它{1}的服务非常多，除了卖吃的、喝的，还能寄东西、付水电费。店里的{2}虽然不大，可是东西放得好好的，要什么一下子就找得到。店员的{3}也很好，碰到很凶的客人，也不会生气。中午不想走远，可以请店员把刚买的鸡腿饭{4}，在店里吃完再回办公室。这家店最大的{5}，是中午常常坐不下。这里的东西比外面贵一点，{6}能省下不少时间，所以大家还是天天来。
passage.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī lóuxià yǒu yì jiā chāoshāng, kěyǐ shuō shì shàngbānzú de hǎo línjū. Tā tígōng de fúwù fēicháng duō, chúle mài chī de, hē de, hái néng jì dōngxi, fù shuǐdiàn fèi. Diàn lǐ de kōngjiān suīrán bú dà, kěshì dōngxi fàng de hǎohǎo de, yào shénme yíxiàzi jiù zhǎo de dào. Diànyuán de tàidù yě hěn hǎo, pèngdào hěn xiōng de kèrén, yě bú huì shēngqì. Zhōngwǔ bù xiǎng zǒu yuǎn, kěyǐ qǐng diànyuán bǎ gāng mǎi de jītuǐ fàn jiārè, zài diàn lǐ chī wán zài huí bàngōngshì. Zhè jiā diàn zuì dà de quēdiǎn, shì zhōngwǔ chángcháng zuò bú xià. Zhèlǐ de dōngxi bǐ wàimiàn guì yìdiǎn, búguò néng shěng xià bù shǎo shíjiān, suǒyǐ dàjiā háishì tiāntiān lái.
passage.english: There is a convenience store below our office; you could call it the office workers' good neighbour. It provides a great many services: besides food and drinks, you can send parcels and pay water and power bills there. The space inside isn't big, but everything is neatly arranged and you find what you want in no time. The clerks' attitude is good too: even with rude customers they don't get angry. At noon, if you don't want to walk far, you can ask a clerk to heat the chicken-leg rice you have just bought, eat it in the store and then go back to the office. The store's biggest drawback is that at noon there is often nowhere to sit. Things here cost a bit more than elsewhere, but you save a lot of time, so everyone still comes every day.

passage.traditional: 我奶奶七十五歲，以前付錢、領錢都得去銀行排隊。後來她家旁邊開了一家超商，也提供領錢的服務，她就很少去銀行了。剛開始，她不會{1}店裡的自動提款機，每次都請店員教她。{2}幾次練習，她現在能自己領錢了。在超商領錢，一次要付五塊錢的{3}，可是不必走遠路，也不必排隊，她覺得很{4}。除了領錢，她也常在店裡買一些{5}，不用再跑去別的地方買牙刷或電池。店員住在她家樓上，下班時常常{6}幫她把東西提回家。
passage.simplified: 我奶奶七十五岁，以前付钱、领钱都得去银行排队。后来她家旁边开了一家超商，也提供领钱的服务，她就很少去银行了。刚开始，她不会{1}店里的自动提款机，每次都请店员教她。{2}几次练习，她现在能自己领钱了。在超商领钱，一次要付五块钱的{3}，可是不必走远路，也不必排队，她觉得很{4}。除了领钱，她也常在店里买一些{5}，不用再跑去别的地方买牙刷或电池。店员住在她家楼上，下班时常常{6}帮她把东西提回家。
passage.pinyin: Wǒ nǎinai qīshíwǔ suì, yǐqián fù qián, lǐng qián dōu děi qù yínháng páiduì. Hòulái tā jiā pángbiān kāi le yì jiā chāoshāng, yě tígōng lǐng qián de fúwù, tā jiù hěn shǎo qù yínháng le. Gāng kāishǐ, tā bú huì shǐyòng diàn lǐ de zìdòng tíkuǎnjī, měi cì dōu qǐng diànyuán jiāo tā. Jīngguò jǐ cì liànxí, tā xiànzài néng zìjǐ lǐng qián le. Zài chāoshāng lǐng qián, yí cì yào fù wǔ kuài qián de shǒuxù fèi, kěshì búbì zǒu yuǎn lù, yě búbì páiduì, tā juéde hěn zhídé. Chúle lǐng qián, tā yě cháng zài diàn lǐ mǎi yìxiē shēnghuó yòngpǐn, búyòng zài pǎo qù bié de dìfāng mǎi yáshuā huò diànchí. Diànyuán zhù zài tā jiā lóushàng, xiàbān shí chángcháng shùnbiàn bāng tā bǎ dōngxi tí huí jiā.
passage.english: My grandmother is seventy-five. She used to have to queue at the bank to pay bills or take out money. Then a convenience store opened next to her home that also lets you take out money, and she seldom goes to the bank now. At first she didn't know how to use the store's ATM and asked a clerk to show her every time. After some practice she can now take out money on her own. Each withdrawal at the store costs a five-dollar fee, but she doesn't have to walk far or queue, so she thinks it's worth it. Besides taking out money, she often buys everyday supplies there, so she no longer has to go elsewhere for toothbrushes or batteries. The clerk lives upstairs from her, and on the way home from work often carries her things home for her.

title.english: Buying Vegetables at a Convenience Store

text.traditional:
以前說起買菜，大家想到的都是傳統市場。現在，不少超商也開始賣白菜、香蕉等蔬菜水果，主要是為了滿足上班族的需求：他們早晚都會經過超商，可是很少有時間去市場。超商用小包裝來賣菜，一包剛好夠一個人吃一兩餐，不會吃不完。
不過，我跟媽媽提到這件事的時候，她說她還是不會在超商買菜。超商的菜一包要四、五十塊，比市場貴；而且包得好好的，不能打開來看，品質好不好，得回家打開才知道。
我覺得這兩個地方各有優點和缺點。週末有時間，就去市場慢慢選；平常下班晚了，在超商買一包，回家煮個湯，也比天天吃泡麵、熱狗有營養。
text.simplified:
以前说起买菜，大家想到的都是传统市场。现在，不少超商也开始卖白菜、香蕉等蔬菜水果，主要是为了满足上班族的需求：他们早晚都会经过超商，可是很少有时间去市场。超商用小包装来卖菜，一包刚好够一个人吃一两餐，不会吃不完。
不过，我跟妈妈提到这件事的时候，她说她还是不会在超商买菜。超商的菜一包要四、五十块，比市场贵；而且包得好好的，不能打开来看，品质好不好，得回家打开才知道。
我觉得这两个地方各有优点和缺点。周末有时间，就去市场慢慢选；平常下班晚了，在超商买一包，回家煮个汤，也比天天吃泡面、热狗有营养。
text.pinyin: Yǐqián shuōqǐ mǎi cài, dàjiā xiǎngdào de dōu shì chuántǒng shìchǎng. Xiànzài, bù shǎo chāoshāng yě kāishǐ mài báicài, xiāngjiāo děng shūcài shuǐguǒ, zhǔyào shì wèile mǎnzú shàngbānzú de xūqiú: tāmen zǎowǎn dōu huì jīngguò chāoshāng, kěshì hěn shǎo yǒu shíjiān qù shìchǎng. Chāoshāng yòng xiǎo bāozhuāng lái mài cài, yì bāo gānghǎo gòu yí ge rén chī yì liǎng cān, bú huì chī bù wán. Búguò, wǒ gēn māma tídào zhè jiàn shì de shíhòu, tā shuō tā háishì bú huì zài chāoshāng mǎi cài. Chāoshāng de cài yì bāo yào sì, wǔshí kuài, bǐ shìchǎng guì; érqiě bāo de hǎohǎo de, bù néng dǎkāi lái kàn, pǐnzhí hǎo bù hǎo, děi huí jiā dǎkāi cái zhīdào. Wǒ juéde zhè liǎng ge dìfāng gè yǒu yōudiǎn hé quēdiǎn. Zhōumò yǒu shíjiān, jiù qù shìchǎng mànmàn xuǎn; píngcháng xiàbān wǎn le, zài chāoshāng mǎi yì bāo, huí jiā zhǔ ge tāng, yě bǐ tiāntiān chī pàomiàn, règǒu yǒu yíngyǎng.
text.english:
People used to think of traditional markets when it came to buying vegetables. Now many convenience stores have started selling vegetables and fruit such as Chinese cabbage and bananas, mainly to meet the needs of office workers, who pass a convenience store morning and evening but seldom have time for the market. The stores sell vegetables in small packs, each just enough for one person for a meal or two, so nothing is left over.
But when I mentioned this to my mother, she said she still won't buy vegetables at a convenience store. A pack costs forty or fifty dollars, more than at the market; and it is tightly wrapped, so you can't open it to look: you only know the quality once you open it at home.
I think both places have their good and bad points. At the weekend, when there is time, go to the market and choose slowly; on weekdays when you finish work late, buy a pack at the store and make soup at home: it is still more nutritious than instant noodles or hot dogs every day.

title.english: The Hard Work You Cannot See

text.traditional:
我剛來臺灣的時候，最讓我嚇一跳的，是超商店員的態度。每次一進門，店員就會馬上說聲歡迎；就算忙得一會兒收錢、一會兒煮咖啡，臉上也一直帶著微笑。
後來我自己在超商打工，才知道這不只是因為店員的性格開朗，也是公司的要求。公司每經過一段時間，就會用「神祕顧客」的方式來檢查服務品質：有人會像一般客人一樣上門買東西，看店員有沒有說歡迎、收錢的速度快不快，再告訴公司。表現不好的店員，就得重新上課。
有一次，我碰到一位很兇的客人，因為咖啡太熱，很不客氣地念了我十分鐘。我很想生氣，可是一想到「神祕顧客」，只好一直說對不起。那天整個下午，我的心情都不好。下班時，我第一次感覺到，好的服務背後，有很多看不見的辛苦。
text.simplified:
我刚来台湾的时候，最让我吓一跳的，是超商店员的态度。每次一进门，店员就会马上说声欢迎；就算忙得一会儿收钱、一会儿煮咖啡，脸上也一直带着微笑。
后来我自己在超商打工，才知道这不只是因为店员的性格开朗，也是公司的要求。公司每经过一段时间，就会用「神秘顾客」的方式来检查服务品质：有人会像一般客人一样上门买东西，看店员有没有说欢迎、收钱的速度快不快，再告诉公司。表现不好的店员，就得重新上课。
有一次，我碰到一位很凶的客人，因为咖啡太热，很不客气地念了我十分钟。我很想生气，可是一想到「神秘顾客」，只好一直说对不起。那天整个下午，我的心情都不好。下班时，我第一次感觉到，好的服务背后，有很多看不见的辛苦。
text.pinyin: Wǒ gāng lái Táiwān de shíhòu, zuì ràng wǒ xiàyítiào de, shì chāoshāng diànyuán de tàidù. Měi cì yí jìn mén, diànyuán jiù huì mǎshàng shuō shēng huānyíng; jiùsuàn máng de yìhuǐr shōu qián, yìhuǐr zhǔ kāfēi, liǎn shàng yě yìzhí dàizhe wéixiào. Hòulái wǒ zìjǐ zài chāoshāng dǎgōng, cái zhīdào zhè bù zhǐ shì yīnwèi diànyuán de xìnggé kāilǎng, yě shì gōngsī de yāoqiú. Gōngsī měi jīngguò yí duàn shíjiān, jiù huì yòng "shénmì gùkè" de fāngshì lái jiǎnchá fúwù pǐnzhí: yǒu rén huì xiàng yìbān kèrén yíyàng shàngmén mǎi dōngxi, kàn diànyuán yǒu méiyǒu shuō huānyíng, shōu qián de sùdù kuài bú kuài, zài gàosu gōngsī. Biǎoxiàn bù hǎo de diànyuán, jiù děi chóngxīn shàngkè. Yǒu yí cì, wǒ pèngdào yí wèi hěn xiōng de kèrén, yīnwèi kāfēi tài rè, hěn bú kèqì de niàn le wǒ shí fēnzhōng. Wǒ hěn xiǎng shēngqì, kěshì yì xiǎngdào "shénmì gùkè", zhǐhǎo yìzhí shuō duìbùqǐ. Nà tiān zhěng ge xiàwǔ, wǒ de xīnqíng dōu bù hǎo. Xiàbān shí, wǒ dì yī cì gǎnjué dào, hǎo de fúwù bèihòu, yǒu hěn duō kàn bú jiàn de xīnkǔ.
text.english:
When I first came to Taiwan, what surprised me most was the attitude of convenience store clerks. Every time you walk in, the clerk at once greets you; even when busy taking money one moment and making coffee the next, they keep smiling.
Later I worked part-time in a store myself and learned that this is not only because clerks are cheerful by nature: it is also what the company requires. Every so often the company uses "mystery customers" to check service quality: someone comes in like an ordinary customer to buy something, sees whether the clerk greets them and how fast they take the money, then reports to the company. Clerks who do badly have to take the training again.
Once I met a very rude customer who scolded me rudely for ten minutes because the coffee was too hot. I wanted to get angry, but at the thought of the mystery customers I just kept saying sorry. I was in a bad mood the whole afternoon. Leaving work, I felt for the first time that behind good service there is a lot of hard work nobody sees.

prompt.pinyin: Gōngsī yòng "shénmì gùkè" lái zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What does the company use "mystery customers" for?

choices.pinyin: Xīyǐn gèng duō kèrén shàngmén.
choices.english: To bring in more customers.

choices.pinyin: Liǎojiě diànyuán zuò de hǎo bù hǎo.
choices.english: To find out how well clerks do.

choices.pinyin: Jiāo xīn diànyuán zěnme shōu qián.
choices.english: To teach new clerks the till.

choices.pinyin: Bāng diànyuán chǔlǐ xiōng de kèrén.
choices.english: To help clerks with rude customers.

questions.why: 公司用「神祕顧客」的方式來檢查服務品質: they pose as customers and report on greetings and how fast clerks take the money, so the company learns how well clerks work. They do not bring customers, teach the till (retraining comes after a bad report), or deal with rude customers.

text.traditional:
我家樓下超商的夜班店員阿明，是一個很特別的年輕人。半夜客人少的時候，他常常拿出劇本，小聲地練習。原來，他的夢想是當演員。
大學畢業以後，他不斷地找演戲的機會，可是一直沒拿到重要的角色。他在這裡上夜班已經三年了。他說，上夜班雖然辛苦，可是白天就有時間去上表演課；再說，每天碰到各式各樣的客人，也能學到不同的人怎麼說話、怎麼走路，對演戲很有幫助。
上個月，一位導演看了他的表演，請他在一部新戲裡演一個超商店員。阿明笑著說：「這個角色，我可以說是已經練習了三年。」
text.simplified:
我家楼下超商的夜班店员阿明，是一个很特别的年轻人。半夜客人少的时候，他常常拿出剧本，小声地练习。原来，他的梦想是当演员。
大学毕业以后，他不断地找演戏的机会，可是一直没拿到重要的角色。他在这里上夜班已经三年了。他说，上夜班虽然辛苦，可是白天就有时间去上表演课；再说，每天碰到各式各样的客人，也能学到不同的人怎么说话、怎么走路，对演戏很有帮助。
上个月，一位导演看了他的表演，请他在一部新戏里演一个超商店员。阿明笑着说：「这个角色，我可以说是已经练习了三年。」
text.pinyin: Wǒ jiā lóuxià chāoshāng de yèbān diànyuán Āmíng, shì yí ge hěn tèbié de niánqīngrén. Bànyè kèrén shǎo de shíhòu, tā chángcháng ná chū jùběn, xiǎoshēng de liànxí. Yuánlái, tā de mèngxiǎng shì dāng yǎnyuán. Dàxué bìyè yǐhòu, tā búduàn de zhǎo yǎn xì de jīhuì, kěshì yìzhí méi ná dào zhòngyào de juésè. Tā zài zhèlǐ shàng yèbān yǐjīng sān nián le. Tā shuō, shàng yèbān suīrán xīnkǔ, kěshì báitiān jiù yǒu shíjiān qù shàng biǎoyǎn kè; zàishuō, měi tiān pèngdào gè shì gè yàng de kèrén, yě néng xué dào bù tóng de rén zěnme shuōhuà, zěnme zǒulù, duì yǎn xì hěn yǒu bāngzhù. Shàng ge yuè, yí wèi dǎoyǎn kàn le tā de biǎoyǎn, qǐng tā zài yí bù xīn xì lǐ yǎn yí ge chāoshāng diànyuán. Āmíng xiàozhe shuō: "Zhège juésè, wǒ kěyǐ shuō shì yǐjīng liànxí le sān nián."
text.english:
A-Ming, the night-shift clerk at the convenience store below my home, is an unusual young man. Late at night when there are few customers, he often takes out a script and practises quietly. It turns out his dream is to be an actor.
Since graduating he has kept looking for acting work, but has never landed an important role. He has worked nights here for three years. He says the night shift is hard, but it leaves his days free for acting classes; besides, meeting all kinds of customers every day teaches him how different people talk and walk, which helps his acting.
Last month a director saw him perform and asked him to play a convenience store clerk in a new drama. A-Ming said with a smile, "You could say I've been rehearsing this role for three years."

text.traditional:
我舅舅以前是律師，工作非常忙，常常因為忙而忘了吃飯，晚上十點才在超商買個饅頭當晚餐。四十歲那年，他決定改變自己的生活，不再當律師，在家附近開了一家小小的早餐店。
家人聽了都很擔心，因為開店不但辛苦，錢也比當律師少很多。可是舅舅說，就算錢少一點，他也想追求自己喜歡的生活。
現在，他每天早上四點就起床做饅頭，常常累得不想說話，可是每天都笑得很開心。他說，看到客人吃得滿意，就是他最大的樂趣。每次我去店裡，他都會說：「人能做自己喜歡的工作，多麼幸福啊！」
text.simplified:
我舅舅以前是律师，工作非常忙，常常因为忙而忘了吃饭，晚上十点才在超商买个馒头当晚餐。四十岁那年，他决定改变自己的生活，不再当律师，在家附近开了一家小小的早餐店。
家人听了都很担心，因为开店不但辛苦，钱也比当律师少很多。可是舅舅说，就算钱少一点，他也想追求自己喜欢的生活。
现在，他每天早上四点就起床做馒头，常常累得不想说话，可是每天都笑得很开心。他说，看到客人吃得满意，就是他最大的乐趣。每次我去店里，他都会说：「人能做自己喜欢的工作，多么幸福啊！」
text.pinyin: Wǒ jiùjiu yǐqián shì lǜshī, gōngzuò fēicháng máng, chángcháng yīnwèi máng ér wàng le chīfàn, wǎnshàng shí diǎn cái zài chāoshāng mǎi ge mántou dāng wǎncān. Sìshí suì nà nián, tā juédìng gǎibiàn zìjǐ de shēnghuó, búzài dāng lǜshī, zài jiā fùjìn kāi le yì jiā xiǎoxiǎo de zǎocān diàn. Jiārén tīng le dōu hěn dānxīn, yīnwèi kāi diàn búdàn xīnkǔ, qián yě bǐ dāng lǜshī shǎo hěn duō. Kěshì jiùjiu shuō, jiùsuàn qián shǎo yìdiǎn, tā yě xiǎng zhuīqiú zìjǐ xǐhuān de shēnghuó. Xiànzài, tā měi tiān zǎoshàng sì diǎn jiù qǐchuáng zuò mántou, chángcháng lèi de bù xiǎng shuōhuà, kěshì měi tiān dōu xiào de hěn kāixīn. Tā shuō, kàndào kèrén chī de mǎnyì, jiù shì tā zuì dà de lèqù. Měi cì wǒ qù diàn lǐ, tā dōu huì shuō: "Rén néng zuò zìjǐ xǐhuān de gōngzuò, duōme xìngfú a!"
text.english:
My uncle used to be a lawyer. His work was very busy; he often forgot to eat because he was so busy, and bought a steamed bun at a convenience store for dinner at ten at night. The year he turned forty, he decided to change his life, gave up being a lawyer and opened a little breakfast shop near his home.
His family were worried, because running a shop is hard and pays much less than law. But my uncle said that even if he earned less, he wanted to pursue the life he liked.
Now he gets up at four every morning to make steamed buns and is often too tired to talk, but he smiles happily every day. He says seeing his customers enjoy their food is his greatest pleasure. Every time I visit the shop he says, "How lucky a person is who can do work they love!"

choices.simplified: 他那时候就想学做馒头

questions.why: The bun bought at ten at night follows 常常因為忙而忘了吃飯: it shows how the job left no time for proper meals, the reason he changed his life. That he makes buns now is a later turn, not what the bun at the store is there to show.

lines.english: Eight pieces a box. If you buy two boxes now there is a discount: twenty percent off the second.
