lines.traditional: 我先買一盒回去。家人也喜歡的話，下次再多買幾盒。
lines.simplified: 我先买一盒回去。家人也喜欢的话，下次再多买几盒。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiān mǎi yì hé huíqù. Jiārén yě xǐhuān dehuà, xià cì zài duō mǎi jǐ hé.
lines.english: I'll take one box home first. If my family like it too, I'll buy a few more next time.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的為什麼沒有趁優惠買兩盒？
prompt.simplified: 女的为什么没有趁优惠买两盒？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de wèishénme méiyǒu chèn yōuhuì mǎi liǎng hé?
prompt.english: Why does the woman not buy two boxes while there is a discount?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Juéde dàngāo tài tián le.
choices.english: She finds the cake too sweet.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Dì èr hé méiyǒu bǐjiào piányí.
choices.english: The second box is not any cheaper.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yì hé bā kuài yǐjīng gòu duō le.
choices.english: Eight pieces a box are already plenty.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 想先知道家人愛不愛吃
choices.simplified: 想先知道家人爱不爱吃
choices.pinyin: Xiǎng xiān zhīdào jiārén ài bú ài chī.
choices.english: She wants to find out first whether her family like it.

questions.why: She buys one box first and will buy more next time 家人也喜歡的話: the family decides. She says the cake is 不會太甜, and the second box is 20% off. Eight pieces a box is the seller's fact, not her reason.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你要出去啊？
lines.simplified: 你要出去啊？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ yào chūqù a?
lines.english: Are you going out?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 對，我要去樓下的超商領錢。
lines.simplified: 对，我要去楼下的超商领钱。
lines.pinyin: Duì, wǒ yào qù lóuxià de chāoshāng lǐng qián.
lines.english: Yes, I'm going to the convenience store downstairs to take out money.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那你順便幫我把這箱舊書寄給我妹妹，好不好？地址我寫好了。
lines.simplified: 那你顺便帮我把这箱旧书寄给我妹妹，好不好？地址我写好了。
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐ shùnbiàn bāng wǒ bǎ zhè xiāng jiù shū jì gěi wǒ mèimei, hǎo bù hǎo? Dìzhǐ wǒ xiě hǎo le.
lines.english: Then could you send this box of old books to my sister for me while you are there? I have written the address.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好。這箱太重，我開車去郵局寄。
lines.simplified: 好。这箱太重，我开车去邮局寄。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo. Zhè xiāng tài zhòng, wǒ kāichē qù yóujú jì.
lines.english: Sure. This box is too heavy; I'll drive to the post office and send it.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的出門以後會怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 男的出门以后会怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de chūmén yǐhòu huì zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What will the man do when he goes out?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zhǐ qù lǐng qián, bù bāng tā jì shū.
choices.english: Only take out money and not send her books.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 領完錢，在超商把書寄出去
choices.simplified: 领完钱，在超商把书寄出去
choices.pinyin: Lǐng wán qián, zài chāoshāng bǎ shū jì chūqù.
choices.english: Take out money, then send the books from the store.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 領錢，再開車去郵局寄書
choices.simplified: 领钱，再开车去邮局寄书
choices.pinyin: Lǐng qián, zài kāichē qù yóujú jì shū.
choices.english: Take out money, then drive to the post office to send the books.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 開車去郵局寄給自己的妹妹
choices.simplified: 开车去邮局寄给自己的妹妹
choices.pinyin: Kāichē qù yóujú jì gěi zìjǐ de mèimei.
choices.english: Drive to the post office and send them to his own sister.

questions.why: He is going to the store to take out money, and she asks him to send her books 順便 while there; but he answers that the box is too heavy and he will drive to the post office to send it. So he does both jobs, and the books go from the post office, not the store. He says 好, so he does send them, and they go to her sister, not his.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我最喜歡的明星設計的球鞋，只賣三天，我一定要買到。
lines.simplified: 我最喜欢的明星设计的球鞋，只卖三天，我一定要买到。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuān de míngxīng shèjì de qiúxié, zhǐ mài sān tiān, wǒ yídìng yào mǎidào.
lines.english: My favourite star has designed some sneakers. They are only on sale for three days, and I must get a pair.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 聽說一雙要一萬多塊，而且要排好幾個小時。
lines.simplified: 听说一双要一万多块，而且要排好几个小时。
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō yì shuāng yào yíwàn duō kuài, érqiě yào pái hǎo jǐ ge xiǎoshí.
lines.english: I hear a pair costs over ten thousand, and you have to queue for hours.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 就算要排一整夜，我也要排。
lines.simplified: 就算要排一整夜，我也要排。
lines.pinyin: Jiùsuàn yào pái yì zhěng yè, wǒ yě yào pái.
lines.english: Even if I have to queue all night, I'll queue.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你上個月才說要節省一點，真受不了你。
lines.simplified: 你上个月才说要节省一点，真受不了你。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ shàng ge yuè cái shuō yào jiéshěng yìdiǎn, zhēn shòubùliǎo nǐ.
lines.english: Only last month you said you would save a bit. You are impossible.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 男的是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the man mean?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Pái duō jiǔ dōu yuànyì.
choices.english: He is willing to queue however long it takes.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tài guì le, bù mǎi le.
choices.english: It is too expensive, so he won't buy it.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiǎng qǐng nǚ de bāng tā pái.
choices.english: He wants the woman to queue for him.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zhǐ pái jǐ ge xiǎoshí jiù hǎo.
choices.english: He will queue only a few hours.

questions.why: 就算要排一整夜，我也要排: even the worst case (all night) will not stop him. The high price and the hours of queuing are her objections, and he answers them with 就算……也…….

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我想去那家皮鞋店，把上次買的鞋子拿去換。
lines.simplified: 我想去那家皮鞋店，把上次买的鞋子拿去换。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng qù nà jiā píxié diàn, bǎ shàng cì mǎi de xiézi ná qù huàn.
lines.english: I want to go to that shoe shop and change the shoes I bought last time.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那家店早就關了。我上個月經過的時候，那裡已經是一家咖啡店了。
lines.simplified: 那家店早就关了。我上个月经过的时候，那里已经是一家咖啡店了。
lines.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn zǎo jiù guān le. Wǒ shàng ge yuè jīngguò de shíhòu, nàlǐ yǐjīng shì yì jiā kāfēi diàn le.
lines.english: That shop closed long ago. When I passed last month, it was already a café.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 真的嗎？那我的鞋子怎麼辦？
lines.simplified: 真的吗？那我的鞋子怎么办？
lines.pinyin: Zhēn de ma? Nà wǒ de xiézi zěnme bàn?
lines.english: Really? Then what about my shoes?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 算了吧，那雙鞋子也沒花多少錢。
lines.simplified: 算了吧，那双鞋子也没花多少钱。
lines.pinyin: Suàn le ba, nà shuāng xiézi yě méi huā duōshǎo qián.
lines.english: Forget it. Those shoes didn't cost much anyway.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的為什麼說「算了吧」？
prompt.simplified: 男的为什么说「算了吧」？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de wèishénme shuō "suàn le ba"?
prompt.english: Why does the man say "forget it"?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn shàng ge yuè cái guān.
choices.english: The shop closed only last month.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 那家店搬到別的地方了
choices.simplified: 那家店搬到别的地方了
choices.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn bān dào bié de dìfāng le.
choices.english: The shop has moved somewhere else.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 店早就沒了，鞋子也不貴
choices.simplified: 店早就没了，鞋子也不贵
choices.pinyin: Diàn zǎo jiù méi le, xiézi yě bú guì.
choices.english: The shop is long gone, and the shoes were cheap.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他上個月已經幫她換過
choices.simplified: 他上个月已经帮她换过
choices.pinyin: Tā shàng ge yuè yǐjīng bāng tā huàn guo.
choices.english: He already changed them for her last month.

questions.why: Two of his lines add up: 那家店早就關了 (a café was already there last month), and 那雙鞋子也沒花多少錢. Last month is only when he passed by, not when it closed or when anything was changed, and nothing says the shop moved.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 公司要買新的工作服，一個人兩套，經理說交給我們負責。
lines.simplified: 公司要买新的工作服，一个人两套，经理说交给我们负责。
lines.pinyin: Gōngsī yào mǎi xīn de gōngzuòfú, yí ge rén liǎng tào, jīnglǐ shuō jiāo gěi wǒmen fùzé.
lines.english: The company is buying new work clothes, two sets each, and the manager has put us in charge.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 貨比三家不吃虧，我問了三家。第一家最便宜，一套才五百塊。
lines.simplified: 货比三家不吃亏，我问了三家。第一家最便宜，一套才五百块。
lines.pinyin: Huò bǐ sān jiā bù chīkuī, wǒ wèn le sān jiā. Dì yī jiā zuì piányí, yí tào cái wǔbǎi kuài.
lines.english: You never lose by shopping around, so I asked three shops. The first is the cheapest, only five hundred a set.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 上次公司也是買最便宜的，可是沒洗幾次就破了，只好再花錢買。
lines.simplified: 上次公司也是买最便宜的，可是没洗几次就破了，只好再花钱买。
lines.pinyin: Shàng cì gōngsī yě shì mǎi zuì piányí de, kěshì méi xǐ jǐ cì jiù pò le, zhǐhǎo zài huā qián mǎi.
lines.english: Last time the company also bought the cheapest, but they tore after only a few washes, and we had to spend money buying more.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 還有一家貴一點，不過品質不錯，不管個子高還是矮，都會照每個人穿的大小做。
lines.simplified: 还有一家贵一点，不过品质不错，不管个子高还是矮，都会照每个人穿的大小做。
lines.pinyin: Hái yǒu yì jiā guì yìdiǎn, búguò pǐnzhí búcuò, bùguǎn gèzi gāo háishì ǎi, dōu huì zhào měi ge rén chuān de dàxiǎo zuò.
lines.english: Another is a bit dearer, but the quality is good, and tall or short, they make them to the size each person wears.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這樣大家穿起來都合適，多花一點錢也值得。
lines.simplified: 这样大家穿起来都合适，多花一点钱也值得。
lines.pinyin: Zhèyàng dàjiā chuān qǐlái dōu héshì, duō huā yìdiǎn qián yě zhíde.
lines.english: Then they will fit everyone. It is worth spending a little more.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好，那我下午就打電話給那家。
lines.simplified: 好，那我下午就打电话给那家。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, nà wǒ xiàwǔ jiù dǎ diànhuà gěi nà jiā.
lines.english: Fine, I'll phone that shop this afternoon.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的為什麼不想選最便宜的那家？
prompt.simplified: 女的为什么不想选最便宜的那家？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de wèishénme bù xiǎng xuǎn zuì piányí de nà jiā?
prompt.english: Why does the woman not want the cheapest shop?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 經理不讓他們買便宜的
choices.simplified: 经理不让他们买便宜的
choices.pinyin: Jīnglǐ bú ràng tāmen mǎi piányí de.
choices.english: The manager will not let them buy cheap ones.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yǐqián piányí de chuān bù jiǔ.
choices.english: The cheap ones before did not last.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 那家店要等很久才做好
choices.simplified: 那家店要等很久才做好
choices.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn yào děng hěn jiǔ cái zuò hǎo.
choices.english: That shop takes a long time to make them.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn de shèjì tài lǎo.
choices.english: That shop's design is old-fashioned.

questions.why: She remembers last time: the cheapest clothes 沒洗幾次就破了 and had to be bought again. The manager only put them in charge; he said nothing about price. Nobody says how long any shop takes or mentions design.

focus.en: to tear; had no choice but

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 他們最後決定怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 他们最后决定怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen zuìhòu juédìng zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What do they decide in the end?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zài qù wèn bié de diàn.
choices.english: Ask some other shops.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Měi ge rén zìjǐ qù mǎi.
choices.english: Let everyone buy their own.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yí ge rén zhǐ mǎi yí tào.
choices.english: Buy only one set per person.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xuǎn pǐnzhí hǎo de nà jiā.
choices.english: Choose the shop with good quality.

questions.why: The other shop costs more but has good quality and makes them to each person's size (照每個人穿的大小做); she says 多花一點錢也值得, and he will phone that shop. They have already asked three shops, and two sets each stays the plan.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 下個月就是爸媽結婚三十年的紀念日了，你想好送什麼了嗎？
lines.simplified: 下个月就是爸妈结婚三十年的纪念日了，你想好送什么了吗？
lines.pinyin: Xià ge yuè jiù shì bà mā jiéhūn sānshí nián de jìniànrì le, nǐ xiǎng hǎo sòng shénme le ma?
lines.english: Next month is Mum and Dad's thirtieth wedding anniversary. Have you decided what to give them?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我想送他們一套情侶裝。他們年輕的時候常穿相同的衣服。
lines.simplified: 我想送他们一套情侣装。他们年轻的时候常穿相同的衣服。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng sòng tāmen yí tào qínglǚ zhuāng. Tāmen niánqīng de shíhòu cháng chuān xiāngtóng de yīfu.
lines.english: I want to give them a couple outfit. When they were young they often wore identical clothes.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好主意！可是爸爸個子高，一般的衣服他穿起來，肩膀那裡都太緊。
lines.simplified: 好主意！可是爸爸个子高，一般的衣服他穿起来，肩膀那里都太紧。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo zhǔyì! Kěshì bàba gèzi gāo, yìbān de yīfu tā chuān qǐlái, jiānbǎng nàlǐ dōu tài jǐn.
lines.english: Good idea! But Dad is tall, and ordinary clothes are all too tight across the shoulders on him.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那我們帶他們去專櫃試穿吧。
lines.simplified: 那我们带他们去专柜试穿吧。
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒmen dài tāmen qù zhuānguì shìchuān ba.
lines.english: Then let's take them to a counter to try them on.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這樣他們就先知道了，那還有什麼意思？
lines.simplified: 这样他们就先知道了，那还有什么意思？
lines.pinyin: Zhèyàng tāmen jiù xiān zhīdào le, nà hái yǒu shénme yìsi?
lines.english: Then they would know beforehand. What would be the point?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那我們先買，把發票留著，不合適七天以內可以換。
lines.simplified: 那我们先买，把发票留着，不合适七天以内可以换。
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒmen xiān mǎi, bǎ fāpiào liú zhe, bù héshì qī tiān yǐnèi kěyǐ huàn.
lines.english: Then we buy it first and keep the receipt. If it does not fit, we can change it within seven days.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的擔心什麼？
prompt.simplified: 女的担心什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de dānxīn shénme?
prompt.english: What is the woman worried about?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bàba chuān qǐlái bù héshì.
choices.english: It may not fit their father.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 爸媽不喜歡相同的衣服
choices.simplified: 爸妈不喜欢相同的衣服
choices.pinyin: Bà mā bù xǐhuān xiāngtóng de yīfu.
choices.english: Their parents dislike identical clothes.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zhuānguì de yīfu tài guì.
choices.english: Clothes at the counters cost too much.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Wǎnglù shàng mǎi bú dào qínglǚ zhuāng.
choices.english: Couple outfits cannot be bought online.

questions.why: She likes the idea (好主意) but adds 可是爸爸個子高, ordinary clothes are 太緊 in the shoulders (肩膀那裡): her worry is the fit. The parents wore matching clothes when young, so they like them.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 他們最後打算怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 他们最后打算怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen zuìhòu dǎsuàn zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What do they plan to do in the end?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Dài bà mā qù zhuānguì shìchuān.
choices.english: Take their parents to try them on.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Ràng bà mā zìjǐ qù xuǎn.
choices.english: Let their parents choose for themselves.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 不讓爸媽知道，買了再說
choices.simplified: 不让爸妈知道，买了再说
choices.pinyin: Bú ràng bà mā zhīdào, mǎi le zàishuō.
choices.english: Keep it from their parents and buy it first.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Gǎi sòng bié de lǐwù.
choices.english: Give a different present instead.

questions.why: Trying it on at a counter was the first plan, but she points out the parents would know beforehand; so they keep it a surprise and buy it first, keeping the receipt (發票) in case it must be changed 七天以內.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段廣播，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段广播，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn guǎngbò, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a radio programme, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 各位聽眾晚安，歡迎收聽「聰明購物」。年底快到了，各家百貨公司都在打折，東西比平常便宜很多。
lines.simplified: 各位听众晚安，欢迎收听「聪明购物」。年底快到了，各家百货公司都在打折，东西比平常便宜很多。
lines.pinyin: Gèwèi tīngzhòng wǎn'ān, huānyíng shōutīng "Cōngmíng Gòuwù". Niándǐ kuài dào le, gè jiā bǎihuò gōngsī dōu zài dǎzhé, dōngxi bǐ píngcháng piányí hěn duō.
lines.english: Good evening, listeners, and welcome to "Smart Shopping". The end of the year is coming, every department store is having a sale, and things are much cheaper than usual.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 不過我要強調，便宜的東西不一定實在，別一看到打折就糊里糊塗地買。
lines.simplified: 不过我要强调，便宜的东西不一定实在，别一看到打折就糊里糊涂地买。
lines.pinyin: Búguò wǒ yào qiángdiào, piányí de dōngxi bù yídìng shízài, bié yí kàndào dǎzhé jiù húlǐhútú de mǎi.
lines.english: But I want to stress that cheap things are not always good value. Don't buy without thinking the moment you see a sale.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 購物以前，先想清楚自己需要什麼，再比一比價格，這樣才能真的節省。
lines.simplified: 购物以前，先想清楚自己需要什么，再比一比价格，这样才能真的节省。
lines.pinyin: Gòuwù yǐqián, xiān xiǎng qīngchǔ zìjǐ xūyào shénme, zài bǐ yì bǐ jiàgé, zhèyàng cái néng zhēn de jiéshěng.
lines.english: Before you shop, think clearly about what you need, then compare prices. That is how you really save.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 買了以後，一定要留好發票。有問題的話，七天以內都可以拿去換。
lines.simplified: 买了以后，一定要留好发票。有问题的话，七天以内都可以拿去换。
lines.pinyin: Mǎi le yǐhòu, yídìng yào liú hǎo fāpiào. Yǒu wèntí dehuà, qī tiān yǐnèi dōu kěyǐ ná qù huàn.
lines.english: After you buy, be sure to keep the receipt. If there is a problem, you can exchange it any time within seven days.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 說話的人為什麼提到年底的打折？
prompt.simplified: 说话的人为什么提到年底的打折？
prompt.pinyin: Shuōhuà de rén wèishénme tídào niándǐ de dǎzhé?
prompt.english: Why does the speaker mention the year-end sales?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 建議大家等年底再去買
choices.simplified: 建议大家等年底再去买
choices.pinyin: Jiànyì dàjiā děng niándǐ zài qù mǎi.
choices.english: To advise everyone to wait until year end to buy.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 要大家別因為便宜就亂買
choices.simplified: 要大家别因为便宜就乱买
choices.pinyin: Yào dàjiā bié yīnwèi piányí jiù luàn mǎi.
choices.english: To warn everyone not to buy carelessly because things are cheap.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Gàosu dàjiā nǎ jiā zuì piányí.
choices.english: To tell everyone which store is cheapest.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 說明打折的東西不能換
choices.simplified: 说明打折的东西不能换
choices.pinyin: Shuōmíng dǎzhé de dōngxi bù néng huàn.
choices.english: To explain that sale goods cannot be exchanged.

questions.why: The sales and the falling prices (比平常便宜很多) lead into her real point after 不過我要強調: cheap is not always good value, so do not buy 糊里糊塗 the moment you see a sale. She names no store, never says to wait, and says bought things can be exchanged within seven days.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 一位先生買了外套，第五天發現口袋破了。照說話的人的建議，他應該怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 一位先生买了外套，第五天发现口袋破了。照说话的人的建议，他应该怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Yí wèi xiānshēng mǎi le wàitào, dì wǔ tiān fāxiàn kǒudài pò le. Zhào shuōhuà de rén de jiànyì, tā yīnggāi zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: A man bought a jacket and on the fifth day found the pocket torn. Following the speaker's advice, what should he do?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zìjǐ qù xiū kǒudài.
choices.english: Get the pocket mended himself.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Děng niándǐ dǎzhé zài mǎi.
choices.english: Wait for the year-end sale and buy again.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Ná zhe fāpiào qù diàn lǐ huàn.
choices.english: Take the receipt to the shop and exchange it.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 不用去了，過了三天就不能換
choices.simplified: 不用去了，过了三天就不能换
choices.pinyin: Búyòng qù le, guò le sān tiān jiù bù néng huàn.
choices.english: Not bother: after three days it cannot be changed.

questions.why: Day five is 七天以內, and a torn pocket is a problem, so with the receipt he can exchange it (有問題的話，七天以內都可以拿去換). Seven days, not three, is the limit.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段介紹，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段介绍，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn jièshào, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to an introduction, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 各位同學，歡迎來到我們的鞋子工廠。我們主要生產皮鞋跟球鞋。
lines.simplified: 各位同学，欢迎来到我们的鞋子工厂。我们主要生产皮鞋跟球鞋。
lines.pinyin: Gèwèi tóngxué, huānyíng lái dào wǒmen de xiézi gōngchǎng. Wǒmen zhǔyào shēngchǎn píxié gēn qiúxié.
lines.english: Welcome to our shoe factory, everyone. We mainly make leather shoes and sneakers.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 十年前，工廠的設備很舊，做一雙鞋子要花很多時間。後來我們採用了新的設備，速度一年比一年快，也節省了不少人力。
lines.simplified: 十年前，工厂的设备很旧，做一双鞋子要花很多时间。后来我们采用了新的设备，速度一年比一年快，也节省了不少人力。
lines.pinyin: Shí nián qián, gōngchǎng de shèbèi hěn jiù, zuò yì shuāng xiézi yào huā hěn duō shíjiān. Hòulái wǒmen cǎiyòng le xīn de shèbèi, sùdù yì nián bǐ yì nián kuài, yě jiéshěng le bù shǎo rénlì.
lines.english: Ten years ago the factory's equipment was old, and one pair of shoes took a long time. Then we brought in new equipment; we get faster every year, and we have saved a lot of labour.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 不過我要強調，每一雙鞋子最後都要有人試穿、檢查過，穿起來舒服才賣。
lines.simplified: 不过我要强调，每一双鞋子最后都要有人试穿、检查过，穿起来舒服才卖。
lines.pinyin: Búguò wǒ yào qiángdiào, měi yì shuāng xiézi zuìhòu dōu yào yǒu rén shìchuān, jiǎnchá guo, chuān qǐlái shūfu cái mài.
lines.english: But I must stress that in the end every pair is tried on and checked by a person, and sold only when we are sure it is comfortable.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 等一下大家可以到二樓，自己試穿看看。
lines.simplified: 等一下大家可以到二楼，自己试穿看看。
lines.pinyin: Děng yíxià dàjiā kěyǐ dào èr lóu, zìjǐ shìchuān kànkan.
lines.english: In a moment you can go up to the second floor and try some on yourselves.

prompt.traditional: 工廠為什麼換了新的設備？
prompt.simplified: 工厂为什么换了新的设备？

prompt.english: Why did the factory get new equipment?

choices.speaker: N

choices.english: Checking by hand cost too much.

questions.why: Ten years ago the equipment was old and 做一雙鞋子要花很多時間; with the new equipment the speed went up year after year. The checking by people is still done, so it was not the reason for the change.

prompt.traditional: 工廠用了新設備以後，哪件事還是要人來做？
prompt.simplified: 工厂用了新设备以后，哪件事还是要人来做？

prompt.english: After the factory got new equipment, what still has to be done by people?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xuǎn chū zuìjiā de shèjì.
choices.english: Choosing the best design.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Ràng cānguān de rén chuānchuan kàn.

choices.simplified: 看每双穿起来舒服不舒服
choices.pinyin: Kàn měi shuāng chuān qǐlái shūfu bù shūfu.
choices.english: Checking whether each pair is comfortable to wear.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bǎ xiézi zuò de gèng kuài.
choices.english: Making shoes faster.

questions.why: The new equipment brought speed and saved labour (一年比一年快，也節省了不少人力), but after 不過 he says each pair is still tried on and checked by a person, 穿起來舒服才賣. The students trying shoes upstairs are visitors, not part of the checking, and nothing is said about design.

passage.traditional: {1}爸爸說不用送他禮物，今年他生日，我還是想送他一樣有用的東西。我發現他身上那條皮帶已經用了十幾年，旁邊都破了。所以我{2}請假，去{3}選皮帶。那裡的價錢比夜市高，可是品質比較好。我比較了好幾個牌子，最後選了一條咖啡色的。店員非常{4}，知道是要{5}的，就把皮帶包好，還送了一張卡片。爸爸打開外面漂亮的紙，馬上換上新皮帶。那條舊的，他第二天就把它{6}掉了。
passage.simplified: {1}爸爸说不用送他礼物，今年他生日，我还是想送他一样有用的东西。我发现他身上那条皮带已经用了十几年，旁边都破了。所以我{2}请假，去{3}选皮带。那里的价钱比夜市高，可是品质比较好。我比较了好几个牌子，最后选了一条咖啡色的。店员非常{4}，知道是要{5}的，就把皮带包好，还送了一张卡片。爸爸打开外面漂亮的纸，马上换上新皮带。那条旧的，他第二天就把它{6}掉了。
passage.pinyin: Jiùsuàn bàba shuō búyòng sòng tā lǐwù, jīnnián tā shēngrì, wǒ háishì xiǎng sòng tā yí yàng yǒuyòng de dōngxi. Wǒ fāxiàn tā shēnshàng nà tiáo pídài yǐjīng yòng le shí jǐ nián, pángbiān dōu pò le. Suǒyǐ wǒ tèdì qǐngjià, qù zhuānguì xuǎn pídài. Nàlǐ de jiàqián bǐ yèshì gāo, kěshì pǐnzhí bǐjiào hǎo. Wǒ bǐjiào le hǎo jǐ ge páizi, zuìhòu xuǎn le yì tiáo kāfēisè de. Diànyuán fēicháng tǐtiē, zhīdào shì yào sòng rén de, jiù bǎ pídài bāo hǎo, hái sòng le yì zhāng kǎpiàn. Bàba dǎkāi wàimiàn piàoliang de zhǐ, mǎshàng huàn shàng xīn pídài. Nà tiáo jiù de, tā dì èr tiān jiù bǎ tā rēngdiào le.
passage.english: Even though my father says there is no need to give him presents, this year for his birthday I still wanted to give him something useful. I noticed that the belt he wears had been in use for over ten years, and its edges were worn through. So I specially took time off and went to a department store counter to choose a belt. Prices there are higher than at the night market, but the quality is better. I compared several brands and chose a brown one. The clerk was very thoughtful: knowing it was a present, she wrapped the belt and added a card. My father opened the pretty paper on the outside and put on the new belt straight away. As for the old one, the next day he threw it away.

choices.english: even if

choices.pinyin: zhǐyào

choices.pinyin: yīnwèi
choices.english: because

choices.english: apart from

questions.why: Father says no presents, and the writer gives one all the same; 還是 shows the second clause goes against the first, which is what 就算……還是/也…… does. 只要 makes a condition and 因為 a reason, and neither fits a present given in spite of what he says.

choices.english: long since

choices.pinyin: yìzhí
choices.english: all along

questions.why: The time off was taken only to go and buy the belt: 特地請假. 順便 needs another errand the shopping is added to, and there is none; 早就 would say the leave was taken long ago, which nothing in the passage supports. 一直請假 would mean leave taken on and on, for a single shopping trip.

choices.pinyin: chāoshāng
choices.english: convenience store

choices.pinyin: shìchǎng
choices.english: market

choices.english: counter

questions.why: Any of the four could follow 去……選皮帶; the next sentences decide. The place costs more than a night market but has better quality, and a clerk wraps the present and adds a card: a department store 專櫃. A 地攤 or a 市場 is cheap like a night market, and an 超商 does not have a clerk who chooses belts with you and wraps them.

choices.pinyin: shízài

choices.english: nervous

questions.why: The clerk thinks of what the customer needs without being asked: it is a present, so she wraps it and adds a card. That is 體貼. 開朗 and 實在 describe her character or her prices, not this care, and being 緊張 would not make her wrap it and add a card.

choices.pinyin: sòng rén
choices.english: to give as a present

questions.why: The writer is buying a birthday present for father, and the clerk wraps the belt (包好) and adds a card: she knows it is 要送人的. Wrapping and a card do not go with exchanging goods, comparing prices or trying something out.

questions.why: With the giveaway gone, earlier lines decide: the old belt 旁邊都破了, so nobody would buy it (賣掉); and father put on the new one the moment he opened the present, so the old one was already taken off and replaced the day before (拿掉, 換掉). The next day he threw it away: 扔掉.

passage.traditional: 我姊姊買東西的{1}很好，朋友買衣服都愛請她看。她常說：「便宜的東西要是品質不好，壞了還得再買，花的錢更多，最後{2}的還是自己。」所以不管去地攤還是專櫃，她都會先比較價格跟品質。她選的東西不一定最便宜，但是都做得很{3}，用好幾年都不壞。我不像她，一看到打折就{4}地買，很多東西都沒用過，最後只好拿到網路上{5}，拿回的錢不到一半。其實這個道理我{6}知道了，只是一直做不到。
passage.simplified: 我姊姊买东西的{1}很好，朋友买衣服都爱请她看。她常说：「便宜的东西要是品质不好，坏了还得再买，花的钱更多，最后{2}的还是自己。」所以不管去地摊还是专柜，她都会先比较价格跟品质。她选的东西不一定最便宜，但是都做得很{3}，用好几年都不坏。我不像她，一看到打折就{4}地买，很多东西都没用过，最后只好拿到网路上{5}，拿回的钱不到一半。其实这个道理我{6}知道了，只是一直做不到。
passage.pinyin: Wǒ jiějie mǎi dōngxi de yǎnguāng hěn hǎo, péngyǒu mǎi yīfu dōu ài qǐng tā kàn. Tā cháng shuō: "Piányí de dōngxi yàoshì pǐnzhí bù hǎo, huài le hái děi zài mǎi, huā de qián gèng duō, zuìhòu chīkuī de háishì zìjǐ." Suǒyǐ bùguǎn qù dìtān háishì zhuānguì, tā dōu huì xiān bǐjiào jiàgé gēn pǐnzhí. Tā xuǎn de dōngxi bù yídìng zuì piányí, dànshì dōu zuò de hěn shízài, yòng hǎo jǐ nián dōu bú huài. Wǒ bú xiàng tā, yí kàndào dǎzhé jiù húlǐhútú de mǎi, hěn duō dōngxi dōu méi yòng guo, zuìhòu zhǐhǎo ná dào wǎnglù shàng màidiào, ná huí de qián bú dào yíbàn. Qíshí zhège dàolǐ wǒ zǎo jiù zhīdào le, zhǐshì yìzhí zuò bú dào.
passage.english: My older sister has a very good eye when she shops, and friends love to ask her to look when they buy clothes. She often says: "If something cheap is poor quality, when it breaks you have to buy it again and spend more, so in the end you are the one who loses out." So whether she is at a street stall or a department store counter, she first compares price and quality. What she picks is not always the cheapest, but it is always solidly made and lasts for years. I am not like her: the moment I see a sale I buy without thinking, many things are never used, and in the end I have to sell them online, getting back less than half the money. In fact I have known this for a long time; I just never manage to do it.

text.traditional: 去年夏天，家裡的冷氣壞了。爸爸沒有馬上買新的，而是先上網看了各家公司生產的冷氣，又跑了三家店比價。他說，冷氣這種設備一用就是十年，不僅要看價格，還要看用電多不多。第一家店的店員一直強調，他們的冷氣是今年賣得最好的，價錢也最便宜。可是爸爸仔細讀了商品說明，發現那台冷氣用電特別多。最後他買了別家公司的，雖然貴了三千塊，可是用電少得多。媽媽本來覺得爸爸太麻煩，買個冷氣也要跑來跑去。可是新冷氣用了一個夏天，電費比去年少了快一半，媽媽現在也常跟朋友說：「貨比三家，真的不吃虧。」
text.simplified: 去年夏天，家里的冷气坏了。爸爸没有马上买新的，而是先上网看了各家公司生产的冷气，又跑了三家店比价。他说，冷气这种设备一用就是十年，不仅要看价格，还要看用电多不多。第一家店的店员一直强调，他们的冷气是今年卖得最好的，价钱也最便宜。可是爸爸仔细读了商品说明，发现那台冷气用电特别多。最后他买了别家公司的，虽然贵了三千块，可是用电少得多。妈妈本来觉得爸爸太麻烦，买个冷气也要跑来跑去。可是新冷气用了一个夏天，电费比去年少了快一半，妈妈现在也常跟朋友说：「货比三家，真的不吃亏。」
text.pinyin: Qùnián xiàtiān, jiā lǐ de lěngqì huài le. Bàba méiyǒu mǎshàng mǎi xīn de, ér shì xiān shàngwǎng kàn le gè jiā gōngsī shēngchǎn de lěngqì, yòu pǎo le sān jiā diàn bǐjià. Tā shuō, lěngqì zhè zhǒng shèbèi yí yòng jiù shì shí nián, bù jǐn yào kàn jiàgé, hái yào kàn yòngdiàn duō bù duō. Dì yī jiā diàn de diànyuán yìzhí qiángdiào, tāmen de lěngqì shì jīnnián mài de zuì hǎo de, jiàqián yě zuì piányí. Kěshì bàba zǐxì dú le shāngpǐn shuōmíng, fāxiàn nà tái lěngqì yòngdiàn tèbié duō. Zuìhòu tā mǎi le bié jiā gōngsī de, suīrán guì le sānqiān kuài, kěshì yòngdiàn shǎo de duō. Māma běnlái juéde bàba tài máfán, mǎi ge lěngqì yě yào pǎo lái pǎo qù. Kěshì xīn lěngqì yòng le yí ge xiàtiān, diànfèi bǐ qùnián shǎo le kuài yíbàn, māma xiànzài yě cháng gēn péngyǒu shuō: "Huò bǐ sān jiā, zhēn de bù chīkuī."
text.english: Last summer our air conditioner broke. Dad did not buy a new one straight away; first he looked online at the air conditioners different companies make, then went round three shops comparing prices. He said a machine like an air conditioner is used for ten years once you have it, so you have to look not only at the price but also at how much electricity it uses. The clerk at the first shop kept stressing that their model was this year's best seller and also the cheapest. But Dad read the product information carefully and found that it used a great deal of electricity. In the end he bought another company's; it cost three thousand more, but used far less electricity. Mum had thought Dad was making too much fuss, running from shop to shop just to buy an air conditioner. But after one summer with the new one, the electricity bill was almost half of last year's, and now Mum often tells her friends: "Shop around, and you really don't lose out."

text.traditional: 我家附近每個星期六早上都有一個市場，幾十個攤販在那裡賣衣服、鞋子跟生活用品。大部分的攤販都很會推銷，客人一走到面前，就說自己的東西又便宜又好。只有一位賣包包的張太太不一樣。她不僅不會一直推銷，還會告訴客人，哪個包包的口袋容易破，哪個包包比較適合上班用。有人說她這樣做生意一定會吃虧，可是她說：「東西賣出去了，客人用得不開心，以後就不會再來了。」這幾年，張太太的客人一年比一年多，很多人還特地從別的地區來找她。我想，做生意跟做人一樣，實在比什麼都重要。
text.simplified: 我家附近每个星期六早上都有一个市场，几十个摊贩在那里卖衣服、鞋子跟生活用品。大部分的摊贩都很会推销，客人一走到面前，就说自己的东西又便宜又好。只有一位卖包包的张太太不一样。她不仅不会一直推销，还会告诉客人，哪个包包的口袋容易破，哪个包包比较适合上班用。有人说她这样做生意一定会吃亏，可是她说：「东西卖出去了，客人用得不开心，以后就不会再来了。」这几年，张太太的客人一年比一年多，很多人还特地从别的地区来找她。我想，做生意跟做人一样，实在比什么都重要。
text.pinyin: Wǒ jiā fùjìn měi ge xīngqíliù zǎoshàng dōu yǒu yí ge shìchǎng, jǐ shí ge tānfàn zài nàlǐ mài yīfu, xiézi gēn shēnghuó yòngpǐn. Dà bùfèn de tānfàn dōu hěn huì tuīxiāo, kèrén yì zǒu dào miànqián, jiù shuō zìjǐ de dōngxi yòu piányí yòu hǎo. Zhǐ yǒu yí wèi mài bāobāo de Zhāng tàitai bù yíyàng. Tā bù jǐn bú huì yìzhí tuīxiāo, hái huì gàosu kèrén, nǎ ge bāobāo de kǒudài róngyì pò, nǎ ge bāobāo bǐjiào shìhé shàngbān yòng. Yǒu rén shuō tā zhèyàng zuò shēngyì yídìng huì chīkuī, kěshì tā shuō: "Dōngxi mài chūqù le, kèrén yòng de bù kāixīn, yǐhòu jiù bú huì zài lái le." Zhè jǐ nián, Zhāng tàitai de kèrén yì nián bǐ yì nián duō, hěn duō rén hái tèdì cóng bié de dìqū lái zhǎo tā. Wǒ xiǎng, zuò shēngyì gēn zuò rén yíyàng, shízài bǐ shénme dōu zhòngyào.
text.english: Every Saturday morning there is a market near my home, where dozens of stallholders sell clothes, shoes and everyday things. Most of them are very good at selling: the moment a customer walks up, they say their goods are cheap and good. Only Mrs. Zhang, who sells bags, is different. Not only does she not keep pushing her goods, she also tells customers which bag has pockets that tear easily and which bag suits going to work. Some people say she is sure to lose out doing business like this, but she says: "If I sell something and the customer is unhappy using it, they won't come back." In the last few years Mrs. Zhang has had more customers every year, and many people even come specially from other areas to find her. I think that in business, as in life, honesty matters more than anything.

text.traditional: 以前我在網路上購物，都請人把東西送到家裡。可是我白天要上班，送貨的人常常找不到我。後來我改到超商拿，才發現這樣做的優點真不少。超商隨時都開，我下班經過的時候，就可以順便把東西拿回家。有一次，我買的上衣大小不合適，店員還教我用超商的服務把衣服寄回去，手續一點也不麻煩。當然，這種方式也有缺點：東西太大、太重的話，就不適合到超商拿，自己提回家挺辛苦的。所以現在除了冰箱、洗衣機這種大東西請人週末送到家裡以外，我買的東西都送到超商。
text.simplified: 以前我在网路上购物，都请人把东西送到家里。可是我白天要上班，送货的人常常找不到我。后来我改到超商拿，才发现这样做的优点真不少。超商随时都开，我下班经过的时候，就可以顺便把东西拿回家。有一次，我买的上衣大小不合适，店员还教我用超商的服务把衣服寄回去，手续一点也不麻烦。当然，这种方式也有缺点：东西太大、太重的话，就不适合到超商拿，自己提回家挺辛苦的。所以现在除了冰箱、洗衣机这种大东西请人周末送到家里以外，我买的东西都送到超商。
text.pinyin: Yǐqián wǒ zài wǎnglù shàng gòuwù, dōu qǐng rén bǎ dōngxi sòng dào jiā lǐ. Kěshì wǒ báitiān yào shàngbān, sònghuò de rén chángcháng zhǎo bú dào wǒ. Hòulái wǒ gǎi dào chāoshāng ná, cái fāxiàn zhèyàng zuò de yōudiǎn zhēn bù shǎo. Chāoshāng suíshí dōu kāi, wǒ xiàbān jīngguò de shíhòu, jiù kěyǐ shùnbiàn bǎ dōngxi ná huí jiā. Yǒu yí cì, wǒ mǎi de shàngyī dàxiǎo bù héshì, diànyuán hái jiāo wǒ yòng chāoshāng de fúwù bǎ yīfu jì huíqù, shǒuxù yìdiǎn yě bù máfán. Dāngrán, zhè zhǒng fāngshì yě yǒu quēdiǎn: dōngxi tài dà, tài zhòng dehuà, jiù bú shìhé dào chāoshāng ná, zìjǐ tí huí jiā tǐng xīnkǔ de. Suǒyǐ xiànzài chúle bīngxiāng, xǐyījī zhè zhǒng dà dōngxi qǐng rén zhōumò sòng dào jiā lǐ yǐwài, wǒ mǎi de dōngxi dōu sòng dào chāoshāng.
text.english: I used to have everything I bought online delivered to my home. But I work during the day, and the delivery people often could not find me in. Later I switched to picking things up at a convenience store, and found it has many advantages. The store is open at any hour, so when I pass it after work I can pick my things up on the way home. Once, a top I bought was the wrong size, and the clerk even showed me how to send it back using the store's service; the procedure was no trouble at all. Of course this way has drawbacks too: if something is too big or heavy, collecting it at the store does not suit, as carrying it home yourself is quite hard work. So now, apart from big things like fridges and washing machines, which I have delivered home at the weekend, everything I buy goes to the convenience store.

text.traditional: 我的朋友小美從小就喜歡畫衣服，她的夢想是有一家自己的服裝店。大學畢業以後，她沒有去公司上班，而是在網路上賣自己設計的衣服。她發現個子不高的女生很難買到合適的洋裝，就決定只設計給這些女生穿。剛開始，每個月只賣出幾件，家人都要她別再做了。她說：「就算現在賣得不多，我也想再試一年。再說，我還年輕，吃點苦沒關係。」後來，一位有名的演員穿了她設計的洋裝去參加婚禮，照片在網路上被很多人看到以後，她的生意一下子就好了起來。現在，她的店可以說是個子不高的女生最喜歡的服裝店。
text.simplified: 我的朋友小美从小就喜欢画衣服，她的梦想是有一家自己的服装店。大学毕业以后，她没有去公司上班，而是在网路上卖自己设计的衣服。她发现个子不高的女生很难买到合适的洋装，就决定只设计给这些女生穿。刚开始，每个月只卖出几件，家人都要她别再做了。她说：「就算现在卖得不多，我也想再试一年。再说，我还年轻，吃点苦没关系。」后来，一位有名的演员穿了她设计的洋装去参加婚礼，照片在网路上被很多人看到以后，她的生意一下子就好了起来。现在，她的店可以说是个子不高的女生最喜欢的服装店。
text.pinyin: Wǒ de péngyǒu Xiǎoměi cóngxiǎo jiù xǐhuān huà yīfu, tā de mèngxiǎng shì yǒu yì jiā zìjǐ de fúzhuāng diàn. Dàxué bìyè yǐhòu, tā méiyǒu qù gōngsī shàngbān, ér shì zài wǎnglù shàng mài zìjǐ shèjì de yīfu. Tā fāxiàn gèzi bù gāo de nǚshēng hěn nán mǎidào héshì de yángzhuāng, jiù juédìng zhǐ shèjì gěi zhèxiē nǚshēng chuān. Gāng kāishǐ, měi ge yuè zhǐ mài chū jǐ jiàn, jiārén dōu yào tā bié zài zuò le. Tā shuō: "Jiùsuàn xiànzài mài de bù duō, wǒ yě xiǎng zài shì yì nián. Zàishuō, wǒ hái niánqīng, chī diǎn kǔ méi guānxi." Hòulái, yí wèi yǒumíng de yǎnyuán chuān le tā shèjì de yángzhuāng qù cānjiā hūnlǐ, zhàopiàn zài wǎnglù shàng bèi hěn duō rén kàndào yǐhòu, tā de shēngyì yíxiàzi jiù hǎo le qǐlái. Xiànzài, tā de diàn kěyǐ shuō shì gèzi bù gāo de nǚshēng zuì xǐhuān de fúzhuāng diàn.
text.english: My friend Xiaomei has loved drawing clothes since she was little, and her dream was to have a clothes shop of her own. After university she did not go to work for a company; she sold clothes she designed online. She found that short women find it hard to buy dresses that fit, so she decided to design only for them. At first she sold only a few pieces a month, and her family all wanted her to stop. She said: "Even if I am not selling much now, I want to try for one more year. Besides, I am young, and a little hardship is fine." Later a well-known actress wore a dress she had designed to a wedding, and once many people saw the photos online her business suddenly took off. Now her shop could be called the favourite clothes shop of women who are not tall.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 聽說你姊姊生了一對雙胞胎，恭喜啊！你準備送什麼禮物？
lines.simplified: 听说你姊姊生了一对双胞胎，恭喜啊！你准备送什么礼物？
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō nǐ jiějie shēng le yí duì shuāngbāotāi, gōngxǐ a! Nǐ zhǔnbèi sòng shénme lǐwù?
lines.english: I hear your sister had twins. Congratulations! What are you going to give?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我本來想買兩雙小鞋子，可是看來看去，還是覺得送紅包最實在。
lines.simplified: 我本来想买两双小鞋子，可是看来看去，还是觉得送红包最实在。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ běnlái xiǎng mǎi liǎng shuāng xiǎo xiézi, kěshì kàn lái kàn qù, háishì juéde sòng hóngbāo zuì shízài.
lines.english: I first wanted to buy two pairs of little shoes, but after looking and looking, I still think a red envelope is the most practical.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 也好，孩子長得快，鞋子很快就穿不下了。
lines.simplified: 也好，孩子长得快，鞋子很快就穿不下了。
lines.pinyin: Yě hǎo, háizi zhǎng de kuài, xiézi hěn kuài jiù chuān bú xià le.
lines.english: That's fine too. Babies grow fast, and they soon grow out of their shoes.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的最後決定怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 男的最后决定怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de zuìhòu juédìng zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What does the man decide to do in the end?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Mǎi liǎng shuāng xiǎo xiézi.
choices.english: Buy two pairs of little shoes.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Sòng qián gěi jiějie.
choices.english: Give his sister money.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Mǎi dà yìdiǎn de xiézi.
choices.english: Buy bigger shoes.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Děng háizi zhǎngdà zài sòng.
choices.english: Wait until the babies grow up.

questions.why: 看來看去，還是覺得送紅包最實在: after looking around he decides on a red envelope, which means giving money. Two pairs of little shoes was his first plan; growing fast is the woman's reason why the red envelope is fine.

focus.zh: V 來 V 去，還是……

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你太太下個月要回去上班，孩子誰帶？
lines.simplified: 你太太下个月要回去上班，孩子谁带？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ tàitai xià ge yuè yào huíqù shàngbān, háizi shéi dài?
lines.english: Your wife goes back to work next month. Who will look after the baby?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 本來想請孩子的外婆來幫忙，可是她住得太遠。我們想來想去，還是決定讓我太太先在家帶孩子，帶到一歲。
lines.simplified: 本来想请孩子的外婆来帮忙，可是她住得太远。我们想来想去，还是决定让我太太先在家带孩子，带到一岁。
lines.pinyin: Běnlái xiǎng qǐng háizi de wàipó lái bāngmáng, kěshì tā zhù de tài yuǎn. Wǒmen xiǎng lái xiǎng qù, háishì juédìng ràng wǒ tàitai xiān zài jiā dài háizi, dài dào yí suì.
lines.english: At first we wanted to ask the baby's grandma to help, but she lives too far away. We thought it over and over, and still decided my wife will stay home first and look after the baby until he is one.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 也好，孩子這麼小，還要餵奶，媽媽跟孩子在一起最重要。
lines.simplified: 也好，孩子这么小，还要喂奶，妈妈跟孩子在一起最重要。
lines.pinyin: Yě hǎo, háizi zhème xiǎo, hái yào wèi nǎi, māma gēn háizi zài yìqǐ zuì zhòngyào.
lines.english: That's good too. The baby is so little and still needs feeding; it's most important for mother and baby to be together.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 他們最後決定怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 他们最后决定怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen zuìhòu juédìng zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What do they decide in the end?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qǐng wàipó lái jiā lǐ zhù.
choices.english: Ask the grandma to come and live with them.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bǎ háizi sòng dào wàipó jiā.
choices.english: Send the baby to the grandma's home.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tàitai xià ge yuè huíqù shàngbān.
choices.english: His wife will go back to work next month.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tàitai xiān bù huíqù shàngbān.
choices.english: His wife will not go back to work for now.

questions.why: 還是決定讓我太太先在家帶孩子: his wife stays home with the baby for now. Asking the grandma was the first plan, dropped because she lives too far away; going back next month was the old plan the woman asks about.

focus.zh: V 來 V 去，還是……

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 嗨，我住你們樓上。這幾天晚上常聽到你們的孩子哭個不停。
lines.simplified: 嗨，我住你们楼上。这几天晚上常听到你们的孩子哭个不停。
lines.pinyin: Hāi, wǒ zhù nǐmen lóushàng. Zhè jǐ tiān wǎnshàng cháng tīngdào nǐmen de háizi kū ge bù tíng.
lines.english: Hi, I live upstairs. These past few nights I've often heard your baby crying non-stop.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 真不好意思，吵到妳了，對不起。他白天很乖，不知道為什麼一到晚上就一直哭。
lines.simplified: 真不好意思，吵到你了，对不起。他白天很乖，不知道为什么一到晚上就一直哭。
lines.pinyin: Zhēn bù hǎoyìsi, chǎo dào nǐ le, duìbùqǐ. Tā báitiān hěn guāi, bù zhīdào wèishénme yí dào wǎnshàng jiù yìzhí kū.
lines.english: I'm really sorry we disturbed you. He's very good in the daytime; we don't know why he keeps crying as soon as night comes.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 沒關係，我不是來抱怨的。我養過兩個孩子，你們要是需要幫忙，可以來找我。
lines.simplified: 没关系，我不是来抱怨的。我养过两个孩子，你们要是需要帮忙，可以来找我。
lines.pinyin: Méi guānxi, wǒ bú shì lái bàoyuàn de. Wǒ yǎng guo liǎng ge háizi, nǐmen yàoshì xūyào bāngmáng, kěyǐ lái zhǎo wǒ.
lines.english: It's all right, I'm not here to complain. I've raised two children; if you need help, you can come to me.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的來找男的，主要是想說什麼？
prompt.simplified: 女的来找男的，主要是想说什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de lái zhǎo nán de, zhǔyào shì xiǎng shuō shénme?
prompt.english: What does the woman mainly want to tell the man?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā kěyǐ bāng tāmen de máng.
choices.english: She can give them a hand.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qǐng tāmen wǎnshàng xiǎoshēng yìdiǎn.
choices.english: She wants them to be quieter at night.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiǎng zhīdào háizi wèishénme kū.
choices.english: She wants to know why the baby cries.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qǐng tāmen dài háizi kàn yīshēng.
choices.english: She wants them to take the baby to a doctor.

questions.why: She hears the baby 哭個不停, which sounds like the start of a complaint, but then says 我不是來抱怨的 and offers help because she has raised two children (可以來找我). Asking them to be quieter is exactly what she says she is not there for.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我婆婆每天打電話來，一說就說個沒完，都是坐月子不能洗頭、不能吹風那些事。
lines.simplified: 我婆婆每天打电话来，一说就说个没完，都是坐月子不能洗头、不能吹风那些事。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ pópo měi tiān dǎ diànhuà lái, yì shuō jiù shuō ge méi wán, dōu shì zuòyuèzi bù néng xǐtóu, bù néng chuīfēng nàxiē shì.
lines.english: My mother-in-law phones every day, and once she starts she goes on and on, all about not washing your hair or going out in the wind while resting after the birth.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 她也是關心妳。不過現在醫生的說法跟以前很不一樣了。
lines.simplified: 她也是关心你。不过现在医生的说法跟以前很不一样了。
lines.pinyin: Tā yě shì guānxīn nǐ. Búguò xiànzài yīshēng de shuōfǎ gēn yǐqián hěn bù yíyàng le.
lines.english: She cares about you. But what doctors say now is very different from before.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我知道。我很尊敬她，不想讓她不高興，只好每次都說「好，我會注意」。
lines.simplified: 我知道。我很尊敬她，不想让她不高兴，只好每次都说「好，我会注意」。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zhīdào. Wǒ hěn zūnjìng tā, bù xiǎng ràng tā bù gāoxìng, zhǐhǎo měi cì dōu shuō "hǎo, wǒ huì zhùyì".
lines.english: I know. I respect her a lot and don't want to upset her, so every time I just say "OK, I'll be careful."

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的對婆婆的電話有什麼感覺？
prompt.simplified: 女的对婆婆的电话有什么感觉？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de duì pópo de diànhuà yǒu shénme gǎnjué?
prompt.english: How does the woman feel about her mother-in-law's calls?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Hěn gǎnxiè tā de guānxīn.
choices.english: She is grateful for her concern.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Hěn tóngyì tā de shuōfǎ.
choices.english: She agrees with what she says.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tīng de yǒu yìdiǎn lèi le.
choices.english: She is a bit tired of hearing it.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xīnlǐ yǒudiǎn shēngqì.
choices.english: She feels a bit angry.

questions.why: 說個沒完 is said of something that will not stop and that the speaker is tired of; she only says 好，我會注意 so as not to upset her. Caring is the man's view of the mother-in-law, and she respects her rather than feeling angry.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這個夜市的鞋子一雙比一雙便宜，我們多買幾雙吧！
lines.simplified: 这个夜市的鞋子一双比一双便宜，我们多买几双吧！
lines.pinyin: Zhège yèshì de xiézi yì shuāng bǐ yì shuāng piányí, wǒmen duō mǎi jǐ shuāng ba!
lines.english: The shoes at this night market are each pair cheaper than the last. Let's buy a few more pairs!

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 別再買了。上次妳在這裡買的兩雙，穿沒幾天就壞了，最後還不是都丟掉了。
lines.simplified: 别再买了。上次你在这里买的两双，穿没几天就坏了，最后还不是都丢掉了。
lines.pinyin: Bié zài mǎi le. Shàng cì nǐ zài zhèlǐ mǎi de liǎng shuāng, chuān méi jǐ tiān jiù huài le, zuìhòu hái bú shì dōu diūdiào le.
lines.english: Don't buy any more. The two pairs you bought here last time fell apart after only a few days of wear, and in the end didn't you throw them both away?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好吧，那我們去百貨公司看看。
lines.simplified: 好吧，那我们去百货公司看看。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo ba, nà wǒmen qù bǎihuò gōngsī kànkàn.
lines.english: All right, then let's go and look at the department store.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的為什麼不想讓女的買？
prompt.simplified: 男的为什么不想让女的买？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de wèishénme bù xiǎng ràng nǚ de mǎi?
prompt.english: Why doesn't the man want the woman to buy them?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiézi yì shuāng bǐ yì shuāng guì.
choices.english: The shoes get more expensive.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā yǐjīng mǎi tài duō shuāng le.
choices.english: She has already bought too many pairs.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bǎihuò gōngsī bǐjiào piányí.
choices.english: The department store is cheaper.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiézi de pǐnzhí bù hǎo.
choices.english: The shoes are poor quality.

questions.why: 穿沒幾天就壞了…都丟掉了: the shoes there fall apart quickly, so cheap is no bargain. The shoes get cheaper, not dearer, and going to the department store is her answer, not because it is cheaper.

focus.zh: 一 M 比一 M；別再……了；V 掉
focus.en: each more … than the last; stop …; V away

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你下班經過那家饅頭店的時候，順便幫我買兩個饅頭，好嗎？
lines.simplified: 你下班经过那家馒头店的时候，顺便帮我买两个馒头，好吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ xiàbān jīngguò nà jiā mántou diàn de shíhòu, shùnbiàn bāng wǒ mǎi liǎng ge mántou, hǎo ma?
lines.english: When you pass that steamed-bun shop after work, could you pick up two steamed buns for me?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那家店這個星期休息，老闆說下星期一才開。要不然我去超商幫妳買？
lines.simplified: 那家店这个星期休息，老板说下星期一才开。要不然我去超商帮你买？
lines.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn zhège xīngqí xiūxí, lǎobǎn shuō xià xīngqíyī cái kāi. Yàobùrán wǒ qù chāoshāng bāng nǐ mǎi?
lines.english: That shop is closed this week; the owner says it won't open until next Monday. Or shall I get some for you at the convenience store?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 算了，超商的不好吃。等它開門，我再自己去。
lines.simplified: 算了，超商的不好吃。等它开门，我再自己去。
lines.pinyin: Suàn le, chāoshāng de bù hǎochī. Děng tā kāimén, wǒ zài zìjǐ qù.
lines.english: Forget it, the convenience store ones aren't good. I'll go myself once it opens.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的最後決定怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 女的最后决定怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de zuìhòu juédìng zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What does the woman decide in the end?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xīngqíyī zài qù nà jiā diàn.
choices.english: Go to that shop on Monday.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Jīntiān qǐng nán de qù chāoshāng.
choices.english: Ask the man to go to the convenience store today.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qǐng nán de xiàbān shùnbiàn mǎi.
choices.english: Ask the man to buy them on his way home.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zhè xīngqí zìjǐ qù chāoshāng.
choices.english: Go to the convenience store herself this week.

questions.why: 算了 drops the convenience-store offer, and 等它開門 points back to the man's 下星期一才開: she will go to the bun shop herself on Monday. Picking them up on his way was her first request, and the convenience store was his offer, which she turns down.

focus.en: while you are at it; forget it

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你不是一直想當律師嗎？怎麼去報名表演課了？
lines.simplified: 你不是一直想当律师吗？怎么去报名表演课了？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ bú shì yìzhí xiǎng dāng lǜshī ma? Zěnme qù bàomíng biǎoyǎn kè le?
lines.english: Haven't you always wanted to be a lawyer? Why have you signed up for an acting class?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 當律師是我父母的夢想，不是我的。就算以後只能演小角色，我也想試試看。
lines.simplified: 当律师是我父母的梦想，不是我的。就算以后只能演小角色，我也想试试看。
lines.pinyin: Dāng lǜshī shì wǒ fùmǔ de mèngxiǎng, bú shì wǒ de. Jiùsuàn yǐhòu zhǐ néng yǎn xiǎo juésè, wǒ yě xiǎng shìshì kàn.
lines.english: Being a lawyer is my parents' dream, not mine. Even if I can only play small parts later, I still want to give it a try.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那你得先跟你父母說清楚。
lines.simplified: 那你得先跟你父母说清楚。
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐ děi xiān gēn nǐ fùmǔ shuō qīngchǔ.
lines.english: Then you need to make it clear to your parents first.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 男的是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the man mean?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā fùmǔ xīwàng tā dāng yǎnyuán.
choices.english: His parents want him to be an actor.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā xiǎng xiān dāng lǜshī zài yǎnxì.
choices.english: He wants to be a lawyer first, then act.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他已經演過重要的角色
choices.simplified: 他已经演过重要的角色
choices.pinyin: Tā yǐjīng yǎn guo zhòngyào de juésè.
choices.english: He has already played important roles.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他覺得角色小也沒關係
choices.simplified: 他觉得角色小也没关系
choices.pinyin: Tā juéde juésè xiǎo yě méi guānxi.
choices.english: He doesn't mind if his parts are small.

questions.why: 就算以後只能演小角色，我也想試試看: even if he only ever gets small parts, he wants to act. Being a lawyer is his parents' dream, the reverse of the second choice, and he has not acted yet.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 孩子下星期就滿月了，我們要送什麼給親人跟朋友？
lines.simplified: 孩子下星期就满月了，我们要送什么给亲人跟朋友？
lines.pinyin: Háizi xià xīngqí jiù mǎnyuè le, wǒmen yào sòng shénme gěi qīnrén gēn péngyǒu?
lines.english: The baby turns one month old next week. What shall we send to family and friends?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我媽媽說一定要送油飯跟紅蛋，這是傳統，也是感謝大家的祝福。
lines.simplified: 我妈妈说一定要送油饭跟红蛋，这是传统，也是感谢大家的祝福。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ māma shuō yídìng yào sòng yóufàn gēn hóngdàn, zhè shì chuántǒng, yě shì gǎnxiè dàjiā de zhùfú.
lines.english: My mom says we must send sticky rice and red eggs; it's tradition, and it thanks everyone for their good wishes.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 可是這一年同事的孩子滿月，送來的不是蛋糕，就是餅乾。現在很多人怕胖，不太吃油飯了。
lines.simplified: 可是这一年同事的孩子满月，送来的不是蛋糕，就是饼干。现在很多人怕胖，不太吃油饭了。
lines.pinyin: Kěshì zhè yì nián tóngshì de háizi mǎnyuè, sòng lái de bú shì dàngāo, jiùshì bǐnggān. Xiànzài hěn duō rén pà pàng, bú tài chī yóufàn le.
lines.english: But this year, whenever a colleague's baby turned one month, what they sent was either cake or cookies. Lots of people are afraid of putting on weight now and hardly eat sticky rice.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那我們兩種都準備吧：年紀大的親人送油飯跟紅蛋，年輕的朋友送蛋糕。
lines.simplified: 那我们两种都准备吧：年纪大的亲人送油饭跟红蛋，年轻的朋友送蛋糕。
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒmen liǎng zhǒng dōu zhǔnbèi ba: niánjì dà de qīnrén sòng yóufàn gēn hóngdàn, niánqīng de péngyǒu sòng dàngāo.
lines.english: Then let's prepare both: sticky rice and red eggs for the older relatives, cake for the young friends.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好！我們討論了一個星期，終於決定了。
lines.simplified: 好！我们讨论了一个星期，终于决定了。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo! Wǒmen tǎolùn le yí ge xīngqí, zhōngyú juédìng le.
lines.english: Great! We've talked about it for a week and finally decided.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 他們最後決定怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 他们最后决定怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen zuìhòu juédìng zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What do they decide in the end?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Dōu sòng yóufàn gēn hóngdàn.
choices.english: Send everyone sticky rice and red eggs.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Dōu sòng dàngāo gēn bǐnggān.
choices.english: Send everyone cake and cookies.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 送不同的人不同的東西
choices.simplified: 送不同的人不同的东西
choices.pinyin: Sòng bùtóng de rén bùtóng de dōngxi.
choices.english: Send different things to different people.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiān wèn dàjiā xiǎng chī shénme.
choices.english: First ask everyone what they want to eat.

questions.why: After a week of talking they 終於決定了 on the man's idea: the older relatives get sticky rice and red eggs, the young friends get cake. Sticky rice for all was his mother's view, cake and cookies what colleagues sent.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的為什麼提到同事？
prompt.simplified: 女的为什么提到同事？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de wèishénme tídào tóngshì?
prompt.english: Why does the woman mention her colleagues?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 說明現在送的東西變了
choices.simplified: 说明现在送的东西变了
choices.pinyin: Shuōmíng xiànzài sòng de dōngxi biàn le.
choices.english: To show that what people send has changed.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiǎng qǐng tóngshì lái chī yóufàn.
choices.english: She wants to invite her colleague for sticky rice.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 想問同事蛋糕在哪裡買
choices.simplified: 想问同事蛋糕在哪里买
choices.pinyin: Xiǎng wèn tóngshì dàngāo zài nǎlǐ mǎi.
choices.english: She wants to ask her colleague where to buy cake.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 同事的孩子也快滿月了
choices.simplified: 同事的孩子也快满月了
choices.pinyin: Tóngshì de háizi yě kuài mǎnyuè le.
choices.english: Her colleague's baby is also nearly one month old.

questions.why: Colleagues sent 不是蛋糕，就是餅乾, and she adds that many people now hardly eat sticky rice: the example shows that what people send has changed. Those babies have already turned one month, so none is nearly one month old.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 醫生說小美上星期就會生，可是她昨天終於生了！大家都等了好久。聽說母子平安。
lines.simplified: 医生说小美上星期就会生，可是她昨天终于生了！大家都等了好久。听说母子平安。
lines.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō Xiǎoměi shàng xīngqí jiù huì shēng, kěshì tā zuótiān zhōngyú shēng le! Dàjiā dōu děng le hǎojiǔ. Tīngshuō mǔzǐ píng'ān.
lines.english: The doctor said Xiaomei would give birth last week, and she finally did yesterday! Everyone had waited so long. I hear mother and son are both well.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 太好了！恭喜她！我們什麼時候去看她？我好想抱抱孩子。
lines.simplified: 太好了！恭喜她！我们什么时候去看她？我好想抱抱孩子。
lines.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Gōngxǐ tā! Wǒmen shénme shíhòu qù kàn tā? Wǒ hǎo xiǎng bàobào háizi.
lines.english: Wonderful! Congratulations to her! When shall we go and see her? I'd love to hold the baby.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 她婆婆說坐月子這段時間別讓客人去，怕孩子生病。
lines.simplified: 她婆婆说坐月子这段时间别让客人去，怕孩子生病。
lines.pinyin: Tā pópo shuō zuòyuèzi zhè duàn shíjiān bié ràng kèrén qù, pà háizi shēngbìng.
lines.english: Her mother-in-law says no visitors during the month of rest, in case the baby gets sick.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那我們先送雞湯過去吧，對身體恢復有幫助。
lines.simplified: 那我们先送鸡汤过去吧，对身体恢复有帮助。
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒmen xiān sòng jītāng guòqù ba, duì shēntǐ huīfù yǒu bāngzhù.
lines.english: Then let's send some chicken soup over first; it helps the body recover.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 不用了。她說她每天不是喝雞湯，就是喝魚湯，已經喝怕了。
lines.simplified: 不用了。她说她每天不是喝鸡汤，就是喝鱼汤，已经喝怕了。
lines.pinyin: Búyòng le. Tā shuō tā měi tiān bú shì hē jītāng, jiùshì hē yútāng, yǐjīng hē pà le.
lines.english: No need. She says every day it's either chicken soup or fish soup, and she's already sick of it.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那我送她幾本書。她這個月不能出門，在家一定很無聊。
lines.simplified: 那我送她几本书。她这个月不能出门，在家一定很无聊。
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒ sòng tā jǐ běn shū. Tā zhège yuè bù néng chūmén, zài jiā yídìng hěn wúliáo.
lines.english: Then I'll give her a few books. She can't go out this month, so she must be bored at home.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 從對話中，可以知道小美怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 从对话中，可以知道小美怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Cóng duìhuà zhōng, kěyǐ zhīdào Xiǎoměi zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: From the conversation, what can we learn about Xiaomei?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Shēng wán háizi shēntǐ bú tài hǎo.
choices.english: She is not well after the birth.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 孩子比大家想的晚出生
choices.simplified: 孩子比大家想的晚出生
choices.pinyin: Háizi bǐ dàjiā xiǎng de wǎn chūshēng.
choices.english: The baby came later than people expected.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bù xiǎng ràng péngyǒu bào háizi.
choices.english: She doesn't want friends to hold the baby.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Měi tiān zìjǐ zhǔ jītāng hē.
choices.english: She makes chicken soup for herself every day.

questions.why: 醫生說上星期就會生, but she 終於 gave birth only yesterday: the baby came later than expected. 母子平安 says both are well, and keeping visitors away is the mother-in-law's rule, not Xiaomei's wish.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的為什麼想送書給小美？
prompt.simplified: 女的为什么想送书给小美？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de wèishénme xiǎng sòng shū gěi Xiǎoměi?
prompt.english: Why does the woman want to give Xiaomei books?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiǎoměi yǐjīng hē tāng hē pà le.
choices.english: Xiaomei is already sick of soup.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiǎoměi de pópo bú ràng rén qù.
choices.english: Xiaomei's mother-in-law lets no one visit.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiǎoměi hěn xǐhuān yuèdú.
choices.english: Xiaomei loves reading.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiǎoměi zài jiā huì juéde wúliáo.
choices.english: Xiaomei will feel bored at home.

questions.why: She chooses books because 她這個月不能出門，在家一定很無聊. Being sick of soup is why they will not send soup, the mother-in-law's rule is why they cannot visit, and nobody says Xiaomei loves reading.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段留言，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段留言，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn liúyán, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a voice message, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 陳太太您好，這裡是安心醫院，恭喜您母子平安。下星期六上午十點，三樓有一堂課，是給第一次當父母的人上的。
lines.simplified: 陈太太您好，这里是安心医院，恭喜您母子平安。下星期六上午十点，三楼有一堂课，是给第一次当父母的人上的。
lines.pinyin: Chén tàitai nín hǎo, zhèlǐ shì Ānxīn Yīyuàn, gōngxǐ nín mǔzǐ píng'ān. Xià xīngqíliù shàngwǔ shí diǎn, sān lóu yǒu yì táng kè, shì gěi dì yī cì dāng fùmǔ de rén shàng de.
lines.english: Hello, Mrs. Chen, this is Anxin Hospital. Congratulations on you and your baby both being well. Next Saturday at 10 a.m. there is a class on the third floor for people becoming parents for the first time.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 很多人以為，孩子出生的第一個月，除了喝奶以外，就是睡覺，其實父母要學的事很多。
lines.simplified: 很多人以为，孩子出生的第一个月，除了喝奶以外，就是睡觉，其实父母要学的事很多。
lines.pinyin: Hěn duō rén yǐwéi, háizi chūshēng de dì yī ge yuè, chúle hē nǎi yǐwài, jiùshì shuìjiào, qíshí fùmǔ yào xué de shì hěn duō.
lines.english: Many people think that in a baby's first month, apart from drinking milk, all it does is sleep, but in fact parents have a lot to learn.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 上課的時候，醫生會仔細地教大家怎麼抱孩子、怎麼餵奶，也會說明坐月子的時候，什麼說法才是對的。
lines.simplified: 上课的时候，医生会仔细地教大家怎么抱孩子、怎么喂奶，也会说明坐月子的时候，什么说法才是对的。
lines.pinyin: Shàngkè de shíhòu, yīshēng huì zǐxì de jiāo dàjiā zěnme bào háizi, zěnme wèi nǎi, yě huì shuōmíng zuòyuèzi de shíhòu, shénme shuōfǎ cái shì duì de.
lines.english: In the class a doctor will carefully show everyone how to hold the baby and how to feed it, and will explain which of the things people say about the month of rest are right.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我們也希望您的先生能跟您一同來上課，這樣兩個人都會照顧孩子。下個月同樣的時間也有一堂。要報名的話，請在星期三以前回電話；有不清楚的地方，也歡迎問我們。
lines.simplified: 我们也希望您的先生能跟您一同来上课，这样两个人都会照顾孩子。下个月同样的时间也有一堂。要报名的话，请在星期三以前回电话；有不清楚的地方，也欢迎问我们。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen yě xīwàng nín de xiānshēng néng gēn nín yìtóng lái shàngkè, zhèyàng liǎng ge rén dōu huì zhàogù háizi. Xià ge yuè tóngyàng de shíjiān yě yǒu yì táng. Yào bàomíng de huà, qǐng zài xīngqísān yǐqián huí diànhuà; yǒu bù qīngchǔ de dìfāng, yě huānyíng wèn wǒmen.
lines.english: We also hope your husband can come to the class with you, so that both of you will know how to look after the baby. There is another class at the same time next month. To sign up, please call back before Wednesday; if anything is unclear, you are welcome to ask us.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 很多人覺得孩子出生的第一個月怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 很多人觉得孩子出生的第一个月怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Hěn duō rén juéde háizi chūshēng de dì yī ge yuè zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What do many people think a baby's first month is like?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Fùmǔ yào xué hěn duō shì.
choices.english: Parents have a lot to learn.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Háizi de shēnghuó hěn jiǎndān.
choices.english: The baby's life is very simple.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Māma zuìhǎo bié chūmén.
choices.english: The mother had better not go out.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Háizi zuì xūyào bàba.
choices.english: The baby needs its father most.

questions.why: 很多人以為……除了喝奶以外，就是睡覺: many people think a newborn only drinks milk and sleeps. That parents have a lot to learn is the hospital's own view (其實……), set against what many people think.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 醫院為什麼希望陳太太的先生也來？
prompt.simplified: 医院为什么希望陈太太的先生也来？
prompt.pinyin: Yīyuàn wèishénme xīwàng Chén tàitai de xiānshēng yě lái?
prompt.english: Why does the hospital want Mrs. Chen's husband to come too?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Ràng xiānshēng gēn yīshēng shuōmíng.
choices.english: So the husband can explain things to the doctor.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yīnwèi māma hái bù néng chūmén.
choices.english: Because the mother cannot go out yet.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 讓爸爸也學會照顧孩子
choices.simplified: 让爸爸也学会照顾孩子
choices.pinyin: Ràng bàba yě xuéhuì zhàogù háizi.
choices.english: So the father learns to look after the baby too.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yīnwèi kè zài xīngqíliù shàngwǔ.
choices.english: Because the class is on Saturday morning.

questions.why: 我們也希望您的先生能跟您一同來上課，這樣兩個人都會照顧孩子: the hospital wants both parents—including the father—to know how to look after the baby. It is the doctor who explains things, and the class time is only a detail of the message.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段介紹，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段介绍，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn jièshào, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to an introduction, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 各位好，今天要跟大家介紹臺灣人怎麼歡迎剛出生的孩子。
lines.simplified: 各位好，今天要跟大家介绍台湾人怎么欢迎刚出生的孩子。
lines.pinyin: Gèwèi hǎo, jīntiān yào gēn dàjiā jièshào Táiwān rén zěnme huānyíng gāng chūshēng de háizi.
lines.english: Hello, everyone. Today I'm going to introduce how people in Taiwan welcome a newborn baby.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 以前的媽媽生完孩子要坐月子，那一個月除了吃飯以外，就是在床上休息，好讓身體恢復。
lines.simplified: 以前的妈妈生完孩子要坐月子，那一个月除了吃饭以外，就是在床上休息，好让身体恢复。
lines.pinyin: Yǐqián de māma shēng wán háizi yào zuòyuèzi, nà yí ge yuè chúle chīfàn yǐwài, jiùshì zài chuáng shàng xiūxí, hǎo ràng shēntǐ huīfù.
lines.english: In the past, after giving birth a mother rested for a month; apart from eating, she spent that month resting in bed so her body could recover.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 孩子滿月那天，家人會送油飯跟紅蛋給親人跟朋友，送的紅蛋一般是雙數。
lines.simplified: 孩子满月那天，家人会送油饭跟红蛋给亲人跟朋友，送的红蛋一般是双数。
lines.pinyin: Háizi mǎnyuè nà tiān, jiārén huì sòng yóufàn gēn hóngdàn gěi qīnrén gēn péngyǒu, sòng de hóngdàn yìbān shì shuāngshù.
lines.english: On the day the baby turns one month old, the family sends sticky rice and red eggs to relatives and friends, usually an even number of red eggs.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 現在的年輕父母，習慣跟以前有不少差異，有的改送蛋糕，不過他們同樣希望讓大家知道孩子很平安，也感謝大家的祝福。
lines.simplified: 现在的年轻父母，习惯跟以前有不少差异，有的改送蛋糕，不过他们同样希望让大家知道孩子很平安，也感谢大家的祝福。
lines.pinyin: Xiànzài de niánqīng fùmǔ, xíguàn gēn yǐqián yǒu bù shǎo chāyì, yǒude gǎi sòng dàngāo, búguò tāmen tóngyàng xīwàng ràng dàjiā zhīdào háizi hěn píng'ān, yě gǎnxiè dàjiā de zhùfú.
lines.english: Young parents today have habits quite different from before, and some send cake instead, but they too want to let everyone know the baby is safe and well, and to thank everyone for their good wishes.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 以前的媽媽坐月子的時候怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 以前的妈妈坐月子的时候怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Yǐqián de māma zuòyuèzi de shíhòu zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What were mothers like during the month of rest in the past?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Měi tiān zhǔnbèi yóufàn gēn hóngdàn.
choices.english: She prepared sticky rice and red eggs every day.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Chángcháng qǐng qīnrén lái jiā lǐ.
choices.english: She often invited relatives home.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Gēn xiànzài de māma chàbùduō.
choices.english: She was much like mothers today.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Hěn shǎo xià chuáng zuò shì.
choices.english: She seldom got out of bed to do things.

questions.why: 除了吃飯以外，就是在床上休息: apart from meals she stayed in bed, so she seldom got up to do anything. Sticky rice, red eggs and relatives belong to the full-month day, and the speaker says young parents today differ (差異) from the past.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 說話的人覺得現在的父母跟以前有什麼相同的地方？
prompt.simplified: 说话的人觉得现在的父母跟以前有什么相同的地方？
prompt.pinyin: Shuōhuà de rén juéde xiànzài de fùmǔ gēn yǐqián yǒu shénme xiāngtóng de dìfāng?
prompt.english: What does the speaker think today's parents have in common with those of the past?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Dōu sòng yóufàn gēn hóngdàn.
choices.english: Both send sticky rice and red eggs.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 都想告訴大家孩子很好
choices.simplified: 都想告诉大家孩子很好
choices.pinyin: Dōu xiǎng gàosù dàjiā háizi hěn hǎo.
choices.english: Both want to tell everyone the baby is well.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Sòng de dàn dōu shì shuāngshù.
choices.english: Both send an even number of eggs.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Dōu yào xiūxí yí ge yuè.

questions.why: 他們同樣希望讓大家知道孩子很平安: young parents who send cake still share the news that the baby is well, just as families did with red eggs. Some no longer send sticky rice and eggs at all, so the egg choices are not shared.

passage.traditional: 我外婆做的菜樣樣都好吃，家人最喜歡的是她的醬料。上個月我請她教我，才明白沒那麼簡單。她說，醬油兩湯匙、{1}一湯匙，不多不少，放得{2}，味道才對。我在家做了好幾次，不是太鹹，就是太酸，後來就{3}到她家，請她看我怎麼做。她看了笑著說：「你加了檸檬汁吧？我{4}用檸檬汁，因為它的味道太重了。」原來我們的做法有這麼大的{5}。照她的方法再做一次以後，我{6}做出了跟她一樣的味道。

passage.pinyin: Wǒ wàipó zuò de cài yàngyàng dōu hǎochī, jiārén zuì xǐhuān de shì tā de jiàngliào. Shàng ge yuè wǒ qǐng tā jiāo wǒ, cái míngbái méi nàme jiǎndān. Tā shuō, jiàngyóu liǎng tāngchí, cù yì tāngchí, bù duō bù shǎo, fàng de gānggāng hǎo, wèidào cái duì. Wǒ zài jiā zuò le hǎo jǐ cì, bú shì tài xián, jiùshì tài suān, hòulái jiù tèdì dào tā jiā, qǐng tā kàn wǒ zěnme zuò. Tā kàn le xiàozhe shuō: "Nǐ jiā le níngméngzhī ba? Wǒ cóngbù yòng níngméngzhī, yīnwèi tā de wèidào tài zhòng le." Yuánlái wǒmen de zuòfǎ yǒu zhème dà de chāyì. Zhào tā de fāngfǎ zài zuò yí cì yǐhòu, wǒ zhōngyú zuò chū le gēn tā yíyàng de wèidào.
passage.english: Every dish my grandma makes is delicious, and the family's favourite is her sauce. Last month I asked her to teach me, and only then did I understand it isn't that simple. She said two tablespoons of soy sauce and one tablespoon of vinegar, no more and no less—only when put in just right is the taste right. I made it several times at home, and it was always either too salty or too sour, so I went to her place specially and asked her to watch me make it. She watched and laughed: "You added lemon juice, didn't you? I never use lemon juice, because its taste is too strong." So there was this big a difference between our ways of making it. After making it once more her way, I finally got the same taste as hers.

passage.traditional: 上個月室友住院了，我想帶一些水果去看她。在水果店，我本來想買梨子，因為她最愛吃梨子。老闆聽了，{1}告訴我：「去看病人，最好{2}送梨子，因為『梨』聽起來像『離開』的『離』。」我這才明白，{3}是水果，在不同的文化裡，意思也可能不一樣。後來我拿了五個蘋果，老闆又說，送病人的水果最好買{4}，我就多拿了一個，不多不少，剛好六個。室友聽我說了買水果的{5}，笑著說：「我是臺灣人，都沒有你這麼懂得{6}。」
passage.simplified: 上个月室友住院了，我想带一些水果去看她。在水果店，我本来想买梨子，因为她最爱吃梨子。老板听了，{1}告诉我：「去看病人，最好{2}送梨子，因为『梨』听起来像『离开』的『离』。」我这才明白，{3}是水果，在不同的文化里，意思也可能不一样。后来我拿了五个苹果，老板又说，送病人的水果最好买{4}，我就多拿了一个，不多不少，刚好六个。室友听我说了买水果的{5}，笑着说：「我是台湾人，都没有你这么懂得{6}。」
passage.pinyin: Shàng ge yuè shìyǒu zhùyuàn le, wǒ xiǎng dài yìxiē shuǐguǒ qù kàn tā. Zài shuǐguǒ diàn, wǒ běnlái xiǎng mǎi lízi, yīnwèi tā zuì ài chī lízi. Lǎobǎn tīng le, lìkè gàosù wǒ: "Qù kàn bìngrén, zuìhǎo bìmiǎn sòng lízi, yīnwèi 'lí' tīngqǐlái xiàng 'líkāi' de 'lí'." Wǒ zhè cái míngbái, tóngyàng shì shuǐguǒ, zài bùtóng de wénhuà lǐ, yìsi yě kěnéng bù yíyàng. Hòulái wǒ ná le wǔ ge píngguǒ, lǎobǎn yòu shuō, sòng bìngrén de shuǐguǒ zuìhǎo mǎi shuāngshù, wǒ jiù duō ná le yí ge, bù duō bù shǎo, gānghǎo liù ge. Shìyǒu tīng wǒ shuō le mǎi shuǐguǒ de jīngguò, xiàozhe shuō: "Wǒ shì Táiwān rén, dōu méiyǒu nǐ zhème dǒngde sònglǐ."
passage.english: Last month my roommate was in hospital, and I wanted to take some fruit to visit her. At the fruit shop I first wanted to buy pears, because she loves pears. When the owner heard this, he immediately told me: "When you visit a patient, you'd better avoid giving pears, because 'pear' (lí) sounds like the lí of 'to leave'." Only then did I understand that, though it is fruit all the same, its meaning can differ between cultures. Then I picked up five apples, and the owner added that fruit for a patient had better be bought in an even number, so I took one more: six, no more and no fewer. When my roommate heard how I had bought the fruit, she laughed and said: "I'm Taiwanese, and even I don't know as much as you about giving gifts."

text.traditional:
我是越南人，跟我先生結婚以後，就跟公公、婆婆住在一起。剛開始，我覺得孝順就是父母說什麼，孩子就做什麼，所以就算我有不同的想法，也從不表達出來。
去年我生了女兒。坐月子的時候，婆婆很重視我的營養，每天煮紅豆湯給我喝，可是她也說，這一個月裡不能洗頭。我忍耐了二十天，終於受不了，跟她吵了一架。後來我很難過，覺得自己不夠尊敬她，就向她道歉。婆婆聽了，拉著我的手說：「我也有不對的地方。我只是照我媽媽的說法做，沒想過現在跟以前已經不同了。」她的話真叫我感動，到現在都是我很珍貴的回憶。
那天以後，我們有不同的想法時，都會一起坐下來好好地談。現在我明白了，不同年代的人，想法本來就有差異，孝順不是什麼都不說；說出自己的想法，再跟家人一起思考怎麼做對大家都好，才是孝順。
text.simplified:
我是越南人，跟我先生结婚以后，就跟公公、婆婆住在一起。刚开始，我觉得孝顺就是父母说什么，孩子就做什么，所以就算我有不同的想法，也从不表达出来。
去年我生了女儿。坐月子的时候，婆婆很重视我的营养，每天煮红豆汤给我喝，可是她也说，这一个月里不能洗头。我忍耐了二十天，终于受不了，跟她吵了一架。后来我很难过，觉得自己不够尊敬她，就向她道歉。婆婆听了，拉着我的手说：「我也有不对的地方。我只是照我妈妈的说法做，没想过现在跟以前已经不同了。」她的话真叫我感动，到现在都是我很珍贵的回忆。
那天以后，我们有不同的想法时，都会一起坐下来好好地谈。现在我明白了，不同年代的人，想法本来就有差异，孝顺不是什么都不说；说出自己的想法，再跟家人一起思考怎么做对大家都好，才是孝顺。
text.pinyin: Wǒ shì Yuènán rén, gēn wǒ xiānshēng jiéhūn yǐhòu, jiù gēn gōnggōng, pópo zhù zài yìqǐ. Gāng kāishǐ, wǒ juéde xiàoshùn jiùshì fùmǔ shuō shénme, háizi jiù zuò shénme, suǒyǐ jiùsuàn wǒ yǒu bùtóng de xiǎngfǎ, yě cóngbù biǎodá chūlái. Qùnián wǒ shēng le nǚ'ér. Zuòyuèzi de shíhòu, pópo hěn zhòngshì wǒ de yíngyǎng, měi tiān zhǔ hóngdòu tāng gěi wǒ hē, kěshì tā yě shuō, zhè yí ge yuè lǐ bù néng xǐtóu. Wǒ rěnnài le èrshí tiān, zhōngyú shòubùliǎo, gēn tā chǎo le yí jià. Hòulái wǒ hěn nánguò, juéde zìjǐ búgòu zūnjìng tā, jiù xiàng tā dàoqiàn. Pópo tīng le, lāzhe wǒ de shǒu shuō: "Wǒ yě yǒu bú duì de dìfāng. Wǒ zhǐshì zhào wǒ māma de shuōfǎ zuò, méi xiǎng guo xiànzài gēn yǐqián yǐjīng bùtóng le." Tā de huà zhēn jiào wǒ gǎndòng, dào xiànzài dōu shì wǒ hěn zhēnguì de huíyì. Nà tiān yǐhòu, wǒmen yǒu bùtóng de xiǎngfǎ shí, dōu huì yìqǐ zuò xiàlái hǎohǎo de tán. Xiànzài wǒ míngbái le, bùtóng niándài de rén, xiǎngfǎ běnlái jiù yǒu chāyì, xiàoshùn bú shì shénme dōu bù shuō; shuō chū zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ, zài gēn jiārén yìqǐ sīkǎo zěnme zuò duì dàjiā dōu hǎo, cái shì xiàoshùn.
text.english:
I'm Vietnamese. After marrying my husband, I lived with his father and mother. At first I thought being a good daughter-in-law meant doing whatever the parents said, so even when I thought differently, I never expressed it.
Last year I had a daughter. During the month of rest my mother-in-law took my nutrition very seriously and made me red bean soup every day, but she also said I couldn't wash my hair that month. I put up with it for twenty days, finally couldn't stand it, and had a fight with her. Afterwards I felt terrible, thought I hadn't respected her enough, and apologized to her. My mother-in-law took my hand and said: "I was in the wrong too. I just did what my mother said, and never thought that things are different now." Her words really moved me, and they are still a precious memory to me.
Since that day, whenever we see things differently, we sit down together and talk it over properly. Now I understand: people of different eras naturally think differently, and filial respect is not keeping quiet about everything; saying what you think and then working out with your family what is best for everyone is what filial respect really is.

text.traditional:
我女兒快一歲了，平常很乖。我跟太太給她買了不少玩具，可是她每天最愛做的事，是把面紙一張一張地抽出來，一抽就抽個不停，一盒面紙一下子就沒了。太太本來想把面紙放到高的地方，我說：「她只是想知道盒子裡有什麼，就讓她玩吧。」
每天晚上睡覺以前，我會抱著她，一起看一本書。她還看不懂字，只是看圖，有時候還想把書放進嘴裡。朋友笑我說，這麼小的孩子，閱讀有什麼用？我想來想去，還是覺得這段時間最要緊的，不是她學會了什麼，是我們每天一同度過的時間。她長大以後，不會記得這些晚上，但是對我來說，這些都是最珍貴的回憶。
text.simplified:
我女儿快一岁了，平常很乖。我跟太太给她买了不少玩具，可是她每天最爱做的事，是把面纸一张一张地抽出来，一抽就抽个不停，一盒面纸一下子就没了。太太本来想把面纸放到高的地方，我说：「她只是想知道盒子里有什么，就让她玩吧。」
每天晚上睡觉以前，我会抱着她，一起看一本书。她还看不懂字，只是看图，有时候还想把书放进嘴里。朋友笑我说，这么小的孩子，阅读有什么用？我想来想去，还是觉得这段时间最要紧的，不是她学会了什么，是我们每天一同度过的时间。她长大以后，不会记得这些晚上，但是对我来说，这些都是最珍贵的回忆。
text.pinyin: Wǒ nǚ'ér kuài yí suì le, píngcháng hěn guāi. Wǒ gēn tàitai gěi tā mǎi le bù shǎo wánjù, kěshì tā měi tiān zuì ài zuò de shì, shì bǎ miànzhǐ yì zhāng yì zhāng de chōu chūlái, yì chōu jiù chōu ge bù tíng, yì hé miànzhǐ yíxiàzi jiù méi le. Tàitai běnlái xiǎng bǎ miànzhǐ fàng dào gāo de dìfāng, wǒ shuō: "Tā zhǐshì xiǎng zhīdào hézi lǐ yǒu shénme, jiù ràng tā wán ba." Měi tiān wǎnshàng shuìjiào yǐqián, wǒ huì bàozhe tā, yìqǐ kàn yì běn shū. Tā hái kàn bù dǒng zì, zhǐshì kàn tú, yǒu shíhòu hái xiǎng bǎ shū fàng jìn zuǐ lǐ. Péngyǒu xiào wǒ shuō, zhème xiǎo de háizi, yuèdú yǒu shénme yòng? Wǒ xiǎng lái xiǎng qù, háishì juéde zhè duàn shíjiān zuì yàojǐn de, bú shì tā xuéhuì le shénme, shì wǒmen měi tiān yìtóng dùguò de shíjiān. Tā zhǎngdà yǐhòu, bú huì jìde zhèxiē wǎnshàng, dànshì duì wǒ lái shuō, zhèxiē dōu shì zuì zhēnguì de huíyì.
text.english:
My daughter is almost one and is usually very good. My wife and I have bought her plenty of toys, but what she loves doing most every day is pulling tissues out one by one; once she starts she won't stop, and a whole box of tissues is gone in no time. My wife wanted to put the tissues somewhere high, but I said: "She just wants to know what's in the box. Let her play."
Every night before bed I hold her and we look at a book together. She can't read the words yet; she only looks at the pictures, and sometimes she tries to put the book in her mouth. A friend laughed at me: what's the use of reading for such a small child? I've thought about it over and over, and I still think what matters most in this time is not what she learns, but the time we spend together every day. When she grows up she won't remember these evenings, but to me they are the most precious memories.

text.traditional:
我姊姊生了一對雙胞胎以後，買東西變得特別小心。孩子一天比一天大，衣服常常穿不到兩個月就太緊了。為了節省，她每次購物以前，都會先上網比價，把每一家的價錢記清楚，再去地攤和百貨公司看看。
她說，地攤的衣服雖然便宜，可是有的洗一次就破了，只好丟掉，錢也就白花了。百貨公司的專櫃雖然貴一點，但是常有優惠，而且七天以內，覺得不合適，還可以拿發票去換。我以前笑她太怕吃虧，後來才明白，她要的不是最便宜的東西，是品質好、價錢也實在的東西。她常說：「貨比三家不吃虧，不僅省錢，也省了以後再買的時間。」
text.simplified:
我姊姊生了一对双胞胎以后，买东西变得特别小心。孩子一天比一天大，衣服常常穿不到两个月就太紧了。为了节省，她每次购物以前，都会先上网比价，把每一家的价钱记清楚，再去地摊和百货公司看看。
她说，地摊的衣服虽然便宜，可是有的洗一次就破了，只好丢掉，钱也就白花了。百货公司的专柜虽然贵一点，但是常有优惠，而且七天以内，觉得不合适，还可以拿发票去换。我以前笑她太怕吃亏，后来才明白，她要的不是最便宜的东西，是品质好、价钱也实在的东西。她常说：「货比三家不吃亏，不仅省钱，也省了以后再买的时间。」
text.pinyin: Wǒ jiějie shēng le yí duì shuāngbāotāi yǐhòu, mǎi dōngxi biàn de tèbié xiǎoxīn. Háizi yì tiān bǐ yì tiān dà, yīfu chángcháng chuān bú dào liǎng ge yuè jiù tài jǐn le. Wèile jiéshěng, tā měi cì gòuwù yǐqián, dōu huì xiān shàngwǎng bǐjià, bǎ měi yì jiā de jiàqián jì qīngchǔ, zài qù dìtān hàn bǎihuò gōngsī kànkàn. Tā shuō, dìtān de yīfu suīrán piányí, kěshì yǒude xǐ yí cì jiù pò le, zhǐhǎo diūdiào, qián yě jiù bái huā le. Bǎihuò gōngsī de zhuānguì suīrán guì yìdiǎn, dànshì cháng yǒu yōuhuì, érqiě qī tiān yǐnèi, juéde bù héshì, hái kěyǐ ná fāpiào qù huàn. Wǒ yǐqián xiào tā tài pà chīkuī, hòulái cái míngbái, tā yào de bú shì zuì piányí de dōngxi, shì pǐnzhí hǎo, jiàqián yě shízài de dōngxi. Tā cháng shuō: "Huò bǐ sān jiā bù chīkuī, bùjǐn shěng qián, yě shěng le yǐhòu zài mǎi de shíjiān."
text.english:
After my sister had twins, she became especially careful about shopping. The babies grow bigger day by day, and clothes are often too tight before two months are up. To save money, before every shopping trip she first compares prices online and notes each shop's prices clearly, then looks at street stalls and department stores.
She says street-stall clothes are cheap, but some tear after one wash and have to be thrown away, so the money is simply wasted. Department-store counters are a bit dearer, but they often have discounts, and within seven days, if something doesn't fit, you can take the receipt and exchange it. I used to laugh at her for being afraid of losing out, but later I understood: what she wants is not the cheapest thing, but something of good quality at an honest price. She often says: "Shop around and you won't lose out: it saves not only money, but also the time of buying again later."
