text.traditional:
我外公年輕的時候長得又高大又英俊，很多人說他可以當演員，可是他的夢想是當導演。後來他因為家裡沒有錢而早早開始工作，沒有機會去學拍電影。他常說：「就算當不了導演，我也不會忘了這個夢想。」
去年我生了兒子，外公高興極了。他每個週末都來我家，用手機拍我兒子，還自己寫劇本，讓家裡的人來演。我先生演警察，我演小偷，兒子當然演最重要的角色，外婆就是我們最好的觀眾。每次大家都演到笑個不停，外公就說，這比當大導演還開心。
現在，外公拍的影片已經有二十多部了。他說，等我兒子長大，要把這些影片送給他，讓他知道，小時候有多少人愛他。
text.simplified:
我外公年轻的时候长得又高大又英俊，很多人说他可以当演员，可是他的梦想是当导演。后来他因为家里没有钱而早早开始工作，没有机会去学拍电影。他常说：「就算当不了导演，我也不会忘了这个梦想。」
去年我生了儿子，外公高兴极了。他每个周末都来我家，用手机拍我儿子，还自己写剧本，让家里的人来演。我先生演警察，我演小偷，儿子当然演最重要的角色，外婆就是我们最好的观众。每次大家都演到笑个不停，外公就说，这比当大导演还开心。
现在，外公拍的影片已经有二十多部了。他说，等我儿子长大，要把这些影片送给他，让他知道，小时候有多少人爱他。
text.pinyin: Wǒ wàigōng niánqīng de shíhòu zhǎng de yòu gāodà yòu yīngjùn, hěn duō rén shuō tā kěyǐ dāng yǎnyuán, kěshì tā de mèngxiǎng shì dāng dǎoyǎn. Hòulái tā yīnwèi jiā lǐ méiyǒu qián ér zǎozǎo kāishǐ gōngzuò, méiyǒu jīhuì qù xué pāi diànyǐng. Tā cháng shuō: "Jiùsuàn dāng bù liǎo dǎoyǎn, wǒ yě bú huì wàng le zhège mèngxiǎng." Qùnián wǒ shēng le érzi, wàigōng gāoxìng jí le. Tā měi ge zhōumò dōu lái wǒ jiā, yòng shǒujī pāi wǒ érzi, hái zìjǐ xiě jùběn, ràng jiā lǐ de rén lái yǎn. Wǒ xiānshēng yǎn jǐngchá, wǒ yǎn xiǎotōu, érzi dāngrán yǎn zuì zhòngyào de juésè, wàipó jiùshì wǒmen zuì hǎo de guānzhòng. Měi cì dàjiā dōu yǎn dào xiào ge bù tíng, wàigōng jiù shuō, zhè bǐ dāng dà dǎoyǎn hái kāixīn. Xiànzài, wàigōng pāi de yǐngpiàn yǐjīng yǒu èrshí duō bù le. Tā shuō, děng wǒ érzi zhǎngdà, yào bǎ zhèxiē yǐngpiàn sòng gěi tā, ràng tā zhīdào, xiǎo shíhòu yǒu duōshǎo rén ài tā.
text.english:
When my grandfather was young he was tall and handsome, and many people said he could be an actor, but his dream was to be a film director. Later, because his family had no money, he started work early and never had the chance to learn filmmaking. He often said: "Even if I can't be a director, I won't forget this dream."
Last year I had a son, and my grandfather was overjoyed. Every weekend he comes to our home, films my son on his phone, and even writes scripts for the family to act. My husband plays a policeman, I play a thief, my son of course plays the most important part, and my grandmother is our best audience. Every time we act until we cannot stop laughing, my grandfather says this is more fun than being a big-name director.
Now he has made more than twenty films. He says that when my son grows up, he will give him these films, so he knows how many people loved him when he was little.

choices.pinyin: Dàjiā yào huí jiàoshì shàngkè.
choices.english: Everyone has to go back to class.

questions.why: She fears another quake and tells him to wait until the building is checked (你還是等……再上去拿吧): going up now is not safe. She says the report can be a little late, not that it is cancelled, and the teacher told everyone to stay on the field.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我們這棟樓一連停了兩天水，我連衣服都沒辦法洗，廚房的螞蟻也越來越多。
lines.simplified: 我们这栋楼一连停了两天水，我连衣服都没办法洗，厨房的蚂蚁也越来越多。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen zhè dòng lóu yìlián tíng le liǎng tiān shuǐ, wǒ lián yīfú dōu méi bànfǎ xǐ, chúfáng de mǎyǐ yě yuè lái yuè duō.
lines.english: Our building has had no water for two days in a row. I can't even wash my clothes, and there are more and more ants in the kitchen.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 大樓的管理人員說，屋頂上送水的設備被颱風吹壞了，今天下午就會有人來修。
lines.simplified: 大楼的管理人员说，屋顶上送水的设备被台风吹坏了，今天下午就会有人来修。
lines.pinyin: Dàlóu de guǎnlǐ rényuán shuō, wūdǐng shàng sòng shuǐ de shèbèi bèi táifēng chuī huài le, jīntiān xiàwǔ jiù huì yǒu rén lái xiū.
lines.english: The building manager says the water equipment on the roof was broken by the typhoon, and someone will come to fix it this afternoon.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 他昨天也是這麼說的。
lines.simplified: 他昨天也是这么说的。
lines.pinyin: Tā zuótiān yě shì zhème shuō de.
lines.english: That's what he said yesterday too.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 男的是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the man mean?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā pà jīntiān yě xiū bù hǎo.
choices.english: He fears it won't be fixed today either.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Shèbèi zuótiān jiù xiū hǎo le.
choices.english: The equipment was fixed yesterday.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tāmen cái tíng le yì tiān shuǐ.
choices.english: They have only been without water for one day.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā yào zìjǐ zhǎo rén lái xiū.
choices.english: He will find someone to fix it himself.

questions.why: The building manager promised the same thing yesterday and the water has now been off two days in a row (一連停了兩天水), so the man doubts today's promise. The equipment was not fixed yesterday, the cut is two days, not one, and he does not say he will find his own repairman.

focus.en: in a row; what the speaker means

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你家門口那棵大樹怎麼不見了？
lines.simplified: 你家门口那棵大树怎么不见了？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ jiā ménkǒu nà kē dà shù zěnme bú jiàn le?
lines.english: What happened to the big tree outside your door?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 上個月一連來了兩個颱風。第一個來的時候，它還好好的；第二個一來，就被吹倒了，還把旁邊的路燈弄壞了。
lines.simplified: 上个月一连来了两个台风。第一个来的时候，它还好好的；第二个一来，就被吹倒了，还把旁边的路灯弄坏了。
lines.pinyin: Shàng ge yuè yìlián lái le liǎng ge táifēng. Dì yī ge lái de shíhòu, tā hái hǎohǎo de; dì èr ge yì lái, jiù bèi chuī dǎo le, hái bǎ pángbiān de lùdēng nòng huài le.
lines.english: Last month two typhoons came one after the other. When the first came, it was still fine; as soon as the second arrived, it was blown over and broke the street lamp next to it.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 真可惜，這附近的樹木本來就不多，以前夏天大家都在那棵樹底下聊天。
lines.simplified: 真可惜，这附近的树木本来就不多，以前夏天大家都在那棵树底下聊天。
lines.pinyin: Zhēn kěxí, zhè fùjìn de shùmù běnlái jiù bù duō, yǐqián xiàtiān dàjiā dōu zài nà kē shù dǐxià liáotiān.
lines.english: What a pity. There weren't many trees round here to begin with, and in summer everyone used to chat under that one.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 聽說社區明年會再種一棵。
lines.simplified: 听说社区明年会再种一棵。
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō shèqū míngnián huì zài zhòng yì kē.
lines.english: I hear the neighbourhood will plant another one next year.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 下面哪一個是對的？
prompt.simplified: 下面哪一个是对的？
prompt.pinyin: Xiàmiàn nǎ yí ge shì duì de?
prompt.english: Which of the following is true?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 第一個颱風來時就倒了
choices.simplified: 第一个台风来时就倒了
choices.pinyin: Dì yī ge táifēng lái shí jiù dǎo le.
choices.english: It fell when the first typhoon came.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Dǎo de shíhòu méi nòng huài dōngxi.
choices.english: It broke nothing when it fell.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 以前很少人在樹下聊天
choices.simplified: 以前很少人在树下聊天
choices.pinyin: Yǐqián hěn shǎo rén zài shù xià liáotiān.
choices.english: Few people used to chat under it.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 附近的樹木變得更少了
choices.simplified: 附近的树木变得更少了
choices.pinyin: Fùjìn de shùmù biàn de gèng shǎo le.
choices.english: There are now even fewer trees nearby.

questions.why: The woman says there were few trees round here to begin with (本來就不多), and now the big one is gone and the new one will only come next year: there are even fewer. It stood through the first typhoon and fell in the second (一連來了兩個……第二個一來), it broke the street lamp, and everyone used to chat under it.

focus.en: in a row; putting two turns together

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 颱風天不能出門，你這兩天都在家做什麼？
lines.simplified: 台风天不能出门，你这两天都在家做什么？
lines.pinyin: Táifēng tiān bù néng chūmén, nǐ zhè liǎng tiān dōu zài jiā zuò shénme?
lines.english: You can't go out in a typhoon. What have you been doing at home these two days?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 不是看電視，就是玩手機。本來想整理房間，想來想去，還是等颱風走了再說吧。
lines.simplified: 不是看电视，就是玩手机。本来想整理房间，想来想去，还是等台风走了再说吧。
lines.pinyin: Bú shì kàn diànshì, jiù shì wán shǒujī. Běnlái xiǎng zhěnglǐ fángjiān, xiǎng lái xiǎng qù, háishì děng táifēng zǒu le zài shuō ba.
lines.english: If I'm not watching TV, I'm on my phone. I meant to tidy my room, but after thinking it over, I'll leave it until the typhoon has gone.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我看你本來就不打算整理吧。
lines.simplified: 我看你本来就不打算整理吧。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ kàn nǐ běnlái jiù bù dǎsuàn zhěnglǐ ba.
lines.english: I think you never meant to tidy up in the first place.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的覺得男的為什麼還沒整理房間？
prompt.simplified: 女的觉得男的为什么还没整理房间？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de juéde nán de wèishénme hái méi zhěnglǐ fángjiān?
prompt.english: Why does the woman think the man hasn't tidied his room yet?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Táifēng tiān bú shìhé zhěnglǐ.
choices.english: A typhoon day is no time for tidying.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā máng zhe kàn diànshì wán shǒujī.
choices.english: He is busy with TV and his phone.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā qíshí zhǐshì bù xiǎng zhěnglǐ.
choices.english: He simply doesn't want to.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他要等颱風來了再整理
choices.simplified: 他要等台风来了再整理
choices.pinyin: Tā yào děng táifēng lái le zài zhěnglǐ.
choices.english: He will tidy once the typhoon arrives.

questions.why: 我看你本來就不打算整理吧: she thinks waiting for the typhoon to pass is only an excuse, so in her eyes he simply does not want to tidy up. Waiting for the typhoon is his own reason, which she rejects; TV and the phone are what he has been doing, not why in her eyes; and he said he would wait until the typhoon has gone (走了), not come.

focus.zh: 不是……，就是……；說話人的意思
focus.en: if not…, then…; what the speaker means

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我要去超商買電池，要不要順便幫妳買什麼？
lines.simplified: 我要去超商买电池，要不要顺便帮你买什么？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yào qù chāoshāng mǎi diànchí, yào bú yào shùnbiàn bāng nǐ mǎi shénme?
lines.english: I'm going to the convenience store for batteries. Shall I get you anything while I'm there?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 不用了，水跟電池我早就準備好了。你家有收音機嗎？萬一停電，就只能聽廣播了。
lines.simplified: 不用了，水跟电池我早就准备好了。你家有收音机吗？万一停电，就只能听广播了。
lines.pinyin: Búyòng le, shuǐ gēn diànchí wǒ zǎo jiù zhǔnbèi hǎo le. Nǐ jiā yǒu shōuyīnjī ma? Wànyī tíngdiàn, jiù zhǐ néng tīng guǎngbò le.
lines.english: No need. I got water and batteries ready long ago. Do you have a radio at home? If the power goes, the radio will be all you have.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 沒有。算了，用手機聽也好。
lines.simplified: 没有。算了，用手机听也好。
lines.pinyin: Méiyǒu. Suànle, yòng shǒujī tīng yěhǎo.
lines.english: No. Never mind, the phone will do.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 停電的時候，手機也會沒電啊。
lines.simplified: 停电的时候，手机也会没电啊。
lines.pinyin: Tíngdiàn de shíhòu, shǒujī yě huì méi diàn a.
lines.english: When the power is out, your phone runs flat too.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的最後說的話是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 女的最后说的话是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de zuìhòu shuō de huà shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the woman mean by her last remark?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiǎng qǐng nán de bāng tā mǎi diànchí.
choices.english: She wants him to buy her batteries.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 停電久了手機也不能用
choices.simplified: 停电久了手机也不能用
choices.pinyin: Tíngdiàn jiǔ le shǒujī yě bù néng yòng.
choices.english: In a long power cut the phone won't work either.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 男的手機已經快沒電了
choices.simplified: 男的手机已经快没电了
choices.pinyin: Nán de shǒujī yǐjīng kuài méi diàn le.
choices.english: The man's phone is already nearly flat.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā jiālǐ méiyǒu shōuyīnjī.
choices.english: She has no radio at home.

questions.why: He plans to use his phone for the news instead of a radio; she points out that with no power the phone cannot be charged, so it will not last: he should get a radio. She already has batteries (早就準備好了), she never says his phone is low now, and it is he who has no radio.

focus.en: long ago; what the speaker means

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳上個週末去哪裡了？打電話都找不到妳。
lines.simplified: 你上个周末去哪里了？打电话都找不到你。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ shàng ge zhōumò qù nǎlǐ le? Dǎ diànhuà dōu zhǎo bú dào nǐ.
lines.english: Where were you last weekend? I couldn't reach you by phone.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我跟同學帶水跟食物去南部山區救災。那裡一連下了三天大雨，發生了很嚴重的水災。
lines.simplified: 我跟同学带水跟食物去南部山区救灾。那里一连下了三天大雨，发生了很严重的水灾。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ gēn tóngxué dài shuǐ gēn shíwù qù nánbù shānqū jiùzāi. Nàlǐ yìlián xià le sān tiān dàyǔ, fāshēng le hěn yánzhòng de shuǐzāi.
lines.english: I took water and food with some classmates to the mountains in the south to help after the disaster. It rained hard there for three days in a row, and there was a serious flood.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 你們怎麼把東西送過去的？
lines.simplified: 你们怎么把东西送过去的？
lines.pinyin: Nǐmen zěnme bǎ dōngxi sòng guòqù de?
lines.english: How did you get supplies there?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我們本來要開卡車把東西送上山，結果路上都是大石頭，車子過不去，只好在山下把東西發給走下來的災民。
lines.simplified: 我们本来要开卡车把东西送上山，结果路上都是大石头，车子过不去，只好在山下把东西发给走下来的灾民。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen běnlái yào kāi kǎchē bǎ dōngxi sòng shàng shān, jiéguǒ lù shàng dōu shì dà shítou, chēzi guò bú qù, zhǐhǎo zài shān xià bǎ dōngxi fā gěi zǒu xiàlái de zāimín.
lines.english: We meant to drive the supplies up the mountain in a truck, but in the end the road was covered in big rocks and the truck couldn't get through, so we handed the supplies out at the foot of the mountain to the victims who walked down.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那山上的人怎麼辦？
lines.simplified: 那山上的人怎么办？
lines.pinyin: Nà shān shàng de rén zěnme bàn?
lines.english: Then what about the people up the mountain?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 第二天軍隊把路打通了，我們才把剩下的東西送進災區。
lines.simplified: 第二天军队把路打通了，我们才把剩下的东西送进灾区。
lines.pinyin: Dì èr tiān jūnduì bǎ lù dǎtōng le, wǒmen cái bǎ shèngxià de dōngxi sòng jìn zāiqū.
lines.english: The next day the army reopened the road, and only then could we take the rest into the disaster area.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 真辛苦！以後還需要人幫忙的話，有力出力嘛。
lines.simplified: 真辛苦！以后还需要人帮忙的话，有力出力嘛。
lines.pinyin: Zhēn xīnkǔ! Yǐhòu hái xūyào rén bāngmáng de huà, yǒu lì chū lì ma.
lines.english: That must have been hard! If people are needed again some time, those who can help should help.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 第一天，他們帶去的水跟食物後來怎麼了？
prompt.simplified: 第一天，他们带去的水跟食物后来怎么了？
prompt.pinyin: Dì yī tiān, tāmen dài qù de shuǐ gēn shíwù hòulái zěnme le?
prompt.english: On the first day, what happened to the water and food they took?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yòng kǎchē sòng shàng shān le.
choices.english: It was driven up the mountain by truck.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Jiāo gěi jūnrén sòng shàng shān.
choices.english: It was given to soldiers to take up.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zài shān xià jiāo gěi le zāimín.
choices.english: It was handed to victims at the foot of the mountain.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yòu dài huí xuéxiào qù le.
choices.english: It was taken back to school.

questions.why: 本來 is the plan (drive it up the mountain) and 結果 gives what really happened that day: the rocks blocked the road, so they gave the supplies out below. The army only cleared the road the next day, and then the students took the rest in themselves.

focus.en: meant to…, but in the end…

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的最後一句話是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 男的最后一句话是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de zuìhòu yí jù huà shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the man mean by his last line?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā yǐhòu yě yuànyì qù bāngmáng
choices.english: He is willing to go and help too next time

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā xiǎng sòng shuǐ gēn shíwù shàng shān
choices.english: He wants to take water and food up the mountain

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他覺得軍隊應該早點來
choices.simplified: 他觉得军队应该早点来
choices.pinyin: Tā juéde jūnduì yīnggāi zǎo diǎn lái
choices.english: He thinks the army should have come sooner

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā juéde nǚ de tài xīnkǔ le
choices.english: He thinks the woman worked too hard

questions.why: 以後還需要人幫忙的話，有力出力嘛: if people are needed again, he will give his effort too, so he is offering to go next time. Taking supplies up the mountain is what the students did, not his plan; he never blames the army; and 真辛苦 is only sympathy, said before his real point.

focus.en: to pitch in; what the speaker means

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你看新聞了嗎？昨天的地震規模六點二，好多地方都有災情。
lines.simplified: 你看新闻了吗？昨天的地震规模六点二，好多地方都有灾情。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ kàn xīnwén le ma? Zuótiān de dìzhèn guīmó liù diǎn èr, hǎo duō dìfāng dōu yǒu zāiqíng.
lines.english: Did you see the news? Yesterday's earthquake was magnitude 6.2, and lots of places have damage.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我親眼看到了。那時候我騎車經過車站旁邊，一棟舊大樓突然塌了一半。
lines.simplified: 我亲眼看到了。那时候我骑车经过车站旁边，一栋旧大楼突然塌了一半。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ qīnyǎn kàn dào le. Nà shíhòu wǒ qí chē jīngguò chēzhàn pángbiān, yí dòng jiù dàlóu túrán tā le yíbàn.
lines.english: I saw it with my own eyes. I was riding past the station when an old building suddenly half collapsed.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 太可怕了！有人被困在裡面嗎？
lines.simplified: 太可怕了！有人被困在里面吗？
lines.pinyin: Tài kěpà le! Yǒu rén bèi kùn zài lǐmiàn ma?
lines.english: How terrifying! Was anyone trapped inside?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 有，我聽到底下有人在求救，就馬上打電話給警察。
lines.simplified: 有，我听到底下有人在求救，就马上打电话给警察。
lines.pinyin: Yǒu, wǒ tīng dào dǐxià yǒu rén zài qiújiù, jiù mǎshàng dǎ diànhuà gěi jǐngchá.
lines.english: Yes. I heard someone underneath calling for help, so I phoned the police right away.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 後來呢？
lines.simplified: 后来呢？
lines.pinyin: Hòulái ne?
lines.english: And then?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 警察跟軍人很快就到了，他們要附近的民眾離遠一點，說萬一又地震就危險了。我只好先回家，可是到現在還一直在想那些人怎麼樣了。
lines.simplified: 警察跟军人很快就到了，他们要附近的民众离远一点，说万一又地震就危险了。我只好先回家，可是到现在还一直在想那些人怎么样了。
lines.pinyin: Jǐngchá gēn jūnrén hěn kuài jiù dào le, tāmen yào fùjìn de mínzhòng lí yuǎn yìdiǎn, shuō wànyī yòu dìzhèn jiù wéixiǎn le. Wǒ zhǐhǎo xiān huíjiā, kěshì dào xiànzài hái yìzhí zài xiǎng nàxiē rén zěnmeyàng le.
lines.english: The police and soldiers came quickly, and they told everyone nearby to keep well back, saying it would be dangerous if there were another quake. So I had to go home, but I still keep wondering what happened to those people.

questions.why: 到現在還一直在想那些人怎麼樣了: he keeps wondering about the trapped people, which is worry. He never says he is glad to be safe; the fear of another quake is the police's reason, not his feeling now; and he accepts the police's reason (萬一又地震就危險了) rather than blaming them.

intro.english: Listen to a radio broadcast, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 各位聽眾晚安，現在報告最新的地震消息。今天下午三點十分發生了規模六點五的強烈地震，位置在花蓮東邊的海上，臺北跟臺中也感覺得到。
lines.simplified: 各位听众晚安，现在报告最新的地震消息。今天下午三点十分发生了规模六点五的强烈地震，位置在花莲东边的海上，台北跟台中也感觉得到。
lines.pinyin: Gèwèi tīngzhòng wǎn'ān, xiànzài bàogào zuì xīn de dìzhèn xiāoxí. Jīntiān xiàwǔ sān diǎn shí fēn fāshēng le guīmó liù diǎn wǔ de qiángliè dìzhèn, wèizhì zài Huālián dōngbiān de hǎi shàng, Táiběi gēn Táizhōng yě gǎnjué de dào.
lines.english: Good evening, listeners. Here is the latest earthquake news. At ten past three this afternoon a strong magnitude 6.5 earthquake struck, centred at sea east of Hualien. It was felt in Taipei and Taichung too.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這次地震造成了一些災情：花蓮以南的山區有好幾條路因為山上有大石頭掉下來而不通，請民眾這幾天不要開車上山。到現在還沒有房屋倒塌的消息。
lines.simplified: 这次地震造成了一些灾情：花莲以南的山区有好几条路因为山上有大石头掉下来而不通，请民众这几天不要开车上山。到现在还没有房屋倒塌的消息。
lines.pinyin: Zhè cì dìzhèn zàochéng le yìxiē zāiqíng: Huālián yǐ nán de shānqū yǒu hǎo jǐ tiáo lù yīnwèi shān shàng yǒu dà shítou diào xiàlái ér bù tōng, qǐng mínzhòng zhè jǐ tiān bú yào kāichē shàng shān. Dào xiànzài hái méiyǒu fángwū dǎotā de xiāoxí.
lines.english: The quake has caused some damage: in the mountains south of Hualien, several roads are closed because big rocks have fallen onto them, and the public is asked not to drive up into the mountains for the next few days. So far there is no news of any buildings collapsing.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 研究人員說，這兩天可能還會再發生地震，請大家把收音機跟電池準備好，萬一停電，也能聽到最新的廣播。
lines.simplified: 研究人员说，这两天可能还会再发生地震，请大家把收音机跟电池准备好，万一停电，也能听到最新的广播。
lines.pinyin: Yánjiù rényuán shuō, zhè liǎng tiān kěnéng hái huì zài fāshēng dìzhèn, qǐng dàjiā bǎ shōuyīnjī gēn diànchí zhǔnbèi hǎo, wànyī tíngdiàn, yě néng tīng dào zuì xīn de guǎngbò.
lines.english: Researchers say there may be further earthquakes over the next two days. Please get your radio and batteries ready, so that if the power goes out you can still hear the latest broadcasts.

questions.why: 花蓮以南的山區……不通: 以南 means the area south of Hualien. East of Hualien is where the quake happened, at sea, and Taichung is only a place where it was felt.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段留言，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段留言，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn liúyán, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a voice message, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 同學你好，我是上星期打電話給你的救災活動負責人。這次颱風在臺東造成很嚴重的水災，我們要去災區幫災民整理房子。星期六早上七點在學校門口集合，大家坐巴士，東西用卡車送過去。
lines.simplified: 同学你好，我是上星期打电话给你的救灾活动负责人。这次台风在台东造成很严重的水灾，我们要去灾区帮灾民整理房子。星期六早上七点在学校门口集合，大家坐巴士，东西用卡车送过去。
lines.pinyin: Tóngxué nǐ hǎo, wǒ shì shàng xīngqí dǎ diànhuà gěi nǐ de jiùzāi huódòng fùzérén. Zhè cì táifēng zài Táidōng zàochéng hěn yánzhòng de shuǐzāi, wǒmen yào qù zāiqū bāng zāimín zhěnglǐ fángzi. Xīngqíliù zǎoshàng qī diǎn zài xuéxiào ménkǒu jíhé, dàjiā zuò bāshì, dōngxi yòng kǎchē sòng guòqù.
lines.english: Hello, this is the organiser of the relief trip who phoned you last week. This typhoon caused serious flooding in Taitung, and we are going to the disaster area to help the victims clean up their homes. We gather at the school gate at seven on Saturday morning; we go by bus and the supplies go by truck.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 因為臺東市以北的路還沒通，我們得先往南開，再從南邊進去，大概要花五個小時才能到達。那裡停水停電，請自己帶水跟吃的，衣服也多帶一套。到了以後不要一個人進山區，萬一發生意外就不好了，生命安全最要緊。如果你那天不能來，請在星期五中午以前打電話告訴我。
lines.simplified: 因为台东市以北的路还没通，我们得先往南开，再从南边进去，大概要花五个小时才能到达。那里停水停电，请自己带水跟吃的，衣服也多带一套。到了以后不要一个人进山区，万一发生意外就不好了，生命安全最要紧。如果你那天不能来，请在星期五中午以前打电话告诉我。
lines.pinyin: Yīnwèi Táidōng shì yǐ běi de lù hái méi tōng, wǒmen děi xiān wǎng nán kāi, zài cóng nánbiān jìnqù, dàgài yào huā wǔ ge xiǎoshí cái néng dàodá. Nàlǐ tíngshuǐ tíngdiàn, qǐng zìjǐ dài shuǐ gēn chī de, yīfú yě duō dài yí tào. Dào le yǐhòu bú yào yí ge rén jìn shānqū, wànyī fāshēng yìwài jiù bù hǎo le, shēngmìng ānquán zuì yàojǐn. Rúguǒ nǐ nà tiān bù néng lái, qǐng zài xīngqíwǔ zhōngwǔ yǐqián dǎ diànhuà gàosu wǒ.
lines.english: Because the roads north of Taitung City are still closed, we have to drive south first and go in from the south, which will take about five hours to get there. There is no water or power there, so please bring your own water and food, and an extra set of clothes. Once there, don't go into the mountains on your own: if there were an accident, that would be bad, and your safety matters most. If you can't come that day, please phone me before noon on Friday.

passage.traditional: 上個月颱風來的時候，我剛好在山區的外婆家。本來晚上的風雨不大，我們都以為颱風不會來了，沒想到半夜兩點，風雨{1}變大，外婆家周圍的樹木被吹倒了好幾棵。第二天早上，我想開車帶外婆下山，{2}路上都是大石頭，車子完全過不去。家裡停水停電，{3}連手機都沒電了，我們沒辦法打電話{4}。一直到第三天下午，救災人員才走路上山，{5}外婆家。外婆說，{6}以後再有颱風，她也不想搬下山去住。
passage.simplified: 上个月台风来的时候，我刚好在山区的外婆家。本来晚上的风雨不大，我们都以为台风不会来了，没想到半夜两点，风雨{1}变大，外婆家周围的树木被吹倒了好几棵。第二天早上，我想开车带外婆下山，{2}路上都是大石头，车子完全过不去。家里停水停电，{3}连手机都没电了，我们没办法打电话{4}。一直到第三天下午，救灾人员才走路上山，{5}外婆家。外婆说，{6}以后再有台风，她也不想搬下山去住。
passage.pinyin: Shàng ge yuè táifēng lái de shíhòu, wǒ gānghǎo zài shānqū de wàipó jiā. Běnlái wǎnshàng de fēngyǔ bú dà, wǒmen dōu yǐwéi táifēng bú huì lái le, méixiǎngdào bànyè liǎng diǎn, fēngyǔ túrán biàn dà, wàipó jiā zhōuwéi de shùmù bèi chuī dǎo le hǎo jǐ kē. Dì èr tiān zǎoshàng, wǒ xiǎng kāichē dài wàipó xià shān, jiéguǒ lù shàng dōu shì dà shítou, chēzi wánquán guò bú qù. Jiālǐ tíngshuǐ tíngdiàn, shènzhì lián shǒujī dōu méi diàn le, wǒmen méi bànfǎ dǎ diànhuà qiújiù. Yìzhí dào dì sān tiān xiàwǔ, jiùzāi rényuán cái zǒulù shàng shān, dàodá wàipó jiā. Wàipó shuō, jiùsuàn yǐhòu zài yǒu táifēng, tā yě bù xiǎng bān xià shān qù zhù.
passage.english: Last month, when the typhoon came, I happened to be at my grandmother's home in the mountains. At first the wind and rain that evening were light, and we thought the typhoon wasn't coming. But at two in the morning the storm suddenly grew strong, and several of the trees around Grandma's house were blown down. The next morning I wanted to drive Grandma down the mountain, but in the end the road was covered in big rocks and the car could not get through at all. We had no water or power, and even our phones went flat, so we could not phone for help. Not until the afternoon of the third day did rescue workers walk up the mountain and reach Grandma's house. Grandma says that even if more typhoons come, she still does not want to move down the mountain.

questions.why: The evening was calm and they thought the typhoon would not come (本來……不大，我們都以為……), then at one moment, two in the morning, it struck hard enough to fell trees: 沒想到……突然變大. 終於 is for something long awaited, but they expected nothing; 一連 needs a count of repeated days or times (一連三天); 早就 would put the change before two o'clock.

choices.pinyin: wànyī

choices.pinyin: zàishuō

passage.traditional: 我們社區的房子大多很老，而且離得很近。上個月颱風來，社區{1}停了三天電，很多人只好點蠟燭。有一天晚上，一位老先生點蠟燭的時候不小心，{2}了一場小火災。還好鄰居馬上跑來，大家把{3}集合起來，有的提水，有的打電話，所以沒有人受傷。從那次以後，社區每個月都開一次會，教大家怎麼{4}火災的危險。負責管理社區的人{5}在會上說明，還一家一家去問大家準備好了沒有。他也告訴大家，家裡要準備好用電池的燈，{6}又停電，就不必點蠟燭了。
passage.simplified: 我们社区的房子大多很老，而且离得很近。上个月台风来，社区{1}停了三天电，很多人只好点蜡烛。有一天晚上，一位老先生点蜡烛的时候不小心，{2}了一场小火灾。还好邻居马上跑来，大家把{3}集合起来，有的提水，有的打电话，所以没有人受伤。从那次以后，社区每个月都开一次会，教大家怎么{4}火灾的危险。负责管理社区的人{5}在会上说明，还一家一家去问大家准备好了没有。他也告诉大家，家里要准备好用电池的灯，{6}又停电，就不必点蜡烛了。
passage.pinyin: Wǒmen shèqū de fángzi dàduō hěn lǎo, érqiě lí de hěn jìn. Shàng ge yuè táifēng lái, shèqū yìlián tíng le sān tiān diàn, hěn duō rén zhǐhǎo diǎn làzhú. Yǒu yì tiān wǎnshàng, yí wèi lǎo xiānshēng diǎn làzhú de shíhòu bù xiǎoxīn, yǐnqǐ le yì chǎng xiǎo huǒzāi. Háihǎo línjū mǎshàng pǎo lái, dàjiā bǎ lìliàng jíhé qǐlái, yǒude tí shuǐ, yǒude dǎ diànhuà, suǒyǐ méiyǒu rén shòushāng. Cóng nà cì yǐhòu, shèqū měi ge yuè dōu kāi yí cì huì, jiāo dàjiā zěnme jiàngdī huǒzāi de wéixiǎn. Fùzé guǎnlǐ shèqū de rén bùjǐn zài huì shàng shuōmíng, hái yì jiā yì jiā qù wèn dàjiā zhǔnbèi hǎo le méiyǒu. Tā yě gàosu dàjiā, jiālǐ yào zhǔnbèi hǎo yòng diànchí de dēng, wànyī yòu tíngdiàn, jiù búbì diǎn làzhú le.
passage.english: Most of the houses in our neighbourhood are old and built close together. When the typhoon came last month, the neighbourhood was without power for three days in a row, and many people had to light candles. One evening an old man was careless while lighting a candle and started a small fire. Luckily the neighbours ran over at once, and everyone pooled their strength: some carried water, some made phone calls, so nobody was hurt. Since then the neighbourhood has held a meeting every month to teach people how to lower the risk of fire. The person who runs the neighbourhood not only explains things at the meetings but also goes from home to home asking whether people are prepared. He also tells everyone to keep battery lamps ready at home, so that if the power goes out again they will not need candles.

颱風明天晚上就會來，請住在本大樓的各位注意下面的事情：
停電：一樓大門旁準備了蠟燭跟電池，一家可以拿一份。電梯會停用，請走樓梯。
停水：一樓大門旁也有水，每家每天可以拿兩箱。
停車：地下停車場萬一淹水，車子可能會被水弄壞。請在明天下午五點以前，把車開到學校旁邊的停車場。
屋頂：颱風天請不要上屋頂。

Diàntī huì tíngyòng, qǐng zǒu lóutī. Tíngshuǐ: yī lóu dàmén páng yě yǒu shuǐ, měi jiā měi tiān kěyǐ ná liǎng xiāng. Tíngchē: dìxià tíngchēchǎng wànyī yānshuǐ, chēzi kěnéng huì bèi shuǐ nòng huài. text.english:
The typhoon will arrive tomorrow evening. Will everyone living in this building please note the following:
Power cuts: candles and batteries are ready beside the main door on the ground floor, one set per household. The lift will be out of service; please use the stairs.
Water cuts: there is also water beside the main door on the ground floor, two boxes per household per day.
Parking: if the underground car park happens to flood, cars may be damaged by the water. Please move your car to the car park beside the school before 5 p.m. tomorrow.
Roof: please do not go up on the roof during the typhoon.
Building Service Centre

text.traditional:
臺灣是太平洋上的海島，因為地理位置的關係，一年到頭大小地震不斷。我在一所國小教書，學校每個月都會做一次地震練習：老師一說「地震來了」，學生就要馬上到桌子底下，等地震停了，再到操場集合。剛開始，不少家長覺得這是白花上課時間，甚至有人打電話到學校，希望學校別再做這種練習了。
去年十月的一個早上，突然發生了一場規模六點一的地震。教室的電燈不停地擺動，書都掉到了地上，有幾個學生嚇哭了。可是大家都記得練習時學的方法，沒有人亂跑。地震一停，大家就安靜地走到操場。後來我們才知道，那天學校一千多個學生，沒有一個受傷。從那天起，再也沒有家長說練習是白花時間了。
人們沒辦法知道地震什麼時候會來。我想，練習的意義不是讓人不怕地震，而是讓人在害怕的時候，還知道應該怎麼做。
text.simplified:
台湾是太平洋上的海岛，因为地理位置的关系，一年到头大小地震不断。我在一所国小教书，学校每个月都会做一次地震练习：老师一说「地震来了」，学生就要马上到桌子底下，等地震停了，再到操场集合。刚开始，不少家长觉得这是白花上课时间，甚至有人打电话到学校，希望学校别再做这种练习了。
去年十月的一个早上，突然发生了一场规模六点一的地震。教室的电灯不停地摆动，书都掉到了地上，有几个学生吓哭了。可是大家都记得练习时学的方法，没有人乱跑。地震一停，大家就安静地走到操场。后来我们才知道，那天学校一千多个学生，没有一个受伤。从那天起，再也没有家长说练习是白花时间了。
人们没办法知道地震什么时候会来。我想，练习的意义不是让人不怕地震，而是让人在害怕的时候，还知道应该怎么做。
text.pinyin: Táiwān shì Tàipíngyáng shàng de hǎidǎo, yīnwèi dìlǐ wèizhì de guānxi, yì nián dào tóu dàxiǎo dìzhèn búduàn. Wǒ zài yì suǒ guóxiǎo jiāoshū, xuéxiào měi ge yuè dōu huì zuò yí cì dìzhèn liànxí: lǎoshī yì shuō "dìzhèn lái le", xuéshēng jiù yào mǎshàng dào zhuōzi dǐxià, děng dìzhèn tíng le, zài dào cāochǎng jíhé. Gāng kāishǐ, bùshǎo jiāzhǎng juéde zhè shì bái huā shàngkè shíjiān, shènzhì yǒu rén dǎ diànhuà dào xuéxiào, xīwàng xuéxiào bié zài zuò zhè zhǒng liànxí le. Qùnián shí yuè de yí ge zǎoshàng, túrán fāshēng le yì chǎng guīmó liù diǎn yī de dìzhèn. Jiàoshì de diàndēng bù tíng de bǎidòng, shū dōu diào dào le dì shàng, yǒu jǐ ge xuéshēng xià kū le. Kěshì dàjiā dōu jìde liànxí shí xué de fāngfǎ, méiyǒu rén luàn pǎo. Dìzhèn yì tíng, dàjiā jiù ānjìng de zǒu dào cāochǎng. Hòulái wǒmen cái zhīdào, nà tiān xuéxiào yì qiān duō ge xuéshēng, méiyǒu yí ge shòushāng. Cóng nà tiān qǐ, zài yě méiyǒu jiāzhǎng shuō liànxí shì bái huā shíjiān le. Rénmen méi bànfǎ zhīdào dìzhèn shénme shíhòu huì lái. Wǒ xiǎng, liànxí de yìyì bú shì ràng rén bú pà dìzhèn, ér shì ràng rén zài hàipà de shíhòu, hái zhīdào yīnggāi zěnme zuò.
text.english:
Taiwan is an island in the Pacific, and because of where it lies, earthquakes large and small never stop all year round. I teach at a primary school, and every month the school holds an earthquake drill: as soon as a teacher says "Earthquake!", the pupils must get under their desks at once, and when the shaking stops they gather on the sports field. At first quite a few parents felt this wasted class time; some even phoned the school asking it to stop the drills.
One morning last October a magnitude 6.1 earthquake suddenly struck. The classroom lights swung back and forth, books fell to the floor, and a few pupils burst into tears. But everyone remembered what they had learned in the drills, and nobody ran about. As soon as the shaking stopped, everyone walked quietly to the sports field. We learned afterwards that of the school's more than a thousand pupils, not one was hurt that day. From then on, no parent ever again said the drills were a waste of time.
Nobody can know when an earthquake will come. I think the point of practising is not to make people unafraid of earthquakes, but to make sure that even when they are afraid, they still know what to do.

choices.simplified: 老师打电话跟家长说明原因

questions.why: Paragraph 1 gives the parents' complaint and paragraph 2 the turning point: in the magnitude 6.1 quake nobody panicked and not one of the thousand pupils was hurt, and 從那天起 nobody complained again. It was parents who phoned the school, not teachers who phoned them; earthquakes never stop (不斷), but the passage does not say they are increasing; and the drills went on every month.

title.pinyin: Zū fángzi yǐqián, xiān kàn shénme?
title.english: What to Check Before You Rent

text.traditional:
很多人租房子的時候，最先想到的是房租跟交通，很少想到颱風和地震。我剛來臺灣時也一樣，租了一間離學校很近、房租又便宜的一樓小房間。沒想到第一個颱風來，那條路一連淹了兩天水，房間裡的東西都被水弄壞了，甚至連護照都差一點救不回來。
後來我問了鄰居，才知道那附近本來就是很低的地帶，每年都會淹水。現在我租房子，一定先做三件事：第一，問問鄰居，這附近以前有沒有淹過水；第二，看看房屋有多老，屋頂有沒有問題；第三，看看周圍有沒有大樹，颱風天萬一樹倒了，可能會把窗戶打破。這些事花不了多少時間，可是能讓人住得放心。
text.simplified:
很多人租房子的时候，最先想到的是房租跟交通，很少想到台风和地震。我刚来台湾时也一样，租了一间离学校很近、房租又便宜的一楼小房间。没想到第一个台风来，那条路一连淹了两天水，房间里的东西都被水弄坏了，甚至连护照都差一点救不回来。
后来我问了邻居，才知道那附近本来就是很低的地带，每年都会淹水。现在我租房子，一定先做三件事：第一，问问邻居，这附近以前有没有淹过水；第二，看看房屋有多老，屋顶有没有问题；第三，看看周围有没有大树，台风天万一树倒了，可能会把窗户打破。这些事花不了多少时间，可是能让人住得放心。
text.pinyin: Hěn duō rén zū fángzi de shíhòu, zuì xiān xiǎng dào de shì fángzū gēn jiāotōng, hěn shǎo xiǎng dào táifēng hé dìzhèn. Wǒ gāng lái Táiwān shí yě yíyàng, zū le yì jiān lí xuéxiào hěn jìn, fángzū yòu piányí de yī lóu xiǎo fángjiān. Méixiǎngdào dì yī ge táifēng lái, nà tiáo lù yìlián yān le liǎng tiān shuǐ, fángjiān lǐ de dōngxi dōu bèi shuǐ nòng huài le, shènzhì lián hùzhào dōu chà yìdiǎn jiù bù huílái. Hòulái wǒ wèn le línjū, cái zhīdào nà fùjìn běnlái jiù shì hěn dī de dìdài, měi nián dōu huì yānshuǐ. Xiànzài wǒ zū fángzi, yídìng xiān zuò sān jiàn shì: dì yī, wènwèn línjū, zhè fùjìn yǐqián yǒu méiyǒu yān guo shuǐ; dì èr, kànkàn fángwū yǒu duō lǎo, wūdǐng yǒu méiyǒu wèntí; dì sān, kànkàn zhōuwéi yǒu méiyǒu dà shù, táifēng tiān wànyī shù dǎo le, kěnéng huì bǎ chuānghù dǎ pò. Zhèxiē shì huā bù liǎo duōshǎo shíjiān, kěshì néng ràng rén zhù de fàngxīn.
text.english:
When renting, most people think first about the rent and transport and seldom about typhoons and earthquakes. When I first came to Taiwan I was the same: I rented a small ground-floor room close to school and cheap as well. But when the first typhoon came, that street was flooded for two days in a row, everything in my room was ruined by water, and I very nearly lost even my passport.
Later I asked the neighbours and learned that the neighbourhood has always been a low-lying area that floods every year. Now, when I rent, I always do three things first: one, ask the neighbours whether this area has flooded before; two, see how old the building is and whether the roof has any problems; three, see whether there are big trees around it, because if a tree happens to fall in a typhoon it may smash the windows. These things take little time, but they let you live without worry.

prompt.traditional: 文章為什麼提到「甚至連護照都差一點救不回來」？
prompt.simplified: 文章为什么提到「甚至连护照都差一点救不回来」？
prompt.pinyin: Wénzhāng wèishénme tí dào "shènzhì lián hùzhào dōu chà yìdiǎn jiù bù huílái"?

choices.pinyin: Yào dàjiā bǎ hùzhào fàng hǎo.

choices.pinyin: Shuōmíng nà cì yānshuǐ duō yánzhòng.

choices.pinyin: Shuōmíng fángdōng méiyǒu gàosu tā.

questions.why: 甚至連……都 adds the most extreme loss to everything else that was ruined: it shows how serious the flood was. The passage gives no advice about passports, the writer learned about the flooding from neighbours (the landlord is never mentioned), and the cheap rent is why he chose the room.

focus.zh: 用作者的方法看新的情況

text.traditional: 我姊姊上個月生了一對雙胞胎。孩子滿月那天，家人本來要在餐廳請客，請大家吃油飯和紅蛋，沒想到前一天新聞說颱風要來了。姊姊想來想去，還是決定把請客的地方改到家裡。那天外面風雨很大，可是客人還是一個一個來了。外婆一進門就抱著孩子不放，外公一整個晚上除了幫孩子拍照，就是一直說「好可愛的孩子啊！」大家吃著油飯，聽著外面的風雨聲，一點也不覺得颱風天可怕。晚上九點，突然停電了，哥哥把蠟燭點了起來，兩個孩子不但沒哭，還在蠟燭旁邊睡著了。姊姊說，這是她最珍貴的回憶。
text.simplified: 我姊姊上个月生了一对双胞胎。孩子满月那天，家人本来要在餐厅请客，请大家吃油饭和红蛋，没想到前一天新闻说台风要来了。姊姊想来想去，还是决定把请客的地方改到家里。那天外面风雨很大，可是客人还是一个一个来了。外婆一进门就抱着孩子不放，外公一整个晚上除了帮孩子拍照，就是一直说「好可爱的孩子啊！」大家吃着油饭，听着外面的风雨声，一点也不觉得台风天可怕。晚上九点，突然停电了，哥哥把蜡烛点了起来，两个孩子不但没哭，还在蜡烛旁边睡着了。姊姊说，这是她最珍贵的回忆。
text.pinyin: Wǒ jiějie shàng ge yuè shēng le yí duì shuāngbāotāi. Háizi mǎnyuè nà tiān, jiārén běnlái yào zài cāntīng qǐngkè, qǐng dàjiā chī yóufàn hé hóngdàn, méixiǎngdào qián yì tiān xīnwén shuō táifēng yào lái le. Jiějie xiǎng lái xiǎng qù, háishì juédìng bǎ qǐngkè de dìfāng gǎi dào jiālǐ. Nà tiān wàimiàn fēngyǔ hěn dà, kěshì kèrén háishì yí ge yí ge lái le. Wàipó yí jìn mén jiù bào zhe háizi bú fàng, wàigōng yì zhěng ge wǎnshàng chúle bāng háizi pāizhào, jiù shì yìzhí shuō "Hǎo kě'ài de háizi a!" Dàjiā chī zhe yóufàn, tīng zhe wàimiàn de fēngyǔshēng, yìdiǎn yě bù juéde táifēng tiān kěpà. Wǎnshàng jiǔ diǎn, túrán tíngdiàn le, gēge bǎ làzhú diǎn le qǐlái, liǎng ge háizi búdàn méi kū, hái zài làzhú pángbiān shuì zháo le. Jiějie shuō, zhè shì tā zuì zhēnguì de huíyì.
text.english: Last month my older sister had twins. For their one-month celebration the family meant to hold a party at a restaurant and treat everyone to sticky rice and red eggs, but the day before, the news said a typhoon was coming. After thinking it over and over, my sister decided to move the party home. That day the storm was fierce outside, yet the guests still came one by one. Grandma took the babies in her arms the moment she arrived and would not let go; all evening Grandpa did nothing but take photos of the babies and keep saying, "What lovely children!" Eating sticky rice and listening to the wind and rain outside, nobody felt the typhoon was frightening at all. At nine in the evening the power suddenly went out, and my brother lit some candles. The two babies did not cry; they fell asleep beside the candles. My sister says it is her most precious memory.

prompt.simplified: 姊姊为什么觉得那天是最珍贵的回忆？

choices.traditional: 颱風天一家人還是過得很溫暖
choices.simplified: 台风天一家人还是过得很温暖
choices.pinyin: Táifēng tiān yì jiā rén háishì guò de hěn wēnnuǎn.

choices.traditional: 客人帶了很多禮物來給孩子

choices.traditional: 家人還是照原來的計畫在餐廳請客

questions.why: The whole passage builds to her last line: storm outside and a power cut, yet the guests still came, nobody felt afraid (一點也不覺得……可怕), and the babies slept by candlelight. The restaurant was the plan the typhoon cancelled: the party was moved home, and nobody prepared a special meal there; presents are never mentioned.

text.traditional: 颱風天，很多商店都關門了，可是我家附近的超商還是開著。上次颱風來，我家停了一整天的電，手機也快沒電了，我只好穿著雨衣走到超商。店裡已經有很多人，店員不但讓大家在店裡休息，還提供熱水，讓我們用熱水來泡麵。我順便買了電池，準備回家的時候，才發現店員早就把店裡的收音機打開了，大家一邊吃，一邊聽颱風的最新消息。那時我才明白，對很多人來說，超商在颱風天不只是買東西的地方，也是一個讓人放心的地方。
text.simplified: 台风天，很多商店都关门了，可是我家附近的超商还是开着。上次台风来，我家停了一整天的电，手机也快没电了，我只好穿着雨衣走到超商。店里已经有很多人，店员不但让大家在店里休息，还提供热水，让我们用热水来泡面。我顺便买了电池，准备回家的时候，才发现店员早就把店里的收音机打开了，大家一边吃，一边听台风的最新消息。那时我才明白，对很多人来说，超商在台风天不只是买东西的地方，也是一个让人放心的地方。
text.pinyin: Táifēng tiān, hěn duō shāngdiàn dōu guānmén le, kěshì wǒ jiā fùjìn de chāoshāng háishì kāi zhe. Shàng cì táifēng lái, wǒ jiā tíng le yì zhěng tiān de diàn, shǒujī yě kuài méi diàn le, wǒ zhǐhǎo chuān zhe yǔyī zǒu dào chāoshāng. Diàn lǐ yǐjīng yǒu hěn duō rén, diànyuán búdàn ràng dàjiā zài diàn lǐ xiūxí, hái tígōng rèshuǐ, ràng wǒmen yòng rèshuǐ lái pào miàn. Wǒ shùnbiàn mǎi le diànchí, zhǔnbèi huíjiā de shíhòu, cái fāxiàn diànyuán zǎo jiù bǎ diàn lǐ de shōuyīnjī dǎkāi le, dàjiā yìbiān chī, yìbiān tīng táifēng de zuì xīn xiāoxí. Nà shí wǒ cái míngbái, duì hěn duō rén lái shuō, chāoshāng zài táifēng tiān bù zhǐ shì mǎi dōngxi de dìfāng, yě shì yí ge ràng rén fàngxīn de dìfāng.
text.english: On typhoon days many shops close, but the convenience store near my home stays open. Last time a typhoon came, we had no power at home for a whole day and my phone was nearly flat, so I put on a raincoat and walked to the store. It was already full of people. The staff not only let everyone rest inside but also provided hot water so we could make instant noodles with it. While I was there I bought batteries, and as I was about to go home I noticed the staff had long since switched on the store's radio, so everyone was eating and listening to the latest typhoon news. Only then did I understand that for many people a convenience store on a typhoon day is not just a place to shop, but also a place that puts their minds at ease.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這個星期天我們去海邊釣魚吧？釣魚的東西我都準備好了。
lines.simplified: 这个星期天我们去海边钓鱼吧？钓鱼的东西我都准备好了。
lines.pinyin: Zhège xīngqítiān wǒmen qù hǎibiān diàoyú ba? Diàoyú de dōngxi wǒ dōu zhǔnbèi hǎo le.
lines.english: Let's go fishing by the sea this Sunday. I've got all the fishing gear ready.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 新聞說有一個颱風正往臺灣來，星期一才會到。可是萬一早一點到呢？
lines.simplified: 新闻说有一个台风正往台湾来，星期一才会到。可是万一早一点到呢？
lines.pinyin: Xīnwén shuō yǒu yí ge táifēng zhèng wǎng Táiwān lái, xīngqíyī cái huì dào. Kěshì wànyī zǎo yìdiǎn dào ne?
lines.english: The news says a typhoon is heading for Taiwan and won't arrive until Monday. But what if it comes earlier?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 應該不會那麼快吧。
lines.simplified: 应该不会那么快吧。
lines.pinyin: Yīnggāi bú huì nàme kuài ba.
lines.english: It shouldn't come that fast.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 海邊風一大就很危險。我們還是去室內釣魚場釣吧，那裡比較安全。
lines.simplified: 海边风一大就很危险。我们还是去室内钓鱼场钓吧，那里比较安全。
lines.pinyin: Hǎibiān fēng yí dà jiù hěn wéixiǎn. Wǒmen háishì qù shìnèi diàoyú chǎng diào ba, nàlǐ bǐjiào ānquán.
lines.english: The seaside gets dangerous as soon as the wind picks up. We'd better fish at an indoor fishing pond; it's safer there.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的為什麼想換地方？
prompt.simplified: 女的为什么想换地方？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de wèishénme xiǎng huàn dìfāng?
prompt.english: Why does the woman want to go somewhere else?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Pà táifēng zǎo yìdiǎn lái.
choices.english: She fears the typhoon may come early.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Diàoyú chǎng de yú bǐjiào duō.
choices.english: There are more fish at the fishing pond.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xīngqíyī cái yǒu shíjiān qù.
choices.english: She is only free on Monday.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nán de hái méi zhǔnbèi dōngxi.
choices.english: The man hasn't got the gear ready.

questions.why: 萬一早一點到呢？ is her worry: the typhoon could arrive before Monday, and strong wind makes the seaside dangerous, so 我們還是去室內釣魚場釣吧. She never says the pond has more fish, Monday is when the typhoon is due, not a free day, and he says the gear is ready.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你兒子暑假都在做什麼？
lines.simplified: 你儿子暑假都在做什么？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ érzi shǔjià dōu zài zuò shénme?
lines.english: What has your son been doing this summer holiday?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 不是在房間裡上網，就是在客廳看電視，叫他出去走走，他都不肯。
lines.simplified: 不是在房间里上网，就是在客厅看电视，叫他出去走走，他都不肯。
lines.pinyin: Bú shì zài fángjiān lǐ shàngwǎng, jiùshì zài kètīng kàn diànshì, jiào tā chūqù zǒuzou, tā dōu bù kěn.
lines.english: If he's not online in his room, he's watching TV in the living room. When I tell him to go out for a walk, he won't.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 青少年都這樣。我女兒參加學校戶外活動，玩得開心又流汗，對身心健康很好。
lines.simplified: 青少年都这样。我女儿参加学校户外活动，玩得开心又流汗，对身心健康很好。
lines.pinyin: Qīngshàonián dōu zhèyàng. Wǒ nǚ'ér cānjiā xuéxiào hùwài huódòng, wán de kāixīn yòu liúhàn, duì shēnxīn jiànkāng hěn hǎo.
lines.english: Teenagers are all like that. My daughter joined the school's outdoor activities; she has fun and works up a sweat every day. It's very good for her physical and mental health.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 真的嗎？那我也去問問他想不想參加。
lines.simplified: 真的吗？那我也去问问他想不想参加。
lines.pinyin: Zhēnde ma? Nà wǒ yě qù wènwen tā xiǎng bù xiǎng cānjiā.
lines.english: Really? Then I'll ask him whether he wants to join too.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的為什麼提到她女兒？
prompt.simplified: 女的为什么提到她女儿？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de wèishénme tídào tā nǚ'ér?
prompt.english: Why does the woman mention her daughter?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她女兒暑假也不肯出門
choices.simplified: 她女儿暑假也不肯出门
choices.pinyin: Tā nǚ'ér shǔjià yě bù kěn chūmén.
choices.english: Her daughter also refuses to go out in the summer holiday.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 想讓男的兒子也試試戶外活動
choices.simplified: 想让男的儿子也试试户外活动
choices.pinyin: Xiǎng ràng nán de érzi yě shìshi hùwài huódòng.
choices.english: She wants the man's son to try outdoor activities too.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 學校的活動讓女兒很累
choices.simplified: 学校的活动让女儿很累
choices.pinyin: Xuéxiào de huódòng ràng nǚ'ér hěn lèi.
choices.english: The school activities wear her daughter out.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 想請男的陪兒子出去走走
choices.simplified: 想请男的陪儿子出去走走
choices.pinyin: Xiǎng qǐng nán de péi érzi chūqù zǒuzou.
choices.english: She wants the man to take his son out for walks.

questions.why: The son will not go out when his father asks (他都不肯). She answers with her daughter, who has fun and sweats in the school's outdoor activities, and the father then says he will ask his son about joining: she is suggesting the activity for the boy. Her daughter does go out and enjoys it, and walks are what the father already tried.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 公司的休閒活動調查，結果出來了嗎？
lines.simplified: 公司的休闲活动调查，结果出来了吗？
lines.pinyin: Gōngsī de xiūxián huódòng diàochá, jiéguǒ chūlái le ma?
lines.english: Are the results of the company's leisure survey out yet?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 總算出來了！本來上個星期就應該做完，可是有兩個部門一直沒交。
lines.simplified: 总算出来了！本来上个星期就应该做完，可是有两个部门一直没交。
lines.pinyin: Zǒngsuàn chūlái le! Běnlái shàng ge xīngqí jiù yīnggāi zuò wán, kěshì yǒu liǎng ge bùmén yìzhí méi jiāo.
lines.english: They're finally out! It should have been done last week, but two departments kept not handing theirs in.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 結果怎麼樣？
lines.simplified: 结果怎么样？
lines.pinyin: Jiéguǒ zěnmeyàng?
lines.english: So what did it show?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 三分之二的同事說，下班以後累得什麼都不想做。讓我驚訝的是，想參加樂團的人比想打球的還多，甚至有人想去日本滑雪。
lines.simplified: 三分之二的同事说，下班以后累得什么都不想做。让我惊讶的是，想参加乐团的人比想打球的还多，甚至有人想去日本滑雪。
lines.pinyin: Sān fēn zhī èr de tóngshì shuō, xiàbān yǐhòu lèi de shénme dōu bù xiǎng zuò. Ràng wǒ jīngyà de shì, xiǎng cānjiā yuètuán de rén bǐ xiǎng dǎqiú de hái duō, shènzhì yǒu rén xiǎng qù Rìběn huáxuě.
lines.english: Two thirds of our colleagues said they're too tired to do anything after work. What surprised me is that more people want to join a band than play ball games, and some even want to go skiing in Japan.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 下個月先找老師來，教大家玩樂團吧。
lines.simplified: 下个月先找老师来，教大家玩乐团吧。
lines.pinyin: Xià ge yuè xiān zhǎo lǎoshī lái, jiāo dàjiā wán yuètuán ba.
lines.english: Then let's get a teacher in next month to teach everyone to play in a band.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 在這個調查中，最多同事下班以後怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 在这个调查中，最多同事下班以后怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Zài zhège diàochá zhōng, zuì duō tóngshì xiàbān yǐhòu zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: In this survey, what is true of most colleagues after work?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiǎng qù cānjiā yuètuán.
choices.english: They want to join a band.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xǐhuān qù dǎqiú.
choices.english: They like playing ball games.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zhǐ xiǎng hǎohǎo xiūxí.
choices.english: They only want to rest.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Hái děi liú xiàlái jiābān.
choices.english: They still have to stay for overtime.

questions.why: 三分之二 (two thirds) are too tired to do anything after work: that is the biggest group. The band beat ball games, which surprised her, but both are smaller groups, and overtime is never mentioned.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 調查總算做完了，男的想先辦什麼活動？
prompt.simplified: 调查总算做完了，男的想先办什么活动？
prompt.pinyin: Diàochá zǒngsuàn zuò wán le, nán de xiǎng xiān bàn shénme huódòng?
prompt.english: Now that the survey is finally done, which activity does the man want to organise first?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qǐng rén lái jiāo dàjiā wán yīnyuè.
choices.english: Get someone to teach everyone to play music.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiān zài shìnèi liànxí huáxuě.
choices.english: Start with indoor ski practice.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qǐng liǎng ge bùmén xiān dǎqiú.
choices.english: Ask two departments to play ball first.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Dào Rìběn cānjiā hùwài huódòng.
choices.english: Go to Japan for an outdoor activity.

questions.why: The survey is finally complete (總算), and the woman says a band is more popular than ball games. The man wants a teacher next month to teach everyone to play in a band, that is, to play music. Skiing, ball games and Japan are only things the survey mentions.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 聽說妳女兒不去補習班了？
lines.simplified: 听说你女儿不去补习班了？
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō nǐ nǚ'ér bú qù bǔxíbān le?
lines.english: I hear your daughter has stopped going to cram school?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 對，上個月她爸爸總算答應了。她以前一個星期補習四天，每天十點才到家。
lines.simplified: 对，上个月她爸爸总算答应了。她以前一个星期补习四天，每天十点才到家。
lines.pinyin: Duì, shàng ge yuè tā bàba zǒngsuàn dāyìng le. Tā yǐqián yí ge xīngqí bǔxí sì tiān, měi tiān shí diǎn cái dào jiā.
lines.english: Yes, last month her father finally agreed. She used to have cram classes four days a week and got home at ten every night.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那她現在下課以後都做什麼？
lines.simplified: 那她现在下课以后都做什么？
lines.pinyin: Nà tā xiànzài xiàkè yǐhòu dōu zuò shénme?
lines.english: So what does she do after school now?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 去學游泳、打球，有三分之一的時間在戶外。晚上睡得好，上課也比較主動問問題了。
lines.simplified: 去学游泳、打球，有三分之一的时间在户外。晚上睡得好，上课也比较主动问问题了。
lines.pinyin: Qù xué yóuyǒng, dǎqiú, yǒu sān fēn zhī yī de shíjiān zài hùwài. Wǎnshàng shuì de hǎo, shàngkè yě bǐjiào zhǔdòng wèn wèntí le.
lines.english: She takes swimming lessons and plays ball games; a third of her time is outdoors. She sleeps well, and she's more ready to ask questions in class.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那成績呢？
lines.simplified: 那成绩呢？
lines.pinyin: Nà chéngjī ne?
lines.english: And her grades?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 跟以前差不多。不過她說，念書不再那麼痛苦了。
lines.simplified: 跟以前差不多。不过她说，念书不再那么痛苦了。
lines.pinyin: Gēn yǐqián chàbùduō. Búguò tā shuō, niànshū bùzài nàme tòngkǔ le.
lines.english: About the same as before. But she says studying isn't so painful any more.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 這位媽媽的女兒現在怎麼安排放學後的時間？
prompt.simplified: 这位妈妈的女儿现在怎么安排放学后的时间？
prompt.pinyin: Zhè wèi māma de nǚ'ér xiànzài zěnme ānpái fàng xué hòu de shíjiān?
prompt.english: How does the mother's daughter spend her time after school now?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yí ge xīngqí bǔxí sì tiān.
choices.english: She goes to cram school four days a week.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Ānpái yìxiē shíjiān zuò yùndòng.
choices.english: She sets aside some time for sports.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 把大部分時間花在戶外
choices.simplified: 把大部分时间花在户外
choices.pinyin: Bǎ dàbùfèn shíjiān huā zài hùwài.
choices.english: She spends most of her time outdoors.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiàkè hòu liú zài xuéxiào niànshū.
choices.english: She stays at school to study after class.

questions.why: Her father finally agreed to let her stop cram school. She now swims and plays ball games, and a third of her time is outdoors, so outdoors does not take up most of her time.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的覺得這個改變怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 女的觉得这个改变怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de juéde zhège gǎibiàn zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What does the woman think of this change?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 成績進步，可是睡得太少
choices.simplified: 成绩进步，可是睡得太少
choices.pinyin: Chéngjī jìnbù, kěshì shuì de tài shǎo.
choices.english: Grades are up, but she sleeps too little.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 孩子快樂，可是成績變差
choices.simplified: 孩子快乐，可是成绩变差
choices.pinyin: Háizi kuàilè, kěshì chéngjī biàn chà.
choices.english: Her child is happier, but grades are down.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yùndòng tài duō, shàngkè méi jīngshén.
choices.english: Too much sport, so she is tired in class.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 成績沒變，孩子輕鬆多了
choices.simplified: 成绩没变，孩子轻松多了
choices.pinyin: Chéngjī méi biàn, háizi qīngsōng duō le.
choices.english: Grades are the same, and her child is more relaxed.

questions.why: She says grades are 跟以前差不多 (about the same) and that studying is no longer so painful (不再那麼痛苦); her daughter also sleeps well and asks more questions. Nothing she says points to worse grades, too little sleep or tiredness in class.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段廣播，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段广播，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn guǎngbò, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a broadcast, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 聽眾朋友晚安。在這次調查中，臺北青少年週末晚上常在家看電影的有二分之一，常去夜店或酒吧的有五分之一。
lines.simplified: 听众朋友晚安。在这次调查中，台北青少年周末晚上常在家看电影的有二分之一，常去夜店或酒吧的有五分之一。
lines.pinyin: Tīngzhòng péngyǒu wǎn'ān. Zài zhè cì diàochá zhōng, Táiběi qīngshàonián zhōumò wǎnshàng cháng zài jiā kàn diànyǐng de yǒu èr fēn zhī yī, cháng qù yèdiàn huò jiǔbā de yǒu wǔ fēn zhī yī.
lines.english: Good evening, listeners. In this survey of Taipei teenagers, half often watch films at home on weekend nights, and one fifth often go to nightclubs or bars.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這些場所的音樂太大聲，聽起來像噪音。有人喝醉，有人吸毒。毒品會傷害身心，讓家人痛苦，被警察抓到還會有法律問題。
lines.simplified: 这些场所的音乐太大声，听起来像噪音。有人喝醉，有人吸毒。毒品会伤害身心，让家人痛苦，被警察抓到还会有法律问题。
lines.pinyin: Zhèxiē chǎngsuǒ de yīnyuè tài dàshēng, tīngqǐlái xiàng zàoyīn. Yǒu rén hē zuì, yǒu rén xīdú. Dúpǐn huì shānghài shēnxīn, ràng jiārén tòngkǔ, bèi jǐngchá zhuā dào hái huì yǒu fǎlǜ wèntí.
lines.english: The music in these places is so loud that it sounds like noise. Some people get drunk, and some take drugs. Drugs harm body and mind, cause suffering for families, and can mean legal trouble if the police catch you.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 所以，父母不能不關心孩子週末晚上去了哪裡、跟誰在一起。下一段節目，我們請到一位醫生，來談談怎麼幫孩子重新找到健康的休閒活動。
lines.simplified: 所以，父母不能不关心孩子周末晚上去了哪里、跟谁在一起。下一段节目，我们请到一位医生，来谈谈怎么帮孩子重新找到健康的休闲活动。
lines.pinyin: Suǒyǐ, fùmǔ bùnéngbù guānxīn háizi zhōumò wǎnshàng qù le nǎlǐ, gēn shéi zài yìqǐ. Xià yí duàn jiémù, wǒmen qǐng dào yí wèi yīshēng, lái tántan zěnme bāng háizi chóngxīn zhǎo dào jiànkāng de xiūxián huódòng.
lines.english: So parents must pay attention to where their children go on weekend nights and who they are with. In the next part of the programme, a doctor joins us to talk about how to help children find healthy leisure activities again.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 這段廣播主要想告訴聽眾什麼？
prompt.simplified: 这段广播主要想告诉听众什么？
prompt.pinyin: Zhè duàn guǎngbò zhǔyào xiǎng gàosu tīngzhòng shénme?
prompt.english: What is the main message of this broadcast?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 介紹青少年愛去的場所
choices.simplified: 介绍青少年爱去的场所
choices.pinyin: Jièshào qīngshàonián ài qù de chǎngsuǒ.
choices.english: Introduce places teenagers like to go.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 請家長關心孩子的休閒
choices.simplified: 请家长关心孩子的休闲
choices.pinyin: Qǐng jiāzhǎng guānxīn háizi de xiūxián.
choices.english: Remind parents to pay attention to their children's leisure activities.

choices.speaker: N

choices.simplified: 说明家长怎么安排回家时间

lines.traditional: 各位家長好，歡迎帶孩子來參加我們的兒童戶外活動。這兩天的行程有爬山、在海灘玩水，還有學釣魚。下雨的時候，就改在室內上課。

lines.pinyin: Gèwèi jiāzhǎng hǎo, huānyíng dài háizi lái cānjiā wǒmen de értóng hùwài huódòng. Zhè liǎng tiān de xíngchéng yǒu pá shān, zài hǎitān wán shuǐ, háiyǒu xué diàoyú. Xià yǔ de shíhòu, jiù gǎi zài shìnèi shàngkè.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 過去的活動中，有的孩子第一次嘗試下水時很怕，後來慢慢克服了怕水的障礙，敢玩水了。

lines.english: At past events, some children were afraid the first time they tried going into the water. Little by little they overcame their fear of the water and felt able to play in the water.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 山上下午常常下大雨，所以我們不能不把爬山改到早上，第一天六點半就要出發。孩子們會一直流汗，請多帶一套衣服來換。

passage.traditional: 我媽媽年輕時很愛唱歌，還在餐廳表演過。結婚後為了照顧家人，她{1}了練歌的時間。去年我跟妹妹都上了大學，她{2}有了自己的時間，就參加了社區的{3}，負責唱歌。第一次上台前，她緊張得吃不下飯，{4}連覺都睡不好。表演時，台下的人都很{5}。他們以為她只會在家唱歌，沒想到她唱歌跟歌星一樣好聽。以前都是朋友約她出去，現在她每個週末都{6}找朋友來家裡練歌，比我們還忙。

passage.pinyin: Wǒ māma niánqīng shí hěn ài chànggē, hái zài cāntīng biǎoyǎn guo. Jiéhūn hòu wèile zhàogù jiārén, tā xīshēng le liàn gē de shíjiān. Qùnián wǒ gēn mèimei dōu shàng le dàxué, tā zǒngsuàn yǒu le zìjǐ de shíjiān, jiù cānjiā le shèqū de yuètuán, fùzé chànggē. Dì yī cì shàngtái qián, tā jǐnzhāng de chī bùxià fàn, shènzhì lián jiào dōu shuì bùhǎo. Biǎoyǎn shí, táixià de rén dōu hěn jīngyà. Tāmen yǐwéi tā zhǐ huì zài jiā chànggē, méixiǎngdào tā chànggē gēn gēxīng yíyàng hǎotīng. Yǐqián dōu shì péngyǒu yuē tā chūqù, xiànzài tā měi ge zhōumò dōu zhǔdòng zhǎo péngyǒu lái jiālǐ liàn gē, bǐ wǒmen hái máng.
passage.english: My mother loved singing when she was young and even sang in a restaurant, but after she married she gave up the time she used to spend practising singing so she could look after the family. Last year my sister and I both started university, and at last she had time of her own, so she joined a community band where she is the singer. Before she first went onstage she was so nervous she couldn't eat, and she couldn't even sleep. On the day of the show, the audience was surprised as soon as she started to sing. They thought she only sang at home, but her singing was as good as a pop star's. It used to be her friends who asked her out; now every weekend she is the one who invites friends home to practise singing, and she is busier than we are.

passage.traditional: 我叔叔在一家大公司當經理，每天的{1}都排得很滿，開會、見客人，連吃飯都得看時間。去年有一天，客人已經在公司等他。他{2}要出門，頭就突然痛了起來，{3}住院一個星期。醫生說，這種生活對身體只有{4}，頭痛還會更嚴重。出院後，叔叔不得不少做一點工作，週末也開始去海邊{5}。他常坐在海邊看著水，有時候等了幾個小時，什麼都沒帶回家。不用接工作的電話，他覺得很{6}。現在他每個月都帶我們去。

Qùnián yǒu yì tiān, kèrén yǐjīng zài gōngsī děng tā. Tā zhèng yào chūmén, tóu jiù túrán tòng le qǐlái, jiéguǒ zhùyuàn yí ge xīngqí. Yīshēng shuō, zhè zhǒng shēnghuó duì shēntǐ zhǐyǒu shānghài, tóutòng hái huì gèng yánzhòng. Chūyuàn hòu, shúshu bùdébù shǎo zuò yìdiǎn gōngzuò, zhōumò yě kāishǐ qù hǎibiān diàoyú. Tā cháng zuò zài hǎibiān kàn zhe shuǐ, yǒushíhòu děng le jǐ ge xiǎoshí, shénme dōu méi dài huí jiā. Búyòng jiē gōngzuò de diànhuà, tā juéde hěn zìyóuzìzài. Xiànzài tā měi ge yuè dōu dài wǒmen qù.
passage.english: My uncle is a manager at a big company. His schedule was full every day with meetings and client visits. He even had to watch the time at meals. One day last year, a client was already waiting for him at the office. Just as he was about to leave, his head suddenly began to hurt, and he ended up spending a week in hospital. The doctor said that living this way could only harm his health and make the headaches worse. After leaving hospital, my uncle had to work a little less, and he started going fishing by the sea on weekends. He often sits by the sea watching the water. Sometimes he waits for hours and takes nothing home. He feels free and easy when he doesn't have to take work calls. Now he takes us along every month.

想嘗試刺激的戶外活動嗎？來海灘學衝浪吧！

Shéi kěyǐ cānjiā: mǎn shí'èr suì kěyǐ bàomíng chōnglàng kè. Hái méi mǎn shí'èr suì de értóng, qǐng cānjiā xīngqírì xiàwǔ de wánshuǐ kè. title.pinyin: Bù pái xíngchéng de yì tiān

text.traditional: 我是一個很怕時間不夠用的人。過去，我每天的行程都規劃得很仔細：幾點上課、幾點去補習、幾點吃飯，連走到捷運站要幾分幾秒都算好了。在朋友眼中，我分分秒秒都想著要怎麼安排時間。上個學期，我累得生了一場病，醫生說我的身心都需要好好休息。從那時候起，我每個星期留一天，除了必要的事，什麼都不排。剛開始，我實在不太適應，總是想拿出手機看看下一件事是什麼，花了一個月才改掉這個習慣。慢慢地，我發現沒有安排的日子也有不少樂趣：有時候去公園看人打球，有時候在咖啡店坐一個下午。以前我覺得休息就是犧牲念書的時間，現在我發現，休息過的第二天，書念得比以前更好。
text.simplified: 我是一个很怕时间不够用的人。过去，我每天的行程都规划得很仔细：几点上课、几点去补习、几点吃饭，连走到捷运站要几分几秒都算好了。在朋友眼中，我分分秒秒都想着要怎么安排时间。上个学期，我累得生了一场病，医生说我的身心都需要好好休息。从那时候起，我每个星期留一天，除了必要的事，什么都不排。刚开始，我实在不太适应，总是想拿出手机看看下一件事是什么，花了一个月才改掉这个习惯。慢慢地，我发现没有安排的日子也有不少乐趣：有时候去公园看人打球，有时候在咖啡店坐一个下午。以前我觉得休息就是牺牲念书的时间，现在我发现，休息过的第二天，书念得比以前更好。
text.pinyin: Wǒ shì yí ge hěn pà shíjiān búgòu yòng de rén. Guòqù, wǒ měi tiān de xíngchéng dōu guīhuà de hěn zǐxì: jǐ diǎn shàngkè, jǐ diǎn qù bǔxí, jǐ diǎn chī fàn, lián zǒu dào jiéyùn zhàn yào jǐ fēn jǐ miǎo dōu suàn hǎo le. Zài péngyǒu yǎn zhōng, wǒ fēnfēn miǎomiǎo dōu xiǎng zhe yào zěnme ānpái shíjiān. Shàng ge xuéqí, wǒ lèi de shēng le yì chǎng bìng, yīshēng shuō wǒ de shēnxīn dōu xūyào hǎohǎo xiūxí. Cóng nà shíhòu qǐ, wǒ měi ge xīngqí liú yì tiān, chúle bìyào de shì, shénme dōu bù pái. Gāng kāishǐ, wǒ shízài bú tài shìyìng, zǒngshì xiǎng ná chū shǒujī kànkan xià yí jiàn shì shì shénme, huā le yí ge yuè cái gǎi diào zhège xíguàn. Mànmàn de, wǒ fāxiàn méiyǒu ānpái de rìzi yě yǒu bùshǎo lèqù: yǒushíhòu qù gōngyuán kàn rén dǎqiú, yǒushíhòu zài kāfēidiàn zuò yí ge xiàwǔ. Yǐqián wǒ juéde xiūxí jiùshì xīshēng niànshū de shíjiān, xiànzài wǒ fāxiàn, xiūxí guo de dì èr tiān, shū niàn de bǐ yǐqián gèng hǎo.
text.english: I'm someone who is always afraid of running out of time. In the past I planned every day's schedule in detail: when to go to class, when to go to cram school, when to eat; I even worked out how many minutes and seconds it took to walk to the MRT station. My friends thought I wanted to plan out every second of my day. Last semester I wore myself out and fell ill, and the doctor said my body and mind both needed a proper rest. Since then I keep one day a week on which I plan nothing but what is necessary. At first I really couldn't adjust: I kept wanting to take out my phone to see what came next, and it took me a month to break that habit. Slowly I found that days without plans have plenty of pleasures too: sometimes I go to the park to watch people play ball games, sometimes I sit in a café all afternoon. I used to think resting meant sacrificing study time. Now I find that on the day after a rest, my studying goes better than before.

text.traditional: 我家附近有一條老街。過去，那裡有十幾家酒吧和夜店，每天晚上都開到天亮。店裡的音響一開，街上都聽得到。這些噪音讓附近的民眾晚上睡不好。常常有人喝醉了在路上大叫，甚至有人在店裡吸毒，警察常常來抓人。附近的民眾不斷抱怨，很多有孩子的家庭都搬走了。三年前，新市長決定重新規劃這條街：店家晚上十二點以後不能再放音樂，沒有人住的房子拿來做兒童圖書館和休閒場所，週末還請小樂團在街上表演。現在，白天常常看到父母帶著孩子來散步，晚上也安靜多了，整條街的環境改善了很多，有一些搬走的人又搬了回來。不過，也有一些年輕人覺得很可惜，說這裡已經不夠酷了，晚上想跟朋友去喝一杯，得坐車到別的地方去。
text.simplified: 我家附近有一条老街。过去，那里有十几家酒吧和夜店，每天晚上都开到天亮。店里的音响一开，街上都听得到。这些噪音让附近的民众晚上睡不好。常常有人喝醉了在路上大叫，甚至有人在店里吸毒，警察常常来抓人。附近的民众不断抱怨，很多有孩子的家庭都搬走了。三年前，新市长决定重新规划这条街：店家晚上十二点以后不能再放音乐，没有人住的房子拿来做儿童图书馆和休闲场所，周末还请小乐团在街上表演。现在，白天常常看到父母带着孩子来散步，晚上也安静多了，整条街的环境改善了很多，有一些搬走的人又搬了回来。不过，也有一些年轻人觉得很可惜，说这里已经不够酷了，晚上想跟朋友去喝一杯，得坐车到别的地方去。
text.pinyin: Wǒ jiā fùjìn yǒu yì tiáo lǎo jiē. Guòqù, nàlǐ yǒu shí jǐ jiā jiǔbā hé yèdiàn, měi tiān wǎnshàng dōu kāi dào tiān liàng. Diàn lǐ de yīnxiǎng yì kāi, jiēshàng dōu tīngdedào. Zhèxiē zàoyīn ràng fùjìn de mínzhòng wǎnshàng shuì bùhǎo. Chángcháng yǒu rén hē zuì le zài lùshàng dàjiào, shènzhì yǒu rén zài diàn lǐ xīdú, jǐngchá chángcháng lái zhuā rén. Fùjìn de mínzhòng búduàn bàoyuàn, hěn duō yǒu háizi de jiātíng dōu bān zǒu le. Sān nián qián, xīn shìzhǎng juédìng chóngxīn guīhuà zhè tiáo jiē: diànjiā wǎnshàng shí'èr diǎn yǐhòu bùnéng zài fàng yīnyuè, méiyǒu rén zhù de fángzi ná lái zuò értóng túshūguǎn hé xiūxián chǎngsuǒ, zhōumò hái qǐng xiǎo yuètuán zài jiēshàng biǎoyǎn. Xiànzài, báitiān chángcháng kàndào fùmǔ dài zhe háizi lái sànbù, wǎnshàng yě ānjìng duō le, zhěng tiáo jiē de huánjìng gǎishàn le hěn duō, yǒu yìxiē bān zǒu de rén yòu bān le huílái. Búguò, yě yǒu yìxiē niánqīng rén juéde hěn kěxí, shuō zhèlǐ yǐjīng búgòu kù le, wǎnshàng xiǎng gēn péngyǒu qù hē yì bēi, děi zuò chē dào biéde dìfāng qù.
text.english: There is an old street near my home. In the past it had a dozen or so bars and nightclubs that stayed open until dawn every night. When the clubs turned on their stereos, the music carried into the street. The noise kept nearby residents awake. Drunk people often shouted in the street, and some people even took drugs in the clubs, so the police often came to arrest people. Nearby residents kept complaining, and many families with children moved away. Three years ago the new mayor decided to replan the street: businesses could no longer play music after midnight, empty buildings turned into a children's library and places for leisure, and small bands invited to play in the street at weekends. Now you often see parents walking there with their children in the daytime, the nights are much quieter, the whole street is a far better place, and some of the families who left have moved back. But some young people think it's a pity: they say the place isn't cool any more, and if they want a drink with friends at night they have to take a bus or taxi somewhere else.

text.traditional: 上個月颱風過去以後，我跟幾個朋友去海邊玩。沒想到，海灘上到處都是被風吹來的東西：有樹枝、瓶子，甚至還有一台壞掉的冰箱。我們決定留下來整理。本來以為只有我們幾個人，一定要忙到天黑，沒想到附近的民眾聽說了，也一個一個主動來幫忙。大家不僅帶了手套，還有人開卡車來收垃圾。那天太陽很大，大家一直流汗，可是沒有一個人停下來休息。到了下午三點，海灘總算乾淨了。那天雖然沒有下水游泳，可是大家一起出力的感覺，比玩水還快樂。
text.simplified: 上个月台风过去以后，我跟几个朋友去海边玩。没想到，海滩上到处都是被风吹来的东西：有树枝、瓶子，甚至还有一台坏掉的冰箱。我们决定留下来整理。本来以为只有我们几个人，一定要忙到天黑，没想到附近的民众听说了，也一个一个主动来帮忙。大家不仅带了手套，还有人开卡车来收垃圾。那天太阳很大，大家一直流汗，可是没有一个人停下来休息。到了下午三点，海滩总算干净了。那天虽然没有下水游泳，可是大家一起出力的感觉，比玩水还快乐。
text.pinyin: Shàng ge yuè táifēng guòqù yǐhòu, wǒ gēn jǐ ge péngyǒu qù hǎibiān wán. Méixiǎngdào, hǎitān shàng dàochù dōu shì bèi fēng chuī lái de dōngxi: yǒu shùzhī, píngzi, shènzhì háiyǒu yì tái huài diào de bīngxiāng. Wǒmen juédìng liú xiàlái zhěnglǐ. Běnlái yǐwéi zhǐyǒu wǒmen jǐ ge rén, yídìng yào máng dào tiān hēi, méixiǎngdào fùjìn de mínzhòng tīngshuō le, yě yí ge yí ge zhǔdòng lái bāngmáng. Dàjiā bùjǐn dài le shǒutào, háiyǒu rén kāi kǎchē lái shōu lèsè. Nà tiān tàiyáng hěn dà, dàjiā yìzhí liúhàn, kěshì méiyǒu yí ge rén tíng xiàlái xiūxí. Dào le xiàwǔ sān diǎn, hǎitān zǒngsuàn gānjìng le. Nà tiān suīrán méiyǒu xià shuǐ yóuyǒng, kěshì dàjiā yìqǐ chūlì de gǎnjué, bǐ wánshuǐ hái kuàilè.
text.english: Last month, after the typhoon had passed, I went to the seaside with a few friends. To our surprise, the beach was covered with things the wind had blown in: branches, bottles, even a broken fridge. We decided to stay and clean up. We thought it would be just the few of us and we'd surely be busy until dark, but people living nearby heard about it and came one after another to help without being asked. They not only brought gloves; someone even drove a truck over to collect the rubbish. The sun was strong that day, everyone sweated non-stop, but nobody stopped to rest. By three in the afternoon the beach was clean at last. We didn't go swimming that day, but working together felt even better than playing in the water.

text.traditional: 我的室友從小的夢想是當演員。他在學校學的是電腦，可是每天下課以後都去上表演課。為了付學費，他晚上還在超商打工，回到宿舍常常已經半夜了。我跟他說別這麼累，他說：「就算一天只能睡五個小時，我也要試試看。」他就這樣練了兩年。去年有一位導演來學校找演員，他也去試了，結果他得到了演小角色的機會。去看電影時，我們才發現他在電影裡只出現了三十秒，大家都很驚訝。可是他高興得不得了，買了很多張票請朋友去看。他說這三十秒可以說是他這輩子最珍貴的回憶，以後他還打算繼續努力，演更多的角色。
text.simplified: 我的室友从小的梦想是当演员。他在学校学的是电脑，可是每天下课以后都去上表演课。为了付学费，他晚上还在超商打工，回到宿舍常常已经半夜了。我跟他说别这么累，他说：「就算一天只能睡五个小时，我也要试试看。」他就这样练了两年。去年有一位导演来学校找演员，他也去试了，结果他得到了演小角色的机会。去看电影时，我们才发现他在电影里只出现了三十秒，大家都很惊讶。可是他高兴得不得了，买了很多张票请朋友去看。他说这三十秒可以说是他这辈子最珍贵的回忆，以后他还打算继续努力，演更多的角色。
text.pinyin: Wǒ de shìyǒu cóngxiǎo de mèngxiǎng shì dāng yǎnyuán. Tā zài xuéxiào xué de shì diànnǎo, kěshì měi tiān xiàkè yǐhòu dōu qù shàng biǎoyǎn kè. Wèile fù xuéfèi, tā wǎnshàng hái zài chāoshāng dǎgōng, huí dào sùshè chángcháng yǐjīng bànyè le. Wǒ gēn tā shuō bié zhème lèi, tā shuō: “Jiùsuàn yì tiān zhǐnéng shuì wǔ ge xiǎoshí, wǒ yě yào shìshi kàn.” Tā jiù zhèyàng liàn le liǎng nián. Qùnián yǒu yí wèi dǎoyǎn lái xuéxiào zhǎo yǎnyuán, tā yě qù shì le, jiéguǒ tā dédào le yǎn xiǎo jiǎosè de jīhuì. Qù kàn diànyǐng shí, wǒmen cái fāxiàn tā zài diànyǐng lǐ zhǐ chūxiàn le sānshí miǎo, dàjiā dōu hěn jīngyà. Kěshì tā gāoxìng de bùdéliǎo, mǎi le hěn duō zhāng piào qǐng péngyǒu qù kàn. Tā shuō zhè sānshí miǎo kěyǐshuō shì tā zhè bèizi zuì zhēnguì de huíyì, yǐhòu tā hái dǎsuàn jìxù nǔlì, yǎn gèng duō de jiǎosè.
text.english: My roommate's dream since childhood has been to be an actor. He studies computing, but every day after class he goes to acting lessons. To pay the fees he also works nights at a convenience store, and when he gets back to the dorm it's often already midnight. I urged him not to wear himself out like this, and he said, "Even if I can only sleep five hours a night, I want to give it a try." He kept at it like that for two years. Last year a director came to our school looking for actors; he tried out too, and as a result he was chosen for a small part. When we went to see the film, we found that he appeared on screen for only thirty seconds, and we were all surprised. But he was overjoyed and bought lots of tickets for his friends. He says those thirty seconds are probably the most precious memory of his life, and he plans to keep working hard and play more parts.
