prompt.pinyin: Kàn le qìxiàng yùbào yǐhòu, liǎng rén běnlái yǐwéi huì zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: After seeing the forecast, what did the two think would happen?

choices.pinyin: Táifēng huì lái dào xiǎo dǎo.
choices.english: The typhoon would come to the island.

choices.pinyin: Děi zài dǎo shàng duō zhù jǐ tiān.
choices.english: They would have to stay on the island a few more days.

choices.pinyin: Dì èr tiān jiù néng zuò chuán huíjiā.
choices.english: They could take the boat home the next day.

choices.pinyin: Dǎo shàng méiyǒu dìfāng dǎ diànhuà.
choices.english: There would be nowhere on the island to make a call.

questions.why: 以為 marks what they believed before things turned out otherwise: the forecast said the typhoon would go north, so they thought they could go home on time the next day. Staying extra days is what really happened, not what they expected, and the owner took them to a shop where they could call.

prompt.traditional: 這一連三天的經驗，給作者留下什麼樣的回憶？
prompt.simplified: 这一连三天的经验，给作者留下什么样的回忆？
prompt.pinyin: Zhè yìlián sān tiān de jīngyàn, gěi zuòzhě liú xià shénme yàng de huíyì?
prompt.english: What memories did the writer take away from those three days?

choices.traditional: 記得最清楚的是別人的照顧
choices.simplified: 记得最清楚的是别人的照顾
choices.pinyin: Jìde zuì qīngchǔ de shì biérén de zhàogù.
choices.english: What he remembers most is the kindness he received.

choices.traditional: 記得最清楚的是小島的景色
choices.simplified: 记得最清楚的是小岛的景色
choices.pinyin: Jìde zuì qīngchǔ de shì xiǎo dǎo de jǐngsè.
choices.english: What he remembers most is the island scenery.

choices.traditional: 最可惜的是少了三天休息時間
choices.simplified: 最可惜的是少了三天休息时间
choices.pinyin: Zuì kěxí de shì shǎo le sān tiān xiūxí shíjiān.
choices.english: What he regrets most is losing three days of rest.

choices.traditional: 最大的收穫是學會看氣象預報
choices.simplified: 最大的收获是学会看气象预报
choices.pinyin: Zuì dà de shōuhuò shì xué huì kàn qìxiàng yùbào.
choices.english: What he gained most was learning to read a weather forecast.

questions.why: The owner helped them call home and invited them to eat. Those are the moments he recalls from the three days he was stuck there, while sightseeing was only the original plan.

text.traditional:
下個月我要去日本滑雪。滑雪的衣服很貴，我本來想在百貨公司的專櫃買，可是一套要一萬多塊。朋友說：「貨比三家不吃虧，你先上網比價吧。」我在網路上找到了一套相同的，價格不僅低了三分之一，還送一雙手套。
可是衣服寄來以後，我發現褲子太緊了。網站上的說明很詳細：七天以內可以換，不過得自己付寄回去的錢，而且最早也得兩個星期才收得到新的。我確認了出發日期，發現有個問題：兩個星期後我已經到了日本。
最後，我只好回到專櫃，用原來的價格再買一條褲子。算一算，我花的錢跟一開始就在專櫃買差不多，還花了不少時間處理這件事。現在我覺得，比價是好習慣，不過像衣服這種得穿穿看的東西，還是先在店裡試穿過再買比較好。
text.simplified:
下个月我要去日本滑雪。滑雪的衣服很贵，我本来想在百货公司的专柜买，可是一套要一万多块。朋友说：「货比三家不吃亏，你先上网比价吧。」我在网路上找到了一套相同的，价格不仅低了三分之一，还送一双手套。
可是衣服寄来以后，我发现裤子太紧了。网站上的说明很详细：七天以内可以换，不过得自己付寄回去的钱，而且最早也得两个星期才收得到新的。我确认了出发日期，发现有个问题：两个星期后我已经到了日本。
最后，我只好回到专柜，用原来的价格再买一条裤子。算一算，我花的钱跟一开始就在专柜买差不多，还花了不少时间处理这件事。现在我觉得，比价是好习惯，不过像衣服这种得穿穿看的东西，还是先在店里试穿过再买比较好。
text.pinyin: Xià ge yuè wǒ yào qù Rìběn huáxuě. Huáxuě de yīfú hěn guì, wǒ běnlái xiǎng zài bǎihuò gōngsī de zhuānguì mǎi, kěshì yí tào yào yíwàn duō kuài. Péngyǒu shuō: “Huò bǐ sān jiā bù chīkuī, nǐ xiān shàngwǎng bǐjià ba.” Wǒ zài wǎnglù shàng zhǎo dào le yí tào xiāngtóng de, jiàgé bùjǐn dī le sān fēn zhī yī, hái sòng yì shuāng shǒutào. Kěshì yīfú jì lái yǐhòu, wǒ fāxiàn kùzi tài jǐn le. Wǎngzhàn shàng de shuōmíng hěn xiángxì: qī tiān yǐnèi kěyǐ huàn, búguò děi zìjǐ fù jì huíqù de qián, érqiě zuìzǎo yě děi liǎng ge xīngqí cái shōu de dào xīn de. Wǒ quèrèn le chūfā rìqī, fāxiàn yǒu ge wèntí: liǎng ge xīngqí hòu wǒ yǐjīng dào le Rìběn. Zuìhòu, wǒ zhǐhǎo huí dào zhuānguì, yòng yuánlái de jiàgé zài mǎi yì tiáo kùzi. Suàn yí suàn, wǒ huā de qián gēn yì kāishǐ jiù zài zhuānguì mǎi chàbùduō, hái huā le bù shǎo shíjiān chǔlǐ zhè jiàn shì. Xiànzài wǒ juéde, bǐjià shì hǎo xíguàn, búguò xiàng yīfú zhè zhǒng děi chuānchuān kàn de dōngxi, háishì xiān zài diàn lǐ shìchuān guo zài mǎi bǐjiào hǎo.
text.english:
Next month I'm going skiing in Japan. Ski clothes are expensive. I first meant to buy them at a department-store counter, but a set cost over ten thousand. A friend said, "Shop around and you won't lose out; compare prices online first." I found the same set online: not only a third cheaper, but with a free pair of gloves.
But when the clothes arrived, the trousers were too tight. The website explained it in detail: I could exchange them within seven days, but I would have to pay the postage back myself, and the new pair would only arrive two weeks later. I checked my departure date and saw the problem: in two weeks I would already be in Japan.
In the end I had to go to the counter and buy another pair of trousers at the full price. Adding it up, I spent about as much as if I had bought everything at the counter in the first place, and I spent a lot of time sorting it out. Now I think comparing prices is a good habit, but for things like clothes that you need to try on, it is better to try them on in a shop before buying.

prompt.traditional: 作者花的錢，為什麼跟一開始就在專櫃買差不多？
prompt.simplified: 作者花的钱，为什么跟一开始就在专柜买差不多？
prompt.pinyin: Zuòzhě huā de qián, wèishénme gēn yì kāishǐ jiù zài zhuānguì mǎi chàbùduō?
prompt.english: Why did the writer spend about as much as buying at the counter in the first place?

choices.pinyin: Tā huā qián bǎ kùzi jì huíqù.
choices.english: He paid to send the trousers back.

choices.pinyin: Tā děi zài mǎi yì tiáo kùzi.
choices.english: He had to buy another pair of trousers.

choices.pinyin: Zhuānguì hòulái yě yǒu yōuhuì.
choices.english: The counter later had a discount too.

choices.pinyin: Wǎnglù shàng de jiàqián biàn guì le.
choices.english: The online price went up.

questions.why: Exchanging the tight trousers would take until after his departure, so he bought another pair at full price. He kept the original pair and never paid to send it back.

prompt.traditional: 要是朋友也要買滑雪衣服，作者比較可能給什麼建議？
prompt.simplified: 要是朋友也要买滑雪衣服，作者比较可能给什么建议？
prompt.pinyin: Yàoshi péngyǒu yě yào mǎi huáxuě yīfú, zuòzhě bǐjiào kěnéng gěi shénme jiànyì?
prompt.english: What advice would the writer most likely give a friend buying ski clothes?

choices.traditional: 先試穿看看，再決定買不買
choices.simplified: 先试穿看看，再决定买不买
choices.pinyin: Xiān shìchuān kànkan, zài juédìng mǎi bù mǎi.
choices.english: Try it on first, then decide whether to buy.

choices.traditional: 先上網比價，便宜就馬上買
choices.simplified: 先上网比价，便宜就马上买
choices.pinyin: Xiān shàngwǎng bǐjià, piányí jiù mǎshàng mǎi.
choices.english: Compare prices online first and buy whatever is cheap.

choices.traditional: 先買回家，太緊再寄回去換
choices.simplified: 先买回家，太紧再寄回去换
choices.pinyin: Xiān mǎi huí jiā, tài jǐn zài jì huíqù huàn.
choices.english: Buy it first and send it back if it is too tight.

choices.traditional: 先問能不能換，再上網買
choices.simplified: 先问能不能换，再上网买
choices.pinyin: Xiān wèn néng bù néng huàn, zài shàngwǎng mǎi.
choices.english: Ask about exchanges first, then buy online.

questions.why: He still sees value in comparing prices, but for clothes he now says to try them on in a shop before buying. Buying cheap online and sending things back is what cost him time and money.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你昨天去參加同事的婚禮，怎麼樣？
lines.simplified: 你昨天去参加同事的婚礼，怎么样？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zuótiān qù cānjiā tóngshì de hūnlǐ, zěnmeyàng?
lines.english: How was your colleague's wedding yesterday?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 一點也不開心。我穿了白襯衫跟黑褲子，好幾位客人把我看成了飯店的服務生，一直請我拿飲料。
lines.simplified: 一点也不开心。我穿了白衬衫跟黑裤子，好几位客人把我看成了饭店的服务生，一直请我拿饮料。
lines.pinyin: Yìdiǎnyěbù kāixīn. Wǒ chuān le bái chènshān gēn hēi kùzi, hǎojǐwèi kèrén bǎ wǒ kànchéng le fàndiàn de fúwùshēng, yìzhí qǐng wǒ ná yǐnliào.
lines.english: Not at all. I wore a white shirt and black trousers, and several guests took me for one of the hotel's waiters and kept asking me to bring them drinks.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 真的嗎？你平時穿得那麼休閒，難得穿得這麼帥，沒想到被誤會了。
lines.simplified: 真的吗？你平时穿得那么休闲，难得穿得这么帅，没想到被误会了。
lines.pinyin: Zhēnde ma? Nǐ píngshí chuān de nàme xiūxián, nán děichuān de zhème shuài, méixiǎngdào bèi wùhuì le.
lines.english: Really? You usually dress so casually; for once you look this sharp, and you get mistaken for someone else.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 下次我要穿出自己的風格。
lines.simplified: 下次我要穿出自己的风格。
lines.pinyin: Xiàcì wǒ yào chuān chū zìjǐ de fēnggé.
lines.english: Next time I'm going to dress in my own style.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的昨天在婚禮上遇到了什麼事？
prompt.simplified: 男的昨天在婚礼上遇到了什么事？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de zuótiān zài hūnlǐ shàng yùdào le shénme shì?
prompt.english: What happened to the man at the wedding yesterday?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他把客人看成了服務生
choices.simplified: 他把客人看成了服务生
choices.pinyin: Tā bǎ kèrén kànchéng le fúwùshēng.
choices.english: He took a guest for a waiter.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他得一直幫同事拿飲料
choices.simplified: 他得一直帮同事拿饮料
choices.pinyin: Tā de yìzhí bāng tóngshì ná yǐnliào.
choices.english: He had to keep fetching drinks for his colleague.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Kèrén yǐwéi tā shì fúwùshēng.
choices.english: The guests thought he was a waiter.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tóngshì shuō tā chuān de tài xiūxián.
choices.english: His colleague said he was dressed too casually.

questions.why: 好幾位客人把我看成了飯店的服務生: the guests mistook him for a waiter, so they kept asking him for drinks. It was not he who mistook anyone, the drinks were for guests, not a colleague, and 穿得那麼休閒 is what the woman says about his usual clothes.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你這個背包好好看，是名牌的吧？
lines.simplified: 你这个背包好好看，是名牌的吧？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zhège bēibāo hǎohǎo kàn, shì míngpái de ba?
lines.english: Your backpack looks great. It's a brand name, isn't it?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 不是，這是在夜市買的平價背包，才三百塊。
lines.simplified: 不是，这是在夜市买的平价背包，才三百块。
lines.pinyin: Bú shì, zhè shì zài yèshì mǎi de píngjià bēibāo, cái sān bǎi kuài.
lines.english: No, it's a cheap backpack I bought at the night market, just three hundred dollars.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 真的看不出來！
lines.simplified: 真的看不出来！
lines.pinyin: Zhēnde kàn bù chūlái!
lines.english: You really can't tell!

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 上次我媽媽也把它看成了名牌，還說我亂花錢。我跟她說了半天，她才相信。所以有沒有品味，跟花多少錢真的沒關係。
lines.simplified: 上次我妈妈也把它看成了名牌，还说我乱花钱。我跟她说了半天，她才相信。所以有没有品味，跟花多少钱真的没关系。
lines.pinyin: Shàngcì wǒ māma yě bǎ tā kànchéng le míngpái, hái shuō wǒ luàn huā qián. Wǒ gēn tā shuō le bàntiān, tā cái xiāngxìn. Suǒyǐ yǒu méi yǒu pǐnwèi, gēn huā duōshǎo qián zhēnde méi guānxi.
lines.english: Last time my mom took it for a brand name too, and said I was wasting money. I explained for ages before she believed me. So whether you have taste really has nothing to do with how much you spend.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 他媽媽上次為什麼不高興？
prompt.simplified: 他妈妈上次为什么不高兴？
prompt.pinyin: Tā māma shàngcì wèishénme bù gāoxìng?
prompt.english: Why was the man's mother unhappy last time?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 以為他花了很多錢買背包
choices.simplified: 以为他花了很多钱买背包
choices.pinyin: Yǐwéi tā huā le hěn duō qián mǎi bēibāo.
choices.english: She thought he had spent a lot on the backpack.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 以為背包是在夜市買的
choices.simplified: 以为背包是在夜市买的
choices.pinyin: Yǐwéi bēibāo shì zài yèshì mǎi de.
choices.english: She thought the backpack came from the night market.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 覺得平價的背包品質不好
choices.simplified: 觉得平价的背包品质不好
choices.pinyin: Juéde píngjià de bēibāo pǐnzhí bù hǎo.
choices.english: She felt cheap backpacks are poorly made.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 覺得他買的背包不好看
choices.simplified: 觉得他买的背包不好看
choices.pinyin: Juéde tā mǎi de bēibāo bù hǎokàn.
choices.english: She felt the backpack he bought looked bad.

questions.why: She took the cheap backpack for a brand name (把它看成了名牌) and so said he was wasting money. That it came from the night market is what he had to explain to her, and nobody says it is badly made or ugly: the woman says it looks great.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 聽說你們新公司對穿著沒什麼限制，很自由吧？
lines.simplified: 听说你们新公司对穿着没什么限制，很自由吧？
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō nǐmen xīn gōngsī duì chuānzhuó méi shénme xiànzhì, hěn zìyóu ba?
lines.english: I hear your new company has hardly any rules about clothes. That must feel free.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 是啊。我以前天天穿襯衫，穿慣了，現在穿得太休閒，覺得不自在。
lines.simplified: 是啊。我以前天天穿衬衫，穿惯了，现在穿得太休闲，觉得不自在。
lines.pinyin: Shì a. Wǒ yǐqián tiāntiān chuān chènshān, chuānguàn le, xiànzài chuān de tài xiūxián, juéde bú zìzài.
lines.english: Yes. I used to wear shirts every day. I got used to them, and now I feel uncomfortable dressing too casually.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那你就繼續穿襯衫啊。
lines.simplified: 那你就继续穿衬衫啊。
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐ jiù jìxù chuān chènshān a.
lines.english: Then just keep wearing shirts.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我也這麼想，可是同事都笑我，說我穿得像在銀行上班的人。
lines.simplified: 我也这么想，可是同事都笑我，说我穿得像在银行上班的人。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yě zhème xiǎng, kěshì tóngshì dōu xiào wǒ, shuō wǒ chuān de xiàng zài yínháng shàngbān de rén.
lines.english: That's what I thought, but my colleagues laugh and say I dress like someone who works at a bank.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的叫他繼續穿襯衫，男的在想什麼？
prompt.simplified: 女的叫他继续穿衬衫，男的在想什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de jiào tā jìxù chuān chènshān, nán de zài xiǎng shénme?
prompt.english: She suggests that he keep wearing shirts. What is he weighing up?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 穿慣了襯衫，又怕穿得太正式
choices.simplified: 穿惯了衬衫，又怕穿得太正式
choices.pinyin: Chuānguàn le chènshān, yòu pà chuān de tài zhèngshì.
choices.english: He is used to shirts but worries about looking too formal.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 喜歡穿襯衫，可是公司有限制
choices.simplified: 喜欢穿衬衫，可是公司有限制
choices.pinyin: Xǐhuān chuān chènshān, kěshì gōngsī yǒu xiànzhì.
choices.english: He likes shirts, but the company has rules about them.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 想穿得休閒，又怕同事笑他
choices.simplified: 想穿得休闲，又怕同事笑他
choices.pinyin: Xiǎng chuān de xiūxián, yòu pà tóngshì xiào tā.
choices.english: He wants to dress casually but fears his colleagues will laugh.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 想跟同事穿得一樣，又怕不好看
choices.simplified: 想跟同事穿得一样，又怕不好看
choices.pinyin: Xiǎng gēn tóngshì chuān de yíyàng, yòu pà bù hǎokàn.
choices.english: He wants to dress like his colleagues but worries it won’t look good.

questions.why: Casual clothes feel wrong because he is used to shirts. But when he wears a shirt, his colleagues tease him about looking like a banker.

focus.en: being used to something; concerns about what to wear

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 爸爸，我上個月送你的那件紅色外套，你怎麼都不穿？
lines.simplified: 爸爸，我上个月送你的那件红色外套，你怎么都不穿？
lines.pinyin: Bàba, wǒ shàng ge yuè sòng nǐ de nà jiàn hóngsè wàitào, nǐ zěnme dōu bù chuān?
lines.english: Dad, why do you never wear the red jacket I gave you last month?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 你去看看我的櫃子，哪一件有這麼亮？我穿慣了顏色深的。
lines.simplified: 你去看看我的柜子，哪一件有这么亮？我穿惯了颜色深的。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ qù kàn kàn wǒ de guìzi, nǎ yíjiàn yǒu zhème liàng? Wǒ chuānguàn le yánsè shēn de.
lines.english: Take a look in my wardrobe. Is anything in there this bright? I’m used to dark colours.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 可是你穿起來很帥啊，一點也不醜。
lines.simplified: 可是你穿起来很帅啊，一点也不丑。
lines.pinyin: Kěshì nǐ chuān qǐlái hěn shuài a, yìdiǎnyěbù chǒu.
lines.english: But you look really handsome in it, not ugly at all.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好吧，那這個星期天去你阿姨家，我就穿那件試試看。
lines.simplified: 好吧，那这个星期天去你阿姨家，我就穿那件试试看。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo ba, nà zhège xīngqítiān qù nǐ āyí jiā, wǒ jiù chuān nà jiàn shì shì kàn.
lines.english: All right, then this Sunday when we go to your aunt's, I'll try wearing it.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 聽了女兒的話，爸爸最後打算怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 听了女儿的话，爸爸最后打算怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Tīng le nǚér dehuà, bàba zuìhòu dǎsuàn zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: After listening to his daughter, what does the father decide to do?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 先換一件顏色深的外套
choices.simplified: 先换一件颜色深的外套
choices.pinyin: Xiān huàn yíjiàn yánsè shēn de wàitào.
choices.english: He will change back into a dark jacket before leaving.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Shì shì píngcháng bù chuān de yánsè.
choices.english: He will try a colour he does not normally wear.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 請女兒幫他換一件外套
choices.simplified: 请女儿帮他换一件外套
choices.pinyin: Qǐng nǚér bāng tā huàn yíjiàn wàitào.
choices.english: He will ask his daughter to exchange the jacket.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 再選一件外套送給阿姨
choices.simplified: 再选一件外套送给阿姨
choices.pinyin: Zài xuǎn yíjiàn wàitào sòng gěi āyí.
choices.english: He will pick another jacket as a gift for the aunt.

questions.why: The wardrobe and his remark about dark clothes establish his habit. After his daughter says he looks good, he agrees to try the bright jacket on their visit.

focus.en: being used to something; change of plan

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這件外套只有今天便宜一半，我非買不可！
lines.simplified: 这件外套只有今天便宜一半，我非买不可！
lines.pinyin: Zhè jiàn wàitào zhǐyǒu jīntiān piányí yíbàn, wǒ fēi mǎi bù kě!
lines.english: This jacket is half price today only. I have to buy it!

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳冷靜一點。妳的櫃子裡不是已經有三件差不多的嗎？
lines.simplified: 你冷静一点。你的柜子里不是已经有三件差不多的吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ lěngjìng yìdiǎn. Nǐ de guìzi lǐ bú shì yǐjīng yǒu sān jiàn chàbùduō de ma?
lines.english: Calm down. Don't you already have three jackets just like it in your wardrobe?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 可是這件是今年最流行的樣式。
lines.simplified: 可是这件是今年最流行的样式。
lines.pinyin: Kěshì zhè jiàn shì jīnnián zuì liúxíng de yàngshì.
lines.english: But this one is this year's most fashionable style.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 流行很快就過去了。妳先回家看看那三件，要是真的需要，晚上再來買也來得及。
lines.simplified: 流行很快就过去了。你先回家看看那三件，要是真的需要，晚上再来买也来得及。
lines.pinyin: Liúxíng hěn kuài jiù guòqù le. Nǐ xiān huí jiā kàn kàn nà sān jiàn, yàoshì zhēnde xūyào, wǎnshàng zài lái mǎi yě láidejí.
lines.english: Fashions pass quickly. Go home and look at those three first; if you really need it, there's still time to come back and buy it tonight.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的建議女的怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 男的建议女的怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de jiànyì nǚ de zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What does the man advise the woman to do?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 今天先把這件外套買下來
choices.simplified: 今天先把这件外套买下来
choices.pinyin: Jīntiān xiān bǎ zhè jiàn wàitào mǎi xiàlái.
choices.english: Buy this jacket today first.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 等過幾天比較便宜再來買
choices.simplified: 等过几天比较便宜再来买
choices.pinyin: Děng guò jǐ tiān bǐjiào piányí zài lái mǎi.
choices.english: Wait a few days until it is cheaper, then buy it.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 先看看家裡的外套再決定
choices.simplified: 先看看家里的外套再决定
choices.pinyin: Xiān kàn kàn jiā lǐ de wàitào zài juédìng.
choices.english: Look at the jackets at home before deciding.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Huàn yíjiàn bù yíyàng de yàngshì.
choices.english: Pick a jacket in a different style.

questions.why: He tells her to look at the three jackets she has first and come back tonight only if she really needs it. Buying today is her plan, not his advice; the discount is for today only, and he says she can come back tonight, not in a few days, and nobody suggests another style.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 明天見日本公司的人，我非穿得那麼正式不可嗎？天氣這麼熱。
lines.simplified: 明天见日本公司的人，我非穿得那么正式不可吗？天气这么热。
lines.pinyin: Míngtiānjiàn Rìběn gōngsī de rén, wǒ fēi chuān de nàme zhèngshì bù kě ma? Tiānqì zhème rè.
lines.english: Tomorrow, when we meet the people from the Japanese company, do I really have to dress so formally? It's so hot.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 當然。這是我們第一次跟他們合作，你的穿著就代表我們公司，不能穿得太休閒。
lines.simplified: 当然。这是我们第一次跟他们合作，你的穿着就代表我们公司，不能穿得太休闲。
lines.pinyin: Dāngrán. Zhè shì wǒmen dìyīcì gēn tāmen hézuò, nǐ de chuānzhuó jiù dàibiǎo wǒmen gōngsī, bù néng chuān de tài xiūxián.
lines.english: Of course. It's our first time working with them; what you wear stands for our company, so you can't be too casual.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好吧。可是我那套顏色深的，去年就穿不下了。
lines.simplified: 好吧。可是我那套颜色深的，去年就穿不下了。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo ba. Kěshì wǒ nà tào yánsè shēn de, qùnián jiù chuānbúxià le.
lines.english: All right. But my dark suit stopped fitting me last year.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那你今天下班就去買一套，別等到明天早上。
lines.simplified: 那你今天下班就去买一套，别等到明天早上。
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐ jīntiān xiàbān jiù qù mǎi yítào, bié děng dào míngtiān zǎoshàng.
lines.english: Then go buy one after work today. Don’t wait until tomorrow morning.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的為什麼認為男的得穿得正式？
prompt.simplified: 女的为什么认为男的得穿得正式？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de wèishénme rènwéi nán de děichuān de zhèngshì?
prompt.english: Why does the woman think the man must dress formally?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 日本公司要大家穿得正式
choices.simplified: 日本公司要大家穿得正式
choices.pinyin: Rìběn gōngsī yào dàjiā chuān de zhèngshì.
choices.english: The Japanese company asks everyone to dress formally.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 第一次跟客人見面都得穿新衣服
choices.simplified: 第一次跟客人见面都得穿新衣服
choices.pinyin: Dì yī cì gēn kèrén jiànmiàn dōu děi chuān xīn yīfu.
choices.english: You should always wear new clothes the first time you meet clients.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 兩家公司已經合作很久了
choices.simplified: 两家公司已经合作很久了
choices.pinyin: Liǎng jiā gōngsī yǐjīng hézuò hěn jiǔ le.
choices.english: The two companies have worked together for a long time.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他的穿著會影響公司給人的感覺
choices.simplified: 他的穿着会影响公司给人的感觉
choices.pinyin: Tā de chuānzhuó huì yǐngxiǎng gōngsī gěi rén de gǎnjué.
choices.english: What he wears shapes how people see the company.

questions.why: She says 你的穿著就代表我們公司: the visitors will judge the company by what he wears. Nobody says the Japanese side asked for it, he must buy a new suit only because the old one no longer fits, and this is their first time working together.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你去日本玩十天，只帶這個小背包？衣服夠穿嗎？
lines.simplified: 你去日本玩十天，只带这个小背包？衣服够穿吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ qù Rìběn wán shí tiān, zhǐ dài zhège xiǎo bēibāo? Yīfu gòu chuān ma?
lines.english: You're going to Japan for ten days with only this little backpack? Will you have enough clothes?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我只帶三件上衣，在那邊洗一洗就好了。當背包客，方便最重要。
lines.simplified: 我只带三件上衣，在那边洗一洗就好了。当背包客，方便最重要。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐ dài sān jiàn shàngyī, zài nàbiān xǐ yì xǐ jiù hǎole. Dāng bēibāokè, fāngbiàn zuì zhòngyào.
lines.english: I'm only taking three tops; I'll wash them there. For a backpacker, travelling light matters most.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 話說回來，你不是要在那裡參加朋友的婚禮嗎？
lines.simplified: 话说回来，你不是要在那里参加朋友的婚礼吗？
lines.pinyin: Huà shuō huí lái, nǐ bú shì yào zài nàlǐ cānjiā péngyǒu de hūnlǐ ma?
lines.english: Then again, aren't you going to a friend's wedding there?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 對！我差點忘了，那還得帶一套正式一點的衣服。
lines.simplified: 对！我差点忘了，那还得带一套正式一点的衣服。
lines.pinyin: Duì! Wǒ chà diǎn wàngle, nà háiděi dài yítào zhèngshì yìdiǎn de yīfu.
lines.english: Right! I nearly forgot. Then I'll have to take a more formal outfit too.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的說「話說回來」，是想讓男的想到什麼？
prompt.simplified: 女的说「话说回来」，是想让男的想到什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de shuō "huà shuō huí lái", shì xiǎng ràng nán de xiǎngdào shénme?
prompt.english: When the woman says 話說回來, what does she want the man to think of?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Shí tiān de yīfu yídìng bú gòu.
choices.english: Ten days of clothes will surely not be enough.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zài nàbiān xǐ yīfu bù fāngbiàn.
choices.english: Washing clothes there will be a hassle.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 小背包放不下三件上衣
choices.simplified: 小背包放不下三件上衣
choices.pinyin: Xiǎo bēibāo fàng bú xià sān jiàn shàngyī.
choices.english: Three tops will not fit in the small backpack.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yǒu yìtiān tā děichuān de zhèngshì.
choices.english: He has to dress formally on one of the days.

questions.why: 話說回來 turns to the other side of his plan: casual tops are fine, but there is a wedding, so he needs one formal outfit. She never says the clothes are too few or that washing is hard, and he is taking the three tops in that backpack.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 明天去花蓮，我想穿這雙新買的白球鞋。
lines.simplified: 明天去花莲，我想穿这双新买的白球鞋。
lines.pinyin: Míngtiān qù Huālián, wǒ xiǎng chuān zhè shuāng xīn mǎi de bái qiúxié.
lines.english: Tomorrow in Hualien I want to wear these new white sneakers.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 氣象預報說會下大雨，萬一弄髒了怎麼辦？還是穿舊的那雙吧。
lines.simplified: 气象预报说会下大雨，万一弄脏了怎么办？还是穿旧的那双吧。
lines.pinyin: Qìxiàng yùbào shuō huì xià dà yǔ, wànyī nòng zāng le zěnmebàn? Háishì chuān jiù de nà shuāng ba.
lines.english: The weather forecast says heavy rain. What if they get dirty? Better wear the old pair.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 舊的那雙太醜了，拍照不好看。
lines.simplified: 旧的那双太丑了，拍照不好看。
lines.pinyin: Jiù de nà shuāng tài chǒu le, pāi zhào bù hǎokàn.
lines.english: The old pair is too ugly; they'll look bad in photos.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那就把新的放在背包裡，到了再換。
lines.simplified: 那就把新的放在背包里，到了再换。
lines.pinyin: Nà jiù bǎ xīn de fàng zài bēibāo lǐ, dào le zài huàn.
lines.english: Then put the new ones in your backpack and change when you get there.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的最後建議男的怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 女的最后建议男的怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de zuìhòu jiànyì nán de zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: In the end, what does the woman suggest the man do?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 穿舊的那雙鞋子去花蓮
choices.simplified: 穿旧的那双鞋子去花莲
choices.pinyin: Chuān jiù de nà shuāng xiézi qù Huālián.
choices.english: Wear the old pair to Hualien.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 帶著新鞋子去，到了再穿
choices.simplified: 带着新鞋子去，到了再穿
choices.pinyin: Dài zhe xīn xiézi qù, dào le zài chuān.
choices.english: Take the new shoes along and put them on there.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Děng tiānqì hǎole zài qù Huālián.
choices.english: Go to Hualien when the weather is better.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 穿新鞋子去，拍完照再換
choices.simplified: 穿新鞋子去，拍完照再换
choices.pinyin: Chuān xīn xiézi qù, pāi wán zhào zài huàn.
choices.english: Wear the new shoes and change after the photos.

questions.why: Her first idea, 還是穿舊的那雙吧, is dropped when he says the old pair looks bad in photos; her last word is to carry the new pair and change when they arrive. Nobody suggests putting off the trip, and the new shoes are not worn on the way.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duì huà, ránhòu huídá liǎngge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a dialogue, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 下星期我要去那家公司談工作。我想買件名牌外套，穿起來比較有自信。
lines.simplified: 下星期我要去那家公司谈工作。我想买件名牌外套，穿起来比较有自信。
lines.pinyin: Xià xīngqí wǒ yào qù nà jiā gōngsī tán gōngzuò. Wǒ xiǎng mǎi jiàn míngpái wàitào, chuān qǐlái bǐjiào yǒu zìxìn.
lines.english: I’m going to that company about a job next week. I want to buy a brand-name jacket so I’ll feel more confident.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我覺得不必。他們看妳的能力跟態度，不是看牌子。況且他們做的是平價服裝，妳特地穿名牌去，人家可能以為妳不喜歡他們的衣服。
lines.simplified: 我觉得不必。他们看你的能力跟态度，不是看牌子。况且他们做的是平价服装，你特地穿名牌去，人家可能以为你不喜欢他们的衣服。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ juéde búbì. Tāmen kàn nǐ de nénglì gēn tàidù, bú shì kàn páizi. Kuàngqiě tāmen zuò de shì píngjià fúzhuāng, nǐ tèdì chuān míngpái qù, rén jiā kěnéng yǐwéi nǐ bù xǐhuān tāmen de yīfu.
lines.english: I don’t think you need to. They’re looking at your ability and attitude, not the label. Besides, they make affordable clothes. If you go out of your way to wear a brand name, they might think you don’t like their clothes.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 說得也是。那我穿什麼好？
lines.simplified: 说得也是。那我穿什么好？
lines.pinyin: Shuōdeyěshì. Nà wǒ chuān shénme hǎo?
lines.english: Fair point. So what should I wear?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 就穿妳平時那件白襯衫吧，乾淨又舒適。畢竟妳是去談工作，不是去參加時尚活動。
lines.simplified: 就穿你平时那件白衬衫吧，干净又舒适。毕竟你是去谈工作，不是去参加时尚活动。
lines.pinyin: Jiù chuān nǐ píngshí nà jiàn bái chènshān ba, gānjìng yòu shūshì. Bìjìng nǐ shì qù tán gōngzuò, bú shì qù cānjiā shíshàng huódòng.
lines.english: Just wear that white shirt you usually wear: clean and comfortable. After all, you're going to talk about a job, not to a fashion event.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好，那我把錢省下來，等找到工作再買。
lines.simplified: 好，那我把钱省下来，等找到工作再买。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, nà wǒ bǎ qián shěng xiàlái, děng zhǎo dào gōngzuò zài mǎi.
lines.english: OK, then I'll save the money and buy one when I've found a job.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的提到那家公司是做平價服裝的，是想說什麼？
prompt.simplified: 男的提到那家公司是做平价服装的，是想说什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de tídào nà jiā gōngsī shì zuò píngjià fúzhuāng de, shì xiǎng shuō shénme?
prompt.english: Why does the man mention that the company makes affordable clothing?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他們可能以為她不喜歡平價衣服
choices.simplified: 他们可能以为她不喜欢平价衣服
choices.pinyin: Tāmen kěnéng yǐwéi tā bù xǐhuān píngjià yīfu.
choices.english: They might think she dislikes affordable clothes.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他們可能以為她想買店裡的衣服
choices.simplified: 他们可能以为她想买店里的衣服
choices.pinyin: Tāmen kěnéng yǐwéi tā xiǎng mǎi diàn lǐ de yīfu.
choices.english: They might think she wants to buy the clothes they sell.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他們可能以為她是去參加活動
choices.simplified: 他们可能以为她是去参加活动
choices.pinyin: Tāmen kěnéng yǐwéi tā shì qù cānjiā huódòng.
choices.english: They might think she is there to attend an event.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他們可能以為她沒準備好
choices.simplified: 他们可能以为她没准备好
choices.pinyin: Tāmen kěnéng yǐwéi tā méi zhǔnbèi hǎo.
choices.english: They might think she is unprepared.

questions.why: He adds that the company sells affordable clothes. Seeing her make a point of wearing a brand name could give them the wrong idea about how she feels about their clothes.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 聽完建議以後，女的改變了什麼打算？
prompt.simplified: 听完建议以后，女的改变了什么打算？
prompt.pinyin: Tīng wán jiànyì yǐhòu, nǚ de gǎibiàn le shénme dǎsuàn?
prompt.english: After hearing the advice, how does the woman change her plans?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 先買件平價外套，名牌晚點買
choices.simplified: 先买件平价外套，名牌晚点买
choices.pinyin: Xiān mǎi jiàn píngjià wàitào, míngpái wǎn diǎn mǎi.
choices.english: Buy an affordable jacket now and a brand-name one later.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 先買名牌外套，下星期就穿
choices.simplified: 先买名牌外套，下星期就穿
choices.pinyin: Xiān mǎi míngpái wàitào, xià xīngqí jiù chuān.
choices.english: Buy a brand-name jacket now and wear it next week.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 先買件外套，再決定穿哪一件
choices.simplified: 先买件外套，再决定穿哪一件
choices.pinyin: Xiān mǎi jiàn wàitào, zài juédìng chuān nǎ yíjiàn.
choices.english: Buy a jacket first and then decide what to wear.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 先穿自己的襯衫，外套晚點買
choices.simplified: 先穿自己的衬衫，外套晚点买
choices.pinyin: Xiān chuān zìjǐ de chènshān, wàitào wǎn diǎn mǎi.
choices.english: Wear her own shirt and buy the jacket later.

questions.why: She accepts that this is about getting a job, so she can wear the white shirt she already has. She decides to hold off buying the jacket until she finds work.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duì huà, ránhòu huídá liǎngge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a dialogue, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 明天第一次跟他出去，我穿這件新買的洋裝好不好？
lines.simplified: 明天第一次跟他出去，我穿这件新买的洋装好不好？
lines.pinyin: Míngtiān dìyīcì gēn tā chūqù, wǒ chuān zhè jiàn xīn mǎi de yángzhuāng hǎo bù hǎo?
lines.english: Tomorrow is my first time going out with him. Shall I wear this new dress?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好看是好看，可是你們不是要去爬山嗎？況且這件是白色的，弄髒了很難洗。
lines.simplified: 好看是好看，可是你们不是要去爬山吗？况且这件是白色的，弄脏了很难洗。
lines.pinyin: Hǎokànshìhǎokàn, kěshì nǐmen bú shì yào qù pá shān ma? Kuàngqiě zhè jiàn shì báisè de, nòng zāng le hěn nán xǐ.
lines.english: It looks nice, sure, but aren't you two going hiking? Besides, it's white: once it's dirty it's hard to wash.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 不用說我也知道，你一定會叫我穿運動服。會不會太休閒？
lines.simplified: 不用说我也知道，你一定会叫我穿运动服。会不会太休闲？
lines.pinyin: Búyòngshuō wǒ yě zhīdào, nǐ yídìng huì jiào wǒ chuān yùndòngfú. Huì bú huì tài xiūxián?
lines.english: I know what you’re going to say: wear sportswear. Won’t that be too casual?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 不會啊。畢竟是去爬山，穿得舒適、自在最重要。他要是真的喜歡妳，也不會只看妳穿什麼。
lines.simplified: 不会啊。毕竟是去爬山，穿得舒适、自在最重要。他要是真的喜欢你，也不会只看你穿什么。
lines.pinyin: Bú huì a. Bìjìng shì qù pá shān, chuān de shūshì, zìzài zuì zhòngyào. Tā yàoshì zhēnde xǐhuān nǐ, yě bú huì zhǐ kàn nǐ chuān shénme.
lines.english: Not at all. After all, you're going hiking: being comfortable and at ease matters most. If he really likes you, he won't only look at what you're wearing.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你說得對。那這件洋裝留到下次去看電影再穿。
lines.simplified: 你说得对。那这件洋装留到下次去看电影再穿。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de duì. Nà zhè jiàn yángzhuāng liú dào xiàcì qù kàn diànyǐng zài chuān.
lines.english: You're right. I'll save this dress for when we go to a film next time.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的為什麼不建議女的穿那件洋裝？
prompt.simplified: 男的为什么不建议女的穿那件洋装？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de wèishénme bú jiànyì nǚ de chuān nà jiàn yángzhuāng?
prompt.english: Why does the man advise against the dress?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yángzhuāng de yàngshì bú gòu hǎokàn.
choices.english: The dress is not stylish enough.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 第一次見面不必穿新衣服
choices.simplified: 第一次见面不必穿新衣服
choices.pinyin: Dìyīcì jiànmiàn búbì chuān xīn yīfu.
choices.english: A first date does not need new clothes.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 爬山不方便，髒了也難洗
choices.simplified: 爬山不方便，脏了也难洗
choices.pinyin: Pá shān bù fāngbiàn, zāng le yě nán xǐ.
choices.english: It’s inconvenient for hiking and hard to wash once dirty.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 洋裝應該留著看電影穿
choices.simplified: 洋装应该留着看电影穿
choices.pinyin: Yángzhuāng yīnggāi liú zhe kàn diànyǐng chuān.
choices.english: The dress should be kept for the cinema.

questions.why: Two reasons joined by 況且: they are going hiking, and a white dress is hard to wash once dirty. He says it looks nice (好看是好看), and saving it for the cinema is her idea at the end, not his reason.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 從女的最後的安排，可以知道她怎麼想？
prompt.simplified: 从女的最后的安排，可以知道她怎么想？
prompt.pinyin: Cóng nǚ de zuìhòu de ānpái, kěyǐ zhīdào tā zěnme xiǎng?
prompt.english: What does the woman’s final plan tell us about her thinking?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她覺得第一次出門要穿新衣服
choices.simplified: 她觉得第一次出门要穿新衣服
choices.pinyin: Tā juéde dìyīcì chūmén yào chuān xīn yīfu.
choices.english: She thinks she should wear something new on the first outing.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她覺得不同活動適合穿不同衣服
choices.simplified: 她觉得不同活动适合穿不同衣服
choices.pinyin: Tā juéde bùtóng huódòng shìhé chuān bùtóng yīfu.
choices.english: She thinks different activities call for different clothes.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她覺得兩次出門都能穿運動服
choices.simplified: 她觉得两次出门都能穿运动服
choices.pinyin: Tā juéde liǎng cì chūmén dōu néng chuān yùndòngfú.
choices.english: She thinks sportswear would suit both outings.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她覺得白色衣服不適合約會
choices.simplified: 她觉得白色衣服不适合约会
choices.pinyin: Tā juéde báisè yīfu bú shìhé yuēhuì.
choices.english: She thinks white clothes aren't right for a date.

questions.why: She worries that sportswear is too casual. The man says comfort matters on the hike, and she decides to keep the dress for the cinema instead, so her choice depends on the activity. She still keeps the white dress for a later date at the cinema, so white itself is not the problem.

focus.en: after all; a plan and its reason

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段說明，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段说明，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn shuōmíng, ránhòu huídá liǎngge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to an announcement, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 各位同學好，下星期三下午兩點，我們請到一位做服裝設計的老師來學校演講，談的是「找工作的時候怎麼穿」。
lines.simplified: 各位同学好，下星期三下午两点，我们请到一位做服装设计的老师来学校演讲，谈的是「找工作的时候怎么穿」。
lines.pinyin: Gè wèi tóngxué hǎo, xià xīngqísān xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn, wǒmen qǐng dào yíwèi zuò fúzhuāng shèjì de lǎoshī lái xuéxiào yǎn jiǎng, tán de shì "zhǎo gōngzuò de shíhòu zěnme chuān".
lines.english: Hello, everyone. Next Wednesday at two p.m., a teacher who works in fashion design is coming to give a talk at our school on "What to Wear When You Look for a Job".

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 一般來說，公司的人一見面就會對你有個看法。所謂穿得合適，跟你要去哪家公司有關。去銀行可以穿得正式一點，去設計公司可以穿出自己的風格。衣服再貴，穿得不自在，也很難對自己有信心。
lines.simplified: 一般来说，公司的人一见面就会对你有个看法。所谓穿得合适，跟你要去哪家公司有关。去银行可以穿得正式一点，去设计公司可以穿出自己的风格。衣服再贵，穿得不自在，也很难对自己有信心。
lines.pinyin: Yìbānláishuō, gōngsī de rén yí jiànmiàn jiù huì duì nǐ yǒu ge kànfǎ. Suǒwèi chuān de héshì, gēn nǐ yào qù nǎ jiā gōngsī yǒuguān. Qù yínháng kěyǐ chuān de zhèngshì yìdiǎn, qù shèjì gōngsī kěyǐ chuān chū zìjǐ de fēnggé. Yīfu zài guì, chuān de bú zìzài, yě hěn nán duì zìjǐ yǒu xìnxīn.
lines.english: In general, people at a company form an impression as soon as they meet you. What’s appropriate depends on the company. For a bank, you can dress more formally. For a design firm, you can show more of your personal style. However expensive your clothes are, it’s hard to feel sure of yourself if you feel uncomfortable.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 想參加的同學，請在星期一以前上網報名，只收八十個人。
lines.simplified: 想参加的同学，请在星期一以前上网报名，只收八十个人。
lines.pinyin: Xiǎng cānjiā de tóngxué, qǐng zài xīngqíyī yǐqián shàngwǎng bàomíng, zhǐ shōu bā shí gèrén.
lines.english: If you want to come, please sign up online by Monday. There are only eighty places.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 一位同學要去銀行談工作。照這段說明，怎麼穿最合適？
prompt.simplified: 一位同学要去银行谈工作。照这段说明，怎么穿最合适？
prompt.pinyin: Yíwèi tóngxué yào qù yínháng tán gōngzuò. Zhào zhè duàn shuōmíng, zěnme chuān zuì héshì?
prompt.english: A student is going to a bank about a job. According to the announcement, what should they wear?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 穿平時最自在的運動服
choices.simplified: 穿平时最自在的运动服
choices.pinyin: Chuān píngshí zuì zìzài de yùndòngfú.
choices.english: Wear the sportswear they usually feel most comfortable in.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 穿好看可是不太舒服的西裝
choices.simplified: 穿好看可是不太舒服的西装
choices.pinyin: Chuān hǎokàn kěshì bú tài shūfu de xī zhuāng.
choices.english: Wear a smart suit that feels uncomfortable.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 穿習慣的襯衫跟黑褲子
choices.simplified: 穿习惯的衬衫跟黑裤子
choices.pinyin: Chuān xíguàn de chènshān gēn hēi kùzi.
choices.english: Wear a familiar shirt and black trousers.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 穿最能表現風格的紅上衣
choices.simplified: 穿最能表现风格的红上衣
choices.pinyin: Chuān zuì néng biǎoxiàn fēnggé de hóng shàngyī.
choices.english: Wear the red top that best shows their style.

questions.why: For the bank, the speaker recommends a more formal look. She also says an uncomfortable outfit makes it hard to show confidence. Familiar formal separates fit both points.

focus.en: no matter how…; occasion and comfort

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 想去聽演講的同學得怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 想去听演讲的同学得怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Xiǎng qù tīng yǎn jiǎng de tóngxué de zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What must a student who wants to attend do?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 星期三下午到了再報名
choices.simplified: 星期三下午到了再报名
choices.pinyin: Xīngqísān xiàwǔ dào le zài bàomíng.
choices.english: Sign up when they arrive on Wednesday.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 星期一前先在網路上報名
choices.simplified: 星期一前先在网路上报名
choices.pinyin: Xīngqíyī qián xiān zài wǎnglù shàng bàomíng.
choices.english: Sign up online before Monday.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xīngqísān yǐqián shàngwǎng bàomíng.
choices.english: Sign up online before Wednesday.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 先問老師還有沒有位子
choices.simplified: 先问老师还有没有位子
choices.pinyin: Xiān wèn lǎoshī háiyǒu méi yǒu wèizi.
choices.english: Ask the teacher whether there are seats left.

questions.why: Signing up online closes on Monday (星期一以前), and only eighty people get in. Wednesday afternoon is when the talk is held, not the sign-up deadline.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段留言，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段留言，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn liúyán, ránhòu huídá liǎngge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a voicemail, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 林老師您好，我是「生活風格」節目的小陳。謝謝您答應來我們的節目，跟大家聊聊「快時尚」這個現象，談談服裝公司怎麼掌握最新的流行，讓年輕人花少少的錢就能趕上流行。
lines.simplified: 林老师您好，我是「生活风格」节目的小陈。谢谢您答应来我们的节目，跟大家聊聊「快时尚」这个现象，谈谈服装公司怎么掌握最新的流行，让年轻人花少少的钱就能赶上流行。
lines.pinyin: Línlǎoshī nín hǎo, wǒ shì "shēnghuó fēnggé" jiémù dì XiǎoChén. Xièxie nín dāyìng lái wǒmen de jiémù, gēn dàjiā liáo liáo "kuàishíshàng" zhège xiànxiàng, tán tán fúzhuāng gōngsī zěnme zhǎngwò zuì xīn de liúxíng, ràng niánqīng rén huā shǎoshǎo de qián jiù néng gǎnshàng liúxíng.
lines.english: Hello, Ms. Lin, this is Xiao Chen from the programme "Life and Style". Thank you for agreeing to come on our show and talk about "fast fashion", about how clothing companies grasp the latest trends so that young people can keep up with fashion for very little money.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我們本來約星期四下午錄，可是導演那天要出差，想改到星期五上午十點，地點不變。節目下個月一號晚上播出。
lines.simplified: 我们本来约星期四下午录，可是导演那天要出差，想改到星期五上午十点，地点不变。节目下个月一号晚上播出。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen běnlái yuē xīngqísì xiàwǔ lù, kěshì dǎoyǎn nà tiān yào chūchāi, xiǎng gǎi dào xīngqíwǔ shàngwǔ shí diǎn, dìdiǎn bú biàn. Jiémù xià ge yuè yīhào wǎnshàng bòchū.
lines.english: We had planned to record on Thursday afternoon, but the director has a business trip that day, so we'd like to move it to Friday at ten a.m., same place. The programme airs on the evening of the first of next month.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 還有，導演希望您穿平時的衣服來就好，衣服再簡單也沒關係，自在最重要。時間要是可以，請您回個電話給我，謝謝。
lines.simplified: 还有，导演希望您穿平时的衣服来就好，衣服再简单也没关系，自在最重要。时间要是可以，请您回个电话给我，谢谢。
lines.pinyin: Háiyǒu, dǎoyǎn xīwàng nín chuān píngshí de yīfu lái jiù hǎo, yīfu zài jiǎndān yě méiguānxi, zìzài zuì zhòngyào. Shíjiān yàoshì kěyǐ, qǐng nín huí ge diànhuà gěi wǒ, xièxie.
lines.english: Also, the director hopes you'll just come in your everyday clothes. However simple they are, that's fine; being at ease matters most. If the time works, please call me back. Thank you.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 照留言，林老師去錄節目以前要怎麼準備？
prompt.simplified: 照留言，林老师去录节目以前要怎么准备？
prompt.pinyin: Zhào liúyán, Línlǎoshī qù lù jiémù yǐqián yào zěnme zhǔnbèi?
prompt.english: According to the message, how should Ms. Lin prepare for the recording?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 穿現在流行的衣服來介紹
choices.simplified: 穿现在流行的衣服来介绍
choices.pinyin: Chuān xiànzài liúxíng de yīfu lái jièshào.
choices.english: Wear clothes that are in fashion and introduce them.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 穿正式一點，準備談服裝公司
choices.simplified: 穿正式一点，准备谈服装公司
choices.pinyin: Chuān zhèngshì yìdiǎn, zhǔnbèi tán fúzhuāng gōngsī.
choices.english: Dress more formally and be ready to discuss clothing companies.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 穿平常的衣服，談自己的穿著
choices.simplified: 穿平常的衣服，谈自己的穿着
choices.pinyin: Chuān píngcháng de yīfu, tán zìjǐ de chuānzhuó.
choices.english: Wear everyday clothes and talk about what she wears.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 穿平常的衣服，準備談流行
choices.simplified: 穿平常的衣服，准备谈流行
choices.pinyin: Chuān píngcháng de yīfu, zhǔnbèi tán liúxíng.
choices.english: Wear everyday clothes and be ready to talk about trends.

questions.why: The topic is how fast fashion lets young people keep up with trends. The director wants the teacher to feel at ease, so her everyday clothes are fine.

focus.en: no matter how…; programme topic and dress

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 林老師要是同意，什麼時候去錄節目？
prompt.simplified: 林老师要是同意，什么时候去录节目？
prompt.pinyin: Línlǎoshī yàoshì tóngyì, shénmeshíhòu qù lù jiémù?
prompt.english: If Ms. Lin agrees, when does she go to record the show?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xīngqíwǔ shàngwǔ.
choices.english: Friday morning

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xīngqísì xiàwǔ.
choices.english: Thursday afternoon

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xià ge yuè yīhào wǎnshàng.
choices.english: the evening of next month's first

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xīngqíwǔ xiàwǔ.
choices.english: Friday afternoon

questions.why: The recording was first set for Thursday afternoon, but the director is away, so it moves to Friday at ten in the morning. The first of next month is when the show airs, not when it is recorded.

passage.traditional: 去年冬天，一家快時尚公司跟明星{1}，明星選樣式，公司做外套。廣告晚上八點才{2}，七點多就有人在電視前等著看。第二天一大早就有人排隊，{3}有人前一天晚上就到了。我很想{4}最新的流行，可是平常沒空逛街，只能看廣告。不用花太多錢就能穿出明星的品味，是這些外套最大的{5}。我特地上街買了一件，穿了幾次才發現品質跟一般平價外套差不多。我不得不{6}，當時只是被廣告吸引了。

Guǎnggào wǎnshàng bā diǎn cái bòchū, qīdiǎnduō jiù yǒu rén zài diànshì qián děng zhe kàn. Dì èr tiān yídàzǎo jiù yǒu rén páiduì, shènzhì yǒu rén qián yìtiān wǎnshàng jiù dào le. Wǒ hěn xiǎng zhǎngwò zuì xīn de liúxíng, kěshì píngcháng méikòng guàngjiē, zhǐ néng kàn guǎnggào. Búyòng huā tài duō qián jiù néng chuān chū míngxīng de pǐnwèi, shì zhè xiē wàitào zuì dà de mèilì. Wǒ tèdì shàngjiē mǎi le yíjiàn, chuān le jǐ cì cái fāxiàn pǐnzhí gēn yìbān píngjià wàitào chàbùduō. Wǒ bùdébù chéngrèn, dāngshí zhǐshì bèi guǎnggào xīyǐn le.
passage.english: Last winter a fast-fashion company worked with a celebrity. The celebrity chose the styles and the company made the jackets. The ad was only shown at eight p.m., but from seven-something people were already in front of the TV waiting to see it. By early the next morning, people were lining up. Some had even arrived the night before. I really wanted to keep up with the latest fashions, but I usually have no time to go shopping and can only watch the adverts. The jackets’ biggest appeal was that I could dress with a celebrity’s taste without spending a lot. I made a special trip to buy one, only to find after a few wears that its quality was about the same as any affordable jacket. I have to admit I was just drawn in by the ad.

passage.traditional: 我跟姊姊對穿著的看法剛好{1}。姊姊穿衣服很{2}，出門前要花一小時，連鞋子的顏色也要跟衣服搭配。她{3}的鞋子超過三十雙，可是真正常穿的只有三、四雙。我{4}只穿球鞋跟牛仔褲，舒服就好。上個月，姊姊要去參加時尚活動，非要我陪她去不可。我本來不想去，因為我對時尚沒興趣，{5}那天晚上還有報告要寫。到了以後，我穿得跟大家不一樣，也不知道怎麼開口跟人說話，站在門口覺得很{6}。

Tā yǒngyǒu de xiézi chāoguò sān shí shuāng, kěshì zhēnzhèng cháng chuān de zhǐyǒu sān, sì shuāng. Wǒ píngshí zhǐ chuān qiúxié gēn niúzǎikù, shūfu jiù hǎo. Shàng ge yuè, zǐ zǐ yào qù cānjiā shíshàng huódòng, fēi yàowǒ péi tā qù bù kě. Wǒ běnlái bù xiǎng qù, yīnwèi wǒ duì shíshàng méi xìngqù, kuàngqiě nà tiān wǎnshàng háiyǒu bàogào yào xiě. Dào le yǐhòu, wǒ chuān de gēn dàjiā bù yíyàng, yě bù zhīdào zěnme kāi kǒu gēn rén shuōhuà, zhàn zài ménkǒu juéde hěn bú zìzài.
passage.english: My older sister and I see clothes in exactly opposite ways. She is very particular about what she wears. It takes her an hour to get ready, and even her shoes have to match her clothes. She owns more than thirty pairs of shoes but only really wears three or four. I usually wear sneakers and jeans. I’m happy as long as I’m comfortable. Last month my sister insisted I accompany her to a fashion event. I didn’t want to go because fashion doesn’t interest me, and besides, I had a report to write that evening. When we arrived, I was dressed differently from everyone else and didn’t know how to start talking to anyone. Standing by the door, I felt ill at ease.

text.traditional:
本公司要為新外套拍廣告，想找大學生當模特兒。
條件：十八歲到二十五歲；男生身高一百七十五公分以上，女生一百六十公分以上
經驗：沒有限制，沒當過模特兒也歡迎
拍廣告的時間：十二月九日、十日（星期六、日），兩天都得來
報名：十一月三十日以前，把兩張照片寄到本公司
廣告明年一月起在電視上播出。選上的人可以免費得到三件新外套。
text.simplified:
本公司要为新外套拍广告，想找大学生当模特儿。
条件：十八岁到二十五岁；男生身高一百七十五公分以上，女生一百六十公分以上
经验：没有限制，没当过模特儿也欢迎
拍广告的时间：十二月九日、十日（星期六、日），两天都得来
报名：十一月三十日以前，把两张照片寄到本公司
广告明年一月起在电视上播出。选上的人可以免费得到三件新外套。
text.pinyin: Běn gōngsī yào wèi xīn wàitào pāi guǎnggào, xiǎng zhǎo dàxuéshēng dāng mótèr. Tiáojiàn: Shí bā suì dào èr shí wǔ suì; nánshēng shēngāo yìbǎiqīshí wǔ gōngfēn yǐ shàng, nǚshēng yìbǎiliùshí gōngfēn yǐ shàng jīngyàn: Méi yǒu xiànzhì, méi dāng guò mótèr yě huānyíng pāi guǎnggào de shíjiān: Shí èr yuè jiǔ rì, shí rì (xīngqíliù, rì), liǎng tiān dōuděi lái bàomíng: Shíyīyuè sān shí rì yǐqián, bǎ liǎng zhāng zhàopiàn jì dào běn gōngsī guǎnggào míngnián yī yuè qǐ zài diànshì shàng bòchū. Xuǎn shàng de rén kěyǐ miǎnfèi dédào sān jiàn xīn wàitào.
text.english:
We are shooting an advert for new jackets and are looking for university students to model.
Requirements: aged 18 to 25; men 175 cm or taller, women 160 cm or taller
Experience: no restriction; you are welcome even if you have never modelled
Shooting dates: 9 and 10 December (Saturday and Sunday); you must come on both days
To apply: send two photos to the company by 30 November
The advert airs on television from next January. Those chosen get three new jackets free.

text.traditional:
我叔叔在一家汽車公司負責賣車。他常說，跟客人見面的時候，穿著代表一個人的地位，所以他對穿著非常講究，天天穿名牌，連手錶都非買最貴的不可。一般來說，這種想法一點也不奇怪。很多公司花大錢請明星拍廣告，讓大家覺得擁有名牌，就是擁有成功的生活，這是很正常的商業作法。
可是我發現，叔叔賣得最好的時候，不是他穿得最貴的時候。有一次下大雨，他的衣服都濕了，還是冷靜、有耐心地回答客人的每一個問題，那位客人當天就買了一輛車。後來叔叔也承認，客人真正在意的，是他能不能把問題說明白、態度好不好。
我覺得，人應該當衣服的主人。名牌可以讓人一時覺得有自信，可是一個人的魅力，跟他穿什麼牌子的衣服無關。
text.simplified:
我叔叔在一家汽车公司负责卖车。他常说，跟客人见面的时候，穿着代表一个人的地位，所以他对穿着非常讲究，天天穿名牌，连手表都非买最贵的不可。一般来说，这种想法一点也不奇怪。很多公司花大钱请明星拍广告，让大家觉得拥有名牌，就是拥有成功的生活，这是很正常的商业作法。
可是我发现，叔叔卖得最好的时候，不是他穿得最贵的时候。有一次下大雨，他的衣服都湿了，还是冷静、有耐心地回答客人的每一个问题，那位客人当天就买了一辆车。后来叔叔也承认，客人真正在意的，是他能不能把问题说明白、态度好不好。
我觉得，人应该当衣服的主人。名牌可以让人一时觉得有自信，可是一个人的魅力，跟他穿什么牌子的衣服无关。
text.pinyin: Wǒ shúshu zài yìjiā qìchē gōngsī fùzé mài chē. Tā cháng shuō, gēn kèrén jiànmiàn de shíhòu, chuānzhuó dàibiǎo yígerén de dìwèi, suǒyǐ tā duì chuānzhuó fēicháng jiǎngjiù, tiāntiān chuān míngpái, lián shǒubiǎo dōu fēi mǎi zuì guì de bù kě. Yìbānláishuō, zhè zhǒng xiǎngfǎ yìdiǎnyěbù qíguài. Hěn duō gōngsī huā dà qián qǐng míngxīng pāi guǎnggào, ràng dàjiā juéde yǒngyǒu míngpái, jiùshì yǒngyǒu chénggōng de shēnghuó, zhè shì hěn zhèngcháng de shāngyè zuòfǎ. Kěshì wǒ fāxiàn, shúshu mài de zuìhǎo de shíhòu, bú shì tā chuān de zuì guì de shíhòu. Yǒu yícì xià dà yǔ, tā de yīfu dōu shī le, háishì lěngjìng, yǒu nàixīn de huídá kèrén de měi yíge wèntí, nà wèi kèrén dàngtiān jiù mǎi le yíliàng chē. Hòulái shúshu yě chéngrèn, kèrén zhēnzhèng zàiyì de, shì tā néng bù néng bǎ wèntí shuō míngbái, tàidù hǎo bù hǎo. Wǒ juéde, rén yīnggāi dāng yīfu de zhǔrén. Míngpái kěyǐ ràng rén yìshí juéde yǒu zìxìn, kěshì yígerén de mèilì, gēn tā chuān shénme páizi de yīfu wúguān.
text.english:
My uncle sells cars for a car company. He often says that when you meet customers, your clothes stand for your status, so he is very particular about clothes and wears brand names every day; even his watch has to be the most expensive. Generally speaking, this idea is not strange. Many companies spend a fortune on stars for their adverts to make people feel that owning brand names means owning a successful life, which is a normal business practice.
But I have noticed that my uncle sells best not when he is dressed most expensively. Once, in heavy rain, his clothes got soaked, yet he still answered every one of a customer's questions calmly and patiently, and the customer bought a car that same day. Later my uncle admitted that what customers really care about is whether he can explain their questions clearly and whether his attitude is good.
I think people should be the masters of their clothes. Brand names can make people feel confident for a while, but a person's charm has nothing to do with the label on their clothes.

text.traditional:
我們辦公室上個月來了一位新同事。一般來說，新同事都會穿得跟大家差不多，可是她的衣服顏色都很亮，樣式也很特別，而且她穿得很有自信。剛開始，大家都把她看成一個不好相處的人，中午吃飯也很少找她。有一天，她在電梯裡聽到兩位同事在討論她的衣服，就笑著說：「這些都是我自己做的。」原來她大學念的是服裝設計，週末還在網路上賣自己設計的衣服。從那天起，她的衣服成了辦公室裡大家最喜歡聊的話題，有的同事還請她幫忙選衣服。
這件事使我明白，一開始的誤會，只是因為大家不了解她。穿出屬於自己的風格，本來就是很自然的事。比起一個人穿什麼，更重要的是，我們肯不肯先花時間認識他。
text.simplified:
我们办公室上个月来了一位新同事。一般来说，新同事都会穿得跟大家差不多，可是她的衣服颜色都很亮，样式也很特别，而且她穿得很有自信。刚开始，大家都把她看成一个不好相处的人，中午吃饭也很少找她。有一天，她在电梯里听到两位同事在讨论她的衣服，就笑着说：「这些都是我自己做的。」原来她大学念的是服装设计，周末还在网路上卖自己设计的衣服。从那天起，她的衣服成了办公室里大家最喜欢聊的话题，有的同事还请她帮忙选衣服。
这件事使我明白，一开始的误会，只是因为大家不了解她。穿出属于自己的风格，本来就是很自然的事。比起一个人穿什么，更重要的是，我们肯不肯先花时间认识他。
text.pinyin: Wǒmen bàngōngshì shàng ge yuè lái le yíwèi xīn tóngshì. Yìbānláishuō, xīn tóngshì dōu huì chuān de gēn dàjiā chàbùduō, kěshì tā de yīfu yánsè dōu hěn liàng, yàngshì yě hěn tèbié, érqiě tā chuān dehěn yǒu zìxìn. Gāng kāishǐ, dàjiā dōu bǎ tā kànchéng yíge bù hǎo xiāngchǔ de rén, zhōngwǔ chī fàn yě hěn shǎo zhǎo tā. Yǒu yìtiān, tā zài diàntī lǐ tīng dào liǎng wèi tóngshì zài tǎolùn tā de yīfu, jiù xiào zhe shuō: "Zhè xiē dōu shì wǒ zìjǐ zuò de." yuánlái tā dàxué niàn de shì fúzhuāng shèjì, zhōumò hái zài wǎnglù shàng mài zìjǐ shèjì de yīfu. Cóng nà tiān qǐ, tā de yīfu chéng le bàngōngshì lǐ dàjiā zuì xǐhuān liáo dehuà tí, yǒude tóngshì hái qǐng tā bāngmáng xuǎn yīfu. Zhè jiàn shì shǐ wǒ míngbái, yìkāishǐ de wùhuì, zhǐshì yīnwèi dàjiā bùliǎo jiě tā. Chuān chū shǔyú zìjǐ de fēnggé, běnlái jiùshì hěn zìrán de shì. Bǐ qǐ yígerén chuān shénme, gèngzhòngyào de shì, wǒmen kěn bù kěn xiān huā shíjiān rènshì tā.
text.english:
Last month a new colleague joined our office. Generally speaking, new colleagues dress much like everyone else, but her clothes were all bright colours and unusual styles, and she wore them with great confidence. At first everyone took her for someone hard to get along with and seldom asked her to lunch. One day in the lift she heard two colleagues discussing her clothes, and she said with a smile, "I made all of these myself." It turned out she had studied fashion design at university and sells clothes she designs online at weekends. From that day on, her clothes became everyone's favourite topic in the office, and some colleagues even asked her to help them choose clothes.
This made me understand that the first misunderstanding was just because nobody knew her. Dressing in a style of one's own is a perfectly natural thing. More important than what someone wears is whether we are willing to take the time to get to know them first.

text.traditional: 我爸爸以前在銀行工作，天天穿襯衫跟皮鞋，忙得沒有休閒的時間。去年他退休了，總算可以做自己想做的事。他說年輕的時候最想學衝浪，可是一直沒時間。媽媽聽了說：「既然現在有時間了，就去試試看吧！」第一次下水，他一連掉進海裡十幾次，喝了好幾口海水，可是他一點也不想停下來。三個月以後，他總算能站在衝浪板上了。現在，他櫃子裡的襯衫越來越少，休閒的衣服越來越多，衝浪也使他變得比以前開朗。媽媽開玩笑說，認識他三十年，從來沒看過他這麼開心。
text.simplified: 我爸爸以前在银行工作，天天穿衬衫跟皮鞋，忙得没有休闲的时间。去年他退休了，总算可以做自己想做的事。他说年轻的时候最想学冲浪，可是一直没时间。妈妈听了说：「既然现在有时间了，就去试试看吧！」第一次下水，他一连掉进海里十几次，喝了好几口海水，可是他一点也不想停下来。三个月以后，他总算能站在冲浪板上了。现在，他柜子里的衬衫越来越少，休闲的衣服越来越多，冲浪也使他变得比以前开朗。妈妈开玩笑说，认识他三十年，从来没看过他这么开心。
text.pinyin: Wǒ bàba yǐqián zài yínháng gōngzuò, tiāntiān chuān chènshān gēn píxié, máng de méi yǒu xiūxián de shíjiān. Qùnián tā tuìxiū le, zǒngsuàn kěyǐ zuò zìjǐ xiǎng zuò de shì. Tā shuō niánqīng de shíhòu zuì xiǎng xué chōnglàng, kěshì yìzhí méi shíjiān. Māma tīng le shuō: "Jìrán xiànzài yǒu shíjiān le, jiù qù shì shì kàn ba!" dìyīcì xià shuǐ, tā yìlián diào jìn hǎi lǐ shí jǐ cì, hē le hǎojǐkǒu hǎi shuǐ, kěshì tā yìdiǎnyěbù xiǎng tíng xiàlái. Sānge yuè yǐhòu, tā zǒngsuàn néng zhàn zài chōnglàngbǎn shàng le. Xiànzài, tā guìzi lǐ de chènshān yuè lái yuè shǎo, xiūxián de yīfu yuè lái yuè duō, chōnglàng yě shǐ tā biàn de bǐ yǐqián kāilǎng. Māma kāiwánxiào shuō, rènshì tā sān shí nián, cónglái méi kàn guò tā zhème kāixīn.
text.english: My father used to work at a bank, in a shirt and leather shoes every day, too busy for any leisure. Last year he retired and at last could do what he wanted. He said that when he was young he most wanted to learn to surf, but never had the time. Hearing this, my mother said, "Since you have time now, go and give it a try!" The first time in the water he fell into the sea more than ten times in a row and swallowed several mouthfuls of seawater, but he did not want to stop at all. Three months later he could finally stand on a surfboard. Now there are fewer and fewer shirts in his wardrobe and more and more casual clothes, and surfing has made him more cheerful than before. My mother jokes that in thirty years of knowing him she has never seen him this happy.

choices.traditional: 她讓他去做想做的事，也高興他變了
choices.simplified: 她让他去做想做的事，也高兴他变了
choices.pinyin: Tā ràng tā qù zuò xiǎng zuò de shì, yě gāoxìng tā biàn le.
choices.english: She let him do what he wanted, and is glad he has changed.

choices.traditional: 她本來怕衝浪太累，後來才同意他去
choices.simplified: 她本来怕冲浪太累，后来才同意他去
choices.pinyin: Tā běnlái pà chōnglàng tài lèi, hòulái cái tóngyì tā qù.
choices.english: At first she feared surfing would be too tiring, and only later agreed.

choices.traditional: 她看他掉進海裡十幾次，就叫他別學
choices.simplified: 她看他掉进海里十几次，就叫他别学
choices.pinyin: Tā kàn tā diào jìn hǎi lǐ shí jǐ cì, jiù jiào tā bié xué.
choices.english: Seeing him fall in more than ten times, she told him to give up.

questions.why: 既然現在有時間了，就去試試看吧 shows she backs his old wish from the start, and 從來沒看過他這麼開心 shows she is glad about the change. She did not go with him, she never doubted the plan, and his falls did not make her tell him to stop: he kept going himself.

focus.en: since… then…; attitude at two points

prompt.traditional: 爸爸退休以後，跟以前有什麼不一樣？
prompt.simplified: 爸爸退休以后，跟以前有什么不一样？
prompt.pinyin: Bàba tuìxiū yǐhòu, gēn yǐqián yǒu shénme bù yíyàng?
prompt.english: How is the father different since he retired?

choices.traditional: 以前不運動，現在常跟媽媽去海邊
choices.simplified: 以前不运动，现在常跟妈妈去海边
choices.pinyin: Yǐqián bú yùndòng, xiànzài cháng gēn māma qù hǎibiān.
choices.english: He seldom exercised; now he goes to the beach with Mum every day.

choices.traditional: 以前想學衝浪，現在覺得衝浪太辛苦
choices.simplified: 以前想学冲浪，现在觉得冲浪太辛苦
choices.pinyin: Yǐqián xiǎng xué chōnglàng, xiànzài juéde chōnglàng tài xīnkǔ.
choices.english: He wanted to learn to surf; now he finds it too hard.

choices.traditional: 以前天天穿襯衫，現在一件也沒有了
choices.simplified: 以前天天穿衬衫，现在一件也没有了
choices.pinyin: Yǐqián tiāntiān chuān chènshān, xiànzài yí jiàn yě méiyǒu le.
choices.english: He wore shirts every day; now he has none at all.

choices.traditional: 以前沒空做想做的事，現在更開朗了
choices.simplified: 以前没空做想做的事，现在更开朗了
choices.pinyin: Yǐqián méi kòng zuò xiǎng zuò de shì, xiànzài gèng kāilǎng le.
choices.english: He had no time for what he wanted to do; now he is more cheerful.

questions.why: At the bank he was 忙得沒有休閒的時間 and could not learn to surf; now surfing 使他變得比以前開朗. Mum only encouraged him and never went along, he never wanted to stop, and his shirts are 越來越少, not all gone.

text.traditional: 我阿姨在南部開了一家小服裝店，賣的都是平價的衣服。去年夏天來了一個強烈颱風，阿姨以為店的位置比較高，不會淹水，沒想到雨一連下了兩天，附近的河水都流進了店裡。第二天早上，放得比較低的衣服都濕了，有的甚至已經不能賣了。阿姨看著店裡的樣子，難過得說不出話來。附近的人知道以後，天天一下班就主動來幫忙整理，有人把濕衣服洗乾淨，有人在網路上幫她介紹這家店。結果，一個月以後，店又開了，來買衣服的人比以前還多。阿姨說，這場颱風讓她失去了很多，可是也讓她親眼看見了大家的力量。
text.simplified: 我阿姨在南部开了一家小服装店，卖的都是平价的衣服。去年夏天来了一个强烈台风，阿姨以为店的位置比较高，不会淹水，没想到雨一连下了两天，附近的河水都流进了店里。第二天早上，放得比较低的衣服都湿了，有的甚至已经不能卖了。阿姨看着店里的样子，难过得说不出话来。附近的人知道以后，天天一下班就主动来帮忙整理，有人把湿衣服洗干净，有人在网路上帮她介绍这家店。结果，一个月以后，店又开了，来买衣服的人比以前还多。阿姨说，这场台风让她失去了很多，可是也让她亲眼看见了大家的力量。
text.pinyin: Wǒ āyí zài nán bù kāi le yìjiā xiǎo fúzhuāng diàn, mài de dōu shì píngjià de yīfu. Qùnián xiàtiān lái le yíge qiángliè táifēng, āyí yǐwéi diàn de wèizhì bǐjiào gāo, bú huì yānshuǐ, méixiǎngdào yǔ yìlián xià le liǎng tiān, fùjìn de hé shuǐ dōu liú jìn le diàn lǐ. Dì èr tiān zǎoshàng, fàng de bǐjiào dī de yīfu dōu shī le, yǒude shènzhì yǐjīng bù néng mài le. Āyí kàn zhe diàn lǐ de yàngzi, nánguò de shuōbùchūhuàlái. Fùjìn de rén zhīdào yǐhòu, tiāntiān yíxiàbān jiù zhǔdòng lái bāngmáng zhěnglǐ, yǒu rén bǎ shī yīfu xǐ gānjìng, yǒu rén zài wǎnglù shàng bāng tā jièshào zhè jiā diàn. Jiéguǒ, yígeyuè yǐhòu, diàn yòu kāi le, lái mǎi yīfu de rén bǐ yǐqián hái duō. Āyí shuō, zhè chǎng táifēng ràng tā shīqù le hěn duō, kěshì yě ràng tā qīnyǎn kànjiàn le dàjiā de lìliàng.
text.english: My aunt runs a small clothes shop in the south, selling only affordable clothes. Last summer a strong typhoon came. She thought the shop stood fairly high and would not flood, but the rain fell for two days in a row and the water from the nearby river ran into the shop. The next morning the clothes kept low down were all wet, and some could not even be sold any more. Looking at the shop, my aunt was too upset to speak. When people nearby heard, they volunteered to help clean up every day after work: some washed the wet clothes, some introduced her shop online. As a result, a month later the shop opened again, and more people came to buy clothes than before. My aunt says the typhoon made her lose a lot, but it also let her see firsthand what people can do together.

prompt.traditional: 寫文章的人為什麼先寫店的位置，再寫河水流進店裡？
prompt.simplified: 写文章的人为什么先写店的位置，再写河水流进店里？
prompt.pinyin: Xiě wénzhāng de rén wèishénme xiān xiě diàn de wèizhì, zài xiě hé shuǐ liú jìn diàn lǐ?
prompt.english: Why does the author mention where the shop stood before describing the river water flowing into it?

choices.traditional: 讓人了解她為什麼在這裡開店
choices.simplified: 让人了解她为什么在这里开店
choices.pinyin: Ràng rén liǎojiě tā wèishénme zài zhèlǐ kāi diàn.
choices.english: To explain why she opened the shop there.

choices.traditional: 讓人知道她為什麼先把衣服搬高
choices.simplified: 让人知道她为什么先把衣服搬高
choices.pinyin: Ràng rén zhīdào tā wèishénme xiān bǎ yīfu bān gāo.
choices.english: To explain why she moved the clothes higher beforehand.

choices.traditional: 讓人看出她沒想到店會淹水
choices.simplified: 让人看出她没想到店会淹水
choices.pinyin: Ràng rén kàn chū tā méixiǎngdào diàn huì yānshuǐ.
choices.english: To show she did not expect the shop to flood.

choices.traditional: 讓人知道店的位置本來就容易淹水
choices.simplified: 让人知道店的位置本来就容易淹水
choices.pinyin: Ràng rén zhīdào diàn de wèizhì běnlái jiù róngyì yānshuǐ.
choices.english: To show that the shop was always likely to flood.

questions.why: The higher location sets up her expectation that the shop will stay dry. The water entering the shop reverses that expectation. The text gives no reason for choosing the location and says the clothes were still down low. Nothing says the shop flooded before: she thought it stood high enough.

focus.zh: 以為……沒想到……；預期和結果

prompt.traditional: 阿姨說的「大家的力量」，指的是什麼？
prompt.simplified: 阿姨说的「大家的力量」，指的是什么？
prompt.pinyin: Āyí shuō de "dàjiā de lìliàng", zhǐ de shì shénme?
prompt.english: What does the aunt mean by 大家的力量?

choices.traditional: 鄰居下班以後一起來幫忙
choices.simplified: 邻居下班以后一起来帮忙
choices.pinyin: Línjū xiàbān yǐhòu yìqǐ lái bāngmáng.
choices.english: Neighbours coming to help together after work.

choices.traditional: 來買衣服的客人變多了
choices.simplified: 来买衣服的客人变多了
choices.pinyin: Lái mǎi yīfu de kèrén biàn duō le.
choices.english: More customers coming to buy clothes.

choices.pinyin: Diàn lǐ de yuángōng jiābān zhěnglǐ.
choices.english: The shop staff working overtime to clean up.

choices.traditional: 家人陪她一起重新開店
choices.simplified: 家人陪她一起重新开店
choices.pinyin: Jiārén péi tā yìqǐ chóngxīn kāi diàn.
choices.english: Her family helping her reopen the shop.

questions.why: 大家的力量 is what she saw: people nearby who came every day after work to wash clothes and promote the shop. More customers is the result (結果) of that help, not the 力量 itself, and the text mentions no staff or family helping.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我以為讓兒子每天多寫幾張考卷，數學就會及格。
lines.simplified: 我以为让儿子每天多写几张考卷，数学就会及格。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yǐwéi ràng érzi měi tiān duō xiě jǐ zhāng kǎojuàn, shùxué jiù huì jígé.
lines.english: I thought that if I had my son do a few more test papers every day, he would pass maths.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 結果呢？他進步了嗎？
lines.simplified: 结果呢？他进步了吗？
lines.pinyin: Jiéguǒ ne? Tā jìnbù le ma?
lines.english: And? Has he improved?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 不但沒進步，反而一看到數學題目就說頭痛。我還罵了他好幾次。
lines.simplified: 不但没进步，反而一看到数学题目就说头痛。我还骂了他好几次。
lines.pinyin: Búdàn méi jìnbù, fǎn'ér yí kàndào shùxué tímù jiù shuō tóutòng. Wǒ hái mà le tā hǎo jǐ cì.
lines.english: Not only has he not improved, now he says he has a headache as soon as he sees a maths question. I even scolded him several times.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 先別逼他了，讓他放輕鬆一點，也許會好一些。
lines.simplified: 先别逼他了，让他放轻松一点，也许会好一些。
lines.pinyin: Xiān bié bī tā le, ràng tā fàng qīngsōng yìdiǎn, yěxǔ huì hǎo yìxiē.
lines.english: Stop pushing him for now. Let him relax a bit; maybe it will get better.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的讓兒子多寫考卷，結果怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 女的让儿子多写考卷，结果怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de ràng érzi duō xiě kǎojuàn, jiéguǒ zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: The woman had her son do more test papers. How did it turn out?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 數學及格了，可是常常頭痛
choices.simplified: 数学及格了，可是常常头痛
choices.pinyin: Shùxué jígé le, kěshì chángcháng tóutòng.
choices.english: He passed maths, but often has headaches.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 數學沒進步，還更怕數學了
choices.simplified: 数学没进步，还更怕数学了
choices.pinyin: Shùxué méi jìnbù, hái gèng pà shùxué le.
choices.english: His maths did not improve, and he dreads it more.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 被罵了以後，開始認真寫考卷
choices.simplified: 被骂了以后，开始认真写考卷
choices.pinyin: Bèi mà le yǐhòu, kāishǐ rènzhēn xiě kǎojuàn.
choices.english: After being scolded he started doing the papers properly.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 放輕鬆以後，成績慢慢變好
choices.simplified: 放轻松以后，成绩慢慢变好
choices.pinyin: Fàng qīngsōng yǐhòu, chéngjī mànmàn biàn hǎo.
choices.english: After relaxing, his grades slowly got better.

questions.why: 不但沒進步，反而一看到數學題目就說頭痛: the extra papers had the opposite effect, so maths now puts him off. He has not passed (that was only her hope), the scolding changed nothing, and relaxing is the man's advice for later, not what happened.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 聽說你妹妹的國中老師上課讓學生用手機，不怕他們玩遊戲嗎？
lines.simplified: 听说你妹妹的国中老师上课让学生用手机，不怕他们玩游戏吗？
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō nǐ mèimei de guózhōng lǎoshī shàngkè ràng xuéshēng yòng shǒujī, bú pà tāmen wán yóuxì ma?
lines.english: I hear your sister's junior high teacher lets students use their phones in class. Isn't she afraid they will play games?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我本來也這麼擔心。可是老師用網路工具出題目，學生不但沒玩，反而搶著舉手回答。
lines.simplified: 我本来也这么担心。可是老师用网路工具出题目，学生不但没玩，反而抢着举手回答。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ běnlái yě zhème dānxīn. Kěshì lǎoshī yòng wǎnglù gōngjù chū tímù, xuéshēng búdàn méi wán, fǎn'ér qiǎngzhe jǔshǒu huídá.
lines.english: I was worried about that too at first. But the teacher sets questions with an online tool, and the students don't play at all; instead they rush to raise their hands and answer.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這種教學方式真特別。
lines.simplified: 这种教学方式真特别。
lines.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng jiàoxué fāngshì zhēn tèbié.
lines.english: That way of teaching is really unusual.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 對啊，我妹妹以前最怕上課，現在天天都想去學校。
lines.simplified: 对啊，我妹妹以前最怕上课，现在天天都想去学校。
lines.pinyin: Duì a, wǒ mèimei yǐqián zuì pà shàngkè, xiànzài tiāntiān dōu xiǎng qù xuéxiào.
lines.english: Yes. My sister used to dread class most of all; now she wants to go to school every day.

prompt.speaker: N

prompt.simplified: 老师让学生上课用手机，结果怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Lǎoshī ràng xuéshēng shàngkè yòng shǒujī, jiéguǒ zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: The teacher let students use phones in class. How did it turn out?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xuéshēng shàngkè dōu zài wán yóuxì.
choices.english: The students play games all through class.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 老師不再讓學生用手機
choices.simplified: 老师不再让学生用手机
choices.pinyin: Lǎoshī bú zài ràng xuéshēng yòng shǒujī.
choices.english: The teacher no longer lets them use phones.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xuéshēng gèng zhǔdòng huídá wèntí.
choices.english: The students answer questions more readily.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Mèimei bǐ yǐqián gèng pà shàngkè.
choices.english: His sister dreads class more than before.

questions.why: 不但沒玩，反而搶著舉手回答: the phones did the opposite of what people feared, so students now volunteer answers. Playing games was the worry (我本來也這麼擔心), nothing says the teacher stopped, and the sister now wants to go to school.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳是念外文的，外文程度那麼好，翻譯作業應該很輕鬆吧？
lines.simplified: 你是念外文的，外文程度那么好，翻译作业应该很轻松吧？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ shì niàn wàiwén de, wàiwén chéngdù nàme hǎo, fānyì zuòyè yīnggāi hěn qīngsōng ba?
lines.english: You study foreign languages and your level is so good; translation homework must be easy for you, right?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 才不輕鬆呢！這次的題目都是商業名詞，很多我都沒學過，昨天弄到半夜兩點。
lines.simplified: 才不轻松呢！这次的题目都是商业名词，很多我都没学过，昨天弄到半夜两点。
lines.pinyin: Cái bù qīngsōng ne! Zhè cì de tímù dōu shì shāngyè míngcí, hěn duō wǒ dōu méi xué guo, zuótiān nòng dào bànyè liǎng diǎn.
lines.english: Easy? Not at all! This time the questions were all business terms, many of which I had never learned. Yesterday I worked on it until two in the morning.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 下次可以請教我哥哥，他在貿易公司當主管。
lines.simplified: 下次可以请教我哥哥，他在贸易公司当主管。
lines.pinyin: Xià cì kěyǐ qǐngjiào wǒ gēge, tā zài màoyì gōngsī dāng zhǔguǎn.
lines.english: Next time you can ask my brother. He is a manager at a trading company.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好啊，那就麻煩你了。
lines.simplified: 好啊，那就麻烦你了。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo a, nà jiù máfan nǐ le.
lines.english: Great, thanks in advance.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的覺得這次的作業怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 女的觉得这次的作业怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de juéde zhè cì de zuòyè zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: What does the woman think of this homework?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 不會的詞太多，弄到很晚
choices.simplified: 不会的词太多，弄到很晚
choices.pinyin: Bú huì de cí tài duō, nòng dào hěn wǎn.
choices.english: Too many terms she did not know; it took her till late.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Gēn nán de xiǎng de yíyàng qīngsōng.
choices.english: As easy as the man thought.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tímù bù nán, zhǐshì tài duō le.
choices.english: The questions were not hard, just too many.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 很有意思，能學到新東西
choices.simplified: 很有意思，能学到新东西
choices.pinyin: Hěn yǒu yìsi, néng xué dào xīn dōngxi.
choices.english: Interesting; she can learn new things.

questions.why: 才不輕鬆呢 flatly rejects his "easy": the business terms were new to her and she worked until two in the morning. "Easy" is his view, not hers; nothing says there were too many questions; and she complains about the terms, she never says the work was interesting.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 新聞說，現在孩子少了，大學錄取的機會大很多，你可以放輕鬆一點了吧？
lines.simplified: 新闻说，现在孩子少了，大学录取的机会大很多，你可以放轻松一点了吧？
lines.pinyin: Xīnwén shuō, xiànzài háizi shǎo le, dàxué lùqǔ de jīhuì dà hěn duō, nǐ kěyǐ fàng qīngsōng yìdiǎn le ba?
lines.english: The news says there are fewer children now, so the chance of getting into university has gone up a lot. You can relax a bit now, can't you?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 才沒那麼簡單呢！機會多的是一般的大學。我想念的那個系，每年只收三十個新生。
lines.simplified: 才没那么简单呢！机会多的是一般的大学。我想念的那个系，每年只收三十个新生。
lines.pinyin: Cái méi nàme jiǎndān ne! Jīhuì duō de shì yìbān de dàxué. Wǒ xiǎng niàn de nàge xì, měi nián zhǐ shōu sānshí ge xīnshēng.

lines.traditional: 很多剛出社會的新同事書念得很好，有的甚至是博士，可是在實際工作上，常常缺乏處理問題的經驗。

passage.traditional: 我們國中的英文老師很少用課本上課。她找了很多英文歌和影片當{1}，讓我們一邊聽一邊學，{2}每堂課都很熱鬧。她說，人在快樂的時候，最容易{3}新的東西。每個星期五，她還會{4}我們用英文演戲，她先演，大家跟著她演。剛開始，大家都很緊張，沒有人敢舉手，有的同學{5}連一句話都說不出來。可是一個學期以後，班上同學說英文都很自然了。這樣學到的英文在生活中用得著，比只會寫考卷{6}多了。
passage.simplified: 我们国中的英文老师很少用课本上课。她找了很多英文歌和影片当{1}，让我们一边听一边学，{2}每堂课都很热闹。她说，人在快乐的时候，最容易{3}新的东西。每个星期五，她还会{4}我们用英文演戏，她先演，大家跟着她演。刚开始，大家都很紧张，没有人敢举手，有的同学{5}连一句话都说不出来。可是一个学期以后，班上同学说英文都很自然了。这样学到的英文在生活中用得着，比只会写考卷{6}多了。
passage.pinyin: Wǒmen guózhōng de Yīngwén lǎoshī hěn shǎo yòng kèběn shàngkè. Tā zhǎo le hěn duō Yīngwén gē hé yǐngpiàn dāng jiàocái, ràng wǒmen yìbiān tīng yìbiān xué, yīncǐ měi táng kè dōu hěn rènao. Tā shuō, rén zài kuàilè de shíhòu, zuì róngyì xīshōu xīn de dōngxi. Měi ge xīngqíwǔ, tā hái huì dàilǐng wǒmen yòng Yīngwén yǎnxì, tā xiān yǎn, dàjiā gēnzhe tā yǎn. Gāng kāishǐ, dàjiā dōu hěn jǐnzhāng, méiyǒu rén gǎn jǔshǒu, yǒu de tóngxué shènzhì lián yí jù huà dōu shuō bù chūlái. Kěshì yí ge xuéqí yǐhòu, bān shàng tóngxué shuō Yīngwén dōu hěn zìrán le. Zhèyàng xué dào de Yīngwén zài shēnghuó zhōng yòng de zháo, bǐ zhǐ huì xiě kǎojuàn shíjì duō le.
passage.english: Our junior high English teacher seldom teaches from the textbook. She found lots of English songs and videos to use as teaching materials, so we learn while we listen, and therefore every lesson is lively. She says people take in new things most easily when they are happy. Every Friday she also leads us in acting out plays in English: she acts first and we follow her. At first everyone was nervous; nobody dared to raise a hand, and some classmates could not even get a sentence out. But after one term, everyone in the class speaks English quite naturally. English learned this way is useful in daily life, and much more practical than only being able to do test papers.

passage.traditional: 我弟弟的高中決定{1}回家功課，每科一個星期最多只能出兩張考卷。很多家長擔心孩子的成績會變差，{2}覺得功課越多就學得越好。沒想到一個學期以後，學生的成績不但沒有變差，{3}比以前更好了。老師發現，以前學生每天寫功課寫到半夜，上課時精神很差，也{4}自己思考的時間。多出來的時間，學校讓學生去參加社團，{5}自己的興趣。校長說：「{6}念書不是生活的全部，孩子也需要時間長大。」
passage.simplified: 我弟弟的高中决定{1}回家功课，每科一个星期最多只能出两张考卷。很多家长担心孩子的成绩会变差，{2}觉得功课越多就学得越好。没想到一个学期以后，学生的成绩不但没有变差，{3}比以前更好了。老师发现，以前学生每天写功课写到半夜，上课时精神很差，也{4}自己思考的时间。多出来的时间，学校让学生去参加社团，{5}自己的兴趣。校长说：「{6}念书不是生活的全部，孩子也需要时间长大。」
passage.pinyin: Wǒ dìdi de gāozhōng juédìng jiǎnshǎo huíjiā gōngkè, měi kē yí ge xīngqí zuìduō zhǐ néng chū liǎng zhāng kǎojuàn. Hěn duō jiāzhǎng dānxīn háizi de chéngjī huì biàn chà, sìhū juéde gōngkè yuè duō jiù xué de yuè hǎo. Méixiǎngdào yí ge xuéqí yǐhòu, xuéshēng de chéngjī búdàn méiyǒu biàn chà, fǎn'ér bǐ yǐqián gèng hǎo le. Lǎoshī fāxiàn, yǐqián xuéshēng měi tiān xiě gōngkè xiě dào bànyè, shàngkè shí jīngshén hěn chà, yě quēfá zìjǐ sīkǎo de shíjiān. Duō chūlái de shíjiān, xuéxiào ràng xuéshēng qù cānjiā shètuán, péiyǎng zìjǐ de xìngqù. Xiàozhǎng shuō: "Bìjìng niànshū bú shì shēnghuó de quánbù, háizi yě xūyào shíjiān zhǎngdà."
passage.english: My younger brother's high school has decided to reduce homework: each subject may set at most two test papers a week. Many parents worried their children's grades would drop; they seemed to think the more homework, the better you learn. Unexpectedly, after one term the students' grades had not dropped at all but were better than before. The teachers found that students used to do homework until midnight every day, were tired in class, and also lacked time to think for themselves. With the time freed up, the school now has students join clubs and develop their own interests. The principal says: "After all, studying is not all of life; children also need time to grow up."

title.traditional: 一年級英文課分班說明
title.simplified: 一年级英文课分班说明
title.pinyin: Yī niánjí Yīngwén kè fēnbān shuōmíng
title.english: Year 1 English: How Classes Are Assigned

text.traditional:
從今年起，一年級英文課改用新的分班制度：
測驗：開學第一個星期三，所有新生參加英文測驗
不到六十分：上「生活英文」，每星期四小時
六十分到七十九分：上「一般英文」，每星期兩小時
八十分到一百分，或高中時在國外念書一年以上：都可以用一門其他外文課代替英文課
測驗當天沒來的同學，請在九月三十日以前到外文中心考試；沒有考的同學，都上「生活英文」
外文中心
text.simplified:
从今年起，一年级英文课改用新的分班制度：
测验：开学第一个星期三，所有新生参加英文测验
不到六十分：上「生活英文」，每星期四小时
六十分到七十九分：上「一般英文」，每星期两小时
八十分到一百分，或高中时在国外念书一年以上：都可以用一门其他外文课代替英文课
测验当天没来的同学，请在九月三十日以前到外文中心考试；没有考的同学，都上「生活英文」
外文中心
text.pinyin: Cóng jīnnián qǐ, yī niánjí Yīngwén kè gǎi yòng xīn de fēnbān zhìdù: Cèyàn: kāixué dì yī ge xīngqísān, suǒyǒu xīnshēng cānjiā Yīngwén cèyàn. Bú dào liùshí fēn: shàng "Shēnghuó Yīngwén", měi xīngqí sì xiǎoshí. Liùshí fēn dào qīshíjiǔ fēn: shàng "Yìbān Yīngwén", měi xīngqí liǎng xiǎoshí. Bāshí fēn dào yìbǎi fēn, huò gāozhōng shí zài guówài niànshū yì nián yǐshàng: dōu kěyǐ yòng yì mén qítā wàiwén kè dàitì Yīngwén kè. Cèyàn dàngtiān méi lái de tóngxué, qǐng zài jiǔ yuè sānshí rì yǐqián dào Wàiwén Zhōngxīn kǎoshì; méiyǒu kǎo de tóngxué, dōu shàng "Shēnghuó Yīngwén". Wàiwén Zhōngxīn
text.english:
From this year, Year 1 English uses a new system for assigning classes:
Test: on the first Wednesday of term, all new students take an English test
Below 60: "Everyday English", four hours a week
60 to 79: "General English", two hours a week
80 to 100, or a year or more of high school abroad: either way you may take another foreign language course in place of English
Students absent on the test day, please take the test at the Foreign Language Centre before 30 September; students who do not take it all go into "Everyday English"
Foreign Language Centre

text.english:
Dear Mrs Gao,
This month Xiaomei passed all her maths quizzes; last week's paper in particular was twenty points higher than last month.
Next Tuesday I am going abroad for a meeting. Could that day's lesson move to Thursday at 7 p.m.? If Thursday doesn't suit you, Saturday morning is fine too.
Also, I have prepared a practice notebook for Xiaomei; every question has the answer and an explanation after it. Please have her do two pages a day. When she finishes, she should check the answers herself and note what she can't do in her own notebook, and we will go over it together in class. I have also written the key points for the next quiz on a note and put it in the practice book.
Mr Zhang

text.traditional: 我舅舅今年五十歲，在一家電腦公司擔任主管已經十年了。在別人眼中，他的工作很有成就，可是他一直有一個沒有達成的理想：念博士。舅舅年輕的時候，家裡的錢不夠讓他升學，他高中畢業就開始工作，晚上再去念大學、研究所。去年，他終於被一所大學的博士班錄取了。很多人不明白，他的工作已經這麼好了，為什麼還要回學校，尤其是在這個年紀。舅舅說，工作了三十年，他發現社會變化得太快，碰到新的情況，如果只有過去的經驗，常常缺乏新的想法。博士班同學的水準都很高，他跟年輕的同學一起討論，吸收了很多新的東西，看事情的方式也大大地改變了。他說，學習不只是為了找工作，而是讓自己不管幾歲，都能為社會貢獻一份力量。
text.simplified: 我舅舅今年五十岁，在一家电脑公司担任主管已经十年了。在别人眼中，他的工作很有成就，可是他一直有一个没有达成的理想：念博士。舅舅年轻的时候，家里的钱不够让他升学，他高中毕业就开始工作，晚上再去念大学、研究所。去年，他终于被一所大学的博士班录取了。很多人不明白，他的工作已经这么好了，为什么还要回学校，尤其是在这个年纪。舅舅说，工作了三十年，他发现社会变化得太快，碰到新的情况，如果只有过去的经验，常常缺乏新的想法。博士班同学的水准都很高，他跟年轻的同学一起讨论，吸收了很多新的东西，看事情的方式也大大地改变了。他说，学习不只是为了找工作，而是让自己不管几岁，都能为社会贡献一份力量。
text.pinyin: Wǒ jiùjiu jīnnián wǔshí suì, zài yì jiā diànnǎo gōngsī dānrèn zhǔguǎn yǐjīng shí nián le. Zài biérén yǎn zhōng, tā de gōngzuò hěn yǒu chéngjiù, kěshì tā yìzhí yǒu yí ge méiyǒu dáchéng de lǐxiǎng: niàn bóshì. Jiùjiu niánqīng de shíhòu, jiālǐ de qián bú gòu ràng tā shēngxué, tā gāozhōng bìyè jiù kāishǐ gōngzuò, wǎnshàng zài qù niàn dàxué, yánjiùsuǒ. Qùnián, tā zhōngyú bèi yì suǒ dàxué de bóshìbān lùqǔ le. Hěn duō rén bù míngbái, tā de gōngzuò yǐjīng zhème hǎo le, wèishénme hái yào huí xuéxiào, yóuqí shì zài zhège niánjì. Jiùjiu shuō, gōngzuò le sānshí nián, tā fāxiàn shèhuì biànhuà de tài kuài, pèngdào xīn de qíngkuàng, rúguǒ zhǐyǒu guòqù de jīngyàn, chángcháng quēfá xīn de xiǎngfǎ. Bóshìbān tóngxué de shuǐzhǔn dōu hěn gāo, tā gēn niánqīng de tóngxué yìqǐ tǎolùn, xīshōu le hěn duō xīn de dōngxi, kàn shìqíng de fāngshì yě dàdà de gǎibiàn le. Tā shuō, xuéxí bù zhǐ shì wèile zhǎo gōngzuò, ér shì ràng zìjǐ bùguǎn jǐ suì, dōu néng wèi shèhuì gòngxiàn yí fèn lìliàng.
text.english: My uncle is fifty this year and has been a manager at a computer company for ten years. In other people's eyes his work is a real accomplishment, but he has always had one dream he has not achieved: doing a PhD. When he was young, his family did not have enough money for him to continue his studies; he started working after high school and studied for his first and master's degrees in the evenings. Last year he was finally admitted to a university's PhD programme. Many people don't understand why, with such a good job, he would go back to school, especially at his age. My uncle says that after thirty years of work he has found that society changes too fast; in new situations, if he has only past experience, he often lacks new ideas. The standard of his PhD classmates is high; he discusses things with the young classmates, has taken in a lot that is new, and the way he sees things has changed greatly. He says learning is not just for finding work; it lets you contribute your share to society whatever your age.
