text.traditional:
張經理您好：
謝謝貴公司安排同事到我們學校參加「設計與職場」說明會，跟同學談談工作經驗和感想。
活動時間是下星期五下午兩點，地點在活動中心二樓，包含一小時的介紹和半小時的討論。我們會在下午一點之前把會場布置好。如果貴公司要帶木頭家具到會場，請在星期三下午五點之前告訴我們，我們會先找好停車的地方，再請同學幫忙搬。
有關當天的介紹內容，同學最想了解的，除了設計方面的工作任務以外，還有到公司上班之後該怎麼跟同事配合、公司有什麼福利。如果貴公司有產品簡介，也歡迎帶來給同學參考。
當天請各位在下午一點半之前抵達活動中心，會有兩位同學在門口等大家。盼望下星期五跟各位見面！
設計系 黃老師
text.simplified:
张经理您好：
谢谢贵公司安排同事到我们学校参加「设计与职场」说明会，跟同学谈谈工作经验和感想。
活动时间是下星期五下午两点，地点在活动中心二楼，包含一小时的介绍和半小时的讨论。我们会在下午一点之前把会场布置好。如果贵公司要带木头家具到会场，请在星期三下午五点之前告诉我们，我们会先找好停车的地方，再请同学帮忙搬。
有关当天的介绍内容，同学最想了解的，除了设计方面的工作任务以外，还有到公司上班之后该怎么跟同事配合、公司有什么福利。如果贵公司有产品简介，也欢迎带来给同学参考。
当天请各位在下午一点半之前抵达活动中心，会有两位同学在门口等大家。盼望下星期五跟各位见面！
设计系 黄老师
text.pinyin: Zhāng jīnglǐ nín hǎo: Xièxie guì gōngsī ānpái tóngshì dào wǒmen xuéxiào cānjiā "shèjì yǔ zhíchǎng" shuōmínghuì, gēn tóngxué tán tan gōngzuò jīngyàn hé gǎnxiǎng. Huódòng shíjiān shì xià xīngqíwǔ xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn, dìdiǎn zài huódòng zhōngxīn èr lóu, bāohán yì xiǎoshí de jièshào hé bàn xiǎoshí de tǎolùn. Wǒmen huì zài xiàwǔ yì diǎn zhīqián bǎ huìchǎng bùzhì hǎo. Rúguǒ guì gōngsī yào dài mùtou jiājù dào huìchǎng, qǐng zài xīngqísān xiàwǔ wǔ diǎn zhīqián gàosu wǒmen, wǒmen huì xiān zhǎo hǎo tíngchē de dìfāng, zài qǐng tóngxué bāngmáng bān. Yǒuguān dāngtiān de jièshào nèiróng, tóngxué zuì xiǎng liǎojiě de, chúle shèjì fāngmiàn de gōngzuò rènwù yǐwài, hái yǒu dào gōngsī shàngbān zhīhòu gāi zěnme gēn tóngshì pèihé, gōngsī yǒu shénme fúlì. Rúguǒ guì gōngsī yǒu chǎnpǐn jiǎnjiè, yě huānyíng dài lái gěi tóngxué cānkǎo. Dāngtiān qǐng gèwèi zài xiàwǔ yì diǎn bàn zhīqián dǐdá huódòng zhōngxīn, huì yǒu liǎng wèi tóngxué zài ménkǒu děng dàjiā. Pànwàng xià xīngqíwǔ gēn gèwèi jiànmiàn! Shèjìxì Huáng lǎoshī
text.english:
Dear Manager Zhang,
Thank you for arranging for colleagues from your company to come to our school's "Design and the Workplace" info session to talk with students about their work experience and thoughts.
The event is at 2:00 p.m. next Friday on the 2nd floor of the Activity Center, with a one-hour presentation and half an hour of discussion. We will have the venue set up before 1:00 p.m. If your company plans to bring wooden furniture to the venue, please let us know before 5:00 p.m. on Wednesday so we can find a place to park first and ask students to help carry it.
Regarding the content of the presentation, besides work tasks in the design field, students most want to learn how to work with colleagues after starting work at a company, and what benefits the company offers. If your company has product brochures, you are also welcome to bring them for students' reference.
On the day, please arrive at the Activity Center before 1:30 p.m.; two students will be waiting at the entrance. I look forward to seeing you all next Friday!
Teacher Huang, Design Department

text.traditional:
臺中有一家家具工廠，做木頭家具已經做了三十年。過去，老老闆一個人管全公司的事。儘管他做的桌子和椅子品質很好，可是他的觀念很傳統，往往只相信自己的經驗，很少聽員工的意見，甚至把別家公司看成敵人。後來年輕客人喜歡的樣式變了，工廠卻沒跟著調整。眼看生意越來越差，老老闆相當擔心。
五年前，老老闆的女兒張小姐回到臺中，開始領導這家工廠。她沒把父親過去的做法都換掉，但決定實行新制度：把員工分成設計和銷售兩個小組，每星期舉行會議討論新產品，也把客人的反應整理起來給大家參考。剛開始，一些老同事不理解為什麼要聽年輕人的看法，工廠變得很混亂，還有人差一點離開。
張小姐沒發脾氣，反而謙虛地向老同事請教做家具的功夫，也讓年輕同事創造新樣式。慢慢地，大家發現不論年紀大小，都在為同一個事業付出，都願意盡最大的力量配合。現在，老工廠的生意比以前好多了，張小姐盼望大家在職場上繼續互相學習。
text.simplified:
台中有一家家具工厂，做木头家具已经做了三十年。过去，老老板一个人管全公司的事。尽管他做的桌子和椅子品质很好，可是他的观念很传统，往往只相信自己的经验，很少听员工的意见，甚至把别家公司看成敌人。后来年轻客人喜欢的样式变了，工厂却没跟着调整。眼看生意越来越差，老老板相当担心。
五年前，老老板的女儿张小姐回到台中，开始领导这家工厂。她没把父亲过去的做法都换掉，但决定实行新制度：把员工分成设计和销售两个小组，每星期举行会议讨论新产品，也把客人的反应整理起来给大家参考。刚开始，一些老同事不理解为什么要听年轻人的看法，工厂变得很混乱，还有人差一点离开。
张小姐没发脾气，反而谦虚地向老同事请教做家具的功夫，也让年轻同事创造新样式。慢慢地，大家发现不论年纪大小，都在为同一个事业付出，都愿意尽最大的力量配合。现在，老工厂的生意比以前好多了，张小姐盼望大家在职场上继续互相学习。
text.pinyin: Táizhōng yǒu yì jiā jiājù gōngchǎng, zuò mùtou jiājù yǐjīng zuò le sānshí nián. Guòqù, lǎo lǎobǎn yí ge rén guǎn quán gōngsī de shì. Jǐnguǎn tā zuò de zhuōzi hé yǐzi pǐnzhí hěn hǎo, kěshì tā de guānniàn hěn chuántǒng, wǎngwǎng zhǐ xiāngxìn zìjǐ de jīngyàn, hěn shǎo tīng yuángōng de yìjiàn, shènzhì bǎ bié jiā gōngsī kàn chéng dírén. Hòulái niánqīng kèrén xǐhuān de yàngshì biàn le, gōngchǎng què méi gēnzhe tiáozhěng. Yǎnkàn shēngyì yuè lái yuè chà, lǎo lǎobǎn xiāngdāng dānxīn. Wǔ nián qián, lǎo lǎobǎn de nǚ'ér Zhāng xiǎojiě huí dào Táizhōng, kāishǐ lǐngdǎo zhè jiā gōngchǎng. Tā méi bǎ fùqīn guòqù de zuòfǎ dōu huàn diào, dàn juédìng shíxíng xīn zhìdù: bǎ yuángōng fēn chéng shèjì hé xiāoshòu liǎng ge xiǎozǔ, měi xīngqí jǔxíng huìyì tǎolùn xīn chǎnpǐn, yě bǎ kèrén de fǎnyìng zhěnglǐ qǐlái gěi dàjiā cānkǎo. Gāng kāishǐ, yìxiē lǎo tóngshì bù lǐjiě wèishénme yào tīng niánqīngrén de kànfǎ, gōngchǎng biàn de hěn hùnluàn, hái yǒu rén chà yìdiǎn líkāi. Zhāng xiǎojiě méi fā píqì, fǎn'ér qiānxū de xiàng lǎo tóngshì qǐngjiào zuò jiājù de gōngfu, yě ràng niánqīng tóngshì chuàngzào xīn yàngshì. Mànman de, dàjiā fāxiàn búlùn niánjì dàxiǎo, dōu zài wèi tóng yí ge shìyè fùchū, dōu yuànyì jìn zuì dà de lìliàng pèihé. Xiànzài, lǎo gōngchǎng de shēngyì bǐ yǐqián hǎo duō le, Zhāng xiǎojiě pànwàng dàjiā zài zhíchǎng shàng jìxù hùxiāng xuéxí.
text.english:
In Taichung there is a furniture factory that has been making wooden furniture for thirty years. In the past, the old owner ran everything in the whole company by himself. Even though the tables and chairs he made were of high quality, his mindset was very traditional: he tended to trust only his own experience, rarely listened to employees' opinions, and even viewed other companies as enemies. Later, the styles young customers liked changed, yet the factory did not adjust with them. Watching business get worse and worse, the old owner was deeply worried.
Five years ago, the old owner's daughter, Ms. Zhang, returned to Taichung and began leading the factory. She did not discard all of her father's past ways, but decided to carry out a new system: dividing staff into design and sales teams, holding weekly meetings to discuss new products, and organizing customers' responses for everyone's reference. At first, some senior colleagues could not understand why they had to listen to young people's views; the factory became quite chaotic, and some nearly left.
Ms. Zhang did not lose her temper; instead she humbly asked the senior colleagues to teach her furniture-making craft, while letting younger colleagues create new styles. Gradually, everyone realized that regardless of age, they were all devoting themselves to the same enterprise and became willing to cooperate to the best of their ability. Today, the old factory's business is much better than before, and Ms. Zhang hopes everyone in the workplace keeps learning from one another.

text.traditional:
很多剛畢業的年輕人進職場之前，都以為只要專業能力強、順利通過面試，自己的事業就會很順利。其實，許多企業主管發現，不少相當優秀的新同事，上班之後往往會遇到挫折，問題卻不在專業方面，是在跟同事的相處上。
一些能力很強的人，太相信自己的看法。同事提出建議時，他們不是隨便聽聽，就是批評別人的想法不夠實際。碰到困難時，他們也只顧自己的表現，甚至把同小組的人看成敵人，破壞了大家的關係。儘管這些人自己很努力，但全組的人如果不能互相理解、配合，再好的計畫也不能順利實行。
相反地，真正在企業裡得到肯定的員工，會盡最大的力量完成自己的任務，做事細心，也願意謙虛地向同事請教。不論是領導小組還是協助同事，他們都願意花時間了解別人的想法，為大家創造一個容易溝通的環境。因此，想在職場上成功的人，除了加強專業能力以外，也該學會跟同事合作。
text.simplified:
很多刚毕业的年轻人进职场之前，都以为只要专业能力强、顺利通过面试，自己的事业就会很顺利。其实，许多企业主管发现，不少相当优秀的新同事，上班之后往往会遇到挫折，问题却不在专业方面，是在跟同事的相处上。
一些能力很强的人，太相信自己的看法。同事提出建议时，他们不是随便听听，就是批评别人的想法不够实际。碰到困难时，他们也只顾自己的表现，甚至把同小组的人看成敌人，破坏了大家的关系。尽管这些人自己很努力，但全组的人如果不能互相理解、配合，再好的计划也不能顺利实行。
相反地，真正在企业里得到肯定的员工，会尽最大的力量完成自己的任务，做事细心，也愿意谦虚地向同事请教。不论是领导小组还是协助同事，他们都愿意花时间了解别人的想法，为大家创造一个容易沟通的环境。因此，想在职场上成功的人，除了加强专业能力以外，也该学会跟同事合作。
text.pinyin: Hěn duō gāng bìyè de niánqīngrén jìn zhíchǎng zhīqián, dōu yǐwéi zhǐyào zhuānyè nénglì qiáng, shùnlì tōngguò miànshì, zìjǐ de shìyè jiù huì hěn shùnlì. Qíshí, xǔduō qìyè zhǔguǎn fāxiàn, bù shǎo xiāngdāng yōuxiù de xīn tóngshì, shàngbān zhīhòu wǎngwǎng huì yùdào cuòzhé, wèntí què bú zài zhuānyè fāngmiàn, shì zài gēn tóngshì de xiāngchǔ shàng. Yìxiē nénglì hěn qiáng de rén, tài xiāngxìn zìjǐ de kànfǎ. Tóngshì tíchū jiànyì shí, tāmen bú shì suíbiàn tīng ting, jiù shì pīpíng biérén de xiǎngfǎ bú gòu shíjì. Pèng dào kùnnán shí, tāmen yě zhǐ gù zìjǐ de biǎoxiàn, shènzhì bǎ tóng xiǎozǔ de rén kàn chéng dírén, pòhuài le dàjiā de guānxì. Jǐnguǎn zhèxiē rén zìjǐ hěn nǔlì, dàn quán zǔ de rén rúguǒ bù néng hùxiāng lǐjiě, pèihé, zài hǎo de jìhuà yě bù néng shùnlì shíxíng. Xiāngfǎn de, zhēnzhèng zài qìyè lǐ dédào kěndìng de yuángōng, huì jìn zuì dà de lìliàng wánchéng zìjǐ de rènwù, zuòshì xìxīn, yě yuànyì qiānxū de xiàng tóngshì qǐngjiào. Búlùn shì lǐngdǎo xiǎozǔ háishì xiézhù tóngshì, tāmen dōu yuànyì huā shíjiān liǎojiě biérén de xiǎngfǎ, wèi dàjiā chuàngzào yí ge róngyì gōutōng de huánjìng. Yīncǐ, xiǎng zài zhíchǎng shàng chénggōng de rén, chúle jiāqiáng zhuānyè nénglì yǐwài, yě gāi xuéhuì gēn tóngshì hézuò.
text.english:
Before entering the workplace, many recent graduates assume that as long as their professional skills are strong and they pass the interview smoothly, their career will go smoothly. In fact, many company supervisors find that quite a few highly capable new colleagues often run into setbacks after starting work—not in terms of professional skills, but in getting along with coworkers.
Some very capable people trust their own views too much. When colleagues make suggestions, they either listen casually or criticize others' ideas as unrealistic. When difficulties arise, they look out only for their own performance, even viewing teammates as enemies and ruining everyone's relationships. Even though such people work hard themselves, if the whole team cannot understand and cooperate with one another, even the best plan cannot be carried out smoothly.
By contrast, employees who truly earn approval in an enterprise do their very best to complete their own tasks, work carefully, and are willing to modestly ask colleagues for advice. Whether leading a team or assisting colleagues, they are willing to spend time understanding what others think, creating an environment where everyone can communicate easily. Therefore, anyone who wants to succeed in the workplace should, besides strengthening their professional ability, also learn to work with colleagues.

prompt.traditional: 女的接下來最可能做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 女的接下来最可能做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de jiēxiàlái zuì kěnéng zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What is the woman most likely to do next?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Míngtiān zài shàngwǎng bàomíng
choices.english: Sign up online tomorrow

choices.speaker: N

choices.speaker: N

choices.english: Wait and sign up next time

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiě diànzǐ yóujiàn gěi xuéxiào
choices.english: Email the school

questions.why: Her 這下子 line is a first reaction: she thinks she has missed this round. 好，我試試看吧 takes up his last suggestion, sending her papers to their email address. Tomorrow is too late because sign-up closes tonight, the office closed before seven so phoning will not work, and waiting for next time is the plan she drops.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你最近怎麼每天都在看攝影機？要買啊？
lines.simplified: 你最近怎么每天都在看摄影机？要买啊？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zuìjìn zěnme měitiān dōu zài kàn shèyǐngjī? Yào mǎi a?
lines.english: Why have you been looking at video cameras every day lately? Are you buying one?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 對啊，下個月社團要去花蓮表演，我想自己負責攝影。
lines.simplified: 对啊，下个月社团要去花莲表演，我想自己负责摄影。
lines.pinyin: Duì a, xià ge yuè shètuán yào qù Huālián biǎoyǎn, wǒ xiǎng zìjǐ fùzé shèyǐng.
lines.english: Yes. Next month my club is performing in Hualien, and I want to be in charge of filming it myself.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好一點的攝影機，價錢都要好幾萬，用手機拍不就好了？
lines.simplified: 好一点的摄影机，价钱都要好几万，用手机拍不就好了？
lines.pinyin: Hǎo yìdiǎn de shèyǐngjī, jiàqián dōu yào hǎo jǐ wàn, yòng shǒujī pāi bú jiù hǎo le?
lines.english: A decent camera costs tens of thousands. Why not just film on your phone?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 手機拍出來的效果差太多了。就是得打工兩個月，我也要買一台。
lines.simplified: 手机拍出来的效果差太多了。就是得打工两个月，我也要买一台。
lines.pinyin: Shǒujī pāi chūlái de xiàoguǒ chà tài duō le. Jiùshì děi dǎgōng liǎng ge yuè, wǒ yě yào mǎi yì tái.
lines.english: A phone looks far worse. Even if I have to work part-time for two months, I'm buying one.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 社團不是有一台嗎？你先借來用用看，確定需要再買也不晚。
lines.simplified: 社团不是有一台吗？你先借来用用看，确定需要再买也不晚。
lines.pinyin: Shètuán bú shì yǒu yì tái ma? Nǐ xiān jiè lái yòngyong kàn, quèdìng xūyào zài mǎi yě bù wǎn.
lines.english: Doesn't the club have one? Borrow it first and try it. Once you're sure you need one, it's not too late to buy.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好啦，我先去問問看。
lines.simplified: 好啦，我先去问问看。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo la, wǒ xiān qù wènwen kàn.
lines.english: All right, I'll go and ask first.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的最後打算怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 男的最后打算怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de zuìhòu dǎsuàn zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What does the man finally plan to do?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiān dǎgōng, zài mǎi yì tái hǎo de
choices.english: Work first, then buy a good one

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiān wèn néng bù néng jiè shètuán de
choices.english: Ask first whether he can borrow the club's

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yòng shǒujī pāi Huālián de biǎoyǎn
choices.english: Film the Hualien show on his phone

choices.pinyin: Qǐng shètuán zài mǎi yì tái xīn de
choices.english: Ask the club to buy a new one

questions.why: 就是得打工兩個月，我也要買 sounds final, but she points out the club already has a camera, and 好啦，我先去問問看 accepts her idea as far as asking: he will find out whether he can borrow it. Working to buy one is the plan he puts off, he has already turned down filming on a phone, and nobody suggests the club buy another.

focus.en: even if… still…; a changed plan

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這部電影的題材很好，可是內容離現實太遠了。哪有人學三天就會開飛機的？
lines.simplified: 这部电影的题材很好，可是内容离现实太远了。哪有人学三天就会开飞机的？
lines.pinyin: Zhè bù diànyǐng de tícái hěn hǎo, kěshì nèiróng lí xiànshí tài yuǎn le. Nǎ yǒu rén xué sān tiān jiù huì kāi fēijī de?
lines.english: The film picked a good subject, but the story is too far from reality. Who learns to fly a plane in three days?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 電影嘛，就是演得不真實，我也覺得很好看啦。
lines.simplified: 电影嘛，就是演得不真实，我也觉得很好看啦。
lines.pinyin: Diànyǐng ma, jiùshì yǎn de bù zhēnshí, wǒ yě juéde hěn hǎokàn la.
lines.english: It's a film. Even if it isn't realistic, I still think it's good.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 可是這位導演以前的作品都很真實，我就是因為這樣才來看的。
lines.simplified: 可是这位导演以前的作品都很真实，我就是因为这样才来看的。
lines.pinyin: Kěshì zhè wèi dǎoyǎn yǐqián de zuòpǐn dōu hěn zhēnshí, wǒ jiù shì yīnwèi zhèyàng cái lái kàn de.
lines.english: But this director's earlier work was always true to life. That is exactly why I came to see it.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 說起來，他以前的電影是比較讓人感動。不過，這部的音樂真的很棒。
lines.simplified: 说起来，他以前的电影是比较让人感动。不过，这部的音乐真的很棒。
lines.pinyin: Shuōqǐlái, tā yǐqián de diànyǐng shì bǐjiào ràng rén gǎndòng. Búguò, zhè bù de yīnyuè zhēn de hěn bàng.
lines.english: Come to think of it, his earlier films were more moving. Still, the music in this one is really great.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的覺得這部電影跟導演以前的作品比起來怎麼樣？
prompt.simplified: 男的觉得这部电影跟导演以前的作品比起来怎么样？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de juéde zhè bù diànyǐng gēn dǎoyǎn yǐqián de zuòpǐn bǐ qǐlái zěnmeyàng?
prompt.english: How does the man think this film compares with the director's earlier work?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 以前的比較感動人，這部也好看
choices.simplified: 以前的比较感动人，这部也好看
choices.pinyin: Yǐqián de bǐjiào gǎndòng rén, zhè bù yě hǎokàn
choices.english: The earlier ones were more moving, but this one is good too

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 這部比以前的更感動人
choices.simplified: 这部比以前的更感动人
choices.pinyin: Zhè bù bǐ yǐqián de gèng gǎndòng rén
choices.english: This one is more moving than the earlier ones

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 以前的比較好，這部不值得看
choices.simplified: 以前的比较好，这部不值得看
choices.pinyin: Yǐqián de bǐjiào hǎo, zhè bù bù zhíde kàn
choices.english: The earlier ones were better; this one is not worth seeing

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zhè bù bǐ yǐqián de gèng zhēnshí
choices.english: This one is more realistic than the earlier ones

questions.why: Two turns together: 就是演得不真實，我也覺得很好看 (he enjoys it although it is unrealistic) and 說起來，他以前的電影是比較讓人感動 (he grants the earlier films were more moving). Not worth seeing is close to the woman's view, more moving reverses his concession, and it was the earlier films that were true to life.

focus.en: even if… still…; two turns together

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 明天的面試，你準備得怎麼樣了？
lines.simplified: 明天的面试，你准备得怎么样了？
lines.pinyin: Míngtiān de miànshì, nǐ zhǔnbèi de zěnmeyàng le?
lines.english: How is your preparation for tomorrow's interview going?

lines.traditional: 有關那家公司的資料我都仔細看過了，不論他們問什麼，我都回答得出來。
lines.simplified: 有关那家公司的资料我都仔细看过了，不论他们问什么，我都回答得出来。
lines.pinyin: Yǒuguān nà jiā gōngsī de zīliào wǒ dōu zǐxì kàn guo le, búlùn tāmen wèn shénme, wǒ dōu huídá de chūlái.
lines.english: I've read everything about that company carefully. Whatever they ask, I can answer.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 萬一他們問你為什麼離開上一家公司呢？
lines.simplified: 万一他们问你为什么离开上一家公司呢？
lines.pinyin: Wànyī tāmen wèn nǐ wèishénme líkāi shàng yì jiā gōngsī ne?
lines.english: What if they ask why you left your last company?

lines.traditional: 這我倒沒想過。說實話，是因為我常跟主管吵架，可是這種話不能說吧？
lines.simplified: 这我倒没想过。说实话，是因为我常跟主管吵架，可是这种话不能说吧？
lines.pinyin: Zhè wǒ dào méi xiǎng guo. Shuō shíhuà, shì yīnwèi wǒ cháng gēn zhǔguǎn chǎojià, kěshì zhè zhǒng huà bù néng shuō ba?
lines.english: I hadn't thought about that. To tell the truth, it was because I often argued with my boss, but I can't say that, can I?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 所以啊，你今天晚上還是好好想一想，怎麼回答比較好。
lines.simplified: 所以啊，你今天晚上还是好好想一想，怎么回答比较好。
lines.pinyin: Suǒyǐ a, nǐ jīntiān wǎnshàng háishì hǎohǎo xiǎng yì xiǎng, zěnme huídá bǐjiào hǎo.

lines.simplified: 爸爸，公司的健康检查你去做了没有？

lines.english: Dad, have you done your company health check yet?

lines.english: Not yet. I've always been healthy, nothing wrong with me, so it hardly matters whether I do it.

lines.simplified: 你上次也这么说，结果直到肚子痛得睡不着，才肯去看医生。

lines.simplified: 好啦，好啦。可是这个月工作多，主任不一定答应让我请假。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo la, hǎo la. Kěshì zhège yuè gōngzuò duō, zhǔrèn bù yídìng dāyìng ràng wǒ qǐngjià.
lines.english: All right, all right. But there's a lot of work this month; my department head may not let me take time off.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 公司的健康檢查本來就能用上班時間去做，你下星期一就去吧。
lines.simplified: 公司的健康检查本来就能用上班时间去做，你下星期一就去吧。
lines.pinyin: Gōngsī de jiànkāng jiǎnchá běnlái jiù néng yòng shàngbān shíjiān qù zuò, nǐ xià xīngqí yī jiù qù ba.

intro.speaker: N

choices.english: Faster internet

questions.why: The second room's pluses are that it is cheaper, roomier and has its own kitchen; only the kitchen is among the choices, and in the first room five tenants share one. Being near the MRT, high-speed internet and 既乾淨又安靜 all belong to the first room, so she keeps them.

focus.en: both… and…; comparing the two rooms

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 第二間比較便宜，男的為什麼還是不建議女的租？
prompt.simplified: 第二间比较便宜，男的为什么还是不建议女的租？
prompt.pinyin: Dì èr jiān bǐjiào piányí, nán de wèishénme háishì bú jiànyì nǚ de zū?
prompt.english: The second room is cheaper, so why does the man still advise against it?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Chúfáng yào gēn biérén yìqǐ yòng

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 空間太小，住起來不舒服
choices.simplified: 空间太小，住起来不舒服
choices.pinyin: Kōngjiān tài xiǎo, zhù qǐlái bù shūfú
choices.english: It is too small to be comfortable

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 照不到陽光，住久了不健康
choices.simplified: 照不到阳光，住久了不健康
choices.pinyin: Zhào bú dào yángguāng, zhù jiǔ le bú jiànkāng
choices.english: No sunlight; unhealthy over time

choices.english: It has already been let to someone else

questions.why: 連窗戶都沒有，更別說陽光了 tells us the room gets no sun at all, and the man answers that living without a window for long is bad for you. The shared kitchen belongs to the first room (the second has its own), the second is roomier, not smaller, and the room the landlord says is empty is the first one; nothing says the second is taken.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的最後打算怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 女的最后打算怎么做？

choices.speaker: N

choices.english: Take the second room and cook there

choices.speaker: N

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 租第一間，不再自己煮飯
choices.simplified: 租第一间，不再自己煮饭
choices.pinyin: Zū dì yī jiān, bú zài zìjǐ zhǔ fàn
choices.english: Take the first room and stop cooking

questions.why: Her worry about the first room was waiting for the shared kitchen. He suggests cooking a little later, and 也對……我明天就去簽約 shows she will take the first room on those terms. She still means to cook, and she is not going to look at other rooms.

focus.zh: 接下來的事；兩句合起來

intro.speaker: N

intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這個週末我要去臺中參加朋友的婚禮，打算騎機車去，可以省一點錢。
lines.simplified: 这个周末我要去台中参加朋友的婚礼，打算骑机车去，可以省一点钱。
lines.pinyin: Zhège zhōumò wǒ yào qù Táizhōng cānjiā péngyǒu de hūnlǐ, dǎsuàn qí jīchē qù, kěyǐ shěng yìdiǎn qián.
lines.english: This weekend I'm going to a friend's wedding in Taichung. I plan to ride my scooter to save a bit of money.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 機車不能上高速公路，只能騎一般道路，恐怕得騎五個小時。
lines.simplified: 机车不能上高速公路，只能骑一般道路，恐怕得骑五个小时。
lines.pinyin: Jīchē bù néng shàng gāosù gōnglù, zhǐ néng qí yìbān dàolù, kǒngpà děi qí wǔ ge xiǎoshí.
lines.english: Scooters can't go on the freeway. You can only take ordinary roads, so it will probably take five hours.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我知道，可是坐高鐵來回要一千多塊，我這個月剩的錢不多了。
lines.simplified: 我知道，可是坐高铁来回要一千多块，我这个月剩的钱不多了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zhīdào, kěshì zuò gāotiě láihuí yào yì qiān duō kuài, wǒ zhège yuè shèng de qián bù duō le.
lines.english: I know, but the high-speed rail costs over a thousand both ways, and I haven't got much money left this month.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 騎那麼久，你到臺中就累壞了，更別說回來了。
lines.simplified: 骑那么久，你到台中就累坏了，更别说回来了。
lines.pinyin: Qí nàme jiǔ, nǐ dào Táizhōng jiù lèi huài le, gèng bié shuō huílái le.
lines.english: Riding that long, you'll be worn out by the time you reach Taichung, let alone coming back.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 可是到了臺中，我還安排了附近的幾個景點，想騎車去看看。
lines.simplified: 可是到了台中，我还安排了附近的几个景点，想骑车去看看。
lines.pinyin: Kěshì dào le Táizhōng, wǒ hái ānpái le fùjìn de jǐ ge jǐngdiǎn, xiǎng qí chē qù kànkan.
lines.english: But in Taichung I've also planned a few sights nearby that I want to ride out to.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 車站旁邊就有租機車的店，一天才三百塊。坐高鐵既快，又不會那麼累。
lines.simplified: 车站旁边就有租机车的店，一天才三百块。坐高铁既快，又不会那么累。
lines.pinyin: Chēzhàn pángbiān jiù yǒu zū jīchē de diàn, yì tiān cái sānbǎi kuài. Zuò gāotiě jì kuài, yòu bú huì nàme lèi.
lines.english: There's a shop right by the station that rents scooters, only three hundred a day. The train is both fast and not so tiring.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這樣方便多了，多花一點錢也值得。好吧，我等一下就上網買票。
lines.simplified: 这样方便多了，多花一点钱也值得。好吧，我等一下就上网买票。
lines.pinyin: Zhèyàng fāngbiàn duō le, duō huā yìdiǎn qián yě zhíde. Hǎo ba, wǒ děng yíxià jiù shàngwǎng mǎi piào.
lines.english: That's much more convenient; it's worth spending a bit more. All right, I'll buy a ticket online in a bit.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的說「更別說回來了」，是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 女的说「更别说回来了」，是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de shuō "gèng bié shuō huílái le", shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the woman mean by "let alone coming back"?

choices.pinyin: Huílái zuìhǎo gǎi zuò gāotiě
choices.english: He had better take the train back

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qù de shíhòu hái bú suàn lèi
choices.english: Going there is not so tiring

choices.pinyin: Huílái de jùlí bǐjiào yuǎn
choices.english: The way back is longer

choices.pinyin: Huílái de shíhòu huì gèng xīnkǔ
choices.english: The ride back will be even harder

questions.why: 更別說 adds the stronger case: if he is already tired when he gets there, the ride back after the wedding will be harder still. She says he will be tired on arrival, the road back is the same one, and she suggests the train for the whole trip, not only the way back.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的提到機車不能上高速公路，是想告訴男的什麼？
prompt.simplified: 女的提到机车不能上高速公路，是想告诉男的什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de tídào jīchē bù néng shàng gāosù gōnglù, shì xiǎng gàosù nán de shénme?
prompt.english: Why does the woman mention that scooters cannot use the freeway?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 高鐵比較便宜，也比較快
choices.simplified: 高铁比较便宜，也比较快
choices.pinyin: Gāotiě bǐjiào piányí, yě bǐjiào kuài
choices.english: The train is cheaper, and faster too

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qí jīchē dào bù liǎo Táizhōng
choices.english: A scooter cannot reach Taichung

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yīnggāi zǎo yìdiǎn chūfā
choices.english: He should set off earlier

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qí qù tài huā shíjiān, yě tài lèi
choices.english: Riding takes too long and is too tiring

questions.why: Two turns together: without the freeway the ride takes about five hours, and she then says he will be worn out by the time he gets there. The train is faster but costs more (over a thousand both ways), ordinary roads do reach Taichung, and she never suggests leaving earlier: she wants him on the train.

focus.zh: 說話人的意思；兩句合起來
focus.en: what a speaker means; two turns together

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的最後為什麼願意坐高鐵？
prompt.simplified: 男的最后为什么愿意坐高铁？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de zuìhòu wèishénme yuànyì zuò gāotiě?
prompt.english: Why does the man finally agree to take the train?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 高鐵票不貴，比騎車省錢
choices.simplified: 高铁票不贵，比骑车省钱
choices.pinyin: Gāotiě piào bú guì, bǐ qí chē shěng qián
choices.english: The ticket isn't dear; it costs less than riding

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Jǐngdiǎn lí chēzhàn dōu hěn jìn
choices.english: The sights are all near the station

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 到了能租車，多花點錢也值得
choices.simplified: 到了能租车，多花点钱也值得
choices.pinyin: Dào le néng zū chē, duō huā diǎn qián yě zhíde
choices.english: He can rent a scooter there, so the extra cost is worth it

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zhège yuè de qián hái gòu yòng
choices.english: He has enough money this month

questions.why: He held out for two reasons, money and wanting a scooter for the sights. She answers the second (a shop by the station rents scooters for three hundred a day, and the train is 既快又不累), and he decides 這樣方便多了，多花一點錢也值得. The ticket is still over a thousand, so it is not cheaper than riding; he said he is short of money this month; and the sights are only nearby, not by the station.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段廣播，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段广播，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn guǎngbò, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a broadcast, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 各位同學午安，歡迎來聽今天的演講。
lines.simplified: 各位同学午安，欢迎来听今天的演讲。
lines.pinyin: Gèwèi tóngxué wǔ'ān, huānyíng lái tīng jīntiān de yǎnjiǎng.
lines.english: Good afternoon, everyone, and welcome to today's talk.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 演講兩點開始，大約一個半小時。開始以前，有幾件事要提醒大家。
lines.simplified: 演讲两点开始，大约一个半小时。开始以前，有几件事要提醒大家。
lines.pinyin: Yǎnjiǎng liǎng diǎn kāishǐ, dàyuē yí ge bàn xiǎoshí. Kāishǐ yǐqián, yǒu jǐ jiàn shì yào tíxǐng dàjiā.
lines.english: The talk starts at two and lasts about an hour and a half. Before it begins, a few reminders.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 第一，演講的時候請不要拍照或攝影。這一方面是因為教授今天要談的研究還沒發表，一方面也是怕影響旁邊的同學。
lines.simplified: 第一，演讲的时候请不要拍照或摄影。这一方面是因为教授今天要谈的研究还没发表，一方面也是怕影响旁边的同学。
lines.pinyin: Dì yī, yǎnjiǎng de shíhòu qǐng búyào pāizhào huò shèyǐng. Zhè yìfāngmiàn shì yīnwèi jiàoshòu jīntiān yào tán de yánjiù hái méi fābiǎo, yìfāngmiàn yě shì pà yǐngxiǎng pángbiān de tóngxué.
lines.english: First, please do not take photos or film during the talk. This is partly because the research the professor will talk about has not been published yet, and partly so as not to disturb the people next to you.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 第二，今天的內容學校會錄下來，三天內上傳到雲端，大家可以自己下載，不必再帶隨身碟來辦公室拿。
lines.simplified: 第二，今天的内容学校会录下来，三天内上传到云端，大家可以自己下载，不必再带随身碟来办公室拿。
lines.pinyin: Dì èr, jīntiān de nèiróng xuéxiào huì lù xiàlái, sān tiān nèi shàngchuán dào yúnduān, dàjiā kěyǐ zìjǐ xiàzài, búbì zài dài suíshēndié lái bàngōngshì ná.
lines.english: Second, the school will record today's talk and upload it to the cloud within three days. You can download it yourselves; there is no need to bring a USB drive to the office for it.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 第三，最後二十分鐘是問問題的時間。想問問題的同學，請先寫在發給大家的紙上，交給門口的工作人員。
lines.simplified: 第三，最后二十分钟是问问题的时间。想问问题的同学，请先写在发给大家的纸上，交给门口的工作人员。
lines.pinyin: Dì sān, zuìhòu èrshí fēnzhōng shì wèn wèntí de shíjiān. Xiǎng wèn wèntí de tóngxué, qǐng xiān xiě zài fā gěi dàjiā de zhǐ shàng, jiāo gěi ménkǒu de gōngzuò rényuán.
lines.english: Third, the last twenty minutes are for questions. If you want to ask something, please first write it on the paper we handed out and give it to the staff at the door.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 演講的時候為什麼不能攝影？
prompt.simplified: 演讲的时候为什么不能摄影？
prompt.pinyin: Yǎnjiǎng de shíhòu wèishénme bù néng shèyǐng?
prompt.english: Why is filming not allowed during the talk?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 怕研究內容傳出去，也怕影響別人
choices.simplified: 怕研究内容传出去，也怕影响别人
choices.pinyin: Pà yánjiù nèiróng chuán chūqù, yě pà yǐngxiǎng biérén
choices.english: The research might get out, and it bothers other people

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 學校會錄下來，不必自己拍
choices.simplified: 学校会录下来，不必自己拍
choices.pinyin: Xuéxiào huì lù xiàlái, búbì zìjǐ pāi
choices.english: The school records it, so there's no need to film it yourself

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 教授不喜歡被人拍下來
choices.simplified: 教授不喜欢被人拍下来
choices.pinyin: Jiàoshòu bù xǐhuān bèi rén pāi xiàlái
choices.english: The professor dislikes being filmed

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 教授的研究已經發表過了
choices.simplified: 教授的研究已经发表过了
choices.pinyin: Jiàoshòu de yánjiù yǐjīng fābiǎo guo le
choices.english: The research has already been published

questions.why: 一方面……一方面…… gives two reasons together: the research is not published yet, and filming disturbs the people nearby. The school's own recording is a separate point, not the reason given for the rule; the professor's feelings are never mentioned, and the research is still unpublished.

focus.en: on one hand… on the other…; a reason

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 一位同學想問教授問題，也想回家以後再看一次演講，他應該怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 一位同学想问教授问题，也想回家以后再看一次演讲，他应该怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Yí wèi tóngxué xiǎng wèn jiàoshòu wèntí, yě xiǎng huí jiā yǐhòu zài kàn yí cì yǎnjiǎng, tā yīnggāi zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: A student wants to ask the professor a question and to watch the talk again at home. What should he do?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 舉手發問，自己用手機錄
choices.simplified: 举手发问，自己用手机录
choices.pinyin: Jǔshǒu fāwèn, zìjǐ yòng shǒujī lù
choices.english: Raise his hand, and record it on his phone

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 寫下問題交出去，自己用手機錄
choices.simplified: 写下问题交出去，自己用手机录
choices.pinyin: Xiě xià wèntí jiāo chūqù, zìjǐ yòng shǒujī lù
choices.english: Hand in a written question, and record it on his phone

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 舉手發問，之後上網下載
choices.simplified: 举手发问，之后上网下载
choices.pinyin: Jǔshǒu fāwèn, zhīhòu shàngwǎng xiàzài
choices.english: Raise his hand, then download it later

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 寫下問題交出去，之後上網下載
choices.simplified: 写下问题交出去，之后上网下载
choices.pinyin: Xiě xià wèntí jiāo chūqù, zhīhòu shàngwǎng xiàzài
choices.english: Hand in a written question, then download it later

questions.why: Two rules together: a question must first be written on the paper and handed to the staff at the door, and filming is not allowed, but the school will put the recording in the cloud within three days for everyone to download. Raising a hand skips the written step, and recording on a phone breaks the first rule.

focus.zh: 把規則用在新的情況；兩句合起來
focus.en: applying the rules to a new case; two parts together

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 這段廣播主要是在說什麼？
prompt.simplified: 这段广播主要是在说什么？

prompt.english: What is the broadcast mainly about?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yǎnjiǎng de tímù gēn nèiróng
choices.english: The topic and content of the talk

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tīng yǎnjiǎng yào zhùyì de shì
choices.english: What to keep in mind at the talk

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zěnme xiàzài yǎnjiǎng de yǐngpiàn
choices.english: How to download the video of the talk

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zěnme wèn jiàoshòu wèntí
choices.english: How to ask the professor questions

questions.why: The speaker says she has a few things to remind everyone of and goes through three rules: no filming, the recording, and how to ask questions. The talk's topic is never described, and downloading and asking questions are each only one of the three points.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段廣播，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段广播，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn guǎngbò, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a broadcast, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 各位朋友大家好，歡迎參觀這次的攝影展。
lines.simplified: 各位朋友大家好，欢迎参观这次的摄影展。
lines.pinyin: Gèwèi péngyǒu dàjiā hǎo, huānyíng cānguān zhè cì de shèyǐng zhǎn.
lines.english: Hello, everyone, and welcome to this photography exhibition.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這裡的作品，都是同一位攝影師四十年來拍的。

lines.traditional: 他選的題材很特別，不拍有名的景點，只拍他在街上觀察到的人，像是賣菜的阿姨、等公車的學生。

lines.speaker: M

lines.pinyin: Tā shuō, tā yìfāngmiàn xiǎng jìlù zhège chéngshì de biànhuà, yìfāngmiàn yě xiǎng ràng dàjiā fāxiàn, shēnghuó zhōng zuì gǎndòng rén de, wǎngwǎng jiù shì zhèyàng píngcháng de rén.

passage.traditional: 我的室友從高中就熱愛寫小說，以往寫好了只讓幾個好朋友閱讀。去年她才嘗試把自己的{1}上傳到網站，沒想到每次一上傳，就有幾百位{2}留言。有的人很欣賞她的故事，也有人不客氣地{3}她，說內容寫得太長。{4}有的話不太好聽，她也一點都沒生氣，還把大家的意見拿來參考，認真修改。上個月，有一家公司跟她聯絡，說想{5}她的小說，明年在全國各地的書店銷售。她接到這個消息時，又高興又緊張地想：「{6}我得更認真寫才行了！」
passage.simplified: 我的室友从高中就热爱写小说，以往写好了只让几个好朋友阅读。去年她才尝试把自己的{1}上传到网站，没想到每次一上传，就有几百位{2}留言。有的人很欣赏她的故事，也有人不客气地{3}她，说内容写得太长。{4}有的话不太好听，她也一点都没生气，还把大家的意见拿来参考，认真修改。上个月，有一家公司跟她联络，说想{5}她的小说，明年在全国各地的书店销售。她接到这个消息时，又高兴又紧张地想：「{6}我得更认真写才行了！」
passage.pinyin: Wǒ de shìyǒu cóng gāozhōng jiù rè'ài xiě xiǎoshuō, yǐwǎng xiě hǎo le zhǐ ràng jǐ ge hǎo péngyǒu yuèdú. Qùnián tā cái chángshì bǎ zìjǐ de zuòpǐn shàngchuán dào wǎngzhàn, méi xiǎngdào měi cì yí shàngchuán, jiù yǒu jǐ bǎi wèi dúzhě liúyán. Yǒu de rén hěn xīnshǎng tā de gùshì, yě yǒu rén bú kèqì de pīpíng tā, shuō nèiróng xiě de tài cháng. Jǐnguǎn yǒu de huà bú tài hǎotīng, tā yě yìdiǎn dōu méi shēngqì, hái bǎ dàjiā de yìjiàn ná lái cānkǎo, rènzhēn xiūgǎi. Shàng ge yuè, yǒu yì jiā gōngsī gēn tā liánluò, shuō xiǎng chūbǎn tā de xiǎoshuō, míngnián zài quánguó gèdì de shūdiàn xiāoshòu. Tā jiē dào zhège xiāoxí shí, yòu gāoxìng yòu jǐnzhāng de xiǎng: "Zhèxiàzi wǒ děi gèng rènzhēn xiě cái xíng le!"
passage.english: My roommate has loved writing novels since high school. In the past, when she finished something she only let a few good friends read it. Only last year did she try uploading her own works to a website, and to her surprise, every time she uploaded something, a few hundred readers left comments. Some really enjoyed her stories; others criticized her bluntly, saying they were too long. Even though some of it was not nice to hear, she did not get angry at all; she took everyone's opinions as a reference and revised carefully. Last month a company contacted her and said it wanted to publish her novel and sell it in bookshops all over the country next year. When she got the news, she thought, happy and nervous at once: "Now I really have to write even more carefully!"

passage.traditional: 以前上作文課，同學不是把作文寫在厚厚的本子上，就是存在隨身碟裡，{1}有人忘了帶，或是弄丟了。這學期老師改用雲端，先把要討論的文章上傳，讓大家{2}，上課時再一起討論。我們的作文也都寫在雲端上，不用再帶本子跟隨身碟，{3}也空了不少。老師改作文的時候，系統會自動{4}他改過的每一個地方，我們一看就知道錯在哪裡。{5}寫得好的句子，老師會在旁邊留言，說明好在哪裡。一個學期下來，大家的錯字減少了許多，想說的意思也表達得更清楚了，老師表示這種上課方式的{6}比他本來想像的還要好。
passage.simplified: 以前上作文课，同学不是把作文写在厚厚的本子上，就是存在随身碟里，{1}有人忘了带，或是弄丢了。这学期老师改用云端，先把要讨论的文章上传，让大家{2}，上课时再一起讨论。我们的作文也都写在云端上，不用再带本子跟随身碟，{3}也空了不少。老师改作文的时候，系统会自动{4}他改过的每一个地方，我们一看就知道错在哪里。{5}写得好的句子，老师会在旁边留言，说明好在哪里。一个学期下来，大家的错字减少了许多，想说的意思也表达得更清楚了，老师表示这种上课方式的{6}比他本来想像的还要好。
passage.pinyin: Yǐqián shàng zuòwén kè, tóngxué búshì bǎ zuòwén xiě zài hòuhòu de běnzi shàng, jiùshì cún zài suíshēndié lǐ, wǎngwǎng yǒu rén wàng le dài, huòshì nòng diū le. Zhè xuéqí lǎoshī gǎi yòng yúnduān, xiān bǎ yào tǎolùn de wénzhāng shàngchuán, ràng dàjiā yùxí, shàngkè shí zài yìqǐ tǎolùn. Wǒmen de zuòwén yě dōu xiě zài yúnduān shàng, búyòng zài dài běnzi gēn suíshēndié, shūbāo yě kōng le bù shǎo. Lǎoshī gǎi zuòwén de shíhòu, xìtǒng huì zìdòng jìlù tā gǎi guo de měi yí ge dìfāng, wǒmen yí kàn jiù zhīdào cuò zài nǎlǐ. Zhìyú xiě de hǎo de jùzi, lǎoshī huì zài pángbiān liúyán, shuōmíng hǎo zài nǎlǐ. Yí ge xuéqí xiàlái, dàjiā de cuòzì jiǎnshǎo le xǔduō, xiǎng shuō de yìsi yě biǎodá de gèng qīngchǔ le, lǎoshī biǎoshì zhè zhǒng shàngkè fāngshì de xiàoguǒ bǐ tā běnlái xiǎngxiàng de hái yào hǎo.
passage.english: In composition class we used to either write our compositions in thick notebooks or keep them on USB drives, and often someone forgot to bring theirs or lost it. This term the teacher has switched to the cloud: he uploads the texts we are going to discuss in advance so that everyone can preview them, and in class we discuss them together. We also write our compositions in the cloud, so we no longer carry notebooks and drives, and our schoolbags are a lot emptier. When the teacher marks a composition, the system automatically records every place he has changed, so we can see at a glance where we went wrong. As for well-written sentences, the teacher leaves a comment beside them explaining what makes them good. After one term there are far fewer wrong characters and we put across what we mean more clearly, and the teacher says this way of teaching has worked even better than he expected.

text.traditional:
本系舉辦小說比賽，歡迎所有同學報名參加。
題材：跟環保有關，例如舊東西再利用、少開車多走路
字數：三千字以內
報名：十月一日到十月三十一日，先在本系網站建立帳號、密碼，再把作品上傳
修改：上傳以後還能變更內容，系統會自動記錄每次上傳的時間；比賽只看報名時間內最後上傳的那一份
結果：系主任和兩位老師會選出前三名，十一月二十日在本系網站上發表他們的作品，也會發給他們證書

title.traditional: 人人都能當作者的時代
title.simplified: 人人都能当作者的时代

title.english: An Era When Anyone Can Be an Author

text.traditional:
想當年還沒有網路的時候，一個人要讓自己的作品被很多人看到，最主要的辦法就是出版。可是一年能出版的書不多，很多寫得不錯的小說，最後只能留在作者自己的筆記本裡。
現在，網路科技的水平提高了許多，情況完全不同了。在網路上，任何人都能發表文章，就是沒有公司願意替你出書，也能讓全球的讀者看到。讀者看完馬上就能留言，作者也能參考讀者的意見來修改，這是以往很難做到的事。不少作者都是先在網路上受歡迎，後來才有機會出書的。可以說，網路為寫小說的人帶來了重大的改變。
不過，問題也跟著來了。網路上的文章太多，品質有好有壞，讀者往往不知道該看哪一篇。作者一方面要寫，一方面還得天天上網回應讀者，真正用來寫的時間反而少了。還有一個現實的問題：網路上的作品大多是免費的，作者很難只依靠寫小說生活。
所以我認為，在網路上發表作品不難；可是要成為一位好作者，說起來容易，做起來不簡單，還是跟以前一樣，得花時間，也得有耐心。
text.simplified:
想当年还没有网路的时候，一个人要让自己的作品被很多人看到，最主要的办法就是出版。可是一年能出版的书不多，很多写得不错的小说，最后只能留在作者自己的笔记本里。
现在，网路科技的水平提高了许多，情况完全不同了。在网路上，任何人都能发表文章，就是没有公司愿意替你出书，也能让全球的读者看到。读者看完马上就能留言，作者也能参考读者的意见来修改，这是以往很难做到的事。不少作者都是先在网路上受欢迎，后来才有机会出书的。可以说，网路为写小说的人带来了重大的改变。
不过，问题也跟着来了。网路上的文章太多，品质有好有坏，读者往往不知道该看哪一篇。作者一方面要写，一方面还得天天上网回应读者，真正用来写的时间反而少了。还有一个现实的问题：网路上的作品大多是免费的，作者很难只依靠写小说生活。
所以我认为，在网路上发表作品不难；可是要成为一位好作者，说起来容易，做起来不简单，还是跟以前一样，得花时间，也得有耐心。
text.pinyin: Xiǎng dāngnián hái méiyǒu wǎnglù de shíhòu, yí ge rén yào ràng zìjǐ de zuòpǐn bèi hěn duō rén kàndào, zuì zhǔyào de bànfǎ jiù shì chūbǎn. Kěshì yì nián néng chūbǎn de shū bù duō, hěn duō xiě de búcuò de xiǎoshuō, zuìhòu zhǐ néng liú zài zuòzhě zìjǐ de bǐjìběn lǐ. Xiànzài, wǎnglù kējì de shuǐpíng tígāo le xǔduō, qíngkuàng wánquán bù tóng le. Zài wǎnglù shàng, rènhé rén dōu néng fābiǎo wénzhāng, jiùshì méiyǒu gōngsī yuànyì tì nǐ chū shū, yě néng ràng quánqiú de dúzhě kàndào. Dúzhě kàn wán mǎshàng jiù néng liúyán, zuòzhě yě néng cānkǎo dúzhě de yìjiàn lái xiūgǎi, zhè shì yǐwǎng hěn nán zuò dào de shì. Bù shǎo zuòzhě dōu shì xiān zài wǎnglù shàng shòu huānyíng, hòulái cái yǒu jīhuì chū shū de. Kěyǐ shuō, wǎnglù wèi xiě xiǎoshuō de rén dàilái le zhòngdà de gǎibiàn. Búguò, wèntí yě gēnzhe lái le. Wǎnglù shàng de wénzhāng tài duō, pǐnzhí yǒu hǎo yǒu huài, dúzhě wǎngwǎng bù zhīdào gāi kàn nǎ yì piān. Zuòzhě yìfāngmiàn yào xiě, yìfāngmiàn hái děi tiāntiān shàngwǎng huíyìng dúzhě, zhēnzhèng yòng lái xiě de shíjiān fǎn'ér shǎo le. Hái yǒu yí ge xiànshí de wèntí: wǎnglù shàng de zuòpǐn dàduō shì miǎnfèi de, zuòzhě hěn nán zhǐ yīkào xiě xiǎoshuō shēnghuó. Suǒyǐ wǒ rènwéi, zài wǎnglù shàng fābiǎo zuòpǐn bù nán; kěshì yào chéngwéi yí wèi hǎo zuòzhě, shuōqǐlái róngyì, zuò qǐlái bù jiǎndān, háishì gēn yǐqián yíyàng, děi huā shíjiān, yě děi yǒu nàixīn.
text.english:
Back in the days before the internet, if you wanted many people to see your work, the main way was to get it published. But not many books could be published in a year, and many quite good novels ended up staying in their authors' own notebooks.
Now internet technology has come a long way, and things are completely different. On the internet anyone can publish writing; even if no company is willing to bring out a book for you, readers all over the world can still see it. Readers can leave comments as soon as they finish, and authors can revise with readers' opinions in mind, something that was hard to do in the past. Quite a few authors first became popular online and only later got the chance to bring out a book. You could say the internet has brought major changes for people who write novels.
But problems have come along too. There is so much writing online, of good and poor quality, that readers often do not know which piece to read. Authors have to write on the one hand, and on the other hand go online every day to answer readers, so the time they actually spend writing has shrunk instead. And there is a practical problem: most works online are free, so it is hard for authors to live on writing novels alone.
So I think publishing your work online is not hard; but becoming a good author is easier said than done, and it takes time and patience, just as it always did.

title.english: A New Road for an Old Bookshop

text.traditional:
陳老闆的書店開在大學旁邊，已經三十年了。當年他剛畢業，在這裡租了一間老房子，自己住樓上，樓下賣書。房東看他是個老實的房客，房租一向收得不高。以往每到開學，店裡總是站滿了來買書的學生。
十年前，閱讀電子書的人越來越多，店裡常常一整天都空空的。再碰上房東說下個月起房租要多收一半，陳老闆差一點就把書店關了。後來，他決定嘗試一種新的方式：把店裡的舊書一本一本拍照，上傳到網路上銷售。對他來說，這是一個重大的決定，因為他對網路一點也不熟悉。沒想到效果相當好。舊書既便宜又環保，吸引了不少讀者，不但臺灣的學生上網訂書，連國外的讀者也透過網路購買，現在他的書已經賣到全球二十幾個國家了。
在這個電子書的時代，書店的生意主要依靠網路，可是陳老闆沒有把店關掉，每個月還邀請剛出版新書的作者來店裡跟讀者面對面交流。他表示：「網路為書店帶來了很多客人，可是讀者和作者坐在一起聊天的時刻，是網路給不了的。」
text.simplified:
陈老板的书店开在大学旁边，已经三十年了。当年他刚毕业，在这里租了一间老房子，自己住楼上，楼下卖书。房东看他是个老实的房客，房租一向收得不高。以往每到开学，店里总是站满了来买书的学生。
十年前，阅读电子书的人越来越多，店里常常一整天都空空的。再碰上房东说下个月起房租要多收一半，陈老板差一点就把书店关了。后来，他决定尝试一种新的方式：把店里的旧书一本一本拍照，上传到网路上销售。对他来说，这是一个重大的决定，因为他对网路一点也不熟悉。没想到效果相当好。旧书既便宜又环保，吸引了不少读者，不但台湾的学生上网订书，连国外的读者也透过网路购买，现在他的书已经卖到全球二十几个国家了。
在这个电子书的时代，书店的生意主要依靠网路，可是陈老板没有把店关掉，每个月还邀请刚出版新书的作者来店里跟读者面对面交流。他表示：「网路为书店带来了很多客人，可是读者和作者坐在一起聊天的时刻，是网路给不了的。」
text.pinyin: Chén lǎobǎn de shūdiàn kāi zài dàxué pángbiān, yǐjīng sānshí nián le. Dāngnián tā gāng bìyè, zài zhèlǐ zū le yì jiān lǎo fángzi, zìjǐ zhù lóu shàng, lóu xià mài shū. Fángdōng kàn tā shì ge lǎoshí de fángkè, fángzū yíxiàng shōu de bù gāo. Yǐwǎng měi dào kāixué, diàn lǐ zǒngshì zhàn mǎn le lái mǎi shū de xuéshēng. Shí nián qián, yuèdú diànzǐshū de rén yuè lái yuè duō, diàn lǐ chángcháng yì zhěng tiān dōu kōngkōng de. Zài pèngshàng fángdōng shuō xià ge yuè qǐ fángzū yào duō shōu yíbàn, Chén lǎobǎn chà yìdiǎn jiù bǎ shūdiàn guān le. Hòulái, tā juédìng chángshì yì zhǒng xīn de fāngshì: bǎ diàn lǐ de jiù shū yì běn yì běn pāizhào, shàngchuán dào wǎnglù shàng xiāoshòu. Duì tā lái shuō, zhè shì yí ge zhòngdà de juédìng, yīnwèi tā duì wǎnglù yìdiǎn yě bù shúxī. Méi xiǎngdào xiàoguǒ xiāngdāng hǎo. Jiù shū jì piányí yòu huánbǎo, xīyǐn le bù shǎo dúzhě, búdàn Táiwān de xuéshēng shàngwǎng dìng shū, lián guówài de dúzhě yě tòuguò wǎnglù gòumǎi, xiànzài tā de shū yǐjīng mài dào quánqiú èrshí jǐ ge guójiā le. Zài zhège diànzǐshū de shídài, shūdiàn de shēngyì zhǔyào yīkào wǎnglù, kěshì Chén lǎobǎn méiyǒu bǎ diàn guān diào, měi ge yuè hái yāoqǐng gāng chūbǎn xīn shū de zuòzhě lái diàn lǐ gēn dúzhě miànduìmiàn jiāoliú. Tā biǎoshì: "Wǎnglù wèi shūdiàn dàilái le hěn duō kèrén, kěshì dúzhě hé zuòzhě zuò zài yìqǐ liáotiān de shíkè, shì wǎnglù gěi bù liǎo de."
text.english:
Mr. Chen's bookshop next to the university has been open for thirty years. Back then he had just graduated and rented an old house here, living upstairs and selling books downstairs. The landlord saw that he was an honest tenant and always charged him a low rent. In the past, at the start of every term, the shop was always full of students coming to buy books.
Ten years ago more and more people were reading e-books, and the shop was often empty all day. On top of that the landlord said the rent would go up by half from the next month, and Mr. Chen very nearly closed the shop. Later he decided to try a new way: photograph the used books in the shop one by one and upload them to sell online. For him this was a major decision, because he knew nothing about the internet. To his surprise it worked very well. Used books are both cheap and good for the environment, and they drew quite a few readers; not only students in Taiwan ordered books online, readers abroad bought them too, and now his books have been sold to more than twenty countries around the world.
In this era of e-books the shop's business depends mainly on the internet, but Mr. Chen has not closed the shop: every month he still invites authors who have just published a new book to come and meet readers face to face there. He says, "The internet has brought the shop a lot of customers, but the moments when readers and authors sit together and chat are something the internet cannot give."

lines.traditional: 這就要從上個月說起了。我奶奶住院，醫院的飯她吃不下去，我只好按照她教我的方法煮，每天送到病房。
lines.simplified: 这就要从上个月说起了。我奶奶住院，医院的饭她吃不下去，我只好按照她教我的方法煮，每天送到病房。
lines.pinyin: Zhè jiù yào cóng shàng ge yuè shuō qǐ le. Wǒ nǎinai zhùyuàn, yīyuàn de fàn tā chī bú xiàqù, wǒ zhǐhǎo ànzhào tā jiāo wǒ de fāngfǎ zhǔ, měi tiān sòng dào bìngfáng.
lines.english: For that I have to start with last month. My grandma was in hospital and couldn't keep eating the hospital food, so I had to cook the way she taught me and take it to her ward every day.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那她現在恢復得怎麼樣？
lines.simplified: 那她现在恢复得怎么样？
lines.pinyin: Nà tā xiànzài huīfù de zěnmeyàng?
lines.english: So how is she recovering?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 已經出院了。她說我做的菜比她自己做的還好吃，我聽了很有信心，就越做越有興趣了。
lines.simplified: 已经出院了。她说我做的菜比她自己做的还好吃，我听了很有信心，就越做越有兴趣了。
lines.pinyin: Yǐjīng chūyuàn le. Tā shuō wǒ zuò de cài bǐ tā zìjǐ zuò de hái hǎochī, wǒ tīng le hěn yǒu xìnxīn, jiù yuè zuò yuè yǒu xìngqù le.
lines.english: She's already out of hospital. She said my cooking tastes even better than her own. That gave me confidence, and the more I cook, the more I enjoy it.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的為什麼對做菜有了興趣？
prompt.simplified: 女的为什么对做菜有了兴趣？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de wèishénme duì zuò cài yǒu le xìngqù?
prompt.english: Why has the woman become interested in cooking?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nǎinai chī bú xià yīyuàn de fàn.
choices.english: Her grandmother couldn't eat the hospital food.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她按照網路影片學會了
choices.simplified: 她按照网路影片学会了
choices.pinyin: Tā ànzhào wǎnglù yǐngpiàn xué huì le.
choices.english: She learned by following videos online.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 奶奶要她以後負責做飯
choices.simplified: 奶奶要她以后负责做饭
choices.pinyin: Nǎinai yào tā yǐhòu fùzé zuò fàn.
choices.english: Her grandmother wants her to do the cooking from now on.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她做的菜得到奶奶的肯定
choices.simplified: 她做的菜得到奶奶的肯定
choices.pinyin: Tā zuò de cài dédào nǎinai de kěndìng.
choices.english: Her cooking won her grandmother's approval.

questions.why: Her interest grew because her grandmother said her cooking tasted better than her own (比她自己做的還好吃), which gave her confidence: approval made her keen. The hospital food is why she started cooking, not why she came to enjoy it, and she cooked the way her grandmother taught her, not from online videos.

focus.en: to explain, start from…; a reason

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 聽說你們社團上個星期去爬山，碰上了大雨？
lines.simplified: 听说你们社团上个星期去爬山，碰上了大雨？
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō nǐmen shètuán shàng ge xīngqí qù páshān, pèng shàng le dàyǔ?
lines.english: I heard your club went hiking last week and got caught in heavy rain?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 對啊。幸虧帶我們去的老師經驗豐富，一看到雲的顏色不對，就叫我們趕快下山，要不然我們恐怕就回不來了。
lines.simplified: 对啊。幸亏带我们去的老师经验丰富，一看到云的颜色不对，就叫我们赶快下山，要不然我们恐怕就回不来了。
lines.pinyin: Duì a. Xìngkuī dài wǒmen qù de lǎoshī jīngyàn fēngfù, yí kàndào yún de yánsè búduì, jiù jiào wǒmen gǎnkuài xià shān, yàobùrán wǒmen kǒngpà jiù huí bù lái le.
lines.english: Yes. Luckily the teacher who took us has a lot of experience. As soon as he saw the clouds were the wrong colour, he told us to hurry down the mountain; otherwise I'm afraid we wouldn't have made it back.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那其他人呢？
lines.simplified: 那其他人呢？
lines.pinyin: Nà qítā rén ne?
lines.english: What about the others?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 有一組人不聽他的，堅持繼續往上爬，結果到了半夜才被警察救下來。
lines.simplified: 有一组人不听他的，坚持继续往上爬，结果到了半夜才被警察救下来。
lines.pinyin: Yǒu yì zǔ rén bù tīng tā de, jiānchí jìxù wǎng shàng pá, jiéguǒ dào le bànyè cái bèi jǐngchá jiù xiàlái.
lines.english: One group didn't listen to him and insisted on climbing on. In the end the police didn't get them down until the middle of the night.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的那一組為什麼能平安回來？
prompt.simplified: 女的那一组为什么能平安回来？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de nà yì zǔ wèishénme néng píng'ān huílái?
prompt.english: Why did the woman's group get back safely?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 半夜有警察上山救他們
choices.simplified: 半夜有警察上山救他们
choices.pinyin: Bànyè yǒu jǐngchá shàng shān jiù tāmen.
choices.english: The police came up the mountain at night to rescue them.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他們等到雨停以後才下山
choices.simplified: 他们等到雨停以后才下山
choices.pinyin: Tāmen děngdào yǔ tíng yǐhòu cái xià shān.
choices.english: They waited until the rain stopped before coming down.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他們接受了老師的建議
choices.simplified: 他们接受了老师的建议
choices.pinyin: Tāmen jiēshòu le lǎoshī de jiànyì.
choices.english: They took the teacher's advice.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 那天山上的雨很快就停了
choices.simplified: 那天山上的雨很快就停了
choices.pinyin: Nà tiān shān shàng de yǔ hěn kuài jiù tíng le.
choices.english: The rain on the mountain stopped quickly that day.

questions.why: 幸虧 names the lucky fact: the experienced teacher saw the clouds were wrong and told them to hurry down, and they did; 要不然 says what would have happened otherwise. Being rescued by the police belongs to the other group, the one that would not listen; they went down at once rather than waiting out the rain, and the rain stopping is never said.

focus.zh: 幸虧……，要不然……；兩句合起來看

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳今天怎麼看起來這麼累？
lines.simplified: 你今天怎么看起来这么累？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ jīntiān zěnme kàn qǐlái zhème lèi?
lines.english: Why do you look so tired today?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 昨天晚上我們家寶貝一直哭，我以為她只是餓了。幸虧我先生發覺情況不對，立刻把她送到醫院，要不然就糟糕了。
lines.simplified: 昨天晚上我们家宝贝一直哭，我以为她只是饿了。幸亏我先生发觉情况不对，立刻把她送到医院，要不然就糟糕了。
lines.pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshàng wǒmen jiā bǎobèi yìzhí kū, wǒ yǐwéi tā zhǐshì è le. Xìngkuī wǒ xiānshēng fājué qíngkuàng búduì, lìkè bǎ tā sòng dào yīyuàn, yàobùrán jiù zāogāo le.
lines.english: Last night our little one kept crying, and I thought she was just hungry. Luckily my husband sensed something was wrong and took her straight to the hospital; otherwise it would have been bad.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 醫生怎麼說？
lines.simplified: 医生怎么说？
lines.pinyin: Yīshēng zěnme shuō?
lines.english: What did the doctor say?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 醫生說她發燒到三十九度。吃了藥已經好多了，可是我們整個晚上都沒睡。
lines.simplified: 医生说她发烧到三十九度。吃了药已经好多了，可是我们整个晚上都没睡。
lines.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō tā fāshāo dào sānshíjiǔ dù. Chī le yào yǐjīng hǎo duō le, kěshì wǒmen zhěng ge wǎnshàng dōu méi shuì.
lines.english: The doctor said she had a fever of thirty-nine degrees. She's much better after the medicine, but we didn't sleep all night.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的說「要不然就糟糕了」，表示什麼？
prompt.simplified: 女的说「要不然就糟糕了」，表示什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de shuō "yàobùrán jiù zāogāo le", biǎoshì shénme?
prompt.english: What does the woman mean by "otherwise it would have been bad"?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 孩子的病可能會更嚴重
choices.simplified: 孩子的病可能会更严重
choices.pinyin: Háizi de bìng kěnéng huì gèng yánzhòng.
choices.english: The child's illness might have got worse.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Háizi huì yìzhí èzhe dùzi.
choices.english: The child would have stayed hungry.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tāmen zhěng wǎn dōu méi bànfǎ shuì.
choices.english: They wouldn't have been able to sleep all night.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā xiānshēng huì guài tā bù xiǎoxīn.
choices.english: Her husband would blame her for being careless.

questions.why: 要不然 introduces what would have happened without the lucky event: had nobody taken the feverish baby (39 degrees) to hospital, her illness could have got worse. Hunger was only the woman's first wrong guess, and the sleepless night really happened; it is not the outcome they escaped.

focus.zh: 幸虧……，要不然……；假設的結果
focus.en: luckily…, otherwise…; what would have happened

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳怎麼現在才到？電影已經開始十分鐘了。
lines.simplified: 你怎么现在才到？电影已经开始十分钟了。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme xiànzài cái dào? Diànyǐng yǐjīng kāishǐ shí fēnzhōng le.
lines.english: Why are you only getting here now? The film started ten minutes ago.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 都是我室友害的。她一再保證五分鐘就好，結果光化妝就花了半個小時。
lines.simplified: 都是我室友害的。她一再保证五分钟就好，结果光化妆就花了半个小时。
lines.pinyin: Dōu shì wǒ shìyǒu hài de. Tā yízài bǎozhèng wǔ fēnzhōng jiù hǎo, jiéguǒ guāng huàzhuāng jiù huā le bàn ge xiǎoshí.
lines.english: It's all my roommate's fault. She kept promising she'd be ready in five minutes, and in the end her make-up alone took half an hour.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那妳怎麼不自己先進去？
lines.simplified: 那你怎么不自己先进去？
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐ zěnme bú zìjǐ xiān jìnqù?
lines.english: Then why didn't you go in first on your own?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我們的票都在她的手機裡啊。她正在買飲料，馬上就過來。
lines.simplified: 我们的票都在她的手机里啊。她正在买饮料，马上就过来。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen de piào dōu zài tā de shǒujī lǐ a. Tā zhèng zài mǎi yǐnliào, mǎshàng jiù guòlái.
lines.english: Our tickets are all on her phone. She's buying drinks right now and will be here in a moment.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的說「票都在她的手機裡」，表示什麼？
prompt.simplified: 女的说「票都在她的手机里」，表示什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de shuō "piào dōu zài tā de shǒujī lǐ", biǎoshì shénme?
prompt.english: What does the woman mean by "the tickets are all on her phone"?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎng yí ge rén xiān jìnchǎng.
choices.english: She didn't want to go in alone first.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她忘了先購買自己的票
choices.simplified: 她忘了先购买自己的票
choices.pinyin: Tā wàng le xiān gòumǎi zìjǐ de piào.
choices.english: She forgot to buy her own ticket first.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 沒有室友她進不了電影院
choices.simplified: 没有室友她进不了电影院
choices.pinyin: Méiyǒu shìyǒu tā jìn bù liǎo diànyǐngyuàn.
choices.english: Without her roommate she couldn't get into the cinema.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 她們約好買完飲料再進去
choices.simplified: 她们约好买完饮料再进去
choices.pinyin: Tāmen yuē hǎo mǎi wán yǐnliào zài jìnqù.
choices.english: They had agreed to go in after buying drinks.

questions.why: She is answering 'why didn't you go in first?': both tickets were on the roommate's phone, so going in alone was impossible. That is how the roommate, who 一再 promised five minutes, 害 her, made her late. She gives a practical reason, not that she minded going in alone, and the drinks are what the roommate is doing now, not a plan they had made.

focus.en: to cause trouble for; again and again; what the speaker means

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這個暑假我們一起去學游泳吧？
lines.simplified: 这个暑假我们一起去学游泳吧？
lines.pinyin: Zhège shǔjià wǒmen yìqǐ qù xué yóuyǒng ba?
lines.english: Shall we learn to swim together this summer holiday?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我連在海邊玩水都害怕，更別說學游泳了。
lines.simplified: 我连在海边玩水都害怕，更别说学游泳了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ lián zài hǎibiān wán shuǐ dōu hàipà, gèng bié shuō xué yóuyǒng le.
lines.english: I'm scared even of playing in the water at the beach, let alone learning to swim.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這次是在學校的室內游泳池上課，水很淺，教練也會一直在旁邊教我們。
lines.simplified: 这次是在学校的室内游泳池上课，水很浅，教练也会一直在旁边教我们。
lines.pinyin: Zhè cì shì zài xuéxiào de shìnèi yóuyǒngchí shàngkè, shuǐ hěn qiǎn, jiàoliàn yě huì yìzhí zài pángbiān jiāo wǒmen.
lines.english: This time the lessons are in the school's indoor pool. The water is shallow, and the coach will be right beside us the whole time to teach us.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 這下子我好像不得不去了。
lines.simplified: 这下子我好像不得不去了。
lines.pinyin: Zhè xiàzi wǒ hǎoxiàng bùdébù qù le.
lines.english: Well, now it looks like I've got no choice but to go.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的最後是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 男的最后是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de zuìhòu shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the man mean at the end?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā háishì bù gǎn xià shuǐ.
choices.english: He still doesn't dare go into the water.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā bǐjiào xiǎng qù hǎibiān wán.
choices.english: He'd rather go and play at the beach.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā xiǎng zhǎo bié de jiàoliàn jiāo tā.
choices.english: He wants a different coach to teach him.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā dāyìng yìqǐ qù shàngkè le.
choices.english: He has agreed to go to the lessons with her.

questions.why: 這下子 marks a new situation that changes things: shallow water and a coach at his side leave him no reason to refuse, so 不得不去 is a joking yes. His fear (更別說學游泳了) was his first answer, before he heard about the pool.

focus.en: now (that this has happened); let alone…

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 七夕那天，我打算跟女朋友求婚，地點就選在百貨公司門口。
lines.simplified: 七夕那天，我打算跟女朋友求婚，地点就选在百货公司门口。
lines.pinyin: Qīxì nà tiān, wǒ dǎsuàn gēn nǚpéngyǒu qiúhūn, dìdiǎn jiù xuǎn zài bǎihuò gōngsī ménkǒu.
lines.english: On Qixi I'm planning to propose to my girlfriend, right outside the department store.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那裡人那麼多，你是想讓大家都看到嗎？
lines.simplified: 那里人那么多，你是想让大家都看到吗？
lines.pinyin: Nàlǐ rén nàme duō, nǐ shì xiǎng ràng dàjiā dōu kàndào ma?
lines.english: There are so many people there. Do you want everyone to see?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 對啊，我還邀請了十幾個朋友，到時候一起拿著玫瑰花出來，一定很浪漫。
lines.simplified: 对啊，我还邀请了十几个朋友，到时候一起拿着玫瑰花出来，一定很浪漫。
lines.pinyin: Duì a, wǒ hái yāoqǐng le shí jǐ ge péngyǒu, dào shíhòu yìqǐ názhe méiguī huā chūlái, yídìng hěn làngmàn.
lines.english: Yes. I've also invited a dozen or so friends to come out together with roses at the right moment. It'll be so romantic.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 可是她個性那麼害羞，上次大家在餐廳幫她慶祝生日，她緊張得都快哭了。
lines.simplified: 可是她个性那么害羞，上次大家在餐厅帮她庆祝生日，她紧张得都快哭了。
lines.pinyin: Kěshì tā gèxìng nàme hàixiū, shàng cì dàjiā zài cāntīng bāng tā qìngzhù shēngrì, tā jǐnzhāng de dōu kuài kū le.
lines.english: But she's so shy. Last time everyone celebrated her birthday at a restaurant, she was so nervous she nearly cried.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 是我想得太天真了嗎？可是我已經準備兩個月了。
lines.simplified: 是我想得太天真了吗？可是我已经准备两个月了。
lines.pinyin: Shì wǒ xiǎng de tài tiānzhēn le ma? Kěshì wǒ yǐjīng zhǔnbèi liǎng ge yuè le.
lines.english: Was I being naive? But I've been preparing for two months.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 朋友們準備的花還是可以用啊。你在家親手做幾道菜，請他們把花放在門口就好。
lines.simplified: 朋友们准备的花还是可以用啊。你在家亲手做几道菜，请他们把花放在门口就好。
lines.pinyin: Péngyǒumen zhǔnbèi de huā háishì kěyǐ yòng a. Nǐ zài jiā qīnshǒu zuò jǐ dào cài, qǐng tāmen bǎ huā fàng zài ménkǒu jiù hǎo.
lines.english: You can still use the flowers your friends got ready. Cook a few dishes yourself at home and just ask them to leave the flowers at the door.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 也對。她在意的是我的心意，不是有多少觀眾。
lines.simplified: 也对。她在意的是我的心意，不是有多少观众。
lines.pinyin: Yě duì. Tā zàiyì de shì wǒ de xīnyì, bú shì yǒu duōshǎo guānzhòng.
lines.english: You're right. What she cares about is how I feel, not how big the audience is.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的本來打算在哪裡求婚？
prompt.simplified: 男的本来打算在哪里求婚？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de běnlái dǎsuàn zài nǎlǐ qiúhūn?
prompt.english: Where did the man first plan to propose?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zài hěn duō rén jīngguò de dìfāng.
choices.english: Somewhere many people pass by.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zài zìjǐ de jiā lǐ.
choices.english: In his own home.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zài cháng qù de cāntīng lǐ.
choices.english: In a restaurant they often go to.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zài péngyǒu de jiā ménkǒu.
choices.english: Outside a friend's door.

questions.why: His first plan was outside a department store, where, as she says, there are so many people: a place many people pass. Home is the new plan, the restaurant is where the birthday was, and the door is where the flowers will be left.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的為什麼覺得這個安排不好？
prompt.simplified: 女的为什么觉得这个安排不好？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de wèishénme juéde zhège ānpái bù hǎo?
prompt.english: Why does the woman think the plan is a bad idea?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Péngyǒu zhǔnbèi de shíjiān bú gòu.
choices.english: The friends haven't had enough time to prepare.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 怕女朋友提早知道計畫
choices.simplified: 怕女朋友提早知道计划
choices.pinyin: Pà nǚpéngyǒu tízǎo zhīdào jìhuà.
choices.english: She is afraid his girlfriend will find out about the plan early.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 女朋友不習慣被很多人注意
choices.simplified: 女朋友不习惯被很多人注意
choices.pinyin: Nǚpéngyǒu bù xíguàn bèi hěn duō rén zhùyì.
choices.english: His girlfriend isn't used to lots of people's attention.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 女朋友不喜歡慶祝生日
choices.simplified: 女朋友不喜欢庆祝生日
choices.pinyin: Nǚpéngyǒu bù xǐhuān qìngzhù shēngrì.
choices.english: His girlfriend doesn't like celebrating her birthday.

questions.why: She asks whether he wants everyone to see, then gives the reason: his girlfriend is shy and nearly cried when a group celebrated her birthday. It is the crowd's attention she cannot handle, not birthdays; the surprise being found out is never her worry, and the two months of preparing are his worry, not hers.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的最後有什麼想法？
prompt.simplified: 男的最后有什么想法？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de zuìhòu yǒu shénme xiǎngfǎ?
prompt.english: What does the man think in the end?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 應該先問女朋友的意見
choices.simplified: 应该先问女朋友的意见
choices.pinyin: Yīnggāi xiān wèn nǚpéngyǒu de yìjiàn.
choices.english: He should ask his girlfriend's opinion first.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zhēnxīn bǐ rènào gèng zhòngyào.
choices.english: Sincerity matters more than a big show.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Péngyǒu zhǔnbèi de dōu bú yòng le.
choices.english: None of what his friends prepared will be used.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zài wàimiàn qiúhūn bǐjiào làngmàn.
choices.english: Proposing outside is more romantic.

questions.why: 她在意的是我的心意，不是有多少觀眾: what counts is that he means it, not a crowd. Asking her first is never mentioned, the friends' flowers will still be used at the door, and the romantic public proposal is the plan he gives up.

focus.en: the speaker's view; one's heartfelt feeling

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你這個星期怎麼天天加班到十點？
lines.simplified: 你这个星期怎么天天加班到十点？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zhège xīngqí zěnme tiāntiān jiābān dào shí diǎn?
lines.english: How come you've worked late until ten every day this week?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 上個月有個同事算錯了價錢，害一位老客人少付了好幾萬塊。
lines.simplified: 上个月有个同事算错了价钱，害一位老客人少付了好几万块。
lines.pinyin: Shàng ge yuè yǒu ge tóngshì suàn cuò le jiàqián, hài yí wèi lǎo kèrén shǎo fù le hǎo jǐ wàn kuài.
lines.english: Last month a colleague got a price wrong, so a long-standing customer paid tens of thousands less than he should have.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那跟你有什麼關係？
lines.simplified: 那跟你有什么关系？
lines.pinyin: Nà gēn nǐ yǒu shénme guānxi?
lines.english: What does that have to do with you?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 經理說這是整個小組的責任，要我們按照新的方法，把這一年的資料全部重新檢查一遍。
lines.simplified: 经理说这是整个小组的责任，要我们按照新的方法，把这一年的资料全部重新检查一遍。
lines.pinyin: Jīnglǐ shuō zhè shì zhěng ge xiǎozǔ de zérèn, yào wǒmen ànzhào xīn de fāngfǎ, bǎ zhè yì nián de zīliào quánbù chóngxīn jiǎnchá yí biàn.
lines.english: The manager said it's the whole team's responsibility, and wants us to check all of this year's files again using a new method.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 犯錯的又不是你，為什麼要大家一起負責？
lines.simplified: 犯错的又不是你，为什么要大家一起负责？
lines.pinyin: Fàncuò de yòu bú shì nǐ, wèishénme yào dàjiā yìqǐ fùzé?
lines.english: You're not the one who made the mistake. Why should everyone take the blame?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 因為那份資料大家都看過，卻沒有一個人發現錯誤。
lines.simplified: 因为那份资料大家都看过，却没有一个人发现错误。
lines.pinyin: Yīnwèi nà fèn zīliào dàjiā dōu kàn guo, què méiyǒu yí ge rén fāxiàn cuòwù.
lines.english: Because all of us had looked at that file, yet not one person spotted the mistake.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這樣說也有道理。可是天天這麼累，你還做得下去嗎？
lines.simplified: 这样说也有道理。可是天天这么累，你还做得下去吗？
lines.pinyin: Zhèyàng shuō yě yǒu dàolǐ. Kěshì tiāntiān zhème lèi, nǐ hái zuò de xiàqù ma?
lines.english: That makes sense. But being this tired every day, can you keep it up?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 只有這個月比較忙。而且經過這件事，我們做事都比以前小心多了。
lines.simplified: 只有这个月比较忙。而且经过这件事，我们做事都比以前小心多了。
lines.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu zhège yuè bǐjiào máng. Érqiě jīngguò zhè jiàn shì, wǒmen zuòshì dōu bǐ yǐqián xiǎoxīn duō le.
lines.english: It's only this month that's busy. Besides, after this we're all much more careful in our work than before.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的這個月要做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 男的这个月要做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de zhège yuè yào zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What does the man have to do this month?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 跟客人說明價錢的問題
choices.simplified: 跟客人说明价钱的问题
choices.pinyin: Gēn kèrén shuōmíng jiàqián de wèntí.
choices.english: Explain the price problem to the customer.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 算出客人少付了多少錢
choices.simplified: 算出客人少付了多少钱
choices.pinyin: Suàn chū kèrén shǎo fù le duōshǎo qián.
choices.english: Work out how much less the customer paid.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Jiāo tóngshì zěnme suàn qián.
choices.english: Teach his colleague how to do the sums.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 用新方法再看一次舊資料
choices.simplified: 用新方法再看一次旧资料
choices.pinyin: Yòng xīn fāngfǎ zài kàn yí cì jiù zīliào.
choices.english: Go through the old files again with a new method.

questions.why: 按照新的方法……重新檢查一遍: the manager wants the year's files checked again the new way. The client, the lost money and the colleague are all in the story, but none of them is the job he was given.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 經理為什麼要整個小組一起負責？
prompt.simplified: 经理为什么要整个小组一起负责？
prompt.pinyin: Jīnglǐ wèishénme yào zhěng ge xiǎozǔ yìqǐ fùzé?
prompt.english: Why does the manager hold the whole team responsible?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 大家都沒做好檢查的工作
choices.simplified: 大家都没做好检查的工作
choices.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu méi zuò hǎo jiǎnchá de gōngzuò.
choices.english: Nobody did the checking properly.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu suàn cuò le qián.
choices.english: Everyone got the sums wrong.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 經理想讓大家學新方法
choices.simplified: 经理想让大家学新方法
choices.pinyin: Jīnglǐ xiǎng ràng dàjiā xué xīn fāngfǎ.
choices.english: The manager wants everyone to learn the new method.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 那位同事一個人做不完
choices.simplified: 那位同事一个人做不完
choices.pinyin: Nà wèi tóngshì yí ge rén zuò bù wán.
choices.english: That colleague can't finish the work alone.

questions.why: Her 犯錯的又不是你 is answered two turns later: everyone had read the file, 卻 no one caught the mistake, so the checking failed for all of them. Only one colleague got the sums wrong, so 每個人都算錯了 overstates; the new method is what they must now use, not why they are to blame; and the workload is never given as the reason.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的對這件事有什麼看法？
prompt.simplified: 男的对这件事有什么看法？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de duì zhè jiàn shì yǒu shénme kànfǎ?
prompt.english: How does the man feel about all this?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Juéde zìjǐ bù yīnggāi fùzé.
choices.english: He thinks he shouldn't be held responsible.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Suīrán lèi, dàn yě yǒu shōuhuò.
choices.english: It's tiring, but he has gained something from it.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 打算這個月做完就離開
choices.simplified: 打算这个月做完就离开
choices.pinyin: Dǎsuàn zhège yuè zuò wán jiù líkāi.
choices.english: He plans to leave once this month is over.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Guài zìjǐ méiyǒu zǎo diǎn fāxiàn.
choices.english: He blames himself for not noticing sooner.

questions.why: Asked whether he can keep going (做得下去), he says the busy time is only this month and the team is now far more careful: tiring, but worth something. 'He shouldn't be responsible' is the woman's view, not his, and he never talks of leaving or blames himself.

focus.zh: 說話人的態度；V 下去
focus.en: the speaker's attitude; keep on doing

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段介紹，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段介绍，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn jièshào, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to an introduction, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 各位，我們面前的這家早餐店，已經開了四十年了。
lines.simplified: 各位，我们面前的这家早餐店，已经开了四十年了。
lines.pinyin: Gèwèi, wǒmen miànqián de zhè jiā zǎocān diàn, yǐjīng kāi le sìshí nián le.
lines.english: Everyone, the breakfast shop in front of us has been open for forty years.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 老闆是一對七十多歲的夫婦，每天早上四點就起床，親手做包子。
lines.simplified: 老板是一对七十多岁的夫妇，每天早上四点就起床，亲手做包子。
lines.pinyin: Lǎobǎn shì yí duì qīshí duō suì de fūfù, měi tiān zǎoshàng sì diǎn jiù qǐchuáng, qīnshǒu zuò bāozi.
lines.english: It is run by a couple in their seventies, who get up at four every morning to make steamed buns by hand.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 附近鄰居都說，這裡的包子不但品質好，價格也幾十年沒變過。
lines.simplified: 附近邻居都说，这里的包子不但品质好，价格也几十年没变过。
lines.pinyin: Fùjìn línjū dōu shuō, zhèlǐ de bāozi búdàn pǐnzhí hǎo, jiàgé yě jǐ shí nián méi biàn guo.
lines.english: The neighbours all say the buns here are not only good quality; the price hasn't changed in decades either.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 可惜的是，這家店下個月底就要關門了。不少老顧客聽到這個消息，都難過得掉眼淚。
lines.simplified: 可惜的是，这家店下个月底就要关门了。不少老顾客听到这个消息，都难过得掉眼泪。
lines.pinyin: Kěxí de shì, zhè jiā diàn xià ge yuè dǐ jiù yào guānmén le. Bù shǎo lǎo gùkè tīngdào zhège xiāoxí, dōu nánguò de diào yǎnlèi.
lines.english: Sadly, the shop will close at the end of next month. When they heard the news, many regulars were so sad they cried.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 很多老顧客問他們為什麼不繼續做下去，老闆說，不是生意不好，而是太太的身體受不了這麼累的工作了。
lines.simplified: 很多老顾客问他们为什么不继续做下去，老板说，不是生意不好，而是太太的身体受不了这么累的工作了。
lines.pinyin: Hěn duō lǎo gùkè wèn tāmen wèishénme bú jìxù zuò xiàqù. Lǎobǎn shuō, bú shì shēngyì bù hǎo, ér shì tàitai de shēntǐ shòu bù liǎo zhème lèi de gōngzuò le.
lines.english: Many regulars have asked why they won't keep going. The owner says it isn't that business is bad; it's that his wife's health can't take such tiring work any more.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 他說：「她跟著我辛苦了一輩子，現在該換我照顧她了。」
lines.simplified: 他说：「她跟着我辛苦了一辈子，现在该换我照顾她了。」
lines.pinyin: Tā shuō: "Tā gēnzhe wǒ xīnkǔ le yíbèizi, xiànzài gāi huàn wǒ zhàogù tā le."
lines.english: He says: "She has worked hard beside me all her life. Now it's my turn to look after her."

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 所以等一下大家買包子的時候，別忘了跟他們說聲謝謝。
lines.simplified: 所以等一下大家买包子的时候，别忘了跟他们说声谢谢。
lines.pinyin: Suǒyǐ děng yíxià dàjiā mǎi bāozi de shíhòu, bié wàng le gēn tāmen shuō shēng xièxie.
lines.english: So in a moment, when you buy your buns, don't forget to say thank you to them.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 老顧客為什麼這麼喜歡這家店？
prompt.simplified: 老顾客为什么这么喜欢这家店？
prompt.pinyin: Lǎo gùkè wèishénme zhème xǐhuān zhè jiā diàn?
prompt.english: Why are the regulars so fond of this shop?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 包子都是太太一個人做的
choices.simplified: 包子都是太太一个人做的
choices.pinyin: Bāozi dōu shì tàitai yí ge rén zuò de.
choices.english: The wife makes all the buns on her own.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 早上四點就開始賣包子
choices.simplified: 早上四点就开始卖包子
choices.pinyin: Zǎoshàng sì diǎn jiù kāishǐ mài bāozi.
choices.english: It starts selling buns at four in the morning.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 用心做包子，又一直沒變貴
choices.simplified: 用心做包子，又一直没变贵
choices.pinyin: Yòngxīn zuò bāozi, yòu yìzhí méi biàn guì.
choices.english: The buns are made with care and haven't got dearer.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 老闆跟顧客都是老鄰居
choices.simplified: 老板跟顾客都是老邻居
choices.pinyin: Lǎobǎn gēn gùkè dōu shì lǎo línjū.
choices.english: The owners and the customers are old neighbours.

questions.why: Two lines together: the couple make the buns by hand every morning (親手做包子), and the neighbours say the quality is good and the price has not changed in decades. Both of them make the buns, not the wife alone; four o'clock is when they get up, not when they sell; the neighbours are only where the praise comes from, not who the customers are.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 這家店為什麼要關門？
prompt.simplified: 这家店为什么要关门？
prompt.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn wèishénme yào guānmén?
prompt.english: Why is the shop closing?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Gùkè bǐ yǐqián shǎo le hěn duō.
choices.english: There are far fewer customers than before.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Lǎobǎn zìjǐ shēntǐ bù hǎo.
choices.english: The owner himself isn't well.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Bāozi de jiàgé tài dī le.
choices.english: The buns are priced too low.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Lǎobǎn xiǎng ràng tàitai xiūxí.
choices.english: The owner wants his wife to rest.

questions.why: 不是生意不好，而是太太的身體受不了: it is his wife's health, so he wants her to stop working so hard. Business is not bad, it is her body and not his, and the unchanged price is a point of pride, not a reason given for closing.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 從老闆說的話，可以知道什麼？
prompt.simplified: 从老板说的话，可以知道什么？
prompt.pinyin: Cóng lǎobǎn shuō de huà, kěyǐ zhīdào shénme?
prompt.english: What can we tell from what the owner says?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他感謝太太這些年的付出
choices.simplified: 他感谢太太这些年的付出
choices.pinyin: Tā gǎnxiè tàitai zhèxiē nián de fùchū.
choices.english: He is grateful for all his wife has given over the years.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他打算以後讓太太照顧他
choices.simplified: 他打算以后让太太照顾他
choices.pinyin: Tā dǎsuàn yǐhòu ràng tàitai zhàogù tā.
choices.english: He plans to let his wife look after him from now on.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā xiǎng yǐhòu wǎn yìdiǎn kāi diàn.
choices.english: He wants to open the shop later from now on.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他想把店交給自己的孩子
choices.simplified: 他想把店交给自己的孩子
choices.pinyin: Tā xiǎng bǎ diàn jiāo gěi zìjǐ de háizi.
choices.english: He wants to hand the shop over to his children.

questions.why: 她跟著我辛苦了一輩子，現在該換我照顧她了: he recognises her lifetime of hard work and wants to repay it. 換我照顧她 means he will look after her, not the other way round; the shop is closing, so opening later is not a plan; and children are never mentioned.

focus.en: the speaker's attitude; a whole life

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段留言，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段留言，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn liúyán, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a voicemail, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 兒子，我是爸爸。明天就是你的婚禮了，有一些話當面不好意思說，我就留言跟你說吧。
lines.simplified: 儿子，我是爸爸。明天就是你的婚礼了，有一些话当面不好意思说，我就留言跟你说吧。
lines.pinyin: Érzi, wǒ shì bàba. Míngtiān jiù shì nǐ de hūnlǐ le, yǒu yìxiē huà dāngmiàn bù hǎoyìsi shuō, wǒ jiù liúyán gēn nǐ shuō ba.
lines.english: Son, it's Dad. Tomorrow is your wedding. There are some things I'm too shy to say to your face, so I'll leave them in a message.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 三年前你帶她回家，說要跟她結婚，我跟你媽媽都不答應，覺得你們還太年輕，連自己的生活都照顧不好。
lines.simplified: 三年前你带她回家，说要跟她结婚，我跟你妈妈都不答应，觉得你们还太年轻，连自己的生活都照顾不好。
lines.pinyin: Sān nián qián nǐ dài tā huíjiā, shuō yào gēn tā jiéhūn, wǒ gēn nǐ māma dōu bù dāyìng, juéde nǐmen hái tài niánqīng, lián zìjǐ de shēnghuó dōu zhàogù bù hǎo.
lines.english: Three years ago you brought her home and said you wanted to marry her. Your mum and I both said no. We thought you were still too young and couldn't even take care of your own lives.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 後來她生了一場大病，你每天下班就到醫院陪在她身邊，一陪就是兩個月。
lines.simplified: 后来她生了一场大病，你每天下班就到医院陪在她身边，一陪就是两个月。
lines.pinyin: Hòulái tā shēng le yì cháng dà bìng, nǐ měi tiān xiàbān jiù dào yīyuàn péi zài tā shēnbiān, yì péi jiù shì liǎng ge yuè.
lines.english: Later she fell seriously ill, and every day after work you went to the hospital to stay by her side, for two whole months.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那段時間我都看在眼裡，才相信你是真心的。
lines.simplified: 那段时间我都看在眼里，才相信你是真心的。
lines.pinyin: Nà duàn shíjiān wǒ dōu kàn zài yǎn lǐ, cái xiāngxìn nǐ shì zhēnxīn de.
lines.english: I saw all of it during that time, and only then did I believe you were sincere.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 結婚不只是兩個人在一起，也代表一份責任。
lines.simplified: 结婚不只是两个人在一起，也代表一份责任。
lines.pinyin: Jiéhūn bù zhǐ shì liǎng ge rén zài yìqǐ, yě dàibiǎo yí fèn zérèn.
lines.english: Marriage isn't just two people being together; it also means taking on a responsibility.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 以後的日子，不管遇到什麼困難，你們都要互相體貼，一起走下去。
lines.simplified: 以后的日子，不管遇到什么困难，你们都要互相体贴，一起走下去。
lines.pinyin: Yǐhòu de rìzi, bùguǎn yùdào shénme kùnnán, nǐmen dōu yào hùxiāng tǐtiē, yìqǐ zǒu xiàqù.
lines.english: In the days ahead, whatever difficulties you meet, you must be considerate to each other and keep going together.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 好了，不多說了，早點休息吧。
lines.simplified: 好了，不多说了，早点休息吧。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo le, bù duō shuō le, zǎo diǎn xiūxí ba.
lines.english: All right, that's enough. Get some rest.

choices.speaker: N

questions.why: He watched his son go to the hospital every day after work for two months (一陪就是兩個月), and 那段時間我都看在眼裡，才相信 links that to his change of mind. Her illness lasted two months, not a short time, and neither the son's words nor the mother agreeing first are mentioned.

focus.en: a reason (combining two lines); to observe, sincere

questions.why: He leaves the message to say what he is too shy to say face to face, and the message builds to 結婚……也代表一份責任 and 一起走下去: his hopes for the marriage. He tells the story of three years ago but never apologises; 早點休息 is only his goodbye, and he asks nothing about the wedding.
